It also has better PAPR reduction performance and lower computational complexity in comparison with other optimized PTS algorithms.

articleTitle: Leader-Following Consensus of Multi-Agent Systems With Disturbances and Input-Output Delays via a Periodic Event-Triggered Control
abstract: The periodic event-triggered output-feedback control in this article is proposed to solve the consensus problem of multi-agent systems, which is in the presence of disturbances and input and output delays. First, the predictor-based-extended state observer is designed by the prediction technique which can be used to estimate the state and disturbances. Then, with the aid of the disturbance/uncertainty estimation and attenuation method, the disturbance rejection and robustness of multi-agent systems can be effectively enhanced. In particular, the proposed observer is designed to obtain the inter sample output dynamics when only the delayed sampled-data measurement output is known. By using the small-gain arguments, some sufficient conditions are derived to guarantee that the consensus errors converge to zero exponentially. Finally, the validity of the theoretical results is demonstrated through a simulation example.

articleTitle: Efficient Transferability of Generative Perturbations with Salient Feature Disruption and Adversarial Transformation
abstract: Transferability of adversarial examples aims at fooling unknown models, which means that adversarial attacks can be conducted in practical scenarios. However, existing adversarial attacks usually exhibit weak transferability owing to the overfitting on the surrogate model and falling into the model-specific local optimum. To alleviate the overfitting issue, a Salient Feature Disruption Adversarial Transformation Generator (SFD-AT-Gen) based attack method is proposed in this paper, which generates highly transferable adversarial examples efficiently. Specifically, the generative model is leveraged to learn generating adversarial perturbations for disrupting the salient object-aware features that dominate the model output. Based on the framework, an adversarial transformation network is further introduced to eliminate the adversarial perturbations and require the generated adversarial examples to be resistant to the introduced transformation, which makes the adversarial examples more robust and transferable. Extensive experimental results on the CIFAR-10 dataset show higher attack success rates are achieved in both white-box and black-box settings than some advanced attacks.

articleTitle: UCAVs Collaborative Target Assignment Based on Improved GWO Algorithm
abstract: With increasing complexity of the operational environment, aiming at the target assignment problem of the manned/unmanned cooperative air-to-ground attack mission, the collaborative target assignment model of UCAVs is built up through analyzing enemy threat coefficient and Unmanned Combat Aerial Vehicles’ (UCAVs) damage effectiveness. An improved Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) algorithm is proposed to improve quality and speed of the solution, which uses triploid grey wolf gene strategy to increase initial population diversity, improves the convergence speed by weighted combination location updating strategy and introduces nonlinear factor as well as different mutation operators to achieve the balance between global search and local search. By simulation experiments, the feasibility and superiority of the algorithm are verified. And compared with GWO algorithm, the improved GWO algorithm’s optimization process is faster and more accurate, which can well adapt to the complex battlefield environment and meet the requirements of target assignment in the dynamic combat process.

articleTitle: Neural Network Disturbance Observer-Incorporated Fault Detection Scheme for Electro-Mechanical Flight Actuators
abstract: This paper studies the fault detection problem for the electro-mechanical flight actuator (EMFA) suffering from high nonlinearity terms and unknown external disturbances. We first establish the dynamic model of the EMFA, which includes the nonlinear factors and unknown disturbances. Second, we construct a fault detection strategy based on a neural network disturbance observer (NNDO). Specifically, the neural network system is integrated to design a disturbance observer, which is capable of delivering efficient estimations of nonlinear factors and unknown disturbances. Later, the produced estimation errors are employed in the fault detection procedure, which thus judges the presence of a fault for the EMFA. Meanwhile, the stability proof indicates that the disturbance observer error could converge to a small extent nearby zero. At last, the numerical simulations and discussions are presented to show the validity and properties of the proposed fault detection strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Subway Fire Evacuation Path Planning Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
abstract: When an ant colony algorithm is used to plan the evacuation path for a fire in a subway station, the traditional ant colony evacuation path scheme cannot dynamically instruct people to evacuate and escape in response to the fire situation in the subway, which leads to a lower escape rate. In order to overcome this problem, this paper proposes an improved ant colony approach for subway fire evacuation, which aims to ensure the safety of the personnel with the optimal escape path at their location. Firstly, according to the development of subway fire events, we consider each parameter of the ant colony algorithm, improve its initial pheromone distribution based on the traditional ant colony algorithm based on the A* algorithm, secondly, improve its pheromone update strategy, and improve the heuristic function and transfer probability of the algorithm, and finally conduct simulation experiments with the M subway station as an example. The results show that the subway fire evacuation algorithm based on the improved A* algorithm effectively improves the algorithm computation speed by about 63% and 55% in the early stage of fire and the spread of fire state, and reduces the total distance of people escaping.

articleTitle: Research on Ideological and Political Education Integrating Professional Development History Learning -- Taking the Professional Development History of School of Automation as an Example
abstract: In order to fulfill the fundamental task of building morality and cultivating talents for the automation profession, promote the craftsman spirit of a major country, and respond to the development strategy of a technological powerhouse, Aiming at the present stage our country faced by scientific research papers first, from the actual demand and bring the negative impact of -- professional students lack confidence in teaching with the career planning of autonomous consciousness, passive add hot industry employment boom, blind worship of "theory of cafe" and does not pay attention to practice ability, and a series of problems, Deep mining institute which is the development history of automation specialty, through classroom teaching, experiment and engineering practice, classroom discussion, test case design a series of measures such as infiltration, past students research pays a return visit, will be the perfect moment in the process of professional development, the historical turning point into the reform of education syllabus, inject new content to political education teaching knowledge, In the process of professional curriculum and practical learning, students are gradually infected by the historical flash point of this major, and correctly understand the content and realization approach of scientific and technological innovation as the first productive force, so as to cultivate compound talents with innovative spirit, adapting to social development and bearing historical responsibility for the development of our national cause.

articleTitle: Hybrid flow shop scheduling problem with flexible and complex assembly
abstract: With the development of industry, manufacturing systems become more and more complex. The traditional manufacturing industry is gradually changing to the intelligent manufacturing industry, which increases the difficulty of scheduling. In order to produce a final product, its parts need to be processed in a hybrid flow shop(HFS), and then assembled according to the predefined product bill of materials. The purpose of this study is to minimize the completion time of the last product. Aiming at the problem under consideration, a constraint programming (CP) model is established and solved by a commercial solver. Then, an iterative greedy algorithm (IGA) is proposed to solve this problem. In order to verify the performance of the algorithm, this paper compares it with simulated annealing (SA) and genetic algorithms (GA). Numerical results prove the effectiveness of the proposed model and solution method.

articleTitle: Matrix approach to multi-department, multi-stage, multi-objective emergency decision-making
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of how to make effective and optimal decisions in the chemical industry. In the face of an unexpected accident, constructing a matrix-based model to deal with multi-objective, multi-department and multi-stage emergency decision making is an effective method. Firstly, novel concepts are proposed, such as correlation coefficient matrix, combined scheme matrix and satisfaction matrix. Then, based on these matrices, a new model is presented, which satisfies the dynamic process of schemes changes from multiple departments. Finally, the problem of production accidents in aerosol plants is solved. The proposed model can be extended to a wider range of areas.

articleTitle: Development And Application of Robotics Technologies in Future Intelligent Soldier Squad
abstract: Robotics technologies has been widely applied to the military field, and it is one of the key technologies that will overturn the traditional combat concept of soldier squad. Robots and Individual Combat Systems (ICS) are important components of future intelligent soldier squad. Integrating soldiers and robots into a human-unmanned joint combat force and introducing artificial intelligence (AI) technology will significantly improve the combat ability and effectiveness of the soldier squad. In this paper, ICS is regarded as a robot-like system. So, the future intelligent soldier squad is regarded as a multi-robot system which is composed of multiple robots and multiple robot-like systems. After that, this paper introduced the development status of robotics technologies on soldier squad, put forward the conception and preliminary ideas of future intelligent soldier squad, and analyzed the related key technologies.

articleTitle: A maximum likelihood identification of block industrial systems with input nonlinearity and applying to the chemical process
abstract: According to the maximum likelihood principle, a recursive maximum likelihood identification method is proposed for the identification of block industrial systems with nonlinear inputs. The system uses the Hammerstein structural model to fit the dynamic input and output data. The parameters of the nonlinear block structure and the static parameters of the system are coupled together, which makes it difficult to separate the parameters and makes the estimation model parameters not unique. The proposed identification method is a kind of parametric method, which facilitates analyzing the dynamic characteristics of the system and designing the system controller. The consistency of the proposed algorithm is also proven. A numerical example and a practical chemical process are used to demonstrate the superiority and usefulness of the proposed algorithm. The algorithm can be extended to multi-variable systems or other real industrial systems.

articleTitle: Mean Square Consensus of Stochastic Multi-agent Systems with Delays via Intermittent Dynamic Event-triggered Control
abstract: This article systematically investigates the leaderless mean-square exponential consensus(MSEC) issue of stochastic multi-agent systems (MASs) on directed graphs through periodically intermittent event-triggered control mechanisms. Due to stochastic effects, the system state is hard to predict and dominate, and the system behavior would vary with every trial (i.e., sample path), even for the same initial condition. This gives rise to substantial challenges, especially in determining the execution/sampling times, which urges us to develop powerful and sophisticated methods for the analysis and design of stochastic event-triggered control. Therefore, periodically intermittent dynamic event-triggering mechanisms are proposed with enforcing a fixed positive lower bound for the inter-execution times to avoid Zeno behavior. For solving the challenge problem caused by intermittent control, the auxiliary system with a dynamic event triggering mechanism (DETM) is introduced. Based on the auxiliary system method, some sufficient conditions are presented to ensure the leaderless mean square consensus for MASs under the continue-time control protocol in the frame of the Lyapunov theorem and Halanay inequality. Finally, the applicability and effectiveness of the proposed design techniques are demonstrated by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Bumpless transfer H∞ control for switched linear systems
abstract: In this paper, the problem of bumpless transfer H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control for a class of switched linear systems is investigated. Based on the controller gain interpolation technique, a novel bumpless transfer control strategy is proposed, in which a slope condition is presented to limit the control bumps as well as the rate of change of the control signal during the switching process. By using multiple Lyapunov functions and dwell time switching, sufficient stability conditions for the interpolated controller are developed for the nominal switched system. In the case of perturbed systems, bumpless transfer control with ensured L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gain is presented. Finally, numerical examples are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed bumpless transfer control strategy.

articleTitle: A Fast Solution Approach for Path Optimization in Software-Defined Energy Internet
abstract: With the rapid development of the Energy Internet, its information subsystem has a large amount of data flow to be transmitted. Since the transmission of data flow requires a large expense to lease the operator network, a stable and economical communication method is critical to the operation of the Energy Internet system. Therefore, this paper proposes a data flow path optimization model for the software- defined energy Internet information subsystem to minimize communication costs while ensuring stable data flow transmission. The method proposed in this paper can be described as a mixed-integer nonlinear programming model. However, due to the inefficiency of commercial solvers for large-scale problems, this paper designs a fast solution approach (ASF) that can effectively improve the efficiency of solving large-scale problems. Numerical tests verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in this paper.

articleTitle: Density Peak Clustering Algorithm Considering Time Series Characteristics for Electricity Load Pattern Analysis
abstract: To address the problems of Instability of clustering results, poor classification accuracy and inability to extract time series characteristics in electricity load curve clustering analysis, a density peak clustering algorithm (DPC) based on optimized derivative dynamic time warping (DDTW) is proposed. Firstly, calculate the estimated derivatives of the standardized load curve dataset and reconstruct the dataset to extract precise time series characteristics, then the reconstructed dataset is processed by dynamic time warping (DTW) to generate similarity distance matrix, and the new matrix is used to replace the Euclidean distance matrix of the original algorithm as the input data, and finally, DPC is used to cluster the new data on the basis of redefining the sample neighborhood. The OpenEI datasets and UCI datasets are used to analyze and verify the practicability and effectiveness of the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: Prediction of Vehicle Fuel Consumption Based on Combination of Improved Whale Optimization and XGBoost
abstract: The highway transportation industry is the most oil-intensive industry in the world. Therefore, an accurate prediction of fuel consumption not only reveals the relationship between fuel consumption and driving characteristics, but also promotes green development of the automobile industry. A fuel consumption prediction model based on Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) is built in this research, where an improved Whale Optimization Algorithm (IWOA) is developed to optimize the main parameters in the prediction model. In the IWOA, Sobol sequence initialization is introduced to improve the diversity of the population and expand the search range. The nonlinear convergence coefficient and Levy Flight are also introduced in the algorithm to balance the global exploration ability and the local exploitation ability. The experimental results show that the IWOA-XGBoost model performs better than some existing popular models in both accuracy and stability. This study provides fundamental theoretical, methodological, and technical support for automobile fuel saving and emission reduction.

articleTitle: Accelerating Safety Verification of Neural Network Dynamical Systems Using Assured Compressed Models
abstract: In this paper, we develop a formal assured simplification method to accelerate the safety verification process of a neural network model that approximates a nonlinear dynamical system. Firstly, an assured compression error is proposed to describe the maximum output difference introduced by neural network compression. A reachability-based computational process is then developed to estimate the assured compression error. The assured compression error is used to accelerate the reachability analysis and safety verification of neural network dynamical system models, which can significantly reduce the computational time for safety verification. Finally, the proposed approach is applied to a case study of a magnetic levitation system to demonstrate its correctness and effectiveness.

articleTitle: A YOLOv5-based method for detecting vehicles in overhead surveillance video
abstract: As one of the core technologies of intelligent transportation system, vehicle detection technology has high requirements for its detection accuracy. For the characteristics of small vehicle targets and complex background in overhead surveillance video, this paper proposes a novel method by improving the original YOLOv5 algorithm. First, the very small target detection layer MSD (Minimal Scale Detection) is added to YOLOv5 network to improve the detection effect of YOLOv5 network on small target vehicles in overhead surveillance video. Second, the CA (Coordinate Attention) attention mechanism is added to the YOLOv5 network to further improve the detection accuracy. Third, the CIOU (Complete Intersection over Union) focal loss function used in the original YOLOv5 is replaced with EIOU (Efficient Intersection over Union) to accelerate the convergence of the prediction box and improve the regression accuracy of the prediction box. By testing on the self-built dataset, compared with the original YOLOv5 network, the mAP (mean Average Precision) value of the proposed method is improved by 3.01%, the Precision is improved by 1.33%, and the Recall is improved by 1.12%. The overall network performance is improved comprehensively, which is more suitable for the detection of small target vehicles in overhead surveillance video.

articleTitle: Consensus filtering algorithm based on dual event triggering
abstract: In order to reduce the transmission frequency and computational burden of the consensus estimation algorithm for distributed sensor networks, a consensus filtering algorithm based on dual event triggering is proposed. In the algorithm, for data transmission, an adaptive trigger condition is designed by using the information vector error function to remove redundant transmission, for consensus iteration, a static event trigger is designed, the information vector error between each moment and the previous moment is used as the trigger condition to reduce the calculation amount. Furthermore, the boundedness of the improved algorithm is proved by using Lyapunov stability theory and linear matrix inequality method. Simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively reduce redundant data transmission and consensus calculation. Compared with the algorithms in the existing literature, the proposed algorithm has higher estimation accuracy under the same trigger frequency.

articleTitle: Multiple Object Tracking algorithm based on cluster cooperative motion constraint
abstract: Multi-target tracking is one of the key research fields of computer vision. Existing methods mainly focus on inferring robust and discriminative features for data association based on targets generated by existing detectors. However, these methods independently process each target when generating the trajectory. In contrast, we propose a new multi-target tracking algorithm, which utilizes spatiotemporal cooperative motion constraints. Our algorithm makes use of the cooperative effect of crowd movement, which means that objects in close range tend to move in a more consistent way. We group several objects with consistent mobility into a cluster. We introduce an affinity matrix to measure the synergy and similarity of the movement between targets in the same cluster. When the target is occluded, the affinity matrix can be used to recover the lost track. We evaluated our approach on the MOT challenge benchmark and proved its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Finite-time backstepping control for quadrotor UAV with uncertain disturbances
abstract: In this article, the finite-time backstepping method is presented for quadrotor UAV with uncertain external disturbances and model parameter uncertainties. First, a finite-time extended state observer (FTESO) is proposed, which can accurately compensate the complex unknown disturbance of the system in finite time and increase the anti-disturbance capability of quadrotor UAV. After that, the finite-time backstepping controller (FTBC) is designed to improve the control accuracy of the system and achieve the stability of attitude angle system in finite time. Finally, the effectiveness of the control methods are verified through theoretical proof and numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Robust adaptive dynamic programming based attitude tracking control for hypersonic vehicle
abstract: In this paper, a robust adaptive dynamic programming (RADP) control approach based on a novel identifier-actor-critic (IAC) framework for the hypersonic vehicle (HSV) attitude tracking system with actuator saturation and disturbances is proposed. The control law is generated by the combination of the desired control law and the optimal feedback control law to track the attitude reference command. To achieve the optimal feedback control, an iterative scheme based on the IAC framework is implemented. An identifier network is constructed for approximating the attitude dynamics. The actor-critic networks are designed to approximate control policy and performance function. In addition, a nonquadratic performance function effectively solves the input-constrained problem, and the online learning controller effectively suppresses parametric uncertainties and external disturbances. Finally, the comparative simulations verify the effectiveness of the proposed controller for the HSV attitude tracking system with parametric uncertainties and external disturbances.

articleTitle: A General Overview of Intelligent Sorting System Based on Machine Vision
abstract: With the development of computer-related technologies, robot technology and machine vision technology have also been greatly improved. The intelligent sorting system composed of traditional robots and machine vision can not only reduce production costs, but also improve the efficiency and accuracy of sorting operations. With these advantages, the machine sorting system is gradually replacing the manual sorting system. It develops in the direction of networking, automation, collaboration and intelligence, and has extremely broad development prospects. Therefore, this paper discusses and analyzes the composition, classification and application of the intelligent sorting system in detail, and expounds the key technologies. At the same time, the intelligent sorting system proposed in this paper is introduced. Finally, the current development of intelligent sorting system is summarized, and the future development trend is prospected.

articleTitle: A λ-Shapley Choquet operator-based collaborative manufacturing capability optimization model in smart fuzzy system
abstract: As an advanced manufacturing form, collaborative manufacturing meets the needs of efficient production. With the development of production technology and increasingly complex market demand, manufacturing enterprises need to make more flexible production plans and resource utilization programs to cope with this change. We build a new smart fuzzy system and use it in the distributed manufacturing network of an enterprise to enhance the collaborative manufacturing capability within the network to help manufacturing enterprises create more economic benefits with limited production resources. This smart fuzzy system combines the arithmetical intuitionistic fuzzy generalized λ-Shapley Choquet (AIFGSC<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gλ</inf>) operator to consider the relationship between index factors, firstly, a multi-objective robust optimization model is constructed by the manufacturing enterprise according to its own equipment requirements and solved by the NSGA-II-MOPSO algorithm. Secondly, combined with the AIFGSC<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gλ</inf> operator to select the optimal equipment transfer scheme and achieve dynamic equipment resource allocation combined with practical cases to illustrate that this new smart fuzzy system will help manufacturing enterprises to make better use of existing manufacturing resources and reduce unnecessary capacity waste. It helps enterprises to establish equipment transfer plan and production planning plan more quickly and easily; it verifies the practicality and effectiveness of this new smart fuzzy system applied in manufacturing enterprises.

articleTitle: Real-Time Demand Response Multi-Energy Trading Strategy in Multiseller-Multibuyer Smart Distribution Grid
abstract: The energy crisis caused by the shortage of traditional fossil fuels has greatly promoted the development of multi-energy resources and prompted the great changes in the energy load structure of users, so a new multibuyer-multiseller multi-energy trading framework based on real-time demand response in smart distribution grid is proposed in this paper. During the process of the multi-energy trading, the price competitions among the sellers are modeled as two non-cooperative games. The seller selection competition among the users is modeled as an evolutionary game. The interaction among the sellers and buyers is modeled as a Stackelberg game. Two iterative algorithms are proposed to obtain a Stackelberg equilibrium strategy, which maximizes the benefits of all electricity utility companies (EUCs), gas utility companies (GUCs) and users. Simulation results show that the real-time demand response strategy proposed in this paper can not only reduce the peak demand, reduce the electricity generation cost of EUCs and the gas production cost of GUCs, but also increase the benefits of users.

articleTitle: Multimodal Process Monitoring Based on Dynamic Extended K-means-VAE-RF
abstract: With the development of customization and flexibility of manufacturing industry, intelligent manufacturing process gradually presents multimodal characteristics, which are reflected in the strong coupling, nonlinear, multi working conditions and other characteristics of the process. In this paper, a multi-modal process monitoring method based on dynamic expansion is proposed. In view of the dynamic characteristics of process data, the process data is dynamically expanded through the amplification matrix, and then the multi-modal process data is modal divided through the improved K-means algorithm. The divided multi-modal process data is monitored using Variational Autoencoder, and relevant statistics and control limits are designed. Finally, the multi-modal process monitoring is constructed by introducing the method of random forest for modal identification. The validity of the algorithm is verified by real data of steel rolling process.

articleTitle: Dynamic gesture tracking and recognition algorithm based on deep learning
abstract: Vision-based dynamic gesture tracking and recognition has always been a difficult point in the field of computer vision. It involves multiple vision-related technologies and is an intersecting topic in multiple visual directions. The most critical dynamic gesture tracking technology and modeling recognition technology are still not mature and perfect. At present, dynamic gesture tracking technology is in the stage of transitioning from traditional tracking methods to deep learning tracking frameworks. The existing deep learning tracking frameworks are not well applicable to the visual target tracking with high degree of freedom and small space ratio such as gestures. On the other hand, it is difficult to establish an effective general gesture model for recognition due to the flexibility of dynamic gestures and complex motion processes. These problems propose a dynamic gesture recognition framework based on improved real-time multi-domain convolutional neural network tracking. The real-time multi-domain convolutional neural network is introduced to realize real-time gesture tracking, and an attention module is added to calibrate the spatial importance of features, which can clarify the discriminative area of the tracking target, and greatly improve the accuracy of gesture tracking. On this basis, the characteristics of gestures are fully considered, and the motion information, appearance information and time information of the gestures are used to establish the frame difference spatiotemporal graph model of the gestures. Finally, the deep learning network is used to recognize dynamic gestures. The CGD International Public Library of Gestures has achieved better recognition results, which offers a workable solution for dynamic gesture tracking and recognition in complex scenarios.

Author Keywords: multi-domain convolutional neural network gesture modeling

articleTitle: Research Progress in Light Environment Regulation of Facility Crops
abstract: Light intensity in the facility plays a key role in the growth and development of crops and their high-quality production, so the regulation of light environment largely determines the yield and economic benefits of facility crops. In order to make full use of relevant research results at home and abroad, and promote the research and application of light environment regulation technology in China’s facility agriculture, this paper summarizes the research progress of light environment regulation technology in facility agriculture from two aspects, namely, light supplement device and light environment regulation method. At the same time, aiming at the current research situation and existing problems in this field of China, this paper proposes some important scientific issues that need to be addressed in the future. This includes establishing a high-precision crop growth model under the influence of multiple environment factors, accurately obtaining the regulation target value of facility light environment, and effective regulation strategies for light environment. The solution of these problems can lay a certain foundation for the theoretical research and construction of intelligent regulation system of facility light environment.

articleTitle: Robust control of an Uncertain Coaxial Rotor UAV with Input Constraint and Guaranteed Tracking Performance
abstract: In this paper, a robust trajectory tracking control scheme is developed for an uncertain coaxial rotor unmanned aerial vehicle (CRUAV) with input constraint and guaranteed tracking performance. To begin, the position subsystem model of the CRUAV is formulated as an input-constrained form by using hyperbolic tangent function and Lagrange mean value theorem, and the barrier Lyapunov function (BLF) based Back-stepping control is designed to obtain the guaranteed tracking performance. Follow that, sliding-mode control combined with a nonlinear disturbance observer (NDOB) is designed for attitude subsystem. Furthermore, the stability of the closed-loop system is demonstrated using the Lyapunov method. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control algorithm is verified by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: ConMAE: Contour Guided MAE for Unsupervised Vehicle Re-Identification
abstract: Vehicle re-identification is a cross-view search task by matching the same target vehicle from different perspectives. It serves an important role in road-vehicle collaboration and intelligent road control. With the large-scale and dynamic road environment, the paradigm of supervised vehicle re-identification shows limited scalability because of the heavy reliance on large-scale annotated datasets. Therefore, the unsupervised vehicle reidentification with stronger cross-scene generalization ability has attracted more attention. Considering that Masked Autoencoder (MAE) has shown excellent performance in self-supervised learning, this work designs a Contour Guided Masked Autoencoder for Unsupervised Vehicle Re-Identification (ConMAE), which is inspired by extracting the informative contour clue to highlight the key regions for cross-view correlation. ConMAE is implemented by preserving the image blocks with contour pixels and randomly masking the blocks with smooth textures. In addition, to improve the quality of pseudo labels of vehicles for unsupervised re-identification, we design a label softening strategy and adaptively update the label with the increase of training steps. We carry out experiments on VeRi-776 and VehiclelD datasets, and a significant performance improvement is obtained by the comparison with the state-of-the-art unsupervised vehicle re-identification methods. The code is available on the website of https://github.com/JWFanggit/ConMAE-Vehicle-ReID

articleTitle: Research on collaborative model of supply chain logistics providers towards intelligent manufacturing
abstract: In view of the problems of high operating costs and low resource utilization rate are caused by unreasonable task allocation among logistics providers in the supply chain of intelligent manufacturing, a collaborative model of logistics providers in the supply chain of intelligent manufacturing is proposed. By establishing an optimal logistics task cost model and an independent logistics task allocation model, the logistics providers oriented to intelligent manufacturing can realize horizontal and efficient collaboration. In order to improve the speed of solving the model, the improved brain storm optimization algorithm and sealed bid auction mechanism are used to solve the model. The simulation results show that the model proposed in this paper can effectively determine the reasonable redistribution of multi-logistics providers and multi logistics-tasks in the intelligent manufacturing supply chain, and realize the horizontal coordination of logistics providers in the supply chain with low cost, high efficiency and high service quality.

articleTitle: Joint Linkage and Motion System Design of Pipeline Detecting Snake Robot
abstract: As a direction of bionic robot research, the snake robot has attracted the attention and research of many scholars at home and abroad. With the advantages of small size and flexible movement to replace humans into narrow and dangerous complex environments, it has great application prospects and economic benefits in the fields of disaster rescue, military reconnaissance and pipeline detection. In this paper, a snake robot motion system with reorganisable modules and strong redundancy is designed, while orthogonal links are selected based on the analysis of the mechanical properties of its joint links. The robot can move forward in the form of traveling waves or spirals in small diameter pipes of 200~500mm diameter to carry out in-pipe surveys and eliminate safety hazards, laying the foundation for subsequent engineering applications.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: Attitude Adaptive Robust Strong Tracking Kalman Filter Based on Unmanned Surface Vehicle Navigational Radar Target Tracking
abstract: The information such as the target’s position and velocity as detected by the radar carried on the unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) are sensitive to the state disturbance and the sensor noise generated from USVs attitude change. The Kalman filter (KF), as a traditional target tracking algorithm, still needs to be improved in terms of accuracy, effectiveness and stability due to its inability to adaptively adjust the noise covariance matrix. In this paper, an attitude-adaptive robust strong tracking Kalman filter (A-ARSTKF) algorithm is proposed, which can solve the problems of inaccurate radar measurements caused by USV attitude changes and improper filter gain estimation to improve the filtering accuracy of the algorithm. Firstly, an attitude improvement method that uses the turning angle information to correct the sensor noise covariance in real time is proposed. Then, a weakening factor is introduced into the A-ARSTKF algorithm for updating the fading factor to better regulate the one-step prediction noise covariance matrix. Finally, the adaptive factor is employed to adjust the Kalman gain and the state estimation error covariance matrix, which enhances the reliability of the A-ARSTKF algorithm. The simulation results show that the A-ARSTKF algorithm effectively eliminates the influence of the state disturbance and the sensor noise caused by the USV's own attitude change, and has strong effectiveness, stability and accuracy.

Author Keywords: attitude adaptive robust tracking Kalman filter

articleTitle: Markov Matrix-based Kernel Reconstruction Method for PET Images
abstract: Positron emission tomography (PET) is a powerful medical imaging technique. PET images obtained in clinical practice usually have low resolution. To address this problem, this paper develops the kernelized expectation maximization (KEM) algorithm and proposes Markov matrix-based kernel reconstruction method. The Markov matrix is constructed by the spatial prior information of PET data and applied to repair the data after each KEM iteration. The results of simulation experiments show that the proposed method has better performance in terms of evaluation metrics and visual effects compared to the classical maximum likelihood expectation maximization (MLEM) and some kernel-based reconstruction methods.

articleTitle: Secondary Restoration of Islanded AC Microgrids under Neural Inverse Optimal Control with Genetic Algorithm
abstract: A distributed neural inverse optimal controller is proposed as a secondary recovery for controlling frequency and voltage of inverter-based islanded microgrids. The proposed controller is further improved on the basis of the conventional droop control. The neural network trained by extended Kalman filtering (EKF) is used to approximate the unknown microgrid model. Next, the network model is used to implement the corresponding inverse optimal controller. Meanwhile, a genetic algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the neural inverse optimal controller so as to improve the performance of the controller and achieve the overall optimization. The designed control system is in distributed form and only information from adjacent distributed generators is required. A four-unit system simulation is performed to verify the effectiveness of the controller.

articleTitle: Research on Stability of Industry University Research Institute Alliance Based on FAHP*
abstract: Based on the current fierce national innovation competitiveness, this paper analyzes the mechanism of industry-university-research institute alliance that can effectively promote national innovation competitiveness, and finds that there is a risk of stability in the industry-university-research institute alliance; The main factors influencing the stability of the industry-university-research institute alliance are extracted, which are divided into 4 first level indicators and 17 second level indicators; The fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) is used to analyze and construct the stability test model of the industry-university-research institute alliance; Finally, taking a specific industry-university-research institute alliance as an example, the stability of the alliance is calculated, and the results show that the model has good practicability. The paper introduces FAHP into the stability quantification of industry-university-research institute alliance, and provides a new idea and method for the research in this field.

articleTitle: Fitting oriented bounding box algorithm for accurate positioning of transformer wiring terminals
abstract: As an important connection component of the power grid, transformer wiring terminals need regular maintenance and repair. Some problems exist in traditional maintenance such as high labor cost, high operation risks, and low efficiency. Relying on the point cloud processing technique, this paper proposes a F-OBB (fitting oriented bounding box) algorithm based on surface normal estimation and applies it to the high-precision positioning of terminal blocks. Surface regions of the rectangular-like terminal are separated by the clustering method of region growing after filtering pre-processing. Then the optimal normal vector of each region is solved by the spherical coordinate system transformation and least-squares method to determine a bounding box to represent the target and obtain the positioning parameters (position and orientation). The practical test results show that the proposed method can generate bounding box highly close to the target, accurately extract the positioning parameters and keeps good robustness in various scenarios.

articleTitle: Predicting atmospheric corrosion of low-alloy steels based on environmental features extracted by improved autoencoder
abstract: Material corrosion can cause substantial economic losses and pose serious damages. One way to reduce those damages is to predict available data before catastrophic occurrences. However, because of the small sample size of the corrosion data, the generalization of the corrosion prediction models remains a challenge. This study adopts an autoencoder to determine the intrinsic features of the natural atmospheric environment to which the materials were exposed. The training process of the autoencoder was designed to ensure that the features were consistent between natural atmospheric environmental data and the averaged environmental data within small-sample corrosion data. In addition, the k-nearest method was used to find a set of extracted features for the corrosion rate data. Thus, the amount of corrosion data increased. In this study, a neural network was adopted for augmented corrosion data to predict corrosion rates. The experimental results showed that the proposed method not only had a satisfactory training accuracy but also a strong generalization ability.

articleTitle: Liquid Level Line Recognition Method Based on UNet Semantic Segmentation Network
abstract: In response to the problems of inapplicability, low accuracy and high cost of existing liquid level detection methods for filling systems, a method of liquid level line recognition based on UNet semantic segmentation was proposed. The liquid level line in the container can be accurately identified by photographing the liquid level image inside the container. Firstly, the liquid level image data set was created through digital image processing. Secondly, feature extraction based on UNet semantic segmentation model was carried out for the data set. At last, each pixel of the liquid level image was classified, and the liquid level of the image was predicted. The average intersection union ratio (MIoU) was 90.95%, and the average pixel accuracy (MPA) was 96.21%.The experimental results showed that the model has good generalization and prediction effect.

articleTitle: Multi-channel Flow Ratio Control Method of Water and Fertilizer Integrated Machine Based on Active Disturbance Rejection Control
abstract: Water and fertilizer integrated machine technology plays an important role in ensuring national food security, developing modern water-saving agriculture, transforming agricultural development mode and promoting sustainable development of agriculture. Multi-channel flow ratio control under the disturbance of mutual coupling between pipeline flows has been a critical issue in the working process of on-line water and fertilizer integrated machine. This paper described a method to achieve multi-channel flow ratio control based on active disturbance rejection control (ADRC). The mechanism modeling of water and fertilizer flow control part was carried out according to the physical mechanism of each device of water and fertilizer integrated machine. The flow control method of water and fertilizer integrated machine based on ADRC was proposed and a self-defined simulation module library based on Simulink was built. The ADRC controller was built by using the simulation module library and the performance was compared with PID controller. The performance of the ADRC controller was eventually verified via simulation.

articleTitle: An Improved Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees Method for Manipulator Trajectory Planning
abstract: To realize the target posture requirement of manipulators and obtain low-cost high-quality trajectories, the trajectory planning problem in joint space is formalized, and an improved Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees algorithm is proposed. The proposed algorithm optimizes the selecting parent procedure and rewiring procedure through the direct connection operation, which is beneficial to reduce the cost and improve the smoothness of the trajectory. Comparison experiments are carried out in simple and complex simulation environment. The experimental results demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed method and its considerable advantages in enhancing the performance of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Path-tracking of Mobile Robot Using PD-type Iterative Learning Control with Forgetting Factor
abstract: In this paper, a discrete iterative learning control strategy is proposed for the path-tracking problem of mobile robot trajectory tracking with repeated trajectories. The algorithm adds the forgetting factor to the PD-type discrete iterative learning control and considers the correction of the initial state of the control. The convergence of the algorithm is proved rigorously by using the paradigm theory, and the sufficient conditions of the paradigm form to make the algorithm converge are obtained. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Oriented Cascade Mask R-CNN for Biomedical Image Segmentation
abstract: Biomedical images play a very important role in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases. In recent years, the technology of computational pathology has developed rapidly. It can effectively help doctors diagnose illnesses, which not only reduces the workload, but also achieves remarkable results. How to accurately segment cells in biomedical images is a very basic but also very important work. In order to analyze multi-tissue histology images, we propose a cell segmentation network, called Oriented Cascade Mask R-CNN (Region-CNN). It is a cascade network based on Oriented Mask R-CNN and Cascade Mask R-CNN. The model can simultaneously segment and classify cells in immunohistochemistry (IHC) images, and achieve good results. Oriented Cascade Mask R-CNN is a two-stage instance segmentation model. The whole network can be trained end-to-end and automatically segment cells. On our IHC dataset, the classification accuracy and recall are 85.8% and 86.0% respectively, and the mAP is 78.5%. Compared with Mask R-CNN, the mAP is improved by 4.9%, and the accuracy and recall are respectively improved by 9.5% and 10.2%.

articleTitle: State-of-Charge Estimation of Lithium Batteries based on Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit and Transfer Learning
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries are a vital energy source in contemporary industry, and they have been widely adopted in the automotive power system. This paper proposes a method to estimate the state of charge (SOC) by incorporating a Dropout layer into the bi-directional gated recurrent unit neural network (BIGRU), which improves the neural network's generalization capability. This paper examines the effect of temperature factors on the estimated SOC. The network model for estimating SOC at 25°C is rapidly mapped to other temperature conditions using transfer learning shared parameters. Under DST and US06 operating conditions, both the root means square error and the mean absolute error of the estimated SOC at three ambient temperatures were less than 0.015. And network models obtained through transfer learning can achieve rapid convergence, resulting in a more precise and rapid estimation of SOC at different temperatures.

articleTitle: A Robust In-Motion Alignment Method for OD-Aided SINS Based on Magnitude Matching
abstract: Initial alignment is one of the key technologies of strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS), which will directly affect the accuracy of subsequent navigation. In this paper, the odometer (OD) is used to implement the in-motion alignment process. The OD measurement often produces outliers due to faults or disturbances, which will affect the accuracy of alignment and positioning. Thus, we propose a robust in-motion alignment method based on magnitude matching. First, by using the velocity provided by OD and the specific force and angular velocity provided by SINS, an observation vector and a reference vector in the inertial frame are constructed. Then, an OD outlier detection method is designed based on the magnitude matching of the mentioned vectors. When an outlier is detected, we predict the velocity at the current moment based on historical velocity data and replace the outlier. Finally, the simulation is constructed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The alignment results show that this method can achieve reasonable attitude results, the interference of outliers in OD measurement can be greatly restrained.

articleTitle: Design and Applications of Q-Learning Adaptive PID Algorithm for Maglev Train Levitation Control System
abstract: To improve the levitation stability of the maglev train, an adaptive PID controller based on Q-learning is proposed. In particular, the parameters of the traditional PID are trained through the Q-learning algorithm where three Q tables for the PID parameters are obtained. When the maglev train runs in different operating conditions, the controller parameters can be adaptively and efficiently selected according to the Q tables. The performance of the proposed Q-learning based PID controller is verified by comparing it with the traditional PID and the experimental results show that the proposed PID controller via Q-learning has favorable features on rapidity and stability. Compared with the traditional PID controller, its overshoot is reduced by 6.19%, and the adjustment time is shortened about 32.25% during the transient levitation process.

articleTitle: PID algorithm-based temperature control system for biological incubators
abstract: In this paper, a temperature control algorithm based on parameter self-tuning is designed on the basis of traditional PID parameter control. The traditional PID algorithm is improved to solve the problems of difficult parameter adjustment, complex parameter setting and integral saturation, and to solve the problem of high precision temperature rise in the middle temperature range of various biological incubators. This work adopts PID control strategy and divides the algorithm design into several stage modules to realize multi-stage temperature control. Smith prediction is introduced to accelerate the stability, and parameter fitting schemes are designed for different types of bioincubators. The final validation results of this design are that the overshoot of various types of bioincubators is within 1°C, the steady-state error is less than 0.2°C, and the heating time is within 60 minutes to meet the heating requirements. This paper presents the implementation of the temperature control system of the bioincubator and the experimental verification of its related performance.

articleTitle: Distributed optimization with unconstrained polynomial objective function
abstract: Distributed optimization has been proposed for parallel computing for many years. At present, many distributed algorithms are developed for solving the cooperative optimization problem of multi-agent systems with objective function in summation form of local utilities. In order to solve more general optimization problems in a distributed way, in this paper, we study the distributed optimization problem with unconstrained polynomial objective function and use the Lasserre's relaxation method to convert the studied optimization problem to an equivalent semidefinite programming. Underlying the knowledge of graph theory, we disassemble the matrix variables and propose a distributed alternating directions method of multipliers to solve the semidefinite programming. Finally, a numerical example is used to illustrate the feasibility of our proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Preliminary design of operation and maintenance Application for helium cryogenic system based on industrial Internet platform
abstract: Comprehensive Research Facility for Fusion Technology (CRAFT) is a comprehensive research platform to provide extreme experimental conditions such as particle flow, electricity, magnetism, heat and force. Cryogenic system is one of the key subsystems for cooling cryogenic pump and providing cryogenic working environment for other devices operating in CRAFT. In order to meet the future fusion reactor cryogenic system high reliability, high efficiency, multiple operation mode and automatic control and other development direction, if the method of traditional uplink monitoring is adopted, it will consume large resources and cause unclear hierarchical structure of each system and low data collaboration among heterogeneous systems. This paper mainly introduces preliminary design of operation and maintenance Application for helium cryogenic system based on industrial Internet platform, to realize the remote monitoring of cryogenic system process, equipment operation status monitoring and performance analysis, equipment information management, equipment fault information analysis and other functions.

articleTitle: A Mission Assignment Algorithm for multi-UAV Air Warfare
abstract: The aim of this paper is to solve the mission assignment problem for multi-UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) air warfare so that the cost of the UAVs is decreased. Firstly, the mission assignment problem is modeled as the static matching game model. Secondly, the preference measurement is designed for each UAV to obtain the preference matrix. Thirdly, the filtering algorithm is proposed to obtain the pre-matches. Finally, the mechanism to find the global optimal result from the pre-matches is designed. Simulation experiments prove that the proposed algorithm in this paper can shorten the strike time and reduce the flying cost.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Hybrid Energy Storage Capacity Based on Northern Goshawk Optimization
abstract: The power fluctuation caused by uncertain factors such as wind-solar energy generation will harm the power quality of the power grid. To improve the power quality and system economy, a capacity optimization configuration method of hybrid energy storage for a wind-solar complementary power generation system is proposed. Firstly, the model is established with the minimum life cycle cost as the objective function, and the load power shortage rate and energy storage energy constraints as constraints. Then, the model is solved by the Northern Goshawk Optimization. Finally, an example simulation is carried out in MATLAB. The experimental results show that the scheme solved by the Northern Goshawk Optimization reduces the system cost and improves the convergence speed. In addition, it also reduces the optimization fluctuation range of the optimal value and improves the optimization stability. Therefore, the correctness of this algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: A Fixed-Time Distributed Optimization Algorithm For First-Order Multi-Agent Systems Based on Dynamic Event-Triggered Mechanism
abstract: In order to solve the convex optimization problem of the local cost function of the multi-agent systems with consistency constraints in fixed time and the continuous-time communication problem, this paper proposes a distributed optimization algorithm for a first-order multi-agent systems based on a dynamic event-triggered communication mechanism. The proposed algorithm is divided into three parts, the first part enables each agent to converge to consensus in fixed time under any initial condition; the second part minimizes the sum of all local objective functions in fixed time while satisfied the consistency constraint; the third part designs a dynamic event-triggered communication mechanism, aiming to reduce the system energy consumption and save communication resources, which can avoid Zeno behavior after reaching consensus. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can make the multi-agent system converge to consensus in any initial state within a fixed time. What’s more, compared with the traditional communication mechanism, the system communication frequency is found to be significantly reduced, which verifies the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed dynamic event-triggered communication mechanism.

articleTitle: An Improved Siamese Tracking Network Based On Self-Attention And Cross-Attention
abstract: Deep Siamese visual tracking network SiamRPN++ is found that its success rate and robustness is unsatisfactory when meeting complex scenes such as occlusion, large deformation, interference of similar objects and long-time tracking. Refer to these, we propose an improvement strategy based on self-attention and cross-attention mechanism. For backbone, we use Channel and Space self-attention modules, and we using different cross channel attention modules between template features and search features in every three RPN modules, finally using special self-attention on similarity feature maps. These tricks effectively suppress interference, improve the features’ quality and make progress in robustness. Comparing with original SiamRPN++ with parameters from official open-source frame, PySOT, our network improves robustness of 3% on VOT2018, accuracy of 2% and success rate of 3% on OTB100.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation Algorithm Based on Deep Learning for OFDM System
abstract: In the process of channel estimation in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems, reliable channel estimation is the key task to achieve high data rate. The traditional channel interpolation algorithm is based on the assumption that the estimated values near the pilot are correlated. When the channel characteristics are discontinuous due to the time-varying and frequency-variable characteristics of the wireless channel, the estimated results will not be ideal. To solve this problem, this paper introduces a super-resolution reconstruction model, ESRGAN, to replace the interpolation processing in channel estimation. First, the estimated value is obtained by the least squares method (LS) at the pilot, and then the estimated value is compared to the pixel points in the low-resolution image. First, the channel characteristics are extracted through the convolution network, and then the mapping relationship is learned through multiple residual networks, and then amplified by the upper sampling layer. Finally, the estimation effect is continuously judged and improved through the discrimination network. The simulation results show that the channel estimation based on ESRGAN is better than the traditional LS algorithm and the same type of SRCNN model. And even if the model has fewer pilots, it also achieves excellent MSE performance, which shows great application potential in spectrum saving.

articleTitle: A Novel Cross-Device Target Handover Method based on Affine Transformation and Correlation Filter
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel template matching method, which achieves target handover between the video monitoring system and security mobile robot. First, a target coordinate transformation scheme across devices is proposed to get the target pixel range in robot perspective. Second, correlation filters utilized to complete target matching process. Finally, an improved target handover method based on affine transformation and correlation filter is proposed, which achieves higher accuracy. Compared with traditional template matching methods and deep learning methods, our proposed method achieves promising performance in both speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: An Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Framework based on Dual Scale Decomposition and Learnable Attention Fusion Strategy
abstract: The fusion of infrared and visible images is a hot field in image processing, aiming to preserve the prominent targets in infrared images and the clear background texture in visible images. This paper proposes a novel auto-encoder framework for infrared and visible image fusion based on dual-scale decomposition and a learnable attention fusion strategy. The core idea is that the encoder decomposes the image into low-level multi-scale features, deep-level difference features, and common features. And we use a two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, the auto-encoder network is trained to decompose, extract features, and reconstruct images. In the second stage, the learnable attention-based fusion network is trained using the proposed loss function, which enables the learnable fusion network to learn different appropriate fusion strategies for different levels of feature layers. The results show that our fusion framework has achieved better performance than the state-of-the-art methods in both subjective and objective evaluation. And our proposed method achieves better values on 6 out of 8 common quality metrics.

articleTitle: Dissipative Control For A Class Of Neutral Time-delay Systems
abstract: The essay mainly focuses on the dissipative control problems for a class of neutral systems. By constructing Lyapunov-Krasovskii function and employing the lemma obtained by the author, some novel results are got through the LMI technique. These obtained criteria ensure the stability and dissipative performance of the neutral systems. Moreover, it doesn’t worry about the impulse systems in terms of the conclusion obtained in this paper.

articleTitle: Event-triggered Control for Leader-Following Consensus of Multiagent Systems via a Fully Distributed Approach
abstract: For the multiagent systems, how to allocate the communication resources effectively and thus prolong the life-span of the systems is an interesting problem. Event-triggered control, which can maintain an anticipated performance while reducing the communication resources of multiagent systems efficaciously, arises for solving such an issue. The majority of the obtained event-based consensus results in literature need some global information. In order to overcome the existing imperfections mentioned above, this article studies the fully distributed consensus problem of multiagent systems with general dynamics. By introducing a couple of adaptive parameters, a fully distributed leader-following consensus protocol in the event-triggered fashion is developed. In such a design, no global information is used. Moreover, the new node-based adaptive parameters developed in this paper is more efficient than traditional edge-based ones. The Zeno behavior is also proved to be excluded in the close-looped system, which makes it possible for practical applications. Finally, a simulation example is provided to demonstrate the validity of the designed strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the Design and Control Scheme of Engineering Excavator Robot
abstract: This paper proposes the design and control scheme of a new engineering excavator robot to improve the automation level of excavation work. The excavator robot is mounted on a towing platform and transported by a tractor to arrive at the designated area for work. It consists of four motion systems, which are designed under the condition that the structural requirements are met. In addition, the control scheme of the excavator robot is introduced to achieve motion control. According to the overall plan, we complete the manufacturing of the excavator robot and improve the solution of excavation.

articleTitle: Unbiased minimum-variance simultaneous input and state estimation based on maximum correntropy criterion
abstract: The existing unbiased minimum-variance (UMV) filter with simultaneous input and state estimation (SISE) is based on the classical minimum mean square error (MMSE) criterion of the optimal Gaussian system. Nevertheless, when the system is in non-Gaussian noise measurement system, the performance of existing SISE algorithms will deteriorate significantly, and the maximum correntropy criterion (MCC) can solve this problem commendably. In this paper, maximum correntropy filter based unbiased minimum-variance simultaneous input and state estimation method (MCF-UMVSISE) is proposed, SISE filter is transformed into standard form firstly, in this case the input estimation is not required when deriving this estimator. Then the maximum correntropy criterion is used for derivation, which will make the performance better under non-Gaussian noise. In the end, experiments and simulations are carried out under Gaussian and non-Gaussian observation noises respectively to prove the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Cooperative Optimization for Inseparable Objective Functions with Coupled Inequality Constraints
abstract: The task of cooperative optimization in a multi-agent system is that multiple agents work together to achieve a global optimization goal. Coupled constraints on behaviors of agents undoubtedly make this task more difficult. In this paper, we study the cooperative optimization problem with coupled inequality constraints and develop a design framework based on potential game theory to solve this problem. Different from the existing results, we do not require the objective function to be the summation form of local utilities, nor do we require the coupled constraints to be linear or nonlinear. We use logarithmic barrier method to transform the constrained optimization problem to an unconstrained optimization problem. A potential game is set up in Euclidean space so that the unconstrained optimization problem can be solved in a distributed way. We also prove that the solution of the decoupled optimization problem is equivalent to the solution of the original problem. An improved gradient projection algorithm is proposed and its convergence is illustrated through a numerical example.

articleTitle: Research on USV Route Planning Based on Simulated Annealing-Chaos Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
abstract: In this paper, a simulated annealing adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm based on the Logistic chaotic mapping model (SA-CAPSO) is proposed to solve the problems of premature, long initialization time, insufficient anti-jamming adaptability, and low convergence speed and accuracy of traditional particle swarm optimization (PSO) for unmanned surface vehicle (USV) route planning in a relatively complex environment. First, in this method, the adaptive coefficient is used to replace the original intrinsic coefficient to improve the velocity distribution of particles. Secondly, the chaos map strategy is introduced to improve the initial division of particles by using its sensitivity to the initial value. Finally, the simulated annealing algorithm (SA) is integrated to improve the optimality of the solution by taking advantage of its probabilistic global optimization characteristics. To evaluate the SA-CAPSO algorithm, we compared the route planning results with the standard Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization (APSO), and Chaos Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization (CAPSO). The experimental results show that the SA-CAPSO algorithm can obtain the planned track curve with good convergence accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of Electric Vehicle Driving Range Based on Markov Chain
abstract: Aiming at the problem that journey planning fails due to insufficient power during the driving of electric vehicles, a discrete-time Markov chain-based model for predicting the driving range of electric vehicles is proposed. It establishes the variation for the state of charge under the charging and discharging of electric vehicles. Then it maps driving duration to the number of state transitions in Markov chain-based model. Finally, it converts the driving duration to the driving range of the electric vehicle. The simulation results show that the proposed model can better predict the actual driving range of electric vehicles based on the remaining power compared with two other prediction algorithms.

articleTitle: Medium and Long-term Load Forecasting Based on EMD-CNN-BLSTM Hybrid Deep Learning Model
abstract: Power load forecasting is the most important part of the power industry. It is affected by various factors such as dew point temperature, weather, electricity price, holidays, etc. Medium and long-term power load forecasting is especially important. So a hybrid prediction algorithm based on empirical modal decomposition (EMD) with convolutional neural network (CNN) and bi-directional long short-term memory (BLSTM) is proposed. First use the EMD to process the non-linear, non-smooth signal sequences with "noise", and use the normalization for data pre-processing, then use the CNN to extract effective data, then use the BLSTM to predict. Finally, through a local example, the analysis verifies that the proposed EMD-CNN-BLSTM model has better load prediction performance than the CNN model alone, the LSTM model alone, the BLSTM model alone, or the CNN-LSTM model, and the EMD-CNN-BLSTM prediction accuracy to 97.98%.

articleTitle: Design of Data Acquisition System for Pipeline Detecting Snake Robot
abstract: Pipeline transportation has the characteristics of large quantity of material transportation, fast running speed, less cost and low cost. Due to the influence of internal and external environmental factors during long-term use, the inside of the pipeline is prone to damage, so it is necessary to check and maintain the inside of the pipeline regularly. The appearance of pipeline detection robot can show the internal situation of pipeline more directly and provide direct basis for operation and maintenance personnel to make decisions. This paper designs a data acquisition system suitable for the snake robot, which can receive the image and video information, positioning and navigation information, temperature and humidity, gas concentration, etc. of the inner wall of the pipeline detected by the snake robot, so that the detection personnel can understand the internal situation of the pipeline more clearly and accurately, and provide a direct decision basis for excavation, filling and plugging.

articleTitle: Research on Movie Recommendation System Based on Multimodal Fusion
abstract: Using the traditional collaborative filtering method to recommend often ignores the characteristics of the film itself. A movie recommendation system based on multimodal fusion is proposed by integrating the movie poster style, movie ID and other contents, and taking the fused feature information as the supplement of collaborative filtering recommendation. Feature extraction is mainly carried out for movie ID, movie genre, movie title, movie poster, etc., and fusion is carried out through convolutional network. Finally, based on the MovieNet dataset, the model is used for experiments, and the experimental results prove that the proposed method is superior to other methods.

articleTitle: A Novel Scenario-based Path Planning Method for Narrow Parking Space
abstract: Automatic parking is an important field in autonomous driving research, and path planning is a crucial step in its realization. However, traditional path planning algorithms tend to fail when confronted with narrow parking space. In this paper, a novel scenario-based path planning Method is proposed for narrow parking space. First, the scenario decision algorithm is used to determine the parking scenario category: parallel parking or perpendicular parking. Then suitable intermediate state in configuration space is selected through the backtracking method and the local path of intermediate-goal is generated. After that, the initial-intermediate path planning is performed. Finally, the global path is obtained by concatenating the two local paths. Experiments are conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed method and the results show that it can not only quickly generate a path that satisfies vehicle kinematic constraints in narrow parking space.

articleTitle: A Water Quality Prediction Method Based on Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network Optimized by Cuckoo Search Algorithm
abstract: Water quality prediction is of positive significance for the protection of water sources. In order to grasp the future water quality of the reservoir, the measured data of the four indicators of pH, biochemical oxygen demand of five days(BOD5), ammonia nitrogen(NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-N)and dissolved oxygen(DO)from 2017 to 2021 were selected as training samples. The Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network was optimized by using the Cuckoo Search(CS)algorithm to predict the four indicators of the reservoir in 2022. LSTM neural network model and BP fully connected neural network model are established and compared with them. The experimental results show that the mean absolute error and root mean square error of the prediction model based on CS-LSTM are lower than those of the comparison model, and the coefficient of determination is higher than that of the comparison model, which is better than the LSTM model.

articleTitle: Research on moment of inertia identification and parameter self-tuning based on generalized high-order SCKF algorithm
abstract: In order to restrain the influence of the sudden change of moment of inertia on the speed response characteristics of the motor, the system should have the functions of moment of inertia identification and controller parameter self-tuning. Aiming at the problems of slow convergence time, low accuracy and poor robustness of traditional parameter identification methods, this paper proposes a generalized high-order square-root cubature Kalman filter (SCKF) algorithm. Compared with SCKF algorithm, this algorithm has more sampling points, faster convergence time and better numerical stability. The simulation results of moment of inertia identification show that the generalized high-order SCKF algorithm is superior to the traditional extended Kalman filter (EKF) and SCKF algorithm in convergence time, identification accuracy and stability in the face of moment of inertia mutation. The speed loop PI control parameter self-tuning method based on inertia identification accelerates the response speed of the motor and improves the control performance of the motor.

articleTitle: Power Allocation Strategy of Multivariate Hybrid Energy Storage System Suitable for Microgrid
abstract: Considering that hybrid energy storage system is regarded as one of the important components of microgrid, it is of great significance to study its power allocation strategy. The power fluctuation of microgrid is decomposed into three different components: random component, pulse component and continuous component. Accordingly, a multivariate hybrid energy storage system composed of supercapacitor, lithium iron phosphate battery and all-vanadium redox flow battery was used to stabilize the power fluctuation in microgrid; Two frequency dividing points of power fluctuation were obtained by wavelet transform, which were decomposed into three frequency components by a low-pass filter and a high-pass filter. Combined with system constraints, the power allocation strategy of multivariate hybrid energy storage system was designed. Compared with the traditional energy storage system, the simulation results showed that the multivariate hybrid energy storage system could effectively reduce the charging and discharging power as well as charging and discharging times of supercapacitors and lithium batteries, maintain the SOC fluctuation between 30% and 70%, and possess a more reasonable working range, thus prolonging the service life of energy storage components.

articleTitle: Design of Dynamic Tactical Control Range in Air Combat based on Three-Party Game
abstract: Traditional combat decision information, which is calculated by assuming the target maneuver state, is no longer suitable for highly dynamic situation in modern air combat. In order to address aforementioned problem, a novel concept of dynamic tactical control range (DTCR) is proposed in this paper under the analysis of aerial confrontation mechanism. Based on differential game theory, an aerial three-party combined system of target-defender-attacker is established. Thus, the combat problem is transformed into a two-team linear differential game model between the attacker and the coalition of the defender and the target. The analytic solution of the game model provides an optimal pursuit-evasion control law (OPCL) for each of the adversarial three-party. Moreover, DTCR boundary search algorithm based on improved advance-retreat method is designed to calculate DTCR in real-time for decision application.
