The simulation results demonstrate that the DTCR approach is effective to improve the hit probability of the missile under aerial confrontation condition, and is reliable to support pilots with rational decision information.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Bearings Based on Multi-head Self-attention Mechanism, Multi-scale Temporal Convolutional Network and Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: Accurate remaining useful life (RUL) prediction of bearings is critical to the safety of the modern manufacturing industry. In this study, an effective end-to-end deep learning framework consisting of a feature extraction module (FEM) and a feature fusion module (FFM) is proposed to predict bearings RUL. In the FEM, an intelligent network architecture fusing a temporal convolutional network and a multi-head self-attention mechanism (MSM) is designed to extract multi-scale temporal features from raw data. Subsequently, the MSM is introduced to capture attention representations of features at different scales from multiple perspectives. All the attention representations are concentrated into an advanced feature vector as the input of the FFM. In the FFM, one-dimensional convolutional neural network layers with the ability of continuous down-sampling are designed to deeply fuse the internal information contained in the feature vector and output the predicted bearings RUL. Extensive experiments on PRONOSTIA dataset analyze the contribution of the framework’s components and indicate that the proposed framework greatly outperforms the existing methods.

articleTitle: Scale-free linear protocol design for global regulated state synchronization of discrete-time double-integrator multi-agent systems subject to actuator saturation
abstract: This paper studies global regulated state synchronization of discrete-time double-integrator multi-agent systems subject to actuator saturation by utilizing localized information exchange. We propose a scalable linear protocol that achieves global regulated state synchronization for any network with arbitrary number of agents and arbitrarily directed communication graph that has a path between each agent and exosystem which generates the reference trajectory.

articleTitle: A Deep Supervised Pavement Crack Detection Network with Multiscale Feature Fusion and Feature Learning
abstract: Cracks are one of the most serious road diseases. Accurate detection of road cracks is an important part of road maintenance. With the development of modern society, infrastructure is increasing day by day. Traditional manual detection is not suitable for modern large-scale crack detection because it is time consuming and depends on people’s subjective consciousness. Due to the complex background and the complexity of the cracks, high-precision autonomous crack detection is still a challenging task. To solve the above problems, this paper takes the attention U-Net as the baseline network, and proposed a deep supervised pavement crack detection network for end-to-end crack detection. To realize effective feature fusion, an attention fusion block (AFB) is proposed for multi-scale feature aggregation. Meanwhile, based on the advantages of feature learning scheme, a progressive fusion block (PCF) is also proposed to capture more global context information. Faced with the problem of limited receptive fields, a multiple receptive field fusion (MRFF) block is proposed for multi-scale feature representation. Experiments on two public datasets show that the proposed network has obtained a better segmentation performance than the mainstream segmentation models.

articleTitle: Iterative learning control of linear induction motor based on model-free adaptive control
abstract: As a special type of motors, linear induction motors have been an important area of research for researchers. But the linear induction motor poses a great challenge for velocity control due to its nonlinearity, strong coupling and unique end effects. In this paper, a model-free adaptive control method is used to simplify the model by using the load disturbance as the input signal firstly. Secondly, the model-free adaptive control method is combined with the iterative learning control method to design a reasonable controller for the problem of low control accuracy, and the stability of the control system is proved by Lyapunov method. Finally, simulation results show that the velocity tracking effect is further enhanced after the addition of iterative learning control, which verifies the accuracy and effectiveness of the composite method.

articleTitle: Infrared Target Tracking Algorithm Based on Motion Features and Contour Features
abstract: With the rapid development of target detection technology, MOT(multi-target tracking) technology has also been developed rapidly. For the field of infrared surveillance, the background is relatively complex and appearance features such as color are lost, so the tracking of infrared targets has been a challenging topic. In order to improve the speed and accuracy of IR target tracking, this paper explores a tracking method based on IR target motion features and contour features. The method follows the paradigm of TBD (Tracking by Detection) in multi-target tracking. Target detection uses a modified yolov5x as a detector, a Kalman filter for target motion state estimation, HOG(histogram of oriented gradients) features of the target frame map for re-identification, and dynamic threshold matching is used. At the same time, the low confidence detection frame is also involved in matching for potential occlusion problems. The experimental results show that the tracking algorithm has better results in IR(infrared radiation) complex permutation environment. Compared with DeepSORT algorithm, The speed of the tracking is improved by 40.2% and the accuracy is improved by 2.3%.

articleTitle: Improved Yolov5 Algorithm for Surface Defect Detection of Solar Cell
abstract: Solar cells are a significant component of photovoltaic power systems, and the quality of the cells directly affects the efficiency of power generation. Aiming to address the difficulty of defect detection caused by complex solar cell backgrounds and diverse defects in the mixed scenario of monocrystalline cells and polycrystalline cells, this paper proposes an improved YOLOv5 algorithm. Firstly, the global attention mechanism (GAM) is incorporated into the backbone network of yolov5 to enhance the feature extraction ability for electroluminescence (EL) images; then, the feature fusion ability of the model is improved due to the introduction of the approach named adaptively spatial feature fusion (ASFF). The experimental results show that the proposed method trained on the solar cell EL image dataset achieves 75.9% mAP, which is 3.5% higher than the original yolov5. In addition, compared with mainstream object detection models, it is further verified that our model has outstanding performance in the solar cell surface defect detection task.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration Scheme of Multi-Sensor Perception for Autonomous Vehicles based on Solid-State LiDAR*
abstract: Environmental perception is the first and most critical part of realizing autonomous driving. Solid-state LiDAR, as an important sensor in the perception layer of autonomous vehicles, gives the vehicles the ability to perceive beyond human eyes and guards the safety of people’s travel. This paper proposes an optimal multi-sensor configuration method for autonomous vehicles based on solid-state LiDAR, camera, millimeter wave radar, and ultrasonic radar. The range of interests (RoIs) is divided into six zones and they are further classified into the core RoI and the extended RoI based on importance. The RoIs discretization mechanism is designed according to the functions and sensing range of various sensors. Considering the cost, coverage, and redundancy, a mixed integer programming model is built to determine the optimal number of sensors and placement positions. The optimal configuration scheme is obtained by using the IBM ILOG CPLEX solver. A model of a well-known vehicle brand is chosen to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method. The solid-state LiDAR-based multi-sensor perception solution can meet the needs of environment perception for autonomous vehicles, and its coverage and redundancy are better than other control schemes, but its cost is relatively high due to the high cost of the solid-state LiDAR. The configuration scheme proposed in this paper will provide effective support for the design of an autonomous vehicle sensing solution.

articleTitle: Motion Imitation of a Humanoid Robot via Pose Estimation
abstract: Due to the complex operation environments, it is with great significance to improve the flexibility, efficiency and usability of robots while reducing the professional requirements and workload of robot deployment. In this paper, we propose a novel motion imitation approach to a humanoid robot based on 3D human pose estimation. First, we present a sparse-tensor-based 3D human pose estimation approach with point cloud pruning, which solves the dependence of 3D pose estimation on 2D results by directly using the quantized RGB-D data. By effective pruning, the memory stability of 3D data can be guaranteed. Second, a simple yet effective motion retargeting method using coordinate transformation and space vector calculation is applied. Finally, experiments demonstrate the accuracy of our proposed human pose estimation method, thus making motion capture less dependent on expensive and complex motion capture devices and the performance of similarity, continuity and stability of motion imitation is verified.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis method of rolling bearing based on SE-DRN
abstract: As a key component of rotating machinery, rolling bearing is widely used. Its health directly affects the normal operation of equipment. Therefore, the rolling bearing fault diagnosis technology has important engineering application value. This chapter proposes a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on Squeeze-Excitation Deep Residual Network (SE-DRN). First, the bearing vibration signal is decomposed by Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD), all Intrinsic Mode Function (IMF) obtained after decomposition are reconstructed, and the Intrinsic Mode Function (IMF) signal matrix is constructed. Then, the signal matrix is input to Squeeze-Excitation Deep Residual Network (SE-DRN) for feature extraction and recognition, the fault diagnosis model of Squeeze-Excitation Deep Residual Network (SE-DRN) is established. Finally, it is compared with other fault diagnosis models.The results show that the fault diagnosis model of Squeeze-Excitation Deep Residual Network (SE-DRN) can well diagnose five different state types of rolling bearings.

articleTitle: Study on health condition monitoring system of electric power system of all-electric helicopter
abstract: The electric power system is an important part of the all-electric helicopter. The health of the system directly affects the performance of the helicopter. This paper analyzes the common faults of main motor, control system, battery, circuit system and mechanical system, and designs the health status monitoring system of electric power system of all-electric helicopter. The system realizes the monitoring of important components of electric power system of all-electric helicopter, improves the efficiency of helicopter Hight, and provides good technical support for ensuring helicopter flight safety.

articleTitle: Prescribed-time Consensus for Multi-Agent Systems based on Prescribed Performance
abstract: The prescribed performance-based prescribed-time tracking error consensus is investigated for second-order leader-following multi-agent systems in this work. Firstly, a suitable performance function is designed, which combined the prescribed performance and the prescribed-time consensus, to keep the error function always within the artificially predetermined performance envelope. Secondly, to provide each follower with the information of the leader, a novel distributed observer is created. In addition, by using the backstepping method, a novel tracking control strategy is proposed to achieve leader-following consensus before an arbitrary artificially predesigned prescribed-time. Finally, examples from simulations are used to illustrate the theoretical viability.

articleTitle: An improved risk priority number model for FMEA based on belief measure
abstract: Decision making under uncertainty in risk analysis is a key issue in practical engineering. The risk priority number (RPN) model in failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) is a widely used tool for ranking of risk items. However, there are limitations in the traditional RPN model. For example, it cannot represent the subjective or inaccurate judgements coming from FMEA experts. In addition, the uncertainty in the assessments of experts in FMEA item is not modelled and transformed to the RPN values. In this paper, a new risk priority number model based on belief Jensen-Shannon divergence measure and Deng entropy in Dempster-Shafer evidence theory is proposed. In the proposed method, the belief Jensen-Shannon divergence measure is adopted to effectively deal with the fuzziness and abnormal adjustment coming from all the FMEA experts. In addition, Deng entropy is used to quantify the uncertain degree of each expert and the result is modelled as a relative importance degree of expert. Dempster’s combination rule is used to fuse experts’ assessments of different failure modes to generate the integrated values of each risk factor. The rationality, superiority and effectiveness of the proposed RPN model are verified based on a case study of a production process in steel industry.

articleTitle: The Improved Optimization Algorithm for UAV SLAM in Visual Odometry-Pose Estimation
abstract: Pose estimation has always been a key research field in SLAM. The absolute positioning of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in large and complex scenarios is easily affected by environmental factors. When there are external image occlusions and interference with moving objects, the impact on the visual-IMU-based UAV is significant, resulting in poor positioning accuracy and even failure, and IMU is prone to drift. Therefore, this paper proposes a framework based on visual-IMU fusion and distributed extend Kalman filter (DEKF). First, when there are overlapping scene detection and relocation tasks, the visual-IMU SLAM system is applied to the visual odometry (VIO) system through a separate mapping thread, and the IMU information is used to estimate the attitude change of the UAV in a short time when the visual information in the agent is lost. Due to the problem of IMU cumulative drift in the system, the traditional EKF algorithm may lead to the accumulation of a priori error, thus affecting the global optimization results. Therefore, the DEKF algorithm is designed to reduce the IMU drift when visual information is missing. Finally, a case study is conducted using the MH01 open data set to prove the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Lightweight and Dynamic Convolutional Network for Real-time Semantic Segmentation
abstract: Semantic segmentation is a difficult task that satisfies most of the demands of autonomous driving and drone aerial photography in a unified fashion. Convolutional neural networks can properly categorize image pixels via end-to-end model training. However, achieving the optimal trade-off between segmentation precision and the number of network parameters while maintaining a suitable inference time has become a challenging task. In this paper, we propose a lightweight dynamic convolutional semantic segmentation network, LDCNet, which belongs to the asymmetric network architecture. First, we designed a coding module that includes dynamic convolution: DDAB. The success of this module is attributed to the use of dynamic convolution, which increases the utilization of local and contextual information of the features. We also designed the decoding module containing feature pyramids and hybrid attention: HA-FP,which performs a multi-scale fusion of features accompanied by feature selection. On the Cityscapes and Camvid datasets, LDCNet obtains 73.5 mIoU and 69.4 mIoU accuracy with 78.4 FPS and 91.3 FPS, respectively, without pre-training or post-processing. Our experimental findings reveal that LDCNet achieves an outstanding balance between segmentation accuracy and network parameters with just 0.96 M.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Economic Dispatch Algorithm in Smart Grid with General Random Noise
abstract: This paper considers the economic dispatch problem (EDP) in smart grid while preserving the privacy of the sensitive information, where the sensitive information is the operation cost. A novel privacy-preserving algorithm with general random noise is proposed to address the EDP. The advantage of this algorithm is that both Laplacian noise mechanism and Gaussian noise mechanism can be considered as the special case of the proposed algorithm. The convergence of the proposed algorithm is theoretically proved and the condition of ε-differential privacy and (ε, δ)-differential privacy are also obtained. Finally, two novel noises (staircase-shaped noise and decaying Gaussian noise) are used to design the privacy-preserving algorithm and verify the obtained results.

articleTitle: Research on start-up strategy of vehicle mounted heat pump air conditioning compressor
abstract: In the vehicle heat pump air-conditioning compressor system, the compressor load will change with the environment, resulting in the inaccurate positioning of the conventional startup method at the predetermined phase of the starting process, causing the compressor starting torque to fluctuate or even fail the start. By analyzing the starting process of the heat pump air conditioning compressor under different working conditions, this paper proposes a hybrid starting strategy based on the combination of high-frequency injection positioning and constant current frequency ratio (I/F) starting, aiming at the problem that the inaccurate starting positioning of the heat pump air conditioning compressor system with I/F leads to system jitter, starting torque fluctuation and then leads to starting failure. The simulation results show that the algorithm can solve the problem of starting failure of the heat pump compressor under high load. The starting torque fluctuation under normal working conditions is reduced by 70%, making the starting of the heat pump air-conditioning compressor more stable and the starting process more smooth.

articleTitle: Robust fixed-time stabilization control for underactuated cart-pendulum system
abstract: An underactuated cart-pendulum system has two degrees of freedom (DOF) and only one control input. This paper discuss the robust stabilization control of this system around the origin equilibrium point. Firstly, we approximately linearize the system at the origin and change it to be a chained form system. And then, a sliding mode surface is constructed for the system. And we use the sliding mode control method to design a controller that makes the state variables reach the zero sliding mode surface in a fixed time. After that, the stability analysis of closed-loop control system gives that the system is robustly stabilized to the origin in a fixed time. Numerical examples demonstrate the validity of our developed control strategy.

articleTitle: Dynamic matrix control based on PID controller design for engraving machine system
abstract: To realize the precise control of engraving machine system with integral factor has important theoretical significance and industrial application value. For an engraving machine system with integral factor, there exist excessive overshoot and drastic change of control input. The mechanism analysis technique is used to understand the internal performance of the system and for guiding the controller design. Based on the established system model, the model prediction technology can be used to control of the engraving machine system. The dynamic matrix control (DMC) algorithm based on the proportional integral derivative (PID) is constructed and applied to control the engraving machine system. Moreover, the characteristics of the control algorithm are analyzed and the key guiding techniques in the process of industrial application are also given. Compared to existing control algorithms, the superiority and robustness of the proposed control algorithm are verified by numerical simulation and experimental test. The proposed control algorithm can also be extended to other industrial systems or equipment.

articleTitle: Multiple Input Mulitple Output Control Method Based on Single Neuron Adaptive PID for Municipal Solid Waste Incineration Process
abstract: The automatic combustion control (ACC) system of municipal solid waste incineration (MSWI) processes realizes the stable operation through the coupling control among multiple loops. However, due to the difference in municipal waste solid components and operating level, the introduced ACC system is difficult to be directly applied in China. The research on MSWI process controlling is still the key to solve its stable running. Aiming at the strong coupling and nonlinear characteristics of MSWI processes, this paper proposes a multiple input multiple output control method based on single neuron adaptive PID. Firstly, multi-input multi-output controlled object models in terms of furnace temperature (FT), boiler steam flow (BSF), and oxygen (OX) content are established, whose input and output are determined on the basis of MSWI process flow and ACC system’s mechanism. Then, based on the experience of experts in the field, the multi-loop controller of the MSWI process is established by using single neuron adaptive PID controller. Finally, the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed framework are verified by actual industrial process data.

articleTitle: RBF neural network modeling and application based on improved sparrow search algorithm
abstract: Using sparrow search algorithm (SSA) to optimize neural network model is easy to fall into local extremum, which leads to low accuracy of soft sensor. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved sparrow search algorithm (ISSA) to optimize the widths, centers and weights of radial basis function neural network (RBFNN). Taking the mean square error value as the individual fitness value, the position update formulas of discoverers, participants and early warning persons in SSA are improved to optimize the parameters of RBFNN. Finally, the convergence of the algorithm was proved, and the chemical oxygen demand (COD) was predicted using the random data validation and the measured data of the sewage treatment plant. The results showed that the mean absolute percentage error of SSA-RBF neural network was 1.55%, the mean absolute percentage error of ISSA-RBF neural network was 1.26%, and the mean absolute percentage error decreased by 0.29%, It shows that ISSA-RBF neural network has high soft-sensing accuracy.

articleTitle: Optimizing the evaluation parameters of Amazon chess with parallel genetic algorithm
abstract: In the process of computer game, in order to improve the accuracy of the situation evaluation of Amazon AI program, an optimization scheme based on parallel genetic algorithm is proposed. This scheme uses a multi-node distributed parallel algorithm to optimize the weight of the parameters of Amazon's chess game evaluation function. The whole optimization system is mainly composed of server and client. Each client uses multithread parallel computing and transmits the result data to the server. Through experiments, the optimization results of the parameters of the situation evaluation function can be obtained in 5 hours. It is proved that the situation assessment is more accurate and the capability of the AI program is significantly improved after the optimization of this scheme.

articleTitle: An improved stable motion control method for quadruped robot based on CPG and VMC
abstract: The gait control of a quadruped robot is the key to the robot's movement in complex terrain. In order to realize the stable motion of the quadruped robot on special terrains such as slopes, the hopf oscillator is used as the central mode generator to control the gait of the quadruped robot. The output of the oscillator is converted into the trajectory of the foot, the trajectory of the foot is adjusted by sensory feedback, the gait phase is switched by detecting the pressure of the foot, and the virtual model is used to control the movement of the foot along the given trajectory to achieve Stable motion of a quadruped robot. The simulated quadruped robot is built on the WEBOTS platform and verified by experiments. The results show that the improved gait controller can achieve smooth and compliant motion for the quadruped robot on flat ground and slopes.

articleTitle: The strongly time consistent in a cooperative game with perfect information
abstract: Under the optimality principle in the multi-stage cooperative game , we have discussed the strong time consistency in cooperative games with perfect information. Strong time consistency requires that if players can obtain higher rewards at a future time point, they should take actions at the current time point to maintain time consistency and maximize their rewards. We have found that in certain specific cases, the general core of cooperative games belongs to its strong dynamic stable core. To this end, we proposed a theorem and used a proof by contradiction to theoretically demonstrate the strong time consistency in cooperative games with perfect information. This finding has a positive impact on the study of cooperative games with specific relations of benefits.

articleTitle: Fault Tolerant Control of Markovian Jump Systems with Uncertain Parameters
abstract: In this paper, the problems of fault estimation (FE) and fault-tolerant control (FTC) are addressed for a class of Markovian jump systems with uncertainties and external disturbances. First, to conveniently obtain estimations of the state vector, sensor/actuator fault vector, and disturbance vector, an augmented descriptor system is presented. Subsequently, a sliding-mode observer is designed to eliminate the effects of actuator/sensor faults on the estimation performance. Based on the FE, an observer-based FTC scheme is then developed to stabilize the system stochastically. Finally, the effectiveness and realizability of the proposed scheme are illustrated based on a numerical example.

articleTitle: Image Binary Classification of Coronary Artery Stenosis Based on Resnet18 and Transfer Learning
abstract: Classification detection of coronary artery stenosis plays a vital role in assisting physicians to diagnose cardiovascular diseases. To classify the degree of coronary stenosis accurately and efficiently, CT angiography (CTA) images are converted into binary images by a joint segmentation method, which is based on maximum between-class variance (OTSU) and region growing. Further, the binarized datasets are normalized, which realizes the preprocessing of the medical datasets. Then, to enhance the classification performance, a classification model of coronary artery stenosis, which is based on ResNet18 and transfer learning, is constructed. Lastly, a dataset of CTA images from real patients is applied for experimental verification. The experiment shows that the accuracy of the proposed method is up to 96.97%, 8.08% higher than ResNet18 model, and 5.06% higher than the ResNet18 model with spatial attention mechanism and channel attention mechanism. It can be concluded that the efficiency and reliability of coronary stenosis classification can be considerably improved.

articleTitle: Underwater visual image enhancement method based on the fusion of optical-model methods and model-free methods
abstract: The ability of underwater robots to autonomously identify specific targets is fundamental for underwater robots to complete underwater tasks autonomously. However, the quality of underwater images decays with increasing underwater depth, resulting in low-contrast and high color distortion. To address this issue, an underwater image enhancement algorithm based on the fusion algorithms of optical-model methods and model-free methods is proposed in this work. The depth map features of a specific scene are first acquired, and the depth map is used as input to measure the attenuation and transmission maps. Subsequently, the images were optimized at the pixel level by improving the model-free based methods of background light estimation, improving the red channel prior, improving gamma correction, and image sharpening. For underwater images with light sources and white bodies, we use a new estimation algorithm based on global background illumination in the background light estimation part, which successfully solves the problem of uneven illumination caused by traditional processing. For the red channel prior, we proposed an adaptive gamma correction method. We connect image pixels with gamma values using the region mapping technique to improve the image quality without knowing the illumination information. Finally, a novel pyramid fusion technique is proposed to fuse the results of optical-model methods and model-free methods. In this paper, the UIQM and UCIQE are used as underwater image quality evaluation metrics. Experimental results show that the proposed method improves 2.23 and 1.311 in two metrics compared to the FUnlE-GAN algorithm, 0.34 and 1.331 compared to the Deep WaveNet algorithm, 0.45 and 1.241 compared to the Retinex-based algorithm, 0.78 and 1 compared to the Automatic red channel algorithm, 0.21 and 0.699 compared to the WCID algorithm, respectively.

articleTitle: An efficient multi-attribute combinatorial auction for 4PL transportation service procurement
abstract: In this paper, we study the mechanism design problem of combinatorial reverse auction for 4PL transportation service procurement (TSP) considering price and multiple non-price attributes. In order to achieve efficient winner determination and transportation request allocation, we develop a 0-1 programing model to minimize social cost, where social cost includes real transportation cost of 3PLs and the costs incurred by non-price attributes. A multi-attribute VCG (MA-VCG) reverse auction mechanism is proposed, which satisfies efficiency, incentive compatibility, individual rationality, and budget balance. Then, a numerical example is designed to demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed mechanism. Finally, sensitivity analysis is implemented to illustrate the influences of attribute preference, cost coefficient and other parameters on auction results.

articleTitle: Research on Position Tracking Control of Pneumatic System based on Model Predictive Control
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the control effect of conventional model predictive control (MPC) becomes worse when the air pressure of pneumatic system changes, an adaptive model predictive control (AMPC) for pneumatic system is designed. Firstly, aiming at the problem that the conventional pneumatic system mathematical model considers less about the change of air pressure, the working principle of the pneumatic system is analyzed, and the Multiple Input and Single Output (MISO) mathematical model of the pneumatic system is established. Secondly, based on this model, MPC controller is designed to compare the influence of different prediction time domain (N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>) and different air pressure on the control effect. Finally, in order to improve the response speed and reduce the system overshoot, an adaptive strategy is designed to adjust the prediction time domain according to the system error and the change of air pressure, thus an AMPC controller is designed. The simulation results show that AMPC controller can control the pneumatic system for faster and more stable position tracking, and when the air pressure changes, it can also make parameter adjustments to optimize the robustness and tracking performance of the system.

articleTitle: Monitoring Method of CIPCA Grinding Process Based on Multi-modal Data Characteristics
abstract: In order to solve the problems of multi-work and uncertainty in the grinding process, a process monitoring method called Multimodal Complete Information Principal Component Analysis was proposed in this paper. In this method, SDAE-K-Means++ is adopted to carry out modal partitioning of grinding production process data, and online mode recognition is realized by calculating the similarity between mode center and online data. At the same time, considering the uncertainty characteristics of field data due to noise and sensor drift, CIPCA was combined with modal center estimation for monitoring. This method combined interval data processing with interval monitoring method to reduce the impact of uncertain information. By applying to the actual grinding process of a mine to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Study of Automatic Positioning Control Based on Vision Servo Control
abstract: The traditional automatic crane positioning method has low accuracy, poor stability and cannot form a true closed-loop control, and the existing crane visual positioning method generally suffers from poor anti-disturbance performance and difficulty in obtaining visual Jacobi matrix parameters. In order to solve the problem of external disturbance affecting the accuracy and stability of visual servo positioning, a mathematical model of the position posture of the crane end-effector under the disturbance condition is established, and a visual servo disturbance suppression method based on a self-anti-disturbance controller is proposed. According to the image projection characteristics, the equation of the differential relationship between the Jacobi matrix parameters and image features is derived, the adaptive update rate of the estimated Jacobi matrix parameters is designed, and the closed-loop dynamics equation is established. According to the image characteristic error, the Liapunov function is constructed and the proof of system stability is given. Simulation and experimental analysis are conducted, and the results show that the position and velocity profiles converge to zero values when the visual error converges, indicating that the method in this paper still has satisfactory positioning accuracy under visual uncertainty and constant, transient perturbations. The analysis of the comparison results with other control methods shows that the method in this paper can speed up the convergence of the visual error and has better stability while ensuring the positioning accuracy of the visual servo system, therefore, it is suitable for the automatic positioning visual servo system of cranes for hoisting.

articleTitle: An RRT* Optimization-based Path Planning Method for Ground Module of Air-ground Vehicle
abstract: Path planning is one of the core technologies to realize air-ground vehicle docking. In order to plan a smooth and collision-free path, an RRT* optimization-based path planning method for the ground module of the air-ground vehicle is proposed in this paper. Considering the planned path for docking should be collision-free, effective and smooth, the path planning problem is formulated as an optimization problem with the optimization objective and constraints, in which kinematics constraints are considered to smooth the path and collision-free constraints are accurately formulated. For that the optimization problem is nonlinear, a reasonable and feasible initial guess generated by modified RRT* with Bezier curve is provided to assist in solving the optimization problem. The proposed method is verified under the general docking scene. The results show that the method can plan a smooth, safe and efficient path, which can effectively improve the safety and efficiency of the air-ground vehicle docking task.

articleTitle: A Fault-Tolerant Soft/Hard Hybrid Control for Fault Diagnosis of Aero-engine Sensors
abstract: In this brief paper, a fault-tolerant soft/hard hybrid control scheme based on the Kalman filter is proposed for fault diagnosis of aero-engine sensors. The designed soft fault diagnosis system, in particular, can detect whether a fault exists by residual processing sensor measurement values and a set of Kalman filter estimation values and summing their weighted squares to compare the known thresholds. In addition, to determine whether there is a fault, the developed hard fault diagnosis system compares the residual absolute value of the sensor measurement value and the estimated value of a Kalman filter with the known threshold value. Finally, some numerical simulations of the fault of the low-pressure rotor speed sensor of an aero-engine are performed to validate the proposed method's feasibility and fault tolerance.

articleTitle: Performance-Based Fault-Tolerant Control For Hot Rolling Processes
abstract: In hot rolling processes, equipment fouling, feedstock variations and product changes may cause multiplicative faults, which will considerably affect the system stability and production quality. This paper focuses on performance-based fault-tolerant control (FTC) for multiplicative faults in hot rolling processes. First, the residual-driven fault-tolerant controller is presented through Youla Parameterization, the parameter of which is designed according to the small gain theory to maximize the fault-tolerant margin of the controller. Subsequently, the mechanism formulas of stand and looper are analysed to construct the nonlinear thinkness-looper integrated model, and then the state space model is obtained by linearizing the nonlinear model at the operating point through Taylor Formula. In light of this model, the effectiveness of the proposed FTC strategy is illustrated. It can be observed that the proposed fault-tolerant controller can stabilize the faulty system whereas the nominal controller can not.

articleTitle: Timing alignment of flotation process based on flow balance
abstract: The large delay characteristic in the flotation process brings difficulties to the optimal operation of the flotation process. It is of great significance to estimate the lag time of the interaction between the sub-processes in the flotation process and realize the timing alignment of the flotation process for timely adjusting the operation scheme and ensuring the stable operation of the subsequent process. For this reason, this paper takes a gold processing plant in Shandong Province as the background, innovatively uses flow as the research object of flotation time sequence alignment. Based on the flow balance relationship of the whole process and the lag time between subprocesses as the alignment parameter, a timing alignment model based on flow balance is established. By optimizing the time parameters in the model, the timing alignment problem is converted into the flow deviation minimization problem. The differential evolution algorithm is used to optimize the solution and the estimated latency between subprocesses is obtained. The optimization results are in line with the actual situation in the field and the proposed method realizes the timing alignment of the flotation process.

articleTitle: An Improved Variable Domain Fuzzy Control Strategy for Three-port Converter in Hybrid Energy Storage Systems
abstract: In order to overcome the shortcomings such as lower output power accuracy and less stability of the traditional three-port converters in DC microgrids, an improved variable domain fuzzy control strategy is presented. A new topology named the isolated three-port converter is structured based on the bidirectional Buck-Boost converter and the dual active bridges, and an appropriate combining structure is constructed simultaneously for the improved strategy. Firstly, an adaptive fuzzy PI controller is utilized in the strategy to further improve the dynamic response ability of the isolated three-port converter. Then, a novel variable domain fuzzy inference method is established, which can effectively improve the utilization rate of the fuzzy rules and the control accuracy of the converter. Finally, the feasibility of the presented scheme is verified by Matlab/Simulink. The results show that the three-port converter can operate with a better dynamic and steady-state performance under the proposed control strategy. Consequently, the drive converter investigated in this paper can work stably and reliably.

articleTitle: The field intersection of machine learning and intelligent decision
abstract: Machine learning is an important tool for intelligent decision, the effective combination of the two is the current research hotspot, but fewer scholars have analyzed their development context. This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the whole context from a scientometric perspective, aiming to help researchers understand the development of the two fields as they collide, and thus create new research results. We retrieved 2,218 documents from the Web of Science (WoS) database from 1990 to 2021 and reveals the research hotspot and research frontiers of the subject in the main path longitudinal comparison of the main path of the four sub-periods, which teases the research direction and its evolution route in the two fields. It is found that the field shows a trend of machine learning algorithms moving from single to multiple directions, and the application areas of intelligent decision are gradually widening.

articleTitle: On Clustering Trend in Language Evolution Based on Dynamical Behaviors of Multi-Agent Model
abstract: Computational models are widely used to overcome the constraints of language evolution time and convert language theory into rules of computer models, which is very helpful to investigate the universal laws of language evolution. This paper designs a multi-agent model to simulate the evolution of human language. Language characteristics of every node should evolve under the influence of its own inherent trends and neighboring nodes in the lattice. By carrying out computational experiment and analysis, we found that the human languages in various settlements converge into several clusters with the gradual deepening of the evolution, which gave us a deeper understanding of the collective evolution in nature.

articleTitle: A Review of Time Series Data Mining Methods Based on Cluster Analysis
abstract: In this paper, time series are used as the analyzed values and the focus is on their data mining methods. This detailed evaluation highlights the clustering algorithms in time series data mining. The traditional k-means algorithm and its improvement and three new clustering analysis algorithms (hierarchical cluster analysis, clustering algorithm based on time series data features, and density-based clustering algorithm) are mainly introduced. In addition we analyze the future research directions and further optimization of time series analysis. In summary, this paper focuses on clustering algorithms in time series data mining.

articleTitle: Decentralized design of consensus protocols with minimal communication links based on directed spanning tree
abstract: This paper proposes a decentralized design approach of consensus protocols of multi-agent systems (MASs) via a directed-spanning-tree(DST)-based linear transformation and the corresponding minimal communication links. First, the consensus problem of multi-agent systems is transformed into the decentralized output stabilization problem by constructing a linear transformation based on a DST of the communication topology, and thus a necessary and sufficient consensus criterion in terms of decentralized fixed mode (DFM) is derived. Next, a new distributed protocol is designed by using only the neighbors’ information on the DST, which is a fully decentralized design approach. Finally, some numerical examples are given to verify the results attained.

articleTitle: Salient Object Detection based on Adaptive deep Differential Pyramid
abstract: In the initial stage of salient object detection, the main structure of the saliency model is based calculation of Center-Surround Contrast, which is introduced into a few CNN-based saliency detection model. However, the receptive field of feature layers could not be dynamically adjusted in these methods. Therefore, an Adaptive depth Difference Pyramid (ADP) module is constructed, in which receptive fields could be dynamically adjusted to calculate the difference between features of different levels, sensing the local characteristics of saliency objects. Subsequently, an ADP-based method for salient object detection is proposed. Experiments was conducted on 4 public datasets, and the mean absolute error (MAE) and maximum F-measure was selected for the evaluation metric, which achieved MAE of 87.1%, 86.7%, 88.9% and 82.3% respectively.

articleTitle: Intent Recognition and Slot Filling Joint Model for Question-Answering of Hazardous Chemical Knowledge
abstract: A question-answering system that provides accurate knowledge about hazardous chemicals is essential for their production and management. The system’s ability to accurately recognize intent and slot in the relevant information in the question sentence is critical to ensuring semantic accuracy in the answers. In response to a field-specific issue that slot information in hazardous chemical questions may impede accurate intent recognition, this paper proposes the CJIRSF-Bert model. This model leverages the location and intent information of slots to strengthen the relationship between key slots and intents. To further enhance intent recognition accuracy, we create a hazardous chemical question dataset through manual labeling. Experimental verification demonstrates that the CJIRSF-Bert model achieves a semantic frame accuracy rate of 91.6% on the dataset, surpassing the Joint-Bert model’s performance by 1.4%. This model effectively addresses the challenges of intent recognition and slot filling in hazardous chemical question-answering systems.

articleTitle: BDNet: A Method-based Forward and Backward Convolutional Networks for Action Recognition in Videos
abstract: Human action recognition analyses the behaviour in a scene according to the spatial-temporal features carried in a series of image sequences. The critical challenge is to extract informative spatial-temporal features in a limited-length video that frequently constrains the receptive field of the 3D Convolutional Neural Network(CNN). However, present methods mainly consider modeling the action’s spatial-temporal features along a single direction and ignore the information in the opposite. Moreover, the fixed-weight fusion of spatial and temporal features does not distinguish their importance for each action sequence. To attack the problems above, we propose a bi-directional network (BDNet) to combinate the features from both directions of action for recognizing action. Two CNNs are set up to extract spatial-temporal features along the forward and backward action, respectively. Then, a dynamic fusion strategy is adopted to measure the importance of spatial and temporal features for each action. We conducted many experiments on the commonly used action recognition dataset UCF101. Compared with other work, the proposed method achieves promising performance in accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: A Canonical Correlation Analysis-Based Approach for Battery State of Charge Estimation
abstract: This brief presents a novel method based on canonical correlation analysis (CCA) and particle filter (PF) for battery state of charge (SOC) estimation. More specifically, CCA is adopted to provide a universal way for battery SOC estimation with PF for error correction. Technically, the input data are first mapped to polynomial terms before training to find the intrinsic features. Afterwards, ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-norm regularization is further added to the loss function in order to prevent overfitting. Finally, the SOC estimation result from CCA training is combined with the Coulomb counting model and updated by PF for error correction. Experimental results using battery testing data at different testing profiles and temperatures show the high accuracy of estimation and robustness to wrong initial guess. In particular, compared with linear regression, support vector regression, and neural network, the error of the proposed method is reduced to 1.47%.

articleTitle: Research on automatic billet turning control system based on BiSeNet
abstract: That the turning of steel billets in the rolling process is completed manually by operators affects the improvement of rolling automation level. A solution based on machine vision for billet edge identification and billet turning control in billet production is proposed. Firstly, the real-time billet image is obtained through image acquisition platform. Secondly, a semantic segmentation model based on bilateral semantic convolutional neural network (BiSeNet) is developed to identify the billet edge. Finally, the automatic control system is designed to realize the automatic turning of billet. The utilization rate of the system is up to 90%, and the application of the control system can reduce the workload of operators and improve the automation level of steel plants.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Vehicle-borne Safety Pre-warning System*
abstract: In order to strengthen the safety of long-distance transportation and solve the problem of failing to timely warn or get rescue when the automobile encounters danger or there is an unexpected situation, a set of intelligent vehicle-borne safety pre-warning systems based on GPRS interface server is designed. The system consists of two parts: the on-site detection terminal (vehicle terminal) and the safety management terminal (remote terminal). The vehicle terminal focuses on detecting the temperature and humidity inside the vehicle, the vehicle body angle, the driver’s heart rate and the vehicle positioning data. The detection data are sent to the server through the GPRS interface using the MQTT protocol. Then the information is forwarded to the remote terminal by the server. The remote terminal based on Linux system obtains the information from the server, displays the vehicle location map and other vehicle information on the human-machine interface after data decoding. The system implements alarm according to the set threshold so that the safety management terminal can grasp the vehicle operation status in time, and take timely rescue measures in case of an accident. This provides guarantee for the safe driving of the vehicle.

articleTitle: An Improved Device-free Localization via Sparse Coding with Log Thresholding Algorithm
abstract: As an emerging technology, Device-free localization (DFL) can localize and track targets by using the space signal perturbation induced by the obstacle in wireless sensor network without carrying any devices. However, such DFL systems still face challenges in robustness and efficiency with low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in more complex environments. To address the issues, we proposed a subspace sparse coding iterative log thresholding algorithm (SSC-ILT) for DFL. The log thresholding regularizer is applied to the objective function as the penalty to derive sparse solutions. To meet the requirement of real-time performance, the dimensionality of dictionaries and observed vectors constructed by received signal strength (RSS) measurements can be reduced with principal component analysis (PCA), and the responding coefficient vector is computed via sparse coding with log thresholding operator. By projecting the index of the coefficient vectors to the coordinate of the target in low-dimensional subspace, the location can be estimated. Numerical experiments verified the performance of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Load Frequency Control of Networked Multi-Area Power Systems under DoS Attack and Actuator Failure
abstract: This paper studies the load frequency control problem of multi-area power systems under denial-of-service (DoS) attack and actuator failure. Bernoulli process is used to represent the stochastic DoS attack. A decentralized reliable control law is proposed. Based on the Lyapunov function, a sufficient condition is presented to ensure the bounded stability of closed-loop multiarea power systems and guarantee the existence of controller gain. Finally, simulation results are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the developed control strategy.

articleTitle: Simulation and Research on Liquid Perfusion Flow Field and Liquid Level Fluctuation of Tank
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the fluctuation of the liquid level in the liquid storage tank greatly affects the accuracy of the liquid level control in the liquid level control process using machine vision technology, the influence of the nozzle shape, the nozzle extension length and the nozzle mouth to pipe diameter ratio on the flow field and the liquid level fluctuation during the filling process was numerically simulated. The changes of velocity field, pressure distribution and wave height difference in liquid storage tank were analyzed by the method of computational fluid dynamics. The reasons for the large fluctuation of liquid level during the filling process were analyzed, and the influence of liquid on the state of liquid level under different structural parameters of nozzle was revealed. The research shows that increasing the cross-sectional area of nozzle outlet, extending the length of nozzle and increasing the diameter ratio between nozzle and pipe can reduce the amplitude of liquid level fluctuation during perfusion. The research results can provide a reference for the structural optimization design and parameter configuration of the perfusion nozzle.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Tracking Control for Uncertain UGV with Controllability Relaxation
abstract: This paper provides a robust adaptive trajectory tracking control strategy for uncertain unmanned ground vehicles (UGV) in the presence of external disturbances. A dynamic model of UGV is obtained without assumption of small angle approximation and an affine system of UGV is derived by considering the steering angle as the state variable. By resorting to the existence of some auxiliary matrix, the controllability condition of UGV system is relaxed. Moreover, the outputs track the desired outputs asymptotically and all the signals in the closed loop system are guaranteed to be globally ultimately uniformly bounded. Besides, the proposed strategy is verified via numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Event-triggered impulsive containment control for fixed-time consensus of a class of heterogeneous multi-agent system with disturbances
abstract: This paper studies the fixed-time containment consensus (FTCC) of a class of nonlinear heterogeneous multi-agent systems (NHMASs) with disturbances. A reference model-based event-triggered impulsive control (ETIC) mechanism is devised to realize the FTCC of NHMASs. The impulsive controller is performed only at the triggering instant, which can substantially decrease energy consumption. Then, some sufficient conditions are presented to guarantee that the NHMASs with multiple leaders can reach consensus within fixed time in the case of that agents’ dynamics are different and high order. It is proved that Zeno behavior can be excluded. Finally, a simulation example is provided to verify the feasibility of the derived results.

articleTitle: Human posture recognition based on wearable sensor
abstract: In recent years, with the development of economy and technology, people were increasingly concerned about health, and at the same time, human behavior data based on wearable devices revealed great research value for human health. Currently, most human recognition study focused on video images, however, human behavior recognition using video images showed the following shortcomings: Firstly, it was necessary to install and fix the equipment in advance and the range observed by the equipment was limited; Secondly, it was the privacy controversy involved in human behavior recognition based on video images and the inconvenience caused by the joint parts obscured. Therefore, this study investigated human behavior recognition for wearable sensor data and constructed a body sensor-based behavior recognition system, which used a multilayer CNN-BiLSTM with one-dimensional convolution for extracting features, then combined a bi-directional long and short-term memory network (BiLSTM) that was good at processing time series data, and finally used a fully connected layer for classification to obtain the final The final recognition result was obtained by using a fully connected layer for classification. The system had been experimented on two publicly available datasets (MHEALTH and USCHAD), and achieved good effects, with recognition accuracy of 98.82% and 97.62% on the MHEALTH and HPAT datasets, respectively, showing that the system had good generalization capability.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Continuous-discrete Fractional-order 2D Roesser Model via Reinforcement Learning and Linear Matrix Equalities
abstract: The stabilization problem of continuous-discrete fractional-order 2D Roesser model is investigated in this paper. Firstly, the new stabilization conditions via state feedback controller are proposed based on the necessary and sufficient stability conditions in our previous results. Then, considering the proposed stabilization conditions are not linear matrix equalities, the new method based on Soft Actor-Critic reinforcement learning algorithm and linear matrix equalities solver is established for solving the proposed stabilization conditions and obtaining the stabilization controllers. This method can be used efficiently in solving such non-convex optimization problems. The illustrated example is provided to verify the effectiveness of our results.

articleTitle: Neural Network-based Adaptive Scaled Consensus Control of Uncertain Fractional-order Multi-agent Systems
abstract: This paper investigates the more general coordination behavior "scaled consensus" of multi-agent systems, which includes the traditional average consensus, bipartite consensus, and group consensus as the special cases. Theoretically, an adaptive scaled consensus controller is designed for uncertain fractional-order multi-agent systems. By adopting the neural network-based method, the uncertainties of each agent are approximated and compensated signals are generated for the robust scaled consensus controller design. Then, the fractional-order adaptive update laws of neural network parameters are constructed by using the Lyapunov stability theory. To this end, the robustness of the multi-agent system is enhanced by adopting the neural networks technique. Finally, some numerical simulations are performed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of Parity Relation in Elevator Fault Diagnosis
abstract: A data-driven fault detection and diagnosis is a promising technology to prevent significant increase failures of elevator due to prolonged uses. But it is facing a challenge of irregular data sequence because of the randomness of elevator operation. In the paper the parity relation approach is proposed to overcome this difficulty based on artificial selection of effective time series. Firstly the left-zero matrix is obtained from the valid time series of state variables standardized by Hankle form by singular value decomposition. Then the residual space is established and the threshold is constructed by health data sets under various conditions. Finally the results are obtained by comparing the test sequence with the threshold in the residual space. Numerical simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Effect of Spot Color on Extraction Quality of Holographic Watermark
abstract: To transplant the digital watermark into the field of packaging and printing anti-counterfeiting, the robustness of watermarks in different color spaces and channels against spot color printing was investigated. Taking holographic watermarking algorithm in discrete wavelet transformation domain as an example, the watermarks were embedded into the B, C and spot color channels of the host image in the form of hologram, and the effects of simulated screening and color space conversion attacks on the invisibility and robustness of the watermarks in different channels were investigated. Experiments shown that although spot color printing improved the PSNR value of the watermarked images, it reduced the robustness of the watermark to the color space changing attack, and the robustness of embedding the watermark in the spot color channel was the lowest. Spot color had different effects on different color spaces and color channels. It was suggested to embed watermark in the non-spot-color channel of CMYK color mode.

articleTitle: Optimal Mixed Attack Scheduling with Resource Constraints in Cyber-Physical Systems
abstract: In this paper, we consider the problems of optimal attack scheduling with resource constraints in cyber-physical systems (CPSs), where the mixed attacks are launched on wireless channels to manipulate remote state estimation. These mixed attacks can be degraded to false data injection (FDI) attacks or denial of service (DoS) attacks. The problem of maximizing the disruption of remote estimation performance is transformed into a convex optimization issue using the matrix decomposition. Furthermore, when the attacker’s compensation matrices have partial orders, a closed-form optimal solution is provided. Finally, two simulation cases are presented to validate the conclusions.

articleTitle: A Conversion Method from IDEF3 to Stochastic Behavior Tree
abstract: Formal description of operational task is the basis of mission planning and effectiveness evaluation. Modeling languages such as IDEF can intuitively describe the hierarchical decomposition relationship and execution process of combat tasks. However, since IDEF focuses on static process description, it is not enough to fully meet the needs of quantitative analysis and optimization of combat process. In contrast, stochastic behavior tree shows huge potentials in the quantitative analysis. This paper proposes a conversion method from IDEF3 to stochastic behavior tree. By establishing detailed conversion rules, IDEF3 can be converted into stochastic behavior tree. Taking this as the foundation, the performance analysis of task is possible. The conversion method lays the foundation for quantitative analysis of combat tasks based on stochastic behavior tree theory.

articleTitle: Optimization design of highway tunnel lighting entrance section for safety and energy saving
abstract: In order to solve the contradiction between over-luminance and under-luminance in the highway tunnel lighting system, an entrance section luminance curve optimization design method is proposed to the purpose of traffic safety and energy consumption reduction. Firstly, under the constraints of the Rules and Guidelines, the objective function of luminance curves optimization considering over-luminance and under-luminance is constructed, and the four-step optimization model and design parameters of the entrance section luminance curve are given. Then the luminance curve optimization model is evaluated and analyzed in terms of comfort, safety and energy saving effect.Finally, combined with the actual tunnel, it is verified that compared with the Rule method, the proposed design method reduces the maximum luminance ratio of adjacent sections by 26.5%, and the lighting step curve in the second half of the entrance section is reduced by 95.7% compared with the adaptive curve.The power consumption was reduced by 6.1% and 6.3% for HPS and LED lights, respectively, compared to the design method considering only traffic safety.

articleTitle: Low-light image enhancement based on Transformer and CNN architecture
abstract: Affected by low photon counts and noise, images captured in low-light environments commonly have low signal-to-noise ratios, details losing, low contrast and other artifacts. Low-light image enhancement which restores clear images from low-light images with unsatisfactory quality is challenging. In this paper, we propose a strong baseline model based on transformer and CNN architecture for low light image enhancement (TrCLLE). In TrCLLE, the advantages of transformer in effectively modeling long-distance dependence and convolutional neural network in modeling local features through inductive bias are integrated. TrCLLE consists of three parts: shallow feature extraction module, deep feature extraction module and high-quality image reconstruction module. At last, the factors affecting performance are analyzed in detail and the experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves enhanced images with higher quality compared to other popular approaches.

articleTitle: An Improved Ant Colony Algorithm Based on Competition Mechanism of SOM Neural Network
abstract: In view of the problems of Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), such as too slow convergence, low search efficiency, and easy to fall into the local optimum, an improved ACO based on Self-Organizing Map (SOM) neural network competition mechanism is proposed. The competition mechanism of SOM neural network is used to adjust the pheromone distribution on the path. The initial pheromones of the path are distributed unevenly by parameter normalization to improve the convergence speed of ACO. In order to solve the slow convergence problem of the improved ACO, the pheromone update threshold is set. The algorithm is applied to path planning. The simulations are carried out under the two-dimensional topological map and the three-dimensional grid map. The results show that, compared with ACO algorithm, the improved algorithm can find the shortest path and is not easy to fall into the local optimum.

articleTitle: Energy optimized D* AUV path planning with underwater digital terrain and ocean current environment
abstract: Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) path planning in the marine environment is different from that in the terrestrial environment. It is important to extend the map to a three-dimensional environment and consider how ocean currents affect the planned path in addition to energy use and safe obstacle avoidance. To solve the above problems, Digital Elevation Model (DEM) is introduced to build a three-dimensional map, and on the basis of the original cost function, obstacle cost items and steering angle cost items are added as constraints to ensure the safety of AUV navigation. Considering the huge impact of ocean currents on AUV energy consumption, this paper establishes a cost model for the impact of ocean currents on AUV energy consumption, and applies it to the D* path planning algorithm. It can be seen from the simulation experiment that AUV can use ocean current to reduce energy consumption. Simulation results show that the improved algorithm can plan the optimal path of energy consumption.

articleTitle: BP neural network control of a host-parasitoid model with Hassell growth function
abstract: Chaos and its control in a host-parasitoid model with Hassell growth function are studied. The existence of chaotic attractors is verified by plotting Lyapunov exponents map and bifurcation diagram. The chaotic control problem is studied by using the extended BP neural network chaotic control method. Based on the BP neural network control principle, a controller is designed to stabilize the chaotic system to the fixed point and periodic tracks. The effectiveness of the designed controller is verified by Matlab numerical simulation, which provides a theoretical basis for eliminating population chaos, maintaining ecological stability and biodiversity, and provides a theoretical reference for the development of infectious disease model based on the parasite model.

articleTitle: Stabilization of linear systems with model uncertainty and external disturbance via UDE-based control method
abstract: The stabilization problem of the linear system with both uncertainty and external disturbance is studied. Firstly, a suitable filter is designed for the unbounded external disturbance which exponentially increases with respect to time. Secondly, some uncertainty and disturbance estimator (UDE)-based controllers are presented to realize the stabilization of such system. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the obtained results are verified by two illustrative examples with numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Optimal Control for Complex Systems
abstract: In this article, the adaptive optimal control problem for a class of switched nonlinear systems with Bouc-Wen hysteresis input is investigated. By establishing an actor-critic (AC) dual networks architecture, the solution of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation can be approximately obtained. Then, an adaptive AC optimal controller is designed, in which the actor and critic updating laws are synchronously tuned, rather than tuned sequentially. Based on the Lyapunov extension theorem, All signals of the closed-loop system are proved to be bounded in the sense of uniformly ultimate boundedness (UUB). Finally, the efficacy of the proposed optimal control method is demonstrated via a practical inverted pendulum system.

articleTitle: Design of Temperature Monitoring System for Gas Fired Boiler Flue Gas Waste Heat Utilization
abstract: PLC and touch screen are used to adjust the hot water temperature at the outlet of flue gas heat exchanger in the flue gas waste heat utilization monitoring system. The hardware composition and working principle of the control system based on S7 1200 PLC and MCGS configuration software are introduced. The PLC program design and MCGS configuration software design key points for realizing temperature PID adjustment are given. The monitoring system can realize dynamic monitoring through MCGS configuration software and display the PID temperature setting value. The temperature acquisition and regulation can realize closed-loop control based on the function of the characteristics of high reliability and strong anti-interference ability of PLC, good openness and powerful interface display of configuration software.

articleTitle: Event-triggered H∞ filtering for discrete-time nonlinear stochastic systems with time-delay
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of event-triggered H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> filtering for a class of discrete-time nonlinear stochastic systems with delay and exogenous disturbances. The main objective of this study is to design an event-triggered H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> filter such that the filtering error system is robustly exponenttially mean-square stable with a given decay rate, and a prescribed H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> disturbance attenuation level is guaranteed. The event-based filter is constructed to reduce unnecessary data transmissions for some networked control systems with limited communication bandwidth, which only transmits and updates the measurement signal to the filter by the pre-defined event-triggered criteria. Based on stochastic differential equations theory and Lyapunov–Krasoviskii functional method, some sufficient conditions for the existence of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> filter are obtained for the suggested system by employing linear matrix inequality technique. Finally, a numerical example is given to demonstrate the design procedure and the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Adaptive-Siding-Mode Disturbance-Observer-Based Control for Mobile Wheeled Robot System
abstract: The disturbance and physical parameter uncertainties of mobile wheeled robot(MWR) system are an important research topic during the trajectory tracking task. An adaptive siding mode disturbance observer (ASMDO) for the MWR system trajectory tracking task is proposed in this paper. Based on this ASMDO, a matching silding mode control is designed. The The convergence of ASMDO is proved and the stability and accuracy of the designed silding mode control is achieved our control task goal. Finally, the effectiveness of proposed methods are varified by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Min-distance Bargaining Solution in Differential Game with Continuous Updating
abstract: In this article, we consider the bargaining solution, "Min-distance bargaining solution" in differential games with continuous updating case, and applied it in the differential game, present the algorithm, show the details in the resource extraction differential game model.

articleTitle: Robust Stabilization of Switched Linear Systems with Dynamic Switching Logic
abstract: In this study, the robust stabilization of discrete-time switched linear systems with switching signal being generated by a logic dynamic system(LDS) is investigated. The main technique used is to merge the logical state and continuous state by semi-tensor product(STP). We can check the robust stabilization of switched systems under dynamic logic switching by merged systems. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Rapid Analytical Calculation of Maximum Crossrange for Hypersonic Gliding Vehicles
abstract: According to lateral maneuver problem for hypersonic gliding vehicles, a novel analytical model of the crossrange is deduced and a rapid method to calculate lateral maximum range is proposed. The analytic solution to the lateral maneuver ability of the hypersonic glide vehicle is an extremely complex problem, because the lateral maneuver variables are heavily coupled with a lot of variables, such as the heading angle, aerodynamic forces, velocity, and other flight variables. First, the non-dimensional centroid dynamic and kinematical equations of the hypersonic vehicle are established, the optimal bank angle with respect to maximum crossrange is obtained by taking the second derivative of latitude. Second, the analytical model for calculating heading angle is deduced and the analytical expression of the lateral maneuver range is described. A rapid calculating method of the maximum crossrange is provided based on the quasi-equilibrium glide condition and extremum principle. Finally, the numerical simulation results with respect to newly proposed analytical method are compared with the maximum lateral range generated by Gauss pseudospectral method, the validity of the new method is completed.

articleTitle: Adaptive Load Swing Angle State Constraint Control for Bridge Crane Systems
abstract: The problems of parametric uncertainties and load swing angle safety in industrial bridge crane systems are investigated via an adaptive angle constraint control method. This controller is designed based on system energy. It consists of an adaptive control law and a state-constrained auxiliary function. The method can guarantee that the underactuated load is always within a certain safe angle range, and the load mass and rope length can be estimated online by system response. Lyapunov-based analysis is utilized to prove asymptotic stability of the closed-loop system's equilibrium point. Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed method has better control performance.

articleTitle: Constrained attitude stabilization for rigid spacecraft with two internal torques using artificial potential function
abstract: This paper proposes a control algorithm for stabilizing an underactuated spacecraft with attitude-forbidden constraints. An unactuated axis of the angular velocity is determined by solving the dynamic equation under the assumption of zero angular momentum and relaxed into an inequality constraint of the Euler axis to identify the feasible attitude region for the underactuated system. Moreover, the forbidden pointing regions are established as cones in the inertial space inaccessible to the spacecraft attitude. Then, an artificial potential function- based control law is proposed to evade the hazardous zones while stabilizing the underactuated system to equilibrium. It is shown that the closed-loop system converges to the largest invariant set of the set of critical points by the LaSalle invariant set theorem. Finally, numerical simulations are conducted to corroborate the effectiveness and performance of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Resilient event-triggered control for Markov jump system under state constraint and denial-of-service attacks
abstract: This paper investigates the resilient event-triggered control for Markov jump system under state constraint and denial-of-service attacks. A mode-dependent controller is designed to guarantee the stability of the closed-loop system under periodic denial-of-service attacks. Resilient event-triggered scheme is adopted to reduce unnecessary data transmission and save communication resources. For a given sequence of periodic denial-of-service attacks, a closed-loop Markov jump system model is established under state constraints and denial-of-service attacks. The stability of the system is analyzed, the controller gain and resilient event-triggered parameters are designed. It shows that the system can tolerate the data loss caused by denial-of-service attacks, and resilient event-triggered scheme can effectively reduce the communication burden and timely update transmission data. Finally, a simulation example is given to verify effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Robust time-varying Kalman predictor for descriptor system with random one-step measurement delay and multiplicative noise
abstract: For the linear stochastic descriptor system with random one-step measurement delay and multiplicative noise, the robust prediction problem is addressed. Applying the singular value decomposition (SVD) method, augmented state approach and the fictitious noise approach, the original descriptor system is transformed to new standard system only with uncertain-variance fictitious noises. Based on Kalman filtering and minimax robust estimation principle, the robust time-varying Kalman predictor is presented by replacing the unrealization conservative measurement by the actual measurement in the conservative Kalman predictor. Further, the robustness is proved by the Lyapunov equation approach, i.e., the actual estimation error variance are guaranteed to have minimal upper bounds for all admissible uncertainties. A simulation example about circuits system verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Optimal Guaranteed Cost Controller Design for Uncertain Discrete Switched Singular Systems
