abstract: The design method of proportional-derivative state feedback (PDSF) guaranteed cost controllers (GCCs) is studied for discrete switched singular systems with uncertainties in the derivative matrices by introducing a generalized cost function. Some sufficient conditions, which can guarantee the existence of GCCs, are obtained by using the multiple Lyapunov function method, and state-dependent switching laws are designed. By introducing some appropriate free-weighting matrices and constructing appropriate transformation matrices, a synchronous design method is proposed to design the gains of PDSF-GCCs. A numerical example is given to demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: RET operators constructed by operators with annihilator
abstract: In the paper, the construction of relevancy transformation operators by means of S−nullnorm and T−nullnorm is studied. By comparing with the nullnorm case, we find that there is no N−pseudo duality about itself for the constructed relevancy transformation operators.

articleTitle: CEEMDAN and Informer Based Model for Aero-Engine Parameter Prediction
abstract: Predicting the parameter values of an aero-engine is beneficial to detect abnormal states in advance. Most existing methods directly predict the original parameters without adopting mode decomposition. This paper proposes a mode decomposition based fusion parameter prediction model, which can capture the transformation law of the raw signal and enjoy improved prediction accuracy. To this end, we utilize complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) to decompose the raw time series data (N1r) to obtain multiple distinct mode components and residual signals. The complexity of each component is evaluated by fuzzy entropy, and the components with similar complexity are fused to reduce the input dimension of the prediction part. Informer is used to predict the fusion components, and the summation method is used to fuse each component to obtain the predicted value of N1r. Finally, the efficiency of the fusion model and the original Informer are verified over an engine’s flight log data. The results show that the proposed mode decomposition based fusion parameter prediction model has better performance than Informer.

articleTitle: Design optimization study of cooling tower in circulating cooling water system of iron and steel industry
abstract: During steel production, a significant amount of waste heat is generated which is typically removed through a circulating cooling water system. However, this process consumes substantial amounts of both energy and water. To tackle this issue, this article proposes a solution that involves selecting the optimal equipment types for cooling towers and determining the best operating parameters. By utilizing an optimization model and GA-DE nested algorithm, the proposed method can reduce overall system investment and operating costs, leading to improved economic efficiency for businesses. Simulation results show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Lorenz system with unbounded external disturbance by DE-based control method
abstract: The stabilization problem of Lorenz system with unbounded external disturbance is investigated in this paper. Firstly, a suitable filter is proposed for the disturbance of polynomial type. Secondly, a disturbance estimator (DE)-based controller is designed and used to realize the stabilization of such system. Finally, the correctness and validity of the obtained theoretical results are verified by the computer simulation.

articleTitle: Research on the Modulation Strategy of a Gradationally Controlled Modular Multilevel Converter
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) has been widely used in HVDC transmission due to many outstanding advantages such as high degree of modularization and easy cascade expansion, but with the increase in the number of sub-modules (SM) connected in series on one bridge arm, the hardware cost rises and the device switching-loss increases, which restricts its development to a certain extent. In this paper, the idea of gradationally controlled inverter is combined with traditional MMC, the topology and working principle of a gradationally controlled MMC are analyzed, a stepwise nearest level modulation (NLM) strategy is proposed, and a simulation model of gradationally controlled MMC system is built on the Matlab/Simulink software platform to verify the feasibility of the stepwise modulation strategy in controlling output voltage levels on the AC side. According to the simulation results, it is proved that the application of gradationally controlled MMC can improve the output voltage waveform quality, reduce the switching frequency and lessen the system hardware cost in high-voltage and high-power occasions such as wind power generation and HVDC transmission.

articleTitle: Research on Hydrodynamic Modeling and Simulation of Streamlined Autonomous Underwater Vehicle based on CFD Method
abstract: This paper proposes a novel computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation method and applies it to solve the main hydrodynamic coefficients of a streamlined autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs). The steady-state solution method is combined with the small-amplitude unsteady solution method to solve the viscous and inertial hydrodynamic coefficients of the AUV, respectively. The steady-state motion of the AUV is simulated in Star CCM+ for each degree of freedom of direct and rotational motion at different velocities and angular velocities, and the velocity and drag data are curve-fitted using least squares to solve the main linear and nonlinear AUVs Viscous hydrodynamic coefficient. In Star CCM+, the unsteady motion of small amplitude pure heave, sway, surge, and yaw motion of AUV is simulated by the method of combining dynamic and static meshes. The periodic curves of the time and drag data were fitted in MATLAB using a Fourier series to obtain the main inertial hydrodynamic coefficients of the AUV by separating the fundamental term from the results. The hydrodynamic coefficients obtained from the simulation are compared with the main hydrodynamic coefficients calculated in FLUENT to verify the feasibility of the CFD calculation method proposed.

articleTitle: Research on multiple coordination contracts of three-level supply chain under the background of carbon trading
abstract: Based on the background of carbon trading policy, considering consumers' low-carbon preference and price sensitive factors, a three-level supply chain master-slave game model under the multi coordination contract mode is constructed. The decision-making and the factors affecting the decision-making when there are multiple contracts in the low-carbon supply chain are analyzed, and the impact of carbon trading on the multi coordination contract is investigated. The research shows that: (1) The profit of distributors and retailers increases first and then decreases with the increase of cost sharing ratio and revenue sharing ratio. Both of them have an optimal contract critical value to maximize the profit, and there is a cross influence relationship between the two critical values; (2) The executors of multiple coordination contracts can grab higher profits from each other's efforts, and there is an economic phenomenon of "free riding". (3) The price of carbon emission rights will have an impact on the formulation of multiple contracts. The higher the price of carbon emission rights, the stronger the enthusiasm of distributors to share emission reduction costs and retailers to share profits, and the enthusiasm of retailers to share profits is more sensitive to the price of carbon emission rights.

articleTitle: BoxNet: Fine-grained Action Classification in Boxing
abstract: The skeleton data is widely used in general action recognition since it is robustly distinguish the action operator and complex background. When it comes to more fine-grained scenario like those in sports competitions, such characteristic of skeleton data could further enlarge differences of actions among varied classes and reduce negative effects from background to achieve better recognition result. However, the problem of coarse video record which severely deteriorate the validity of neural network is still to be solved. In this work, we present an improved graph convolutional network(GCN) methods of fine-grained technical action classification based on previous works, where early fusion and parameterized adjacency matrix are also adopted. An interpolation method is firstly applied in action classification to elevate the performance of networks with coarse input. Moreover, a new dataset about boxing established for fine-grained action classification task. Our model is verified on NTU-RGB+D and tested on established boxing dataset, and exceeds common GCN methods.

articleTitle: Combined Binocular Vision and IMU Navigation Algorithm Based on Nonlinear Optimization
abstract: To address the problem that multiple interfering factors join the optimization process and lead to large errors in the optimization results, a nonlinear optimization algorithm based on the Cauchy robust kernel function is proposed to directly reduce the weight of interfering factors in the optimization solution model, and the fusion of binocular camera and IMU data is performed by the Dog-Leg algorithm. Simulation results show that the algorithm has significant advantages in localization and navigation accuracy in complex environments by comparing with ROVIO and VINS-Mono in two aspects of algorithm accuracy and algorithm performance, as well as reducing the time complexity and space complexity of the algorithm and improving the robustness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Discrete Markov-Based Topology Control of Star-Wireless Sensor Network for Lifetime Maximization
abstract: Star-wireless sensor network is the basic structure of most large-area wireless sensor network applications and is very important in many wireless sensor network applications. Its lifetime directly affects the performance of the network. To maximize the network lifetime, this paper proposes a topology control algorithm based on discrete Markov for star-wireless sensor networks. Based on discrete Markov theory, the node is divided into two states. The lifetime of the node is predicted by the number of transfers, and the topology control is carried out while the lifetime of the node is predicted. The simulation results show that this algorithm can improve the network lifetime.

articleTitle: Global Output Feedback Stabilization for Stochastic Nonlinear Time-delay Systems with Unknown Measurement Noise
abstract: This paper studies the problem of global output feedback stabilization for a class of stochastic nonlinear time-delay systems with unknown measurement noise, in which a dual-control method is introduced to explicitly design an output feedback controller. Then, using Lyapunov-Krasovskii functionals to deal with time-varying delays, it is verified that the proposed control law can guarantee the global asymptotic stability in probability of the closed-loop system. Finally, an actual simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Distributed Dual Gradient Tracking Method for Economic Dispatch Problem
abstract: In this paper, we focus on solving the economic dispatch problem (EDP) in the smart grid, which aims to minimize the total generation cost while ensuring the supply-demand coordination and generation capacity constraints. First, we develop a distributed optimization algorithm by employing the gradient tracking method. Different from most existing works, our proposed algorithm allows the objective function to be strongly convex only in the range of generation capacity constraint rather than in the whole interval. Then, we prove that the convergence rate of the proposed algorithm is $\mathcal{O}\left( {1/k} \right)$ with k being the number of iteration and becomes linear rate when the average value of optimization parameters for each agent falls into a closed interval. The closed interval consists of two endpoints, which are the minimum and the maximum gradients obtained from the cost function of all generations. Finally, numerical simulations are given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Simultaneous Localization and Mapping System for Intelligent Elderly Care Robot Based on Monocular Visual-Inertial-Encoder Fusion and ORB Feature Extraction
abstract: A Simultaneous Localization And Mapping (SLAM) system based on tightly coupled monocular Visual-Inertial-Encoder fusion and Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF (ORB) feature extraction, called SLAM-VIE-ORB, is proposed to solve the cost and security problems of intelligent elderly care robot. It aims at achieving localization accuracy high enough to ensure the safety of users - the elderly, while the cost is as low as possible to meet the needs of promotion in the field of intelligent elderly care robot service as the application of the most basic localization technology. Experiments under indoor and outdoor real environments on Qiming 2 robot using the proposed system comparing with the lidar-based adaptive Monte Carlo localization (AMCL) and VINS-Mono show that the localization error of SLAM-VIE-ORB is 80% of ACML and 50% of VINS-Mono, while the cost of the system is one fifth of AMCL which is used for traditional intelligent elderly care robot localization. The system for localization in the indoor static environment to help the elderly living alone will be put into use in the near future.

articleTitle: A YOLOv4-tiny Based Moving Object Detection Method for Embedded Vision System
abstract: YOLO nets have been widely used in the field of object detection,but the nets are designed for specific object detection in single image without motion information.They are difficult to be applied in embedded vision system directly to do the task of moving object detection.In this paper, combining the YOLO net and inter-frame motion detect,a fast moving object detection method is proposed for embedded vision system.First of all,YOLOv4-tiny is applied to detect objects in sequence images; then,by the the confirmation of inter-frame motion information,every detected object is judged to be moving object or not,the moving objects are saved as final result. Experiments show that the algorithm can detect moving objects in real time and accurately.

articleTitle: Design of Technical Architecture of Top-drive Equipment Fault Diagnosis System Based on Cloud Platform
abstract: Top-drive system (TDS) is a complex structure of mechanical, electrical and hydraulic integration drilling equipment, which is a high-tech equipment in modern drilling equipment. However, TDS in the process of drilling operation will inevitably have faults, which has high requirements for maintenance personnel. Shortening maintenance cycle, reducing cost and improving operation efficiency have become an important problem for engineering and technical personnel. In this paper, a new fault diagnosis method is proposed based on the current harmonic characteristics to diagnose the deterioration state of equipment. According to the deterioration degree, a prognotics and health management system (PHM) is designed based on the concept of predictive maintenance (PdM), which can truly prevent the failure before it occurs. The designed PHM has been applied to the top-drive device and achieved preliminary results, which lays a foundation for further research and can support the realization of predictive maintenance and health management of the top-drive device.

articleTitle: A Smooth Five-axis Transformation Function in CNC System
abstract: Five-axis machine tool is the equipment of manufacturing high precision workpieces such as turbine blades in aviation fields. In industrial motion controller, after G-code interpreter recognize and interpret motion commands, before interpolation and trajectory planning, cartesian space instructions are processed via forward transformation to generate cutter location data. In this paper, a smooth five-axis transformation function is proposed and put into practical use in CNC system. Because of the non-linear relationship between axis space and programming space in 5-axis machine, vibrations occur during converting smooth interpolation data into axis motion, actuator space is not smooth. Based on the existing RTCP function, a method of converting interpolated data into axis motion is proposed, to generate continuous velocity in actuator space. By calculating the nonlinear mapping relationship between the axis space and the programming space of the five-axis machine tool, and then calculate the scaling factor, the speed of the axis space is calculated, so as to ensure smooth and continuous speed in axis space. Through actual machining of typical "S" specimens, it is verified the method in this paper can meet surface finish requirements.

articleTitle: Event-triggered output regulation bumpless transfer control for discrete-time switched systems under DoS
abstract: This paper studies the output regulation bumpless transfer control for event-triggered discrete-time switched systems under denial-of-service (DoS) attacks. For switched systems subject to DoS, both the sensor signal and switching signal may be blocked. To satisfy the bumpless transfer (BT) performance, we cannot use the common input zeroing method. The problem that the triggering error being attacked may not follow the triggering condition arises. Moreover, the controller mode may be asynchronous with the plant mode. Faced with the above two problems, we design an event-triggered dynamic error feedback controller and a switching law to guarantee that the output regulation problem for switched systems is solvable, and the BT performance can be satisfied. Then, corresponding sufficient conditions are proposed in the form of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the validity of our results.

articleTitle: Extended Sliding Mode Observer-Based Adaptive Nonlinear Feedback Control of Electrical-optical Gyro-stabilized Platform
abstract: In order to address the state constraints of three-axis electrical-optical gyro-stabilized platform (TEOGSP) with the unknown disturbances, a nonlinear adaptive feedback control with an extended sliding mode observer (ANCESO) has been proposed. To further handle the unmeasurable signal and the external disturbances, the extended sliding mode observer (ESMDO) is constructed via integrating adaptive nonlinear feedback tracking control design, which has better transient behavior of the estimations. An improved prescribed performance function is developed for the TEOGSP systems with error constraint, and the tracking error is ensured within a prescribed region. The tracking differentiator (TD) design in adaptive nonlinear feedback tracking control is introduced here to estimate the derivative of the virtual control and to avoid the ‘explosion of complexity’ problem, respectively. By integrating the fundamentally different working mechanisms of the approaches, the developed ANCESO strategy is able to preserve the theoretical performance results of both design approaches while overcoming their practical performance limitations. Extensive comparative simulation results are obtained to verify high performance nature of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Prediction of Active Cases of COVID-19 Based on small-scale-KNN-LSTM
abstract: Anomalies in vaccine data are often encountered when projecting the active cases in Africa. This issue could severely impact the accuracy of expected active case, thereby affecting future government intervention protection policies etc. In this paper, a new method to accurately predict active cases considering anomalies is presented. Firstly, an autoencoder is used to detect the vaccine anomalies, Then, in order to impute missing values in the complete African vaccination data a small-scale k nearest neighbor (ssKNN) with upper and lower bounds is developed. As an extension of K-nearest neighbor interpolation, ssKNN could guarantee the interpolation quality and efficiency by limiting the filling range. To be specific, the upper and lower bounds of missing values are found based on the proposed method, and then the missing values could be filled according to the upper and lower bounds as well as the Euclidean distance. Then, the transmission rate β is estimated using long short-term memory (LSTM), which is an essential parameter in a classical mechanistic model for projecting the number of future active cases. Finally, the effectiveness of proposed method is verified on dataset of 15 worst-affected countries by COVID-19 epidemic in Africa demonstrating its efficacy in prediction of active cases of COVID-19 with vaccine anomalies.

articleTitle: Non-singular fast terminal -sliding mode control of PMSM with novel approach law
abstract: To enhance fast starting and smooth switching of a permanent magnet synchronous motor, this paper proposes nonsingular fast terminal sliding mode control for PMSM speed control based on an improved exponential reaching law. Firstly, the improved exponential reaching law self-adapts the gain of the sliding mode switching function to balance the system's fast dynamic response and chattering control. Secondly, we adopt an Anti-reset Windup strategy to solve the controller's saturation problem. This strategy can effectively reduce overshoot without affecting accuracy. Finally, Lyapunov stability theory proves that this system can make the speed tracking error converge to zero in finite time.The experimental findings demonstrate that the motor can start rapidly, reach the reference speed without overshooting, and react swiftly to sudden loads with slight speed drops and quick recovery. When compared with conventional PI and sliding mode control, this approach has the advantages of high steady-state tracking accuracy while also weakening chattering, enhancing response time, and reducing the system's steady-state error.

Author Keywords: Nonsingular fast terminal sliding mode control

articleTitle: Anti-saturation Sliding Mode Control with Preassigned settling Time for Hypersonic Aircraft
abstract: In this paper, a model of the attitude control system for a second-order hypersonic aircraft with uncertainty is presented, and an adaptive anti-saturation sliding mode control law is designed to make the attitude angle error of the aircraft reach the specified accuracy within the preassigned settling time. The adaptive law is designed to estimate the upper bound of system interference and the sliding mode use saturation function instead of sign function to decrease the chattering phenomenon. In addition, the desaturation auxiliary system in the control system is designed. When the control input is saturated, it can quickly exit from saturation. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the control law can meet the above control requirements and has good robustness. Compared with the control law without auxiliary system, the control input can exit saturation more quickly.

articleTitle: Defect Detection Method of Trash Trap Based on Deep Learning Semantic Segmentation
abstract: Due to the fact that the image information of trash trap is usually collected underwater, the quality of the image is low, which affects the reliability of the results of trash trap defect detection. Therefore, a trash trap defect detection method based on deep learning semantic segmentation is proposed. The threshold segmentation in semantic segmentation is used to realize the division of the target part and the background part, and the valley gray value between the corresponding wave peak in the mesh rope area and the corresponding wave peak in the mesh area is taken as the segmentation threshold value. When the gray value of the pixel in the trash net bag image is less than the threshold value, its gray value is set to 0, otherwise it is set to 255, so as to realize the segmentation of the target image. The convolution neural network in deep learning is used to recognize and detect the segmented target image. After the convolution neural network is preprocessed by Xavier initialization, the segmented target image of the trash trap is propagated forward in the convolution neural network to extract the characteristics of the image, which is normalized by softmax, and then the corresponding defects are identified by back propagation. In the comparison test results, regarding the detection of the defects of the trash trap, the design method witnesses the error rate of lower than 15.00%, the accuracy rate of more than 85.00%, the effective detection rate of more than 85.00%, and the maximum value of 95.00%, which is significantly better than the comparison method.

articleTitle: Operation Monitoring and Optimization of Industrial Boiler Based on Improved PCA
abstract: An operation monitoring and optimization method based on cross-segmented principal component analysis (PCA) is proposed to improve the energy efficiency level of industrial boilers. Firstly, the boiler operation data is divided into different modes according to the load using the modal identification values. Historical data with high thermal efficiency is chosen in each model to construct the principal component model. The operating condition of the boiler is monitored using the multi-mode cross-over method. Then, the boiler’s operation condition is tested. When it deviates significantly from the high energy efficiency condition, contribution plots are used to determine the factors that lead to this condition. Finally, the operator is guided to carry out targeted operations to optimize the boiler operation process. The practical application in an industrial boiler shows that this method can effectively identify the boiler’s operation condition, detect the specific factors, and significantly improve the energy efficiency level of the boiler.

articleTitle: UAV Relay Altitude Optimization Strategy for Minimizing Outage Probability
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) has been widely used in wireless communication systems because of their mobility and flexibility. In this paper, we consider an UAV relay system to assist wireless transmission from the base station to the user. Different from ground communication, the UAV communication channel is an air-to-ground channel, and its line-of-sight (DoS) transmission component is larger. For the UAV air-to-ground channel model, we consider both large-scale fading and small-scale fading. The large-scale fading adopts the probabilistic DoS channel model, and the small-scale fading adopts the Rician fading model. In order to improve the UAV communication performance, we propose a relay altitude optimization strategy based on the minimization of outage probability, and derive the approximate expression of the optimal altitude. Simulation results illustrate that the altitude optimized algorithm proposed in this paper can greatly decrease the system outage probability.

articleTitle: A practical method for robot navigation in variable indoor scenes
abstract: When a robot works in variable indoor scenes where the position of the objects around it change dynamically, its navigation module should not only estimate its own location, but also sense the changes of the objects. The traditional navigation method of navigation based on pre-set navigation goals may fail to guide the robot to the target position. To solve this problem, this paper designs a practical method based on visual detection in indoor variable scenes. First, we employ the lightweight CNN model SSDLite-MobileNetv2 to identify the dynamic objects in the environment. Then, we use Semi-Global Block Matching algorithm to measure the relative position of the objects. Finally, we insert the position of the objects into the grid map constructed by Laser SLAM. By this map with object’s positions, the robot can be guided to its target through path planning algorithm. The proposed method is Integrated into the navigation module of a physical robot, experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed navigation method.

articleTitle: UAV target tracking algorithm based on kernel correlation filter
abstract: Three improvements are made to address the traditional kernel correlation filtering algorithm in terms of poor robustness of single features, unsound scale update and model update mechanism: first, by studying the focus of each feature, the directional gradient feature (HOG), color feature (CN) and edge feature (EDGE) are fused, and a feature with stronger discriminative ability can be obtained; second, the scale pyramid principle is used for scale changing targets for adaptive tracking; finally, a combination of average peak correlation energy (APCE) and maximum response is used to propose a template update method with adaptive learning rate, so that the algorithm has higher robustness in the face of occlusion and thus improves the tracking accuracy of targets. Finally, the algorithm comparison experiments are conducted on the UAV123 dataset. The results show that compared with the traditional algorithm, the improved algorithm has significantly enhanced target discrimination, scale perception and anti-interference ability, and can effectively cope with the common challenges in UAV tracking process.

articleTitle: Intelligent Optimization Control for Air Starting Systems Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent optimization control method based on deep reinforcement learning is proposed for air starting systems of altitude test facility. A deep Q-network (DQN) controller with self-learning capability is employed to effectively improve the dynamic and steady-state performance of the air starting system under pressure and flow disturbances. Key design methods including state space selection, action output and reward function design are studied and given. Simulation results show that compared with PID control, the designed controller can realize no overshoot adjustment of the intake pressure under constant or variable operating conditions, and the adjustment time is shorter. The results verify the rapidity, stability and robustness of the proposed intelligent optimization control method.

articleTitle: Improved Euclidean clustering point cloud segmentation algorithm based on curvature constraint
abstract: In response to the problem that the traditional segmentation algorithm is not ideal for segmenting point cloud data in parts with large changes in geometric features and complex shapes, a curvature constraint-based Euclidean clustering algorithm is proposed. This method first calculates the curvature information corresponding to each point according to the spatial coordinate information of the point cloud, then redefines the improved Euclidean distance between the point clouds according to the coordinates and curvature, and finally performs the clustering segmentation according to the comparison relationship between this distance and the set search radius. The experimental results show that this method achieves the fine segmentation of point cloud data at the parts with complex geometric features, and can be applied to point cloud data with different degrees of variation in geometric features by adjusting the curvature constraint parameters, which is of positive significance for target identification, feature description and surface reconstruction.

articleTitle: TripleGAN: Multi-Adversarial Network Domain Adaptation for Satellite Image Segmentation
abstract: Satellite image segmentation has become an important auxiliary tool for decision-making in various fields, including city planning, building extraction, traffic control, and environmental protection. However, for satellite images, there is a significant challenge that the datasets are often small and lacked of label. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework called the Triple Generative Adaptive Networks (TripleGAN), which employs domain adaptation to transfer models from labeled datasets to unlabeled ones.TripleGAN is a deep neural network consisting of one segmentation module and three discriminators to reduce the domain gap between labeled and unlabeled datasets. By jointly training three GANs, our model achieves a significantly better performance in handling different data distributions. In experiments on IS-PRS public datasets, TripleGAN outperforms the state-of-the-art model, demonstrating its advantages and providing a promising multi adversarial learning scheme for future researches.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of Reconfigurable Quadrotors with Rotational Deformation
abstract: Quadrotors has been an useful research platform for decades, reconfigurable quadrotors opens a thoroughly challenging field for scientific research and engineering applications. This paper presents a quadrotors reconfiguration model through rotational deformation, then the mathematical model of this reconfiguration is proposed, and control laws based on sliding mode control theory is presented, and simulation model is constructed under MATLAB environment, finally the simulation results validate the proposed control laws.

articleTitle: New type of Lyapunov–Krasovskii functional method on stability of uncertain stochastic systems with time delay
abstract: This paper presents a new kind of Lyapunov–Krasovskii functional method for investigating the asymptotic stability of uncertain stochastic systems with time delay. Two resulting delay-dependent asymptotic stability conditions in the form of linear matrix inequalities are given. The feasibility of the new methods has been proved by theory and simulation.

articleTitle: An RGB-T Object Tracking Method for Solving Camera Motion Based on Correlation Filter
abstract: The RGB-T tracking based on correlation filter frame is widely studied because of its high efficiency in most complex scenes. However, the performance of these trackers is limited when facing some specific challenges, such as camera motion and background clutter. This paper focuses on how to solve the camera motion in the framework of correlation filter. First, given the input infrared and RGB images, we extract different features and use multi-expert systems to select the experts, and then conduct decision fusion tracking. Secondly, we first design a feature matching algorithm to locate the target that shows excellent performance. Comprehensive experimental results show that the proposed tracker has better performance in both accuracy and robustness. Our results on VOT-RGBT2019 dataset also demonstrate that it solves the common camera motion challenges in RGB-T tracking.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis of Pumping Based on DWR-VGG
abstract: Rod-pumping is still the primary means of lifting technology for crude oil extraction, and the acquisition and analysis of dynamometer card is the critical link for detecting, preventing, and solving various faults in the production process, and the automatic classification identification and fault diagnosis of dynamometer cards using artificial intelligence methods has been the focus of research. We propose a DWR-VGG network model for the intelligent diagnosis of oil well pumping machine faults in this paper by applying deepwise separable convolution and residual learning techniques to the VGG network model with inter-layer deletion and structural adjustment, which improves the effective extraction of contour features from the dynamometer card while compressing network model computation. The engineering experimental results show that the DWR-VGG model effectively reduces model training time while maintaining high fault diagnosis accuracy, and compared with other classical convolutional neural networks, it not only has the highest fault classification accuracy and higher diagnosis efficiency, smaller weight space, easy to deploy in mobile and embedded devices, and better model reliability and adaptability in actual oilfield production provides a new technical solution for oil pumping unit fault diagnosis in real-time.

articleTitle: Subspace learning based classification of ADHD patients
abstract: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) can seriously affect children’s development. Effective diagnosis of ADHD is widely concerned, but accurate diagnosis is still a challenge. In this paper, we propose a classification method based on the subspace learning. Specifically, the corresponding control subspace and patient subspace are learned according to subspace metrics of the control group and the patient group, and linear regression constraints are used to learn the most important and distinctive information. In the learned subspace, subjects have greater energy in the corresponding subspace. Compared with several advanced machine learning methods, our method shows significant classification performance, with an accuracy rate of 94.6% in the ADHD-200 database.

articleTitle: Finite-time output-feedback control design for a class of nonlinear time-delay systems*
abstract: This study investigates the practical finite-time output feedback control for a class of nonlinear time-delay systems. The observer is first constructed to estimate the unmeasurable states. By combining finite-time Lyapunov stability theory with the backstepping design, a fuzzy adaptive practical finite-time control strategy is proposed. Together with an appropriate Lyapunov-Krasoviskii functional, the stability of the closed-loop system is proved, which means that the closed-loop system is semi-global practical finite-time stability. Finally, one example is provided to demonstrate the validity of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Relay Selection Scheme with Optimal Bit Error Rate in Simultaneous Wireless Information and Power Transfer System
abstract: In this paper, a relay selection scheme is proposed to solve the problems of high bit error rate (BER) and poor adaptive ability in simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) system. In this scheme, the relay adopts the hybrid decode amplify and forward (HDAF) mode, the amplify-and-forward (AF) mode and decode-and-forward (DF) mode are selected according to the signal-to-noise-ratio (SNR) of the received signal to improve the transmission quality of the signal. In order to ensure the relay energy allocation while reducing the system bit error rate, a joint optimization function based on the constraints of bit error rate, relay mode and energy allocation factor is constructed. Then, the optimization function is solved by the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm, and the optimal relay and power splitting (PS) factor are obtained to achieve the optimization of the system's bit error rate. Finally, the results of simulation experiments prove that the PSO algorithm can effectively jump out of the local optimal solution. Compared with a single relay strategy, the relay selection scheme can reduce the bit error rate of the system.

Author Keywords: simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT)

articleTitle: Kinematic Control for Redundant Manipulators with Remote Center of Motion Constraint based on Neural Network
abstract: In this paper, a dynamic neural network-based kinematic controller is proposed for redundant manipulators under the remote center of motion (RCM). The constraint of RCM is built into an equality constraint and is then written as an augmented equality constraint together with the end-trajectory tracking mechanism. Considering physical limitations such as joint angles and velocities, the kinematic control problem is established as a dynamic programming system, and then a dynamic neural network-based controller is built to obtain the control command recurrently in real-time. Numerical experiments show the effectiveness of the proposed controller in both static and dynamic RCM situations.

articleTitle: State-of-Charge Estimation of Lithium Battery Based on Deep Residual Shrinkage Networks and a Variant Long Short Term Memory Neural Network
abstract: Accurate state-of-charge (SOC) estimation, which is critical to ensuring the safe and reliable operation of battery management systems in electric vehicles, is still a challenging task due to sophisticated battery dynamics and ever-changing ambient conditions. This paper proposes a method combining DRSN and ASTLSTM neural networks to estimate lithium batteries' state of charge (SOC). The proposed method can not only utilize the historical information of the data but also eliminate unimportant features by inserting soft thresholding into the deep architectures. To reveal the performance of the proposed method, the results are compared with several other methods from the literature. The comparative experimental results show that the proposed method achieves a lower root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.83% with normal data and RMSE of 0.98% with noisy data, respectively.

articleTitle: Turing Instability and Hopf Bifurcation Analysis for Malicious Virus Propagation in Cyber Physical Systems with Time Delays and Diffusion
abstract: In order to investigate the propagation mechanism of malicious virus in cyber-physical systems (CPS), this paper proposes a class of SIR malicious virus model depicted by patrial differential equations. In particular, we introduce nonlinear incidence and diffusion terms into the model so as to be more relevant to the reality. We choose the time delay as the bifurcation parameter. In the analysis, the local stability of the system is determined firstly. Then, the condition of appearances of Turing instability induced by diffusion and the criterion of Hopf bifurcation induced by time delay are obtained, respectively. Finally, several numerical simulations are used to verify the correctness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of stochastic scalar Markovian jump systems with sample switching and state signals
abstract: This paper investigates the stability of scalar stochastic Markovian jump systems with sampled switching and state signals. The analysis of the system is complicated and difficult due to the fact that both states and modes are sampled. In order to clearly analyse these factors, a comparison method based on the solution of auxiliary functions is proposed to solve the problem of sampling both modes and states. Some novel amplification techniques are also proposed to finally establish the linear inequalities conditions. A numerical example is used to illustrate the effectiveness and superiority of these methods.

articleTitle: Study on steelmaking-continuous casting scheduling problem with considering limited buffer and preventive maintenance
abstract: According to the characteristics of steelmaking continuous casting production process, a model of SCC production scheduling problem with limited buffer and flexible maintenance constraints was established. A hybrid optimization algorithm based on Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithms (NSGA) and artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm was designed. The improved hybrid algorithm uses the way of updating the solution in the ABC algorithm, using the external set to retain the individuals searched from the neighborhood to ensure that the best individuals are not lost, and introducing the operation of cross-variance in the non-dominated set to improve the search performance of the algorithm. Finally, five groups of production data with different scales are designed. The experimental results show that the hybrid improved algorithm is better than NSGA-II algorithm and ABC algorithm.

articleTitle: Tracking Assisted LiDAR Target Detection Method During Rainy and Foggy Weather
abstract: When intelligent vehicles drive in rainy and foggy weather, the LiDAR results in false detection of targets frequently because the laser beam emitted by the sensor is easily reflected by raindrops or fog to form noise points. In order to improve the targets detection effect of LiDAR during rainy and foggy weather, a tracking assisted LiDAR target detection method is proposed. By the method, the target's motion state at last moment is considered as prior information to assist target detection at the current instant. Firstly, the radius filter is used to preprocess the point cloud data acquired by the LiDAR to filter most of the rain and fog noise points in the air, and then the point clouds are clustered to obtain the target measurement set. Then a one-step prediction is generated based on the motion state of the known target at the last moment, and the tracking gate of each target is calculated. Finally, the trust degree of the target in the measurement set is calculated by the point cloud density of the target and its intersection with the tracking gate, so the credible target can be screened out according to the trust level and the false target caused by rain and fog can be distinguished also. Experimental results show that proposed method can effectively improve the accuracy of LiDAR target detection in rainy and foggy weather and reduce the false alarm rate.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control of Electrically Excited Synchronous Motor Based on Pseudo Random High Frequency Signal Injection at Low-Speed Region
abstract: Nowadays, the cascaded H-bridge inverter-based high-voltage electrically excited synchronous motor (EESM) drive system has been widely used in the many industry fields. To reduce the hardware cost and improve the dynamic performance at the low-speed region, the field-oriented control (FOC)-based sensorless drive strategy is investigated in this work. At the low-speed region, a pseudo random high-frequency signal injection method is proposed to detect the rotor position and the speed for EESM drives. In details, a pre-designed pseudo high-frequency voltage is injected to the d-axis reference voltage. Then, a high-frequency mathematical model of EESM is established for the current response analysis. By using the dq- axis current response, the rotor position information can be extracted for low-speed operation. As compared to the conventional high-frequency signal injection, the noise pollution is mitigated by using random signal injection method. In simulation-based case studies, the effectiveness of noise mitigation and rotor position estimation for low-speed operation are verified.

articleTitle: Sound Event Detection via Conformer Recurrent Neural Networks
abstract: Sound Event Detection (SED) is a critical subject in machine listening that aims to mimic the capacity of the human auditory system. Recently, convolutional recurrent neural networks (CRNN) have attained state-of-the-art SED performance. Local time-frequency information of audio are extracted using the convolution module in CRNN. However, global information cannot be obtained due to the size of the convolution kernel. Convolution module is replaced with conformer block module for the shortcoming, which combines the advantages of transformer and convolutional neural networks to successfully describe the local and global interdependence of audio sequences. When compared to CNN, RNN, and CRNN models using the TUT-SED 2017 dataset, the proposed method can improve F1-score by 9.86% and reduce ER by 0.1235 in the development dataset and improve F1-score by 9.13% and reduce ER by 0.0836 in the evaluation dataset. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Vector map drawing method for path planning in automatic driving
abstract: Vector map is an important part of path planning. As an open source autopilot software, Autoware provides a learning platform for autopilot practitioners. However, the drawing process of vector maps tends to be commercialized,at the same time, the drawing of vector maps requires manual point drawing based on 3D point cloud maps and takes a lot of time. On the basis of the autoware autopilot software platform, this paper designs a network connected online tool AutoCar, which optimizes the drawing and loading process of vector map in path planning. The experimental results show that under the condition of using traditional methods to complete the same global path planning, the path completion time and cost of this paper are greatly reduced, and the accuracy and convenience are also steadily improved.

articleTitle: Robust Sampled-Data Control for Uncertain Markov Jumping Parabolic PDE Systems
abstract: This paper introduces a robust sampled-data (SD) control for uncertain parabolic partial differential equation (PDE) system with Markov jumping parameters (MJPs). In control engineering, in order to fully utilize the advantages of digital technology and handle the uncertainties in the system, a mode-dependent robust SD control strategy presented by linear matrix inequality (LMI) based conditions is given on basis of an appropriate Lyapunov functional, which can ensure the stochastically exponential stability of closed-loop Markov jumping parabolic PDE SD control system. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of Power Communication Network Security Management System
abstract: The maintenance of electric power communication network is beneficial to ensure the economical, stable and safe operation of power grid. It is urgent to continuously ensure the security of electric communication network. Therefore, this paper designs the security management system of electric communication network. Firstly, it introduces the current operation situation and risk of electric communication network, and then explains the goal and strategy of electric communication network security according to the current situation. Finally, the system technical structure design, system logic architecture design and network security risk assessment model of the power communication network security management system are carried out. The design of the whole system can meet the requirements of the power grid for the safety of the power communication network. Supplemented by algorithm technologies such as data mining and artificial intelligence, it can realize the prediction and accurate positioning of the safety problems of the power communication network.

articleTitle: Robust Attitude Controller Designation of Launch Vehicle under Actuator Failure Condition via Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
abstract: This paper focuses on the robust and adaptive attitude control algorithm of the launch vehicle under the condition of the thrust drop failure of the attitude control nozzle during the flight process. To solve this problem, we build a three-channel end to end attitude controller with TD3 (Twin-delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient) reinforcement learning algorithm which performs outstanding on solving the problems of continuous action space reinforcement learning. The simulation results indicate that the attitude controller designed with the algorithm can automatically adapt to the thrust drop condition of the launch vehicle nozzle and quickly adjust the output of the actuator to correct the attitude control error. This method shows strong adaptability and robustness to the fault conditions and can be used as a potential algorithm in solving the problem of controller reconfiguration under the fault conditions of the launch vehicle.

Author Keywords: thrust drop failure of attitude control nozzle
end to end and decouple free

articleTitle: Optimal Time-Varying Formation Tracking Control for Second-Order Swarm Systems Based on LQR Method
abstract: This paper deals with optimal time-varying formation tracking control problems for second-order swarm systems, where the formation tracking performance as well as the energy consumption are considered. First, an objective optimization function integrated tracking performance index, collaborative energy consumption index and tracking energy consumption index is proposed to impose restriction on the design of the controller. Afterwards, by establishing the formation tracking error differential equation of the swarm system and taking a non-singular transformation, it turns into a linear quadratic regulator (LQR) optimal control problem. Hence, the optimal controller is obtained by solving Riccati equation, where the controller only requires that the communication topology of the swarm system is undirected and connected, and the specific minimum value of the objective optimization function is subsequently derived. At last, a numerical simulation example is constructed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the optimal controller.

articleTitle: Secure State Estimation for Cyber-Physical Systems with Actuator Attacks
abstract: This manuscript investigates the problem of secure state estimation for cyber-physical systems subjected to actuator attacks. Using multi-input multi-output continuous-time linear system modeling, two different state observers are proposed for attacked system state and unattacked system state. Firstly, a Luenberger state observer is proposed, which can effectively observe the unattacked state of the system. Then, based on the multivariable super-twisting sliding mode algorithm, a sliding mode state observer is designed to estimate the system state and attack signal under actuator attacks, and the method can make the system achieve bounded stability. Finally, simulation experiments verify the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Feature learning of nonlinear process fault detection detection based on SRB-SCAE
abstract: In recent years, fault detection and diagnosis methods based on deep learning have attracted more and more attention. In this paper, a fault monitoring method for sparse convolution autoencoder based on selective residual blocks(SRB-SCAE) is proposed. First, the sparse AE can obtain the sparse representation of the data, and the convolution AE can be used to extract the temporal features between the processed data. Secondly, the selective residual block can increase the attention to jump connection to improve the training accuracy. In addition, the reconstruction error between input and output is used as a statistic and the control limit is determined by kernel density estimation. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of this method are verified in Tennessee-Eastman benchmark process.

articleTitle: Multi label feature selection for copper flotation process design
abstract: The copper flotation process design is a multi label learning. Before multi label classification and regression, label-specific features for each label need to be selected from the original features. This paper puts forward a multi label feature selection (MLFS) based on domain knowledge and label correlation. In the proposed MLFS, the domain knowledge function applies the knowledge of copper flotation in feature selection, and the label correlation function introduces the Kullback Leibler divergence between labels in feature selection. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed MLFS has superiority over benchmark multi label feature selection algorithms in the copper flotation backbone process design.

articleTitle: Distributed Vehicle Platoon Tracking Control for Optimal Energy Consumption with Switching Topologies
abstract: This paper investigates the distributed platoon tracking control problem for a group of nonlinear vehicles. The optimal energy consumption and switching communication topologies are both taken into consideration. In order to reach the optimal performance, an optimization framework is developed involving the switching topologies. Then, according to the neighboring vehicles’ states, a distributed platoon control scheme is proposed with two control parameters. The first control parameter is to deal with the switching topologies and the other one can optimize the energy consumption. Moreover, the stability conditions of our proposed platoon control system and the average dwell time for the switching topologies are both provided. In final, numerical simulations are provided to illustrate the effectiveness and advantages of our proposed approach.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of discrete-time systems with constrained delays
abstract: This paper addresses the asymptotic stability issue of discrete-time multiple time-varying delays systems with given delay digraph. By using the switching transformation approach, the discrete-time system with multiple time-varying delays is transformed into an equivalent switched system. Different delays correspond to the different switching signals, and the stability analysis of the delay system is turned into that of a switched system. It is the first time that switched homogeneous Lyapunov function approach is applied to constrained delay systems. A sufficient condition is established to check the stability of the considered system, and the monotonicity property of the condition is provided. Finally, an example is listed to illustrate the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Constrained H∞ control for the reaction-diffusion systems with spatiotemporal uncertainty
abstract: In this paper, an LMI-based H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control is proposed for a class of reaction-diffusion systems subject to the actuator saturation and spatiotemporal uncertainty. Based on the Lyapunov’s direct method, a sufficient condition is initially derived to stabilize the original closed-loop system. Subsequently, the distributed and boundary-based H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control is obtained in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) to give a tradeoff between actuator saturation and anti-disturbance performance. Then, a recursive algorithm is explicitly presented by combining the LMI optimization technology and spatial difference method. Finally, a comparison simulation study is performed to illustrate the effectiveness of proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Construction Vehicle Detection Method Based on Multi-Scale Residual Network
abstract: In the process of urbanization, construction vehicles such as cranes pose a significant threat to the safe operation of overhead transmission lines. It is helpful to reduce the risk of lines by collecting images in the construction area through cameras, monitors, and other equipment, and detecting the construction vehicle targets that may pose a threat in real-time. Aiming at the problems of large scale variation and poor detection accuracy of construction vehicles, a multi-scale residual construction vehicle detection network (MSRCVD-Net) is designed based on the residual network. By introducing a hierarchical residual connection structure into the residual blocks in the feature extraction network, the model can express coded multi-scale features at a more refined level, enhance the receptive field range of each network layer, and improve the feature extraction capability. In addition, by adding a receptive field enhancement network after the feature extraction network, the problem of information loss caused by the network in the process of sampling under feature extraction is alleviated, and the detection capability of construction vehicles is further improved. The experiment shows that the MAP value of MSRCVD-Net is 71.8%. The effect of detection is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Short Interval Replay Attack Detection for Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems Based on Wavelet Coherence
abstract: Most of existing data-driven methods for industrial Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs) replay attacks detection require an obvious difference between the replayed historical data and real current data. However, for short interval replay attacks, attackers replay data to the system instantly after they finish recording measurements, making it difficult to distinguish the normal data from the attacked data according to the slight variation of distance index. In this paper, we propose a coherence-based, which is between sensor measurements and control signals, detection scheme against short interval replay attacks. We first compute wavelet coherence between measurements and control signals. Two sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test is employed to detect replay attacks according to the mean values of wavelet coherence between measurements and control signals. To deal with the noise of measurements, wavelet denoise is used to improve the detection performance. Simulation tests are demonstrated on a semi-physical simulation testbed. The experimental results illustrate that the proposed method can accurately detect not only short interval replay attacks but also long interval continuous replay attacks and intermittent replay attacks.

articleTitle: Planning of an industrial process microgrid powered entirely by renewable energy sources
abstract: The development of industry has been constrained by its massive energy demands. However, the massive curtailment of renewable energy (RE) means an enormous amount of electricity is in a crisis of being wasted. Therefore, this article proposes a framework for an industrial process microgrid (IPMG) powered entirely by RE to help deal with the two issues. In addition, a two-stage scheduling-planning model is designed to search for the optimal economic planning solution for the IPMG, which includes both the electricity storage station (ESS) establishment cost and RE usage rate. Finally, several cases demonstrate the necessity of establishing the IPMG powered entirely by RE.

articleTitle: An Improved NSGA-III Algorithm for Optimal Power Dispatch with Power Flow Constraints
abstract: Optimal power dispatching for power systems is a non-linear, non-convex and non-smooth optimization problem with multiple competing objective functions and non-linear constraints. In this paper, an improved NSGA-III algorithm is proposed to solve the power optimisation scheduling problem for power systems. The algorithm utilizes a differential evolutionary selection variation strategy to enhance convergence and diversity. In addition, a hybrid multi-constraint processing mechanism is proposed to enhance the exploration capability. The results of the method on an IEEE 30-bus system are compared with other operators. The simulation results show the superiority and feasibility of the improved NSGA-III algorithm in solving the power optimization scheduling problem for power systems.

articleTitle: A Multi-dimensional Evaluation Criterion Scheme for Autonomous Vehicles: Behavioral Performance
abstract: Autonomous driving (AD) is an enhancement or replacement for human drivers, while AD has brought a huge challenge to automotive testing and evaluation (T&E) technologies. As AD replaces drivers’ perception, decision-making and control, the T&E procedure for autonomous vehicles (AVs) changes from independent T&E of human-vehicle binary to integrated T&E of human-vehicle systems. Complex weather, traffic and electromagnet environments under open-road testing make a quantitative T&E of AVs very difficult. To solve this problem, in this paper, we propose a multi-dimensional evaluation criterion scheme for AVs, in which behavioral performance is the highlight. Specifically, The criterion framework of behavioral performance consists of five dimensions: safety, efficiency, comfort, intelligence and reliability. Then, a scenario-based evaluation approach is realized by the formal approach, i.e., linear temporal logic (LTL). The proposed evaluation criterion scheme is verified by a typical scenario in China GB and implemented by simulations based on the SCANeR studio software.

articleTitle: Research on health management and intelligent analysis method for aircraft power supply system
abstract: The PHM technology and intelligent analysis method for the aircraft power supply system Based on the AMESim simulation model are studied, and for the shortcomings of the existing fault diagnosis system that does not meet the real-time test requirements of the function and performance of the power supply PHM technology in the airborne environment, A power supply system PHM semi-physical real-time simulation verification platform is developed to realize the engineering application of power supply system PHM technology. The platform can be used to simulate the dynamic change process of the typical working state of the power supply system from normal to fault, the change process of multiple interface signals is synchronized, the real simulation system fault process, and the flexible matching of fault modes and associated signals can be realized. The number and types of characteristic signals are adjusted as needed, and the system is universal.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control of Aeroengines Based on Safe Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: An aeroengine is a complex multivariable control system with strong nonlinearities and high requirements for safety. It is necessary to optimize the control performance on the premise of ensuring safety. Classical control methods and modern control methods often need accurate mathematical models. It is difficult to design a controller to realize steady-state and transient control at the same time, resulting in difficulty in improving safety and optimization at the same time. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes an aeroengine intelligent control design mothed based on the safety deep reinforcement learning and control barrier functions. The proposed safety intelligent control can ensure that the aeroengine is strictly within the safety range during both steady-state and transient control under a single safety intelligent controller. Finally, the simulation shows that this method can realize the safe and intelligent control of an aeroengine for both steady-state and transient control and greatly improve the performances in transient behavior and disturbance rejection.

articleTitle: An Improved Discrete Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm for Steelmaking and Continuous Casting Scheduling Problem
abstract: Steelmaking-continuous casting (SCC) is the core link of the whole process of steel production. Therefore, this paper investigates a real-world hybrid flowshop scheduling problem in steelmaking process, in which the sojourn time, the earliness/tardiness of cast starting and the makespan are taken as the objective functions. Further, the mathematical model for this issue is established. An improved discrete artificial bee colony algorithm (IDABC) is presented to efficiently handle this issue. In the proposed algorithm, a neighborhood search strategy based on multiple block exchange is developed to improve the searching abilities. The IDABC algorithm is evaluated using a sample of the real SCC scheduling system, and numerical analysis is used to confirm the technique's efficacy. The experimental findings demonstrate that the presented IDABC method provides a better performance by comparing with other four efficient algorithms.

articleTitle: A Recursive Algorithm for Performance Analysis of Complex Stochastic Behavior Tree
abstract: Behavior trees are increasingly widely used for task descriptions, due to their advantages in modularity and reactivity. The performance analysis of behavior trees plays an important role in quantitative evaluations of tasks. When analyzing behavior tree performance using the theory of stochastic behavior tree, one of the most important steps is converting the stochastic behavior tree to corresponding Markov chain. However, when faced with complex behavior trees, the manual conversion is time consuming and err-prone. In this paper, we proposed a recursive algorithm which can convert arbitrarily complex scale and structure behavior tree to corresponding Markov chain, and record the corresponding transfer matrix. On this basis, key performance indicators such as success probability and failure probability can be calculated. This algorithm provides an operable method for performance analysis of complex stochastic behavior trees.

articleTitle: A continuous state transition algorithm with guaranteed optimality
abstract: As a constructivism-based intelligent optimization method, the state transition algorithm (STA) has exhibited powerful search ability in optimization. However, in basic STA, it usually sets the maximum number of iterations or function evaluations as the termination condition by experience. If the termination condition is not set well, it may stop at an unpredictable point. In this study, a continuous STA with guaranteed optimality is proposed by altering the termination conditions of the basic STA, without using the maximum number of iterations or function evaluations. It is proved that the modified STA can find a final solution with guaranteed optimality. Experimental results have testified the findings.

articleTitle: Stability and Interaction Analysis of PMSG-based Wind Farms Connected with LCC-HVDC
abstract: The small-signal stability of a system connected with wind turbines (WTs) and line-commutated converter based high voltage direct current (LCC-HVDC) is a significant problem. Meanwhile, interactions among LCC-HVDC and WTs are considered to be the key factors leading to the instability. This paper analyzes the interactions among 2 permanent-magnet-synchronous-generator (PMSG)-based WTs and LCC-HVDC utilizing the interaction quantification method based on the self-stabilizing and en-stabilizing functions. By carefully considering the particular characteristics of the current source converter of LCC-HVDC, this paper proposes a small-signal model of such a system and calculates the transfer functions reflecting different interactions among different devices. Two case studies are presented to show different effect of the interactions and the control parameters on the system stability.

articleTitle: HierNet: Hierarchical Transformer U-Shape Network for RGB-D Salient Object Detection
abstract: With the popularity of depth sensors, research on RGB-D salient object detection (SOD) is also thriving. However, given the limitations of the external environment and the sensor itself, depth information is often less credible. To meet this challenge, existing models often purify the depth information using complex convolution and pooling operations. This causes a large amount of useful information besides noise to be dropped as well, and multi-modality interaction chances between RGB and depth become less. Also, with the gradual loss of information, the hidden relationship of features between multi-level is thus ignored. To tackle the aforementioned problems, we propose a Hierarchical Transformer U-Shape Network (HierNet) that include three aspects: 1) With a simple structure, a depth calibration module provides faithful depth information with minimal loss of information, providing conditions for cross-modality cross-layer information interaction; 2) With multi-head attention, a set of global view-based transformer encoders are employed to find the potential coherence between RGB and depth modalities. With weight sharing, several transformer encoder sets comprise the hierarchical transformer embedding module to search long-range dependencies cross-level; 3) Considering the complementary features of U-shape network, we use dual-stream U-shape network as our backbone. Extensive fair experiments on four challenging datasets have demonstrated the outstanding performance of the proposed model compared to state-of-the-art models.

articleTitle: Complex Multistep Manipulator Planning Algorithm Based on Improved UOF
abstract: The manipulator is challenging to perform multistep tasks, such as block stacking. Universal Option Framework (UOF) has a high success rate in completing multistep tasks. The Deep Deterministic Policy Gradients (DDPG) algorithm based on Hindsight Experience Replay (HER) in UOF trains low-level policy. However, it has a low success rate, long convergence time, and low training efficiency for complex tasks. To solve the above problems, this article proposes the UOF algorithm for improved DDPG and the UOF algorithm for improved HER. The improved DDPG algorithm suggests the soft double estimation softmax operator based on UOF and introduces it into the DDPG algorithm. By improving the deviation of the DDPG algorithm, the success rate of complex tasks is increased, and the task convergence time is significantly shortened; By introducing curiosity and proximity into the improved HER algorithm, the failure experience of each learning stage is effectively utilized to solve further the sparse reward problem, which significantly enhances the training efficiency and the success rate of complex tasks. Experiments on block stacking tasks show that the improved method can effectively complete complex tasks.

articleTitle: Trajectory optimization of multistage launch vehicle based on an improved differential evolution-pseudo spectral method
abstract: This paper studies the orbital flight phase trajectory optimization of multistage launch vehicle based on an improved differential evolution (DE)-pseudo spectral method(PSM). PSM is a classic method which solves the trajectory optimization problem with a high precision and a fast convergence under the condition of good initial guess. However, the free motion of launch vehicle in the sliding phase usually causes bad initial state which will greatly affect the convergence and accuracy of PSM. To solve the problem, DE algorithm is adopted by employing its high search ability. Firstly, the cost function of the optimization problem is adjusted for the orbital flight phase which make it more suitable for the requirements of orbital elements. The adaptive operator of the mutation process in DE is adjusted to avoid falling into local optimum, and the fitness function is improved with the orbital elements. Then PSM shows the advantages of high accuracy and good convergence with good initial guess searched by DE. By comparing the simulation results, it is verified that the proposed algorithm can improve the accuracy of the launch vehicle in the orbital flight phase.

articleTitle: Joint Decision of Information Disclosure and Channel Encroachment Based on Online Review
abstract: With the continuous development of the Internet, there are more and more ways for consumers to post comments. Online comments have a significant impact on consumers' purchasing decisions. Information disclosure has become a means for enterprises to control market information. On this basis, we also consider the decision of channel encroachment and study the equilibrium outcome of the two strategies. With the richness of comments and the improvement of social learning intensity, the motivation of manufacturers to disclose information is weakening, while the motivation of channel encroachment is increasing. When the manufacturer does not disclose the quality information, the encroachment threshold is greater than the quality information disclosure. That is, information disclosure can encourage the manufacturer to encroach on the market, and encroachment can expand manufacturers' market size and gain more profits through disclosure. Hence, the interaction between intrusion and disclosure improves the transparency of the whole supply chain. Also, we obtain the equilibrium decision under the influence of consumers' quality preference, cost, authentic quality, and other factors.

articleTitle: A Mixed-traffic Car-Following Model Considering Cooperation Efficiency
abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristics of connected vehicles (CVs) and human-driven vehicles (HDVs), and considers the cooperative driving of CVs with the preceding vehicle. On this basis, a general vehicle following model is proposed, and the stability of mixed flow system is discussed. Through simulation experiments, the effects of collaboration efficiency and penetration rate (PR) on the stability of mixed flow system are analyzed, and the rationality of the proposed vehicle tracking (CF) model is verified.

articleTitle: Global attracting set and asymptotic behavior for a class of impulsive functional Hopfield neural networks by a novel vector inequality
abstract: This article is concerned with a class of nonlinear and nonautonomous functional Hopfield neural networks with impulsive effects. The existence of attracting set and invariant set of the desired impulsive differential equations is established. Firstly, we construct a novel vector inequality, which considers the features of M-matrix. Based on the more general vector inequality, we ensure the positive invariant set and global attracting set for a class of the impulsive functional differential equations. By means of numerical simulation, the effectiveness of our theoretical results is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Prediction of Boiler Heat-Conducting Oil Temperature Based on Multi-Modality Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
abstract: Accurate and interpretable time series prediction is of great significance in production, it can help people deal with boiler abnormalities timely and accurately, and provide guarantee for safe production. This paper proposes a time series prediction method based on multi-modality fuzzy cognitive maps with data preprocessing, which can soundly achieve the purpose. As the model is for solving practical problems, the experiment in paper uses real boiler data to improve objectivity. Firstly, the outliers in the dataset are replaced with reasonable data, then fuzzify the processed time series. Subsequently, the subsequences are chosen in the time series, and the fuzzy cognitive maps model is established on each subsequence. Finally, the model outputs of each subsequence are mixed as the prediction results and obtaining the forecast results. The experimental results contracted with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) show that the proposed model can well predict the changing trend of the actual industrial heat-conducting oil temperature of boiler.

articleTitle: Gyro Fault Detection under Strong Vibrations via Polynomial Nonlinear Filter
abstract: In this paper, the fault detection problem of gyro is developed for the rotary steerable drilling tool system (RSDTS), which is attributed to a nonlinear fault detection problem under high-frequency noise. First of all, considering the nonlinear characteristics of the system, RSDTS is modeled as a polynomial nonlinear system. Then a novel fault detection filter is constructed, and its parameters could be calculated by solving the parameter-dependent linear matrix inequality through the sum-of-squares decomposition method. Subsequently, the high-frequency noise with large amplitude caused by strong vibrations in the sensor measurements is cleared by the low-pass filter, so that the fault is not overwhelmed. Finally, a simulation is implemented to validate the feasibility as well as effectiveness of the proposed detection filter.

articleTitle: Observer-like State Augmented Model Reference Adaptive Robust Control of Fixed-wing UAV with Disturbances and Uncertainties
abstract: In this article, an observer-like state augmented model reference adaptive robust controller (OAMRARC) is proposed for fixed-wing UAV system with disturbances and uncertainties and inaccurate dynamic model. An output feedback controller is proposed to achieve the desired instruction tracking.
