Finally, experimental results show that cost-sensitive learning can effectively improve the recognition of collapsed columns.

articleTitle: Exploration of Smart Tunnel Solutions
abstract: Smart tunnel solution focuses on the development strategy requirements of digital transportation development plan, transportation power construction outline, comprehensive transportation three-dimensional planning, based on holographic perception, data mining, cloud platform analysis, mobile Internet and other advanced technologies, aiming at the safety, unimpeded, energy saving, operation and maintenance and other business needs involved in tunnel management, through all factor perception, all business management, all services and other measures, provides software and hardware integrated intelligent tunnel solutions. It breaks the barriers between businesses, realizes the effective integration of resources, resource sharing, business collaboration, strengthens data analysis, improves the ability to assist decision-making, builds a safe, reliable, convenient, efficient, green, intensive and intelligent advanced smart tunnel, realizes intelligent control, networking collaboration and digital services of the tunnel, and realizes the visibility, measurability, controllability and serviceability of tunnel operation.

articleTitle: Concentrate grade prediction using improved Transformer in zinc froth flotation process
abstract: Early and accurate prediction of concentrate grade is important for flotation process. Existing methods are usually insufficient to extract the time series information of flotation system, which cannot guarantee the accuracy and validity of zinc concentrate grade prediction. Therefore, we propose an improved Transformer model. First, we extract feature vector sequences from the froth video as input features to obtain the dynamic time information of the input data. Meanwhile, the position encoding module and decoder module are improved according to the characteristics of the flotation data. Then, we use the improved Transformer model to learn the internal rules of the sequences and the long-range correlation between the sequences to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the prediction. The method is validated on real flotation data, and the results show that the improved Transformer method outperforms other algorithms in terms of accuracy, while ensuring real-time performance.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Handling of Digital Twin Power Data Communication Network Based on GIS Geographic Information
abstract: With the continuous development of the power grid industry, the information network has been closely integrated with the production, management, operation, service and other work links of power grid enterprises. Digital twin technology can connect the real world and the virtual world. Establishing a digital twin model of power data communication can fully simulate the operation state of power data communication. Combined with GIS geographic information, Cooperating with the research of the project preamble can strongly support the fault handling of the power data communication network. This paper first introduces the digital twin technology and organically combines it with the power data communication network. Secondly, it studies the digital twin architecture of the power data communication network. Finally, through the combination of GIS geographic information and digital twin, on the basis of carrying capacity prediction, it can quickly locate fault information, deal with faults in time, and optimize the power data communication network.

articleTitle: Design of the Hardware-in-the-Loop Real-Time Simulation Platform for the Servo Control System of Leighton Chajnantor Telescope
abstract: The Caltech Submillimeter Observatory (CSO) telescope will be moved from Mauna Kea, Hawaii, to Chajnantor Plateau, Chile, in 2023, refurbished there and renamed as Leighton Chajnantor Telescope (LCT). LCT’s servo control system plays an important role in realizing the high pointing accuracy (1 arcsec) for submillimeter astronomical observations. Based on the hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation technology, this paper proposes a real-time simulation platform for the LCT’s servo control system, in which the Speedgoat target machine, the SimuCAT communication interface, the ARM-based controller, and MATLAB/Simulink-based simulation model are integrated seamlessly. Based on the real-time simulation platform, the servo control algorithm of LCT is implemented and its performance is evaluated.

articleTitle: Simultaneous input and state estimation for uncertain discrete-time stochastic systems
abstract: This paper investigates the simultaneous unknown input and state estimation (SUISE) problem for a class of uncertain linear discrete-time stochastic systems with unknown input. First, the augmented system is constructed with the aid of the input model, which is described as a random walk process with finite covariance. Next, a robust filter for the augmented system is proposed. Then, a new SUISE algorithm is obtained from the robust filter as the covariance of the input approaches infinity. Finally, a simulation example illustrates the proposed SUISE algorithm’s effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design of RBF Neural Network Based on Entropy and Sensitivity Analysis
abstract: Aiming at the problem of how to determine the hidden layer structure of radial basis function (RBF) neural network, an RBF neural network algorithm based on entropy and sensitivity analysis is proposed to optimize the network structure. Firstly, an entropy-based initial clustering is proposed to get the number and position of the initial clustering centers which serve as the input to the K-means algorithm. Secondly, a hidden node deletion method based on sensitivity analysis is proposed to analyze the weight and standard deviation between the hidden layer with the output layer, and the hidden nodes which have low contributions to the network will be removed. Simulation experiments on the nonlinear function approximation and the nonlinear dynamic system identification are set to verify the proposed method. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves stronger approximation ability and better identification effect than the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Feedback Stabilization of a class of Nonlinear Systems Using Nonlinear Normal Form
abstract: This paper investigates the design of a feedback controller via nonlinear normal form for a class of nonlinear systems. A general second-order nonlinear system affine in control is firstly presented. In general, it is more difficult to construct a nonlinear norm form, since the change of coordinates is achieved by solving the corresponding partial differential equations, which is more troublesome for an abstract nonlinear system. However, for the nonlinear affine system studied in this paper, a change of coordinates is found successfully and used to transform the nonlinear affine system into its nonlinear normal form, based on which the stabilizing state feedback control law and the Lyapunov function are obtained through a constructive design method. Then, this design approach is extended to stabilize nth-order nonlinear systems with a similar structure. Finally, the proposed controller is applied to control the second-order system, and simulation results show that the developed controller can effectively guarantees the stability of the closed loop system.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Multiple Model Algorithm based on Factor Graph for Integrated Navigation System
abstract: To solve the problem of poor positioning accuracy or sensors failure of the vehicle navigation system caused by the multipath effect in urban environments, an adaptive multiple model estimation algorithm based on the factor graph is proposed. In this article, the navigation information of multiple models is fused with the robust factor graph algorithm to achieve global positioning optimization. The weight of information fusion by multiple models is adjusted through adaptive factors to reduce the impact of the multipath effect and satellite failure, which improves the positioning accuracy of the integrated vehicle navigation system. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the positioning accuracy of vehicle navigation in complex urban environments. Compared with the traditional factor graph integrated navigation algorithm, the positioning accuracy of the proposed method in this paper is improved by more than 40%.

articleTitle: Passing method at unsignalized intersections for intelligent vehicle
abstract: Traffic congestion and accidents are prone to occurring at multi-lane unsignalized intersections during high traffic flow, and it is a challenge to automated vehicle also. To improve safety and passage efficiency, a passing method for connected automated vehicle (CAV) at unsignalized intersections is proposed. The solution can be divided to two stages, passing sequence decision and token-based resource reservation. Firstly, a decision method based on the optimal model of multi-lane queue is proposed. CAVs are stored in queue models, and the cost function is established based on three indicators, traffic efficiency, vehicle waiting time and static right-of-way priority, to evaluate each queue. Then the passing sequences of vehicles at the intersection are optimized by selecting the best queue continuously. Finally, the conflict areas are associated with tokens, and the token is preempted by the head vehicle of best queue by resource reservation in advance to lead the queue to pass through the intersection. The simulation results show that the scheme can effectively improve the traffic efficiency at intersections and reduce vehicle waiting time and queue length at medium or high traffic flows. In addition, the proposed method is also applicable to non-autonomous vehicles by providing assisted decision-making information to drivers to pass the unsignalized intersections.

articleTitle: Stackelberg games with dynamic spanning trees
abstract: This article considers a Stackelberg game with dynamic spanning trees. The leader will identify the edges between some of the followers, which will be shown in red. Then the followers will play a two-stage spanning tree game with "shock", which means that after the first stage, a specific follower will leave the game with a certain probability, which depends on the behavior of all the followers in the first stage. The equilibrium of the Stackelberg game with dynamic spanning tree is defined, and correlative conclusions are given.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation Based on Improved Wavelet Transform
abstract: In order to preserve the effective information of the image and segment it better, an image segmentation method based on improved wavelet transform is proposed. First, the image is decomposed based on wavelet transform to obtain the horizontal, vertical and diagonal information of the image. Then, the peak and valley points are determined by the decomposed wavelet coefficients, and the segmentation threshold is obtained. Finally, the experimental results show that the improved wavelet transform segmentation method proposed in this paper has better segmentation effect than the traditional segmentation method.

articleTitle: Research on Correlation Model of Diabetes Complications Based on CI-Apriori Algorithm
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of computer technology has made great progress in the field of smart health-care. Using data mining technology can obtain useful information in medical big data, discover the correlations among diseases and achieve the prevention and control of diseases. However, the traditional mining algorithms can no longer satisfy the demands of medical big data, it is an important direction of future research to improve and optimize the algorithms to make them applicable to the medical field. Based on this, this paper improves Apriori algorithm through parallel processing, matrix compression, and the introduction of lifting rate and interest. The optimized algorithm is called CI-Apriori, and an association rule model of diabetes complications based on CI-Apriori is proposed. The experimental results show that CI-Apriori has a great improvement in time and space efficiency, and can mine the strong association rules among diabetes complications faster and more effectively, so as to find the medical laws for the prevention and treatment of diseases.

articleTitle: Formation of Non-holonomic UAVs with Visual Constraints in Three Dimensional Space
abstract: This paper aims to propose a formation control strategy for multi UAVs with non-holonomic in three dimensions. The fish-eye cameras are installed on the UAVs for relative information obtain. For this purpose, each UAV is required to stay within the field of view of the neighboring cameras, which is regarded as the visual sensing constraints. Two cost functions related to the relative distances and relative angles are constructed to characterize the visual constraint performances between the UAVs. Then, the gradient-based control laws are derived for the UAVs for three dimensional formation with visual constraints. Moreover, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by both theoretical analysis and simulations.

articleTitle: Observer-based dynamic event-triggered control for autonomous underwater vehicle
abstract: In this paper, an observer-based dynamic event-triggered control scheme is designed for the tracking control of Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) with system uncertainties, external disturbances and limited communication. Firstly, a neural network extended state observer is designed to estimate the system uncertainties and external disturbances online. Then, a dynamic event-triggered controller is designed for the tracking control of the AUV to reduce the communication burden while also reducing the actuator wear and tear. Furthermore, the introduction of dynamic variables in the event-triggered mechanism can reduce the number of triggers. It is proved that all the signals in the closed-loop system are uniformly ultimately bounded, and the Zeno behavior is excluded. Finally, some simulations are demonstrated to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Research the Coordination of Supply Chain Considering Promotional Effort Based on Carbon Emissions Trading
abstract: This paper studies the coordination of supply chain in the context of carbon emissions trading mechanism, which considering the competition between retailers. Supply chain models were constructed to discuss the prices of products, the revenue-sharing contract was introduced to coordinate the supply chain, and the mechanism of contract coordination was given. Research shows that the carbon emissions trading reduce emissions effectively, but the higher cut down the total profit of supply chain. The competition upgrades the supply chain members¡ä profit. Coordination was achieved by introducing contract. Finally, numerical example was given to illustrate the validity of the revenue-sharing contract, and the sensitivity analysis of parameters such as the price of the emissions trading and the retailers¡¯ competition and were presented.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to MI-EEG Classification via 3D Interpolation and 3DCNN
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) contains rich information about brain activity. Classification based on motor imagery EEG (MI-EEG) is essential for active intelligent rehabilitation using brain-computer interface technology. However, most of the current MI-EEG decoding methods are dedicated to the study of efficient time-frequency feature extraction from the raw EEG, ignoring the spatial features associated with electrode distribution. Therefore, this paper proposed an MI-EEG classification method using a combination of three dimensional (3D) spatial interpolation and 3D convolutional neural network (3DCNN) to fully utilize the 3D spatial features of electrodes. First, the frequency transformation was applied to the EEG signal at each electrode using the fast Fourier transform and the energy value was obtained. Then, the 3D coordinates of the scalp electrodes were projected into the 3D space and the energy values were interpolated using the 3D interpolation method to generate a 3D feature image containing the 3D real spatial location information of the electrodes. Finally, a 3DCNN was designed to match the 3D feature image for feature extraction and recognition. The proposed method obtained 77.19% accuracy in the BCI Competition IV 2a dataset, which is higher than the existing decoding methods. Results from experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed MI-EEG classification method.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic power prediction Based on Backpropagation Neural Network with Honey Badger Algorithm
abstract: As a predictive algorithm, the backpropagation (BP) neural network has been applied for the power generation anticipation of photovoltaic systems, whereas forecast accuracy in practical applications has been a problem. Therefore, to resolve the problem mentioned above, a photovoltaic (PV) power generation forecast model based on integrating a backpropagation (BP) neural network and honey badger algorithm (HBA) is proposed. Solar irradiance and ambient temperature are utilized as the input parameters to the backpropagation neural network, and the historical power generation is the output expectation. At the same time, the honey badger algorithm is introduced in the structure optimization of the network. The experiment result manifests that the optimized backpropagation neural network model outperforms the traditional backpropagation neural network model in terms of forecast accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Data-driven Surrogate Modeling for Computational Fluid Dynamics in Simulating Spray Fluidized Bed Granulation
abstract: This paper presents a data-driven surrogate modeling methodology for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) to deliver a more accurate and efficient modeling for simulating segmented simulating spray fluidized bed granulation (SFBG) which fully considers the fluidization dynamics of being in actual production. Specifically, a data-driven surrogate model is developed for replacing the actual CFD simulations to calculate the time-varying fluidization parameters, and then integrating with a two-compartmental population balance model (TCPBM) to formulate a surrogate-assisted CFD-TCPBM coupled simulation modeling framework. The proposed surrogate-assisted methodology is illustrated by its application to a case study, in which the simulation results indicate the feasibility and effectiveness of surrogate-assisted CFD in simulating SFBG compared to actual CFD simulations. Therefore, one can conclude that the proposed methodology has great potential to deliver more accurate and realistic results in simulating SFBG of being in actual production.

articleTitle: Dynamic Event-Triggered Optimal Control for Linear Systems with State Observer
abstract: In this paper, we present a dynamic event-triggered optimal control method based on state observer for linear systems. Firstly, combining with the minimum principle in optimal control theory, we obtain the optimal feedback control law of the systems by setting the minimum performance index of system state and observer error states. Moreover, we propose a feedback system and observer error system under event-triggered control. Furthermore, a dynamic event-triggered control method is proposed by introducing an internal dynamic variable and the asymptotic stability of the two systems is guaranteed by conditions linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Finally, a simulation example shows the correctness and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Observer-based actuator fault detection for quadrotor UAV with experimental validation
abstract: This paper develops an observer-based actuator fault detection method for quadrotors with fault sensitivity. Firstly, a qLPV model of quadrotor UAV is established. Then an actuator fault detection method is designed. The pole assignment theory guarantees the transient response of the augmented system, and integrated H_/H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance theory is applied to enhance the sensitivity of residual signals to faults. Finally, online experiments based on the QDrone quadrotor platform are performed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: New results on fixed-time synchronization of two delayed complex networks with disturbance via periodically semi-intermittent control
abstract: The fixed-time synchronization issue of delayed drive-response complex dynamic networks is investigated in this paper. Not only hybrid delays but also external disturbance are included in the network model. An improved fixed-time stability lemma with tighter setting-time is introduced by means of intermediate value theorem. By employing periodically semi-intermittent controllers and using the vital lemma, some sufficient criteria ensuring fixed-time synchronization are derived. The settling-time only relates to the intermittent control ratio and network parameters. Finally, examples are performed to illustrate the validity of the method.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Edge Caching for Industrial Control Applications
abstract: To enhance the quality of service for field users in industrial control applications, a suitable caching strategy at edge servers is essential. This paper proposes a cache replacement strategy based on deep reinforcement learning. Status space, action space and reward function are defined considering the varying real-time requirements of the application files. The performance of the proposed algorithm is compared with baseline algorithms using user requests with dynamic popularities. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can effectively enhance the hit rate of control files while maintaining the overall cache hit rate, without sacrificing performance.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Anomaly Detection of Bridge Data Based on Improved Transformer
abstract: In the past, learning point-wise representations through recursive networks has been effective for addressing anomaly detection problems, but it has been difficult to extend to more complex temporal patterns. Transformer’s self-attention weights, on the other hand, can capture rich associations between each time point and the entire sequence. Because of the rarity of anomalies, it is difficult for anomalous points to establish associations with the entire sequence, but they tend to have close associations with neighboring regions.This difference can be leveraged to differentiate anomalies.By improving the self-attention module of the original Transformer model, we construct a Transformer model with dual-path modeling capability. Using the idea of anomaly detection based on association modeling, we perform anomaly detection on bridge data. The experimental results show that the precision reaches 91.5%. This detection method is effective in distinguishing anomalies.This paper takes the bridge of urban rail transportation in Wuhan as the background, with a large amount of data and a high demand for real-time support for the detection of numerous sensor data. After adopting the sparse attention mechanism, the time cost decreased by 10.7% while the precision did not decrease by about 1%. By combining deep learning with the time series database IoTDB, the ability to detect anomalies in time series data is improved, providing data protection for bridge safety assessment.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Fuel Leakage in Solid Oxide Fuel Cell System
abstract: Fuel cell technology is the fourth generation technology after hydropower, thermal power and nuclear power. Once the solid oxide fuel cell system fails, if it can't be found in time, the initial glitch may slowly evolve and spread to the subsequent components. Therefore, fault diagnosis is a prerequisite to ensure its stability. In order to diagnose fuel leakage fault of solid oxide fuel cell system, a decision tree is proposed to diagnose the fuel leakage fault of solid oxide fuel cell. Compared with other machine learning methods, it can be clearly observed that the decision tree method can effectively identify the severity of faults. This method can be extended to the fault diagnosis of air leakage.

articleTitle: Satellite Selection Method Based on Entropy Weight TOPSIS under Ionospheric Scintillation
abstract: Ionospheric scintillation degrades the positioning accuracy of GNSS receivers, different satellites suffer from scintillation of different intensities during the same time, satellite selection have to consider this anomaly. Hence, a satellite selection method based on entropy weight Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) is proposed. This method considers the variation of multiple characteristic parameters under ionospheric scintillation, calculate the comprehensive evaluation value of visible satellites and flexible selection of satellites for positioning not limited by a priori fixed number. Experimental results show that this method can reduce the error fluctuation, improve the positioning accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Server Cache Management Mechanism Based on Bayesian Probability and Comprehensive Value
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low hit ratio and increasing response delay caused by exponential growth of Internet users, a cache management mechanism suitable for server local cache is proposed. The Bayesian network is used to calculate the probability of data being accessed continuously, and the decision whether to cache data is made based on the probability. After the data is cached, the number of data being accessed within a unit time is counted to obtain the data activity. When the data in the cache area needs to be recovered, the Newton cooling law is used to calculate the proximity value of cached data to protect the new data. The CRITIC method is adopted to calculate the continuous access probability of cache data, the activity and the weight of adjacent value index, and the comprehensive value is obtained by linear weighting. When the cache area capacity is insufficient, the cache data with the comprehensive value lower will be removed. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional cache management mechanisms LFU and FIFO, the proposed cache management mechanism improves the cache hit ratio by 20.96% and 32.46%, respectively, and reduces the server response delay by 24.94% and 31.74%.

articleTitle: Research on Double Predictive Controller of Integral Objects
abstract: Pure lag objects are generally controlled by Smith predictive controllers to eliminate the adverse effects of dead time on control and improve the closed-loop response performance of the entire system. But when Smith predicts that the controller controls the integration plus pure lag process, the robust stability is poor, and the output has a static residual. This paper proposes a dual-predictive controller for the integral plus pure delay object. This kind of controller has two kinds of predictive PI controllers, inner loop and outer loop. The function of the inner loop is to stabilize the system, and the function of the outer loop is to eliminate the influence of input interference and improve the dynamic performance of the control system. The controller has a simple structure, fewer parameters to be adjusted, and convenient parameter adjustment. Simulation experiments show that this kind of controller still has good control performance in the case of interference and model mismatch.

articleTitle: Dynamic Mean-Variance Portfolio Selection with Return and Risk Predictability
abstract: We derive a semi-explicit solution to a multi-period mean-variance portfolio selection problem with return and risk predictability. Specifically, we assume that asset return and risk are predicted by a factor structure. The semi-explicit optimal portfolio policy is a linear function of current wealth level and the linear coefficients are characterized by a random process.

articleTitle: Energy management strategy based on CEEMDAN and fuzzy logic control for hybrid power system of ship
abstract: An energy management strategy (EMS) based on complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise(CEEMDAN) and fuzzy logic control is proposed for a multi-power hybrid system consisting of fuel cell (FC)/battery (BAT)/supercapacitor (SC) in a hydrogen powered ship. The EMS manages and controls the balance between different types of energy and load requirements to ensure system stability and reliability. CEEMDAN is used to decompose the demand power signal of ship. The CEEMDAN filtering order is set according to the significant difference between the energy of the low and high frequency intrinsic mode functions (IMF). The filtering order is adjusted in accordance with the limits required for the FC output power fluctuation rate. The low frequency power demand component that meets the volatility requirements is allocated to the FC and the high frequency component is shared by BAT and SC. The real-time state of charge (SOC) of BAT and SC is judged and further optimized by fuzzy logic control to prevent SC from over-charging and over-discharging. The simulation results prove that the proposed EMS can ensure the FC output power is in a reasonable range while stabilizing the SOC of BAT and SC in the appropriate interval, therefore improving the lifetime of the hybrid system.

Author Keywords: Complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN)

articleTitle: GIB-RRT: a gamma interpolation bidirectional RRT algorithm
abstract: In a complex environment, when B-RRT and RRT* algorithms are used for path planning, there will be problems such as long planned paths, large number of iterations, low sampling efficiency and long search time. To solve these problems, this paper proposes a gamma interpolation bidirectional RRT algorithm––GIB-RRT. First, the algorithm uses a bidirectional search strategy to expand two random trees simultaneously to speed up the convergence speed. In the expansion process, an adaptive goal biasing strategy is introduced to improve the sampling efficiency, and the probability of expansion to the respective target point is continuously changed according to the number of collision detection failures. After the initial path is obtained, a greedy pruning algorithm is used to simplify the path points and reduce the path cost. An optimisation method of Gamma interpolation is then devised for the simplified path and combined with cubic uniform B-spline curve to generate shorter and smoothly executable path. The proposed algorithm is compared with B-RRT*, IB-RRT* and B-RRT in different complex environments in simulation experiment, and the results show that the proposed algorithm has better search efficiency and is able to obtain optimal path in the least time and with the most stable efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on improved aero-engine Min-Max controller method based on coordination function
abstract: In order to improve the deficiencies of the existing aero-engine Min-Max controller, this paper proposes a safety margin-based coordination function to change the thrust control loop controller's gain to improve the fan speed's response speed in the transition state of the aero-engine. The basic idea is to introduce the coordination function based on the safety margin without changing the structure of the Min-Max controller, and use the coordination function to guide each controller to change the control signal to control the current operating state. Simulation results show that the method effectively reduces the possibility of the transition state violating the safety boundary and improves the limiting protection performance of the aero-engine Min-Max controller.

articleTitle: Multi-Sensor Localization for End-to-End Logistic Robots Across Indoor and Outdoor Areas
abstract: Logistics robots are becoming increasingly necessary for practical scenarios such as logistics terminal distribution and goods transportation within campuses or factories. These robots must be able to provide end-to-end delivery services in indoor and outdoor settings, including cross-floor environments. However, single-sensor localization methods are insufficient for such complex environments. To address this, we propose a multi-sensor localization method that fuses encoders, IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit), lidar, camera, and GPS measurements using EKF(Extended Kalman Filter) and AMCL(Adaptive Monte Carlo Localization) algorithm. Additionally, we introduce a map structure and management method to support end-to-end robots operating in a campus. Our approach has successfully solved the localization challenges of logistics robots in the campus environments discussed in this paper, demonstrating advantages over existing localization methods.

articleTitle: Disturbance-Observer-based Fast Terminal Sliding Mode Control for Quadrotor UAVs
abstract: External disturbance and parametric perturbation are two adverse factors threatening the flight safety of quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). To address this issue, a disturbance observer based fast terminal sliding mode control with adaptive reaching law is proposed in this paper. The designed adaptive reaching law can suppress the overshoot of UAV state variables. Furthermore, the disturbance observer can compensate for the external disturbance and parametric perturbation to enhance the anti-disturbance capability of UAVs for accurate trajectory tracking. The stability of the UAV control system is proved by the Lyapunov stability theory. Simulation results show that the proposed controller has good robustness against external disturbances and parametric perturbations during trajectory tracking scenarios.

articleTitle: An adjustment distributed method for Route Planning of Space Exploration Task
abstract: Aerospace missions are usually accomplished with limited resources and time, and important to use time and resources wisely. With limited resources and time, it is very complicated to complete aerospace exploration missions, such as target classification missions, object tracking missions, target collection, space junk cleanup. Reasonable route planning is the basis for completing aerospace exploration missions. We are unable to complete aerospace exploration missions at once, and need two or more times to complete, or the total cost is too large, which will waste a lot of time and cost. Heuristic optimization algorithms are often used to solve path planning problems, while generated inefficient route, and require more time and costs. Therefore, in this paper, we propose an adjustment distributed algorithm (ADM) to address the limitations of heuristic optimization algorithms and save cost of time and cost, and obtain more reasonable routes. Experimental results show that our algorithm has better route planning capability with lower total cost.

articleTitle: Robust fault estimation for Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy systems with interval nonlinear state time-varying delay
abstract: The research object of this paper is a nonlinear interval time-varying time-delay system with external disturbances, actuator and sensor faults based on T-S fuzzy model. A proportional integral observer is constructed to estimate the state, actuator and sensor faults simultaneously. Then, the Lyapunov function is constructed to analyze the stability of the system, and the delay dependent conclusion described by linear matrix inequality is obtained. The upper and lower bounds of interval time-varying delay are considered, which greatly reduces the conservatism of the conclusion, and the effect of fault estimation will be more accurate. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a simulation example, that is, the designed observer can realize the simultaneous estimation of actuator and sensor faults, and meet the given H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance index of the system.

articleTitle: Target Detection Method of Apple Harvesting Robot Based on Improved YOLO v5
abstract: A target detection method for picking robot based on depth-separable convolution YOLO v5 is proposed. After the apple sample image was collected and the experimental data set was made, model training and testing were carried out. The deep separable convolution YOLO v5 network was introduced to extract features from the apple image, which solved the problem of parameter redundancy in the network and improved the recognition speed of the picking robot. The CIoU-Loss function and DIoU-NMS non-maximum suppression method were used to optimize the loss function and improve the positioning accuracy of the robot vision system on Apple.

articleTitle: Research on optimal configuration method of thermoelectric decoupling system with heat storage
abstract: To improve the flexible adjustment ability of the system and expand the consumption space of new energy is an important issue to be solved in the construction of new power system with new energy as the main body. In this paper, the principle and necessity of thermoelectric decoupling are discussed, the main technical route of thermoelectric decoupling is sorted out, the technical characteristics of molten salt heat storage and electric boiler heat storage are analyzed, and the typical design scheme of thermoelectric unit decoupling transformation is proposed. To evaluate the regulation potential and new energy consumption space of thermoelectric units under the typical scheme of thermoelectric decoupling transformation; Compare and analyze the economy of different reformation measures of thermoelectric decoupling technology.

articleTitle: Fractional order internal model control strategy for inverse response time delay process
abstract: A double-loop control structure based on IMC is proposed for the inverse response time delay process. In order to suppress the input of the interference signals, an anti-interference controller is provided in the inner loop, in the form of proportional derivative. The internal model controller of the outer loop adopts fractional order form, it is used to track the set-points. The parameters tuning of PD controller is obtained from the Routh-Hurwitz stability criteria and the Maximum sensitivity function. The proposed control structure includes four adjustable parameters, they are proportional parameter, derivative parameter, the adjustable time parameter and fractional order parameter of the low-pass filter. Through a large number of simulations, an adjustable range of four adjustable parameters are given. The performance of the proposed structure is assessed using ISE, IAE, and ITAE. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method has good performance in both set-point tracking and anti-interference. Compared to other methods it has better control performance.

articleTitle: Text Classification for Fault Knowledge Graph Construction Based on CNN-BiLSTM
abstract: In order to make full use of fault historical text data, knowledge graph is used to assist fault diagnosis. Text classification, a fundamental method for constructing knowledge graph, is prone to the overfitting issue when dealing with sparse and small sample data such as fault domain data. Therefore, an integrated neural network model based on CNN-BiLSTM (convolutional neural networks and bidirectional long and short-term memory networks) is proposed in this paper. In this model, CNN layers extract local semantic features while BiLSTM layers integrate contextual semantic information. Then, adversarial training and attention mechanism are introduced to enhance model performance and prevent overfitting. The proposed method is verified on two datasets, general text data set THUCNews and bearing fault dataset. Comparative experiments reveal that the model can push text classification accuracy in the bearing fault domain to 90%, thereby contributing to greater efficiency and lower labor costs for fault knowledge graph construction.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of Reconfigurable Quadrotors with Translational Deformation
abstract: Quadrotors has been an useful research platform for decades, reconfigurable quadrotors opens a thoroughly challenging field for scientific research and engineering applications. This paper presents a quadrotors reconfiguration model through translational deformation, then the mathematical model of this reconfiguration is proposed, and control laws based on sliding mode control theory is presented, and simulation model is constructed under MATLAB environment, finally the simulation results validate the proposed control laws.

articleTitle: An Advanced Control Method of Manipulator Based on Visual Servo Control
abstract: At present, because of the shortcomings of traditional visual servo control methods, such as slow convergence speed and camera calibration, an advanced visual servo control method is based on the combination of fuzzy logic and Kalman filter, which is proposed in the paper. In the control method, Kalman filter algorithm is used to estimate image Jacobian matrix online, and fuzzy logic control algorithm is used to design variable control coefficient instead of traditional fixed control coefficient, which not only reduces convergence time of visual servo control system, but also avoids complex phase machine calibration, saves a lot of time, and improves work efficiency. Finally, the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed control method are verified by experiment simulation.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Variable Working Conditions Based on Transfer Learning and Multi-channel CNN-LSTM Network
abstract: As an indispensable component in the operation of machines, rolling bearings play an important role in modern industrial systems. In order to accurately diagnose the target domain fault data in this context, in this paper, the variable working condition dataset is firstly constructed. Further, the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) is applied to the original vibration signals, which can obtain the frequency domain signals. Then, on the basis of the domain adversarial neural networks(DANN) network, the multi-channel convolutional long short-term memory neural network(CNN-LSTM) network is utilized to perform feature fusion, the feature extraction module is reconstructed, and a cross-domain fault diagnosis model is established. Finally, the experimental results show that the proposed network model can extract the temporal characteristics of vibration signals more fully, improve the diagnostic performance of target domain datasets under different variable working conditions, and have good generalization performance under different working conditions.

articleTitle: Constrained Robotic Manipulator Control with Dynamic Uncertainty Using Impendance Learning
abstract: In this paper, we solve the motion control problem of robotic manipulator (RM) in the constrained space using impedance learning and unknown dynamics observer (UDO). An estimation method for dynamic uncertainty designed by low-pass filters is proposed to handle the unknown part of the information of the robotic system, including unknown external disturbance, partially unknown inertia, Coriolis and gravity matrix. Impedance learning will be utilized in the interaction of RM with the external environment to ensure that RM can track the desired trajectory. Then, UDO and impedance learning are added into the controller to achieve the desired effect, and we will verify the stability and error convergence of the observer and controller using Lyapunov function. Finally, several simulation studies are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the designed controller.

articleTitle: Optimal path planning for electric vehicle travel time based on Dijkstra
abstract: To alleviate the environmental pollution caused by traditional fuel vehicles, electric vehicles have started to develop on a large scale and gradually replace traditional fuel vehicles. However, the limited mileage of electric vehicles, road traffic conditions and the status of charging stations affect the path planning of users. Therefore, to improve the travel efficiency of users using EVs, this paper proposes a path algorithm for optimal travel time based on Dijkstra algorithm. It takes the characteristics of EVs, road traffic conditions, and the status of charging stations into account to formulate the weight in Dijkstra algorithm. Then it constructs a binary sort tree to reduce the path search efficiency furtherly. Simulation results show that the proposed optimal path algorithm can plan the travel path with optimal time for users.

articleTitle: Dynamic guidance strategy and path optimization method for crowd evacuation in large space public buildings based Multi-agent modeling and simulation
abstract: At present, the proportion of stampede accidents in large space public buildings is relatively high, and it is easy to cause secondary casualties in emergencies. Guidance evacuation based on guiders can effectively avoid trampling and improve crowd evacuation efficiency. It has been a vital evacuation strategy in recent years. To improve personnel safety and efficiency in evacuation processes, a real-time dynamic guidance strategy is proposed, and a path optimization method cooperated with a dynamic guidance strategy is also put forward for obstacle avoidance. A real stadium is taken as a case to study and verify the validity of the method based on Multi-agent modeling and simulation technology. In the future, it should be considered to apply in emergency management and control in reality.

articleTitle: Adaptive Planning of Optimal Grinding Path based on Improved MAX-MIN Ant System
abstract: In grinding tasks of robotic arms, grinding efficiency is a very important factor. In this paper, an efficient grinding path planning is proposed to improve grinding efficiency by adaptively shortening grinding path as much as possible for workpieces with unknown sizes and arbitrary surface characteristics. First, the size of workpiece is calculated based on information of all points to be ground, and the length of the shortest path along the surface of workpiece between arbitrary two points is obtained based on workpiece size. Second, MAX-MIN Ant System (MMAS) is improved through modifications of pheromone concentration update mechanism as well as the adding of pheromone concentration disturbance to enhance its efficiency and optimization capability, and improved-MMAS is applied in optimal sorting algorithm to adaptively generate the shortest grinding path on the workpiece with arbitrary surface characteristics. Experiment results validate that the proposed grinding path planning can adaptively generate the shortest grinding path on workpieces with unknown sizes and arbitrary surface characteristics.

articleTitle: Fractional Order Differential Sliding Mode Guidance Law with Impact Angle Constraint
abstract: In this paper, a fractional order sliding mode guidance law to stationary targets is proposed which can also achieve impact angle constraint. A new independent variable is introduced. The sliding surface is well analyzed by both Lyapunov stability and analytical expressions. The fractional order term and initializing term affect the variations of the sliding surface, flight path angle and trajectory. Regulations are summarized according to the guidance expectations. By setting parameters properly, the fractional order guidance law has further hit downrange compared with the integer one. The extension of hit downrange can be applied in practical engineering. The proposed guidance law shows good effectiveness and robustness.

articleTitle: Node Sensing Area Intersection Algorithm for Directional Sensor Networks
abstract: In recent years, regarded as the infrastructure of Internet of Things (IoT), wireless sensor network technology has developed rapidly. Based on the two-dimensional sector-shaped sensing model, the intersecting problem of sensor nodes in directional sensor networks is further investigated in this paper. By dividing the intersecting area between two nodes into circular segment area(s) and polygonal area(s), a directional sensor nodes sensing area intersection (SAI) algorithm based on coordinate location of sensor node is proposed in this paper. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively solve the intersecting problem of sensor nodes with the characteristics of high accuracy. Further simulations is performed to investigate the property of the proposed correlation coefficient.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimization in Prescribed-Time with Time-Varying Cost Functions
abstract: In this paper, we study distributed optimization problems with time-varying cost functions, allowing each agent to have a different Hessian matrix. Based on the average consensus estimator and time scale function, a continuous-time timevarying distributed optimization algorithm with prescribed-time convergence is constructed. The convergence of the algorithm is analyzed by Lyapunov theory. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by a practical numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Sampled Control for Markovian Jump Systems
abstract: This work discusses the problem of sliding mode sampled control for Markovian jump systems (MJSs), in which the system state is sampled via two randomly switching periods. By means of the input-delay approach, the controlled MJSs is modeled as a continuous time-delay system. A mode-dependent sliding mode sampled controller is designed to achieve the mean-square exponential ultimate boundedness and the reachability of the specified sliding surface. Meanwhile, the corresponding sufficient conditions are derived and an optimization solving algorithm is provided. Finally, simulation results via a boost converter circuit are provided to illustrate the designed control scheme.

articleTitle: Formation Transformation Control Based on Leader-follower Strategy for Multi-AUV System
abstract: A strategy of formation transformation control for multiple automatic underwater vehicle (multi-AUV) systems based on the priority model is presented in this paper. Firstly, the model of leader-follower multi-AUV formation is established. Then, the priority model is adopted to solve the problem of multi-AUV formation transformation. Next, the back-stepping based sliding motion controller (BSMC) is designed for multi-AUV formation, which can deal with the uncertainty of mismatch and ensure real-time performance. Finally, the simulation results are presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Dual-Arm Robot Rubik’s Cube Solving System
abstract: The existing Rubik’s cube robots are developed based on specialized hardware structures, such as six axis and rolling robots, which have no other use except for cube solving. In the future, humanoid dual-arm robots will work for every family, including doing housework, tutoring homework, etc. In this paper, we design and implement a Rubik’s cube solving system based on the dual-arm robot named Baymax. The system consists of three nodes, including the visual perception node, the cube solving node and the motion control node. The visual perception node is to recognize the color sequence of the cube by using HSV color mode. The cube solving node uses the Kociemba algorithm to calculate the action sequence to restore the cube. The motion control node implements eighteen actions by using RRT-Connect algorithm. It executes the actions according to the sequence. Experiments show that the success rate of the system designed in this paper is 86%.

articleTitle: MMEL-Based Approach To Aircraft Operational Reliability Prediction
abstract: This paper proposes an MMEL-based reliability prediction method for civil aircraft operations. First, the sensitivity factors which affect the operational interruption of civil aircraft are researched according to the operational environment and design requirements of civil aircraft. In consequence, key parameters affecting civil aircraft Operational interruption are obtained and a reliability prediction index system for civil aircraft operations is developed. On this foundation, an operational reliability prediction model for the civil aircraft development phase is established and an analytical expression for operational reliability calculation is derived. Finally, an example analysis using data from the A350 shows that the method proposed in this paper is effective in predicting and assessing the operational reliability of civil aircraft during the design phase.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking for Discrete-Time UAVs Formation Using Improved Model Predictive Control with Packet Dropout
abstract: This paper studies a model predictive tracking control scheme under packet dropout for multiple unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). To solve the tracking control problem of multiple UAVs cooperatives with packet dropout, we propose a dynamic tracking control strategy combined with an improved model predictive control (MPC) method. Firstly, a time-varying leader-follower cooperative tracking control model is established. Secondly, a tracking control scheme of the UAV using an improved MPC method with kinematics constraints is proposed, and a control input adjust term is designed to restrain the jump phenomenon of the control input. Finally, simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Bifurcation Dynamics Analysis of A Class of Fractional Neural Networks with Mixed Delays
abstract: In this paper, a three-dimensional integer order neural network with mixed time delays is extended to fractional order form. By introducing three virtual neurons, the network proposed can be transformed into a six dimensional fractional order system only involving discrete time delays. The critical threshold with respect to the system delay parameter is obtained, by employing the stable principle and the fractional order theory. The correctness of the achievements is verified by numerical simulation. Ultimately, it is observed that the introduction of fractional order can expand the stability region of the original system selecting discrete delays as bifurcation parameter.

articleTitle: Cross-domain recommendation of overlapping users based on self-attention graph convolution network
abstract: The cold start and data sparsity problems of the recommendation system can be effectively alleviated by cross-domain recommendation. It is possible to achieve good results by combining information from several knowledge-rich domain sources to recommend users with less information in the target domain . In other cross-domain recommendations, user and domain item information are embedded separately, and messages are transmitted through information sharing or potential feature mapping. A similarity relationship between items between domains and a relationship between users' preferences for items between domains are not considered in the transmission process. This paper proposes Cross-domain recommendation of overlapping users based on self-attention graph convolution network(OUAG). We use the graph convolution neural network to extract characteristics of embedded users and items, the attention mechanism dynamically assigns weights, and captures the higher-order user preferences in the graph through the propagation layer. A large number of experiments on two real-world data sets show that our model performs better than the baseline algorithm.

articleTitle: Admittance Control of Hip Exoskeleton Robots Based on the Enhanced Unknown System Dynamics Estimation
abstract: The human-robot interaction torque can affect the control performance of hip exoskeleton robots while it is difficult to install sensors to measure the human-robot interaction torque. In order to address this issue and improve the flexibility, an admittance control method based on an enhanced unknown system dynamics estimator (EUSDE) is proposed for the hip exoskeleton robot in this paper. More specifically, the EUSDE based on two low-pass filters and simple algebra operation is first developed in order to estimate the unknown human-machine interaction torque, where only two filter coefficients need to be adjusted and the robustness against noise is enhanced. Moreover, the proposed EUSDE can be easily embedded into an admittance controller such that the flexibility of the exoskeleton robot is enhanced. Finally, comparative simulation results are conducted to show the efficacy of the admittance controller with the proposed EUSDE for the hip exoskeleton robot.

articleTitle: Self-supervised learning based multi-modal intra-hour irradiance forecast
abstract: Multi-modal short-term irradiance forecast models usually fuse multi-source heterogeneous variables to predict future irrdiance and ground-based cloud images is one of the important modal. The dynamic information of clouds is shown to improve the models performance. However, such methods usually use original images directly for prediction, which decreases the efficiency and practicality of the training process. Therefore, a self-supervised learning method is proposed to learn the features of ground-based cloud images and meteorological factors. The obtained representations of exogenous variables are then used as the input for multi-modal short-term irradiance forecast. This method is validated on an open access dataset, and the results demonstrate that the self-supervised based approach outperforms other classical forecast models. Meanwhile, the images are compressed into vectors, which not only saves storage space but also reduces the training time of the prediction model significantly. In addition, the model achieves good transferability for ground-based cloud images with different qualities.

articleTitle: Interactive two-stage recursive least squares identification algorithms for controlled autoregressive systems
abstract: For a stochastic system described by the controlled autoregressive model, this paper gives an interactive two-stage recursive least squares (2S-RLS) algorithm based on the hierarchical identification principle by separating the system parameters of the controlled autoregressive model. Differently from the traditional recursive least squares algorithm, the proposed 2S-RLS algorithm does not require computing the covariance matrix of large sizes and can reduce the computational burden. A numerical example illustrates the efficiency of the proposed 2S-RLS identification algorithm.

articleTitle: Anti-occlusion Object Tracking Algorithm using Response Template Fusion and Combined Features
abstract: The kernel correlation filtering algorithm cannot judge the occlusion by itself when the object is occluded by foreign objects, and the tracking performance is greatly affected. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes an anti-occlusion object tracking algorithm that fuses response templates and combined features. The peak sidelobe ratio (PSR) is used to determine whether the object is occluded. When the object is partially occluded, a combined feature representation object model is introduced to enhance robustness, and a multi-response template with anti-occlusion performance is constructed to improve the performance of the object when it is occluded by foreign objects. The problem of reducing the available information, thereby improving algorithm performance. Experiments in the OTB-100 data set can prove that the success rate and accuracy of the algorithm have competitive results compared with the comparison algorithms.

articleTitle: Study on Exhaust Gas Temperature Prediction Model Based on GBDT
abstract: The real-time prediction of exhaust gas temperature is of great significance to the condition monitoring of aero engine. In this paper, a real-time EGT prediction model based on GBDT is proposed to solve the problem that the traditional machine learning model cannot provide sufficiently accurate prediction methods of EGT. Firstly, the idea of ensemble learning and the basic principle of GBDT algorithm are introduced. Secondly, combined with the demand of EGT prediction, the flow of the EGT prediction model based on GBDT is given. Finally, by using the actual QAR data of A320, a case study is carried out. The results of case study show that the model in this paper can predict EGT with a higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Super-twisting Sliding Mode Observer based Sensorless Control for TPFSI-Fed IPMSM Drives
abstract: The sliding mode observer (SMO) is widely used in sensorless control for IPMSM drives in medium- and high- speed region. However, the low pass filter (LPF) in conventional SMO to reduce the chattering effect led to a degradation in position estimation accuracy. This paper presents a super-twisting SMO (STSMO) based sensorless control strategy for three-phase four-switch inverter (TPFSI) fed PMSM drives. Firstly, the SVPWM for TPFSI considering capacitor voltage offset (CVO) and current compensation based CVO suppression scheme are illustrated in detail. Secondly, The parameter design of STSMO for extended back electromotive force (EEMF) and PLL-based sensorless observer are presented. The chattering effect of EEMF is reduced due to the continuous output of STSMO. Finally, the simulation results verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Bipartite Consensus of Multi-Agent Systems under Directed Matrix-Weighted Graph
abstract: The problem of bipartite consensus in the undirected topology of matrix-weighted multi-agent systems has been effectively discussed in recent years. In some real situations, agents in the network need to exchange directed information with other agents. Therefore, in order to to solve the problem of the directed communication in reality, this paper focuses on the related problem of bipartite consensus of the matrix-weighted directed communication topology for the first time. We propose the bipartite consensus algorithm of directed multi-agent systems, and derive the algebraic conditions for the bipartite consensus of directed networks with the Lyapunov stability theory. Finally, the simulation results verify the correctness of the analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Lightweight Remote Sensing Image Object Detection Algorithm
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low accuracy and slow speed that appear in traditional remote sensing detection algorithms, this paper proposes a remote sensing image object detection algorithm yolov5sf based on yolov5s improvement. The more lightweight ghost convolution module is used in the yolov5sf algorithm to reduce the redundancy in the feature map, and the hard-swish activation function is used to avoid a large number of exponential operations. We embed the GC attention module in the csp block to capture the dependencies between different channels and suppress useless features. Meanwhile, to address the problem that the network is not accurate for oversized targets detection, an mixed receptive field feature enhancement module is proposed to be placed in the downsampling layer for adaptive scaling of features of different receptive fields. The Yolov5sf algorithm is lightweight enough, with only 4.4M parameters, and only 65% of the computational effort of yolov5s and 6.7% of yolov3. Our map-50 metrics on the RSOD dataset was reduced by only 0.4%, with a 1.2% improvement in detection accuracy for the oversize target overpass category.

articleTitle: Integrating Eye-movement Interaction into Spatial Super-resolution Reconstruction
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm based on interpolation for eye movement information control image super resolution is proposed. The key of the eye movement system is to obtain the area the user is looking at, and calculate the staring area by constantly checking the kappa Angle information. Firstly, the near-infrared light can be used to calculate the 3D gaze estimation vector through the corneal reflection for optical tracking. Secondly, based on resampling and interpolation methods, this paper implements an adaptive spatial resolution improvement algorithm with arbitrary adjustable multiples, and carries out an adaptive contrast sharpening adjustment. Then, based on the eye-movement interaction information, the two-dimensional plane observation coordinates were calculated through the gaze vector, and the key region being gazed at was calculated according to the most sensitive field of view Angle of the human body, so as to improve the resolution of this region. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method is tested from qualitative and quantitative dimensions. Experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can significantly improve the user's interactive visual effect.

articleTitle: Design of a controller for the SHINE injector
abstract: An advanced and large research facility - Shanghai High repetition rate X-ray free electron laser (XFEL) and Extreme Light (SHINE) - has been under construction at Shanghai Advanced Research Institute (SARI), Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS). Among all the instruments, the injector is one of the main components, which enables the electron bunches to be extracted from a solid cathode by a laser beam, focused and accelerated by an electron radio frequency (RF) gun, and directed towards the linear accelerators (linac) with an exit energy of 8 GeV. A programmable logic control (PLC) controller based on the Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System (EPICS) is built to acquire the status, enable the power, and cope with the interlock and alarms of the kicker power supply. The control scheme and modular configurations are given. The compact design allows autonomous, reliable and robust operation when the kicker is applied in a harsh environment.

articleTitle: Variable Stiffness Control of a Soft Rehabilitation Robot with Sliding Mode Method
abstract: In most applications that involve human-robot interactions, compliant actuators with variable stiffness can be used to improve fast and safe motion for robots. The bio-inspired agonist-antagonistic setup of variable stiffness actuator (VSA) systems enable online compliance adaptation through co-contraction of actuator pairs. However, the promise of these platforms is limited by the difficulty of control. In this paper, we develop a sliding mode variable stiffness controller for a soft rehabilitation robot actuated by an antagonistic pair of McKibben muscles. To demonstrate the stability of this controller, the robotic control system is analyzed using the Lyapunov method. Finally, several simulations are conducted on the robot, and the results show that the proposed controller has good tracking performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Stability analysis for stochastic Lur’e systems with time-varying delay via some novel Lyapunov–Krasovskii functionals*
abstract: The problem of asymptotic stability is studied for a class of stochastic Lur’e systems with time-varying delay in this work. According to the characteristics of this type of systems, the suitable Lyapunov-Krasovskii functionals (LKFs) are constructed based on the dynamic delay interval (DDI) method. Then, the time-derivative of LKFs are treated by matrix inequality. According to Lyapunov stability theory, and using Schur complement, the stability criteria in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) for stochastic time-varying delay Lur’e systems are obtained. Finally, numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the criteria.

articleTitle: DMS Fatigue Detection System For Driver In Vehicle
abstract: Aiming at the problem of automobile accidents caused by driver fatigue and driving distraction, a DMS (Driving Monitoring System) driver monitoring system is designed to monitor driver status in real time. First, we detect the wearing of the driver’s safety belt. We regard the safety belt detection process as a row based selection problem based on global features. The safety belt can be quickly detected by selecting rows. Then, face detection is carried out by MTCNN(multitask convolution neural network). MTCNN puts face area detection and face key point detection together to realize the calibration of five face feature points. The fatigue state of the driver is judged by opening and closing the eyes and mouth. Finally, the target detection algorithm is used to detect the driver’s cell phone calls and smoking. The experiment results show that the system can effectively monitor the driver’s status and meet the detection requirements of practical application scenarios.

articleTitle: A new portable 2D ground-based synthetic aperture radar system for micro-deformation monitoring and SAR imaging
abstract: The ground-based synthetic aperture radar (GB-SAR) has a greater observation distance, larger field of view, can provides space coverage and real-time monitoring. This paper presents a GBSAR system device with a new high-precision two-dimension (2D) rail which is designed based on frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW), synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging and micro-deformation phase inversion. Firstly, the hardware structure composition of the system and the software program part are pointed out in detail. Then an algorithm is proposed to obtain the target micro-deformation from the phase inversion and we carried out principle derivation. The 2D SAR image and micro-deformation inversion experiments are carried out based on the measured data collected by the equipment system. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and high-accuracy of the GBSAR system in radar line-of-sight direction image ability and millimeter-level micro-deformation calculation.

articleTitle: Design of Industrial Network Topology Discovery Algorithm Based on Multi-protocol
abstract: Industrial network plays an important role in network application due to its special application environment and different requirements compared with the common Internet. To fully and quickly respond to the connection relationship of each equipment in the industrial control network system is the focus of research on industrial network perception. On basis of analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of existing methods, we have designed a topology discovery algorithm that can simultaneously meet the requirements of topology discovery of network layer and link layer device connection. The topology data integration is carried out through multi-source information fusion which is gathered by the algorithm. Finally, we simulated the network topology on eNSP platform, which is developed by Huawei, displayed the generated topology graph on the frontend interface based on ElementUI and achieved excellent results.

articleTitle: Differential Co-expression Analysis of Breast Cancer Based on a Meta-module Recovery Method
abstract: The problem of potential biomarkers in breast cancer is investigated in this paper. A meta-module recovery method is proposed to explore potential biomarkers. Firstly, meta-modules are constructed using Differential Correlation in Expression for meta-module Recovery (DICER) method. Then, enrichment analysis is performed on these modules. Enrichment analysis shows that the genes in the module are mainly involved in some biological processes and pathways. Finally, a protein-protein interaction (PPI) network of related genes is established and 10 key genes in this network are identified. Survival analysis shows that there are obvious links between 5 genes and the prognosis of patients.

articleTitle: Image Based Visual Servoing Model Predictive Control of Manipulator
abstract: Visual servoing as an important implementation of machine intelligence has been widely studied. While in the visual servoing control task of multi-joint manipulator, the task often fails due to the occurrence of camera retreat phenomenon. The present paper considers the combinations of the image based visual servoing and model predictive control (MPC) scheme to control manipulator. The visual servoing control of the manipulator system includes the object detection system, visual servoing controller and manipulator. By considering the MPC scheme with dynamic weight matrices, the phenomenon of camera retreat in the process of manipulator visual servoing is properly dealt with. The designed methods are verified in the simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Spacial sampled-data intermittent synchronization of multiweighted coupled reaction-diffusion neural networks with hybrid coupling
abstract: In this paper, the exponential synchronization by means of an intermittent control based on spacial sampled-data for multiweighted coupled reaction-diffusion neural networks with hybrid coupling (MCRDNNHC) is investigated. As opposed to considering only coupling, in this paper the case of both multiple state couplings and spatial diffusion couplings are presented. In addition, by adopting a suitable intermittent controller and applying the inequality skills, synchronization criteria of system based on novelly designed Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) method is achieved. Finally, the derived theorem results are effectively confirmed by a numerical simulation example.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Laser Auto-collimation System
abstract: Semiconductor lasers have the advantages of small size, lightweight, high reliability, long service life, and low power consumption, and they are widely used in many fields. The semiconductor laser has a large divergence angle and needs to be collimated by a lens before it can be used as a laser radar light source. In the actual production process, the adjustment and assembly of the collimator are usually made manually, and the accuracy and efficiency are relatively low. According to the manufacturing requirements of lidar, this paper designs a laser automatic alignment system based on vision. Its advantage is that it compresses the workspace required for alignment according to the principle of spot transformation and automatically adjusts it by combining image processing methods and search algorithms. The system uses a near-infrared industrial camera to collect light spots, completes image processing on the NVIDIA development board, generates control signals, and drives the electric translation stage through the controller. The system can precisely adjust the laser diodes position and realize the lasers automatic alignment. After experimental verification, the alignment accuracy of the system is about 1mrad.

articleTitle: Plant-wide Oscillation Detection Using Improved DMITD
abstract: Automatic detection of the oscillatory behavior of multiple control loops has become an important research element with the increasing integration and scale of modern process industries. The direct multi-dimensional intrinsic time scale decomposition (DMITD) is incapable of better preserving the local features of the signal when extracting the modalities of complex multi-dimensional signals, resulting in an over-decomposition. This work suggests an improvement of the direct multi-dimensional intrinsic time-scale decomposition (IDMITD) algorithm through boundary processing, multi-dimensional baseline selection, and inner-loop re-decomposition, which can more accurately extract different frequency components of the signal. The accuracy of plant-wide oscillation detection in control loops can be improved to some extent by combining oscillation regularity indicators. Simulated signals and models of industrial cases confirm the superiority of the improved algorithm for plant-wide vibration detection.

articleTitle: A Small-Area Fingerprint Recognition Algorithm Based on Inverted Residual Connection
abstract: Small-area fingerprints image contain less detailed point information. The traditional fingerprint recognition method is based on the detail points that cannot be applied to small-area fingerprints appropriately. To solve this problem, a small-area fingerprint recognition algorithm is proposed in this paper. The algorithm is built on a small-area fingerprint recognition network with inverse residual structure reducing the parameters and computation of the deep neural network. The network converts a fingerprint image to a 256-dimensional vector and judges the similarity of fingerprints by the Euclidean distance between the vectors. The experimental results show that the method achieves a correct rate of 96.4% on the small-area fingerprint dataset established on FVC2002 and self-collected fingerprints. And the model parameter is 4.34M satisfying the usage needs of mobile terminals.

articleTitle: Improved Backstepping Sliding Mode Control for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Speed Control System
abstract: An improved adaptive torque siding mode control algorithm is proposed in this paper for a permanent magnet synchronous motor speed control system. Firstly, based on the chattering problem of traditional sliding mode control, the PID sliding surface is selected to reduce the system error, and the sliding function is used to modify the sliding mode reaching law to weaken the chattering phenomenon. Then, based on the premise of speed error and torque error, the backstepping control algorithm is used to obtain a new torque update law for compensation, and the asymptotic stability of the whole system is verified by Lyapunov stability theory. Finally, the simulation is carried out by MATLAB/Simulink. The experimental results show that the control algorithm improves the tracking performance of the system, weakens the chattering phenomenon of the traditional sliding mode control, and reduces the load torque interference.

articleTitle: Multi-Layer Features Based Self-Support Network for Few-Shot Segmentation
abstract: Few-shot semantic segmentation aims to make the network identify the object regions of new categories with only a few annotated samples. The key to the few-shot segmentation is to complete information interaction between support and query images, and avoid overfitting as much as possible. For combining the advantages of metric-based prototype learning and visual correspondence, we propose a Multi-Layer Features Based Self-Support Network (MFSNet). In MFSNet, we divide the interactive part of support and query features into two stages, multi-layer similarity feature stage and self-support prototype fusion stage. The multi-layer similarity feature stage focuses more on extracting the details of the segmented object, and the self-support prototype fusion stage refine the general feature information of the object. The two stages are linked together through self-support strategies. In addition, we propose a Fusion Block in MFSNet to establish a more robust semantic relationship between multi-layer features. MFSNet is tested on two benchmark semantic segmentation datasets, Pascal-5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sup> and COCO-20<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sup>, and achieves new state-of-the-art performances on 1-shot segmentation tasks.
