articleTitle: Lateral Dynamic Model for Full-Size Semi-Trailer Container Trucks with Practical Evaluation
abstract: Vehicle dynamic model is essential for the control and simulation in autonomous driving. Compared to passenger cars that have been widely researched and applied, the modeling and evaluation of semi-trailer container trucks are less researched in the literature, and suffer from larger structure complexity and working condition variation. This paper proposes a 4-DOF and simplified 3-DOF dynamic models for semi-trailer trucks. Motivated by abundant real world data in various working conditions, the dynamic model is developed according to the trade-off between model complexity and accuracy. In low vehicle speed, the discretization error of solving differential equations can not be neglected, the model inference suffers from numerical instability, such as oscillation or divergence, which is a general problem. A stable and continuous model refinement method is proposed to deal with this problem. Evaluation is made for full-size semi-trailer container trucks using the real working data in Ningbo Zhoushan Port. Results show the effectiveness of the proposed model, which can be widely used in the autonomous driving system of semi-trailer trucks.

articleTitle: Texture feature extraction and classification based on improved LBP
abstract: The traditional LBP (Local Binary Pattern) algorithm has the problems of poor sensitivity to noise and low robustness to manic point interference when extracting texture features. An Improved Local Noise Robustness Binary Pattern (ILNRBP) is proposed in this paper. Using this algorithm, the gray value of pixels in each field is replaced by the average value of four neighboring pixels, and the difference between the gray value and the mean value of the central pixel is calculated. Then, the binary value of the difference between the difference and the threshold value T is quantized to get the binary string, and the texture characteristic value of the corresponding defect is obtained. The obtained texture feature vectors are sent to the SVM model for classification, and the purpose of classification is finally achieved. The experimental results show that the improved method integrates the texture direction information into the texture feature extraction, and the discrimination effect is more obvious, and the anti-noise robustness of texture classification is improved.

Author Keywords: Improved Local Noise Robustness Binary Pattern

articleTitle: A Novel Temporal Convolutional Network Based on Position Encoding for Remaining Useful Life Prediction
abstract: The technology of prognostics and health management (PHM) has developed rapidly. As one of the important tasks in PHM field, remaining useful life (RUL) prediction can effectively predict the remaining service time before machine failure, so that enterprises can make decisions in advance and avoid safety accidents. In this article, a new data-driven method is proposed, which adopts a position encoding scheme to extract more time sequence information from the original data, and then uses a novel temporal convolutional network (TCN) and attention mechanism to predict RUL. In order to evaluate the effect of the model, C-MAPSS dataset is used for testing the performance, and the results are compared with other methods, which shows that the proposed method is more effective.

articleTitle: Entity Recognition for Military Situation Awareness Knowledge Graph with Wikipedia Data
abstract: Entity recognition is an essential component of knowledge representation and knowledge extraction research. To enhance military situation awareness through the construction of a knowledge graph, this paper presents a novel method, BERTATT_POSBiLSTMLSTMCRF, which is based on the traditional entity recognition model BERT_BiLSTM_CRF. The local location information and the impact of the entity's position in the sentence on the entity recognition task are both fully considered by introducing the attention mechanism. Additionally, an LSTM layer is added after the BiLSTM layer to deal with long-distance label dependencies while improving the model's ability to recognize long entities. Comparative experiments demonstrate that the improved model proposed in this paper is effective in entity recognition with Wikipedia data.

articleTitle: Task allocation and path planning problems of multi-AUV system based on auction-dynamic neural network
abstract: How to carry out reasonable task allocation and path planning in the real environment of the seabed are the two major problems of the multi-AUV system. In this paper, the task preprocessing of the 26 set targets is obtained by using the K-means method to obtain three cluster center points. The task allocation process of the system is solved using a distributed auction algorithm, and according to the results of the allocation, the dynamic neural network (DNN) algorithm is used for path planning. The proposed algorithm can be applied to the real environment where ocean currents and obstacles exist. Finally, in the simulation part, the results under the particle swarm (PSO) algorithm are compared, to verify the reliability of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Opinion Formation over Clustered Social Networks with Intermittent Communication
abstract: Inspired by practical situations in which individuals must make group decisions by grouping, we propose an extended Hegselmann-Krause model to describe the opinion dynamics over a clustered social network with intermittent communication. First, a hierarchical clustered network was built where the agent with the largest degree in each cluster is defined as the opinion leader. Second, an intermittent opinion dynamics model was developed using a bounded confidence rule. Each time interval was divided into two consecutive sub-intervals. During the first sub-interval, the agents only communicated with those in the same cluster, and during the second sub-interval, only the opinion leaders communicated among the clusters. Finally, a quantitative analysis was performed for the simulation results, which showed an interesting opinion-wave phenomenon: the cluster leaders’ opinions fluctuate during the different stages of communication before the consensus appears.

articleTitle: The SOC of Lithium-ion battery prediction based on transfer learning
abstract: Transfer learning can solve the problem of low modeling accuracy due to the lack of training data. The SOC (State of Charge) estimation of lithium-ion power battery based on transfer learning can solve the problem that the data of vehicles are difficult to collect under some working conditions. It also can solve the problem of SOC estimation method in practical application and reduce the operation cost of enterprises. This paper designs a lithium-ion battery SOC prediction model based on transfer learning strategy. A comprehensive feature evaluation index combining DTW (Dynamic Time Warping) and JS divergence (Jensen - Shannon divergence) is proposed to obtain the transferable features between source and target domains. The domain invariant features between the source domain and the target domain are obtained by the mixed scale measurement method, and the combined domain adaptation technology is proposed for the adaptation problem of the distribution difference between the source domain and the target domain. A multi-level correction method is adopted to match the difference between source domain and target domain. Finally, the improved transfer learning model is compared with the non-transfer-learning model. The results show that the improved transfer model has higher accuracy and stronger robustness.

articleTitle: Bipartite Network Analysis for miRNA-mRNA Regulation in Breast Cancer
abstract: This paper investigates miRNA-mRNA regulation in breast cancer. A bipartite network recommended algorithm in complex network is proposed. In this algorithm, bipartite network is constructed by combining the known similarities of miRNA and mRNA, repectively, and the initial information of each node in the network is configured. The recommended algorithm of bipartite network is used to get the prediction results. Then the genes are identified with high prediction scores as genetic markers and verified in independent data set. The final verification result is completely consistent with the results in the previous experimental analysis and has better prognosis.

articleTitle: Master-slave System of Bionic Manipulator Based on Multi-sensor Data Glove
abstract: To solve the problems of high operation difficulty, low operation accuracy, and poor flexibility in the current remote operation mode of the bionic manipulator, a set master-slave control system of fire-fighting auxiliary manipulators based on multi-sensor data gloves are designed. The manipulator grasping control method and multi-sensor information fusion technology are introduced in this paper, and the structure and working principle of the multi-sensor data glove are explained in detail. From two aspects of hardware design and software design, the design ideas of key components, control software and bluetooth communication module of the master-slave control system are analyzed in detail. A set of prototypes was developed, and the effectiveness of the master-slave control system was verified through the grasping tests of two sets of simulated dangerous explosives with different parameters.

articleTitle: Cloud accounting resource sharing platform to participate in the subject behavior game research
abstract: The participants of the cloud accounting resource sharing platform, resource providers and resource demanders, are the core factors that affect the development of the platform. Their behavior plays a decisive role in the speed and direction of the platform's development. Therefore, using an incomplete information static game model to analyze the game behavior between the platform and resource providers, and using an incomplete information dynamic game model to analyze the game behavior between the platform and resource demanders, the Nash equilibrium of both models can be obtained. It is known that the strategic choices of resource providers and resource demanders will affect the strategic choices of the platform, and then the factors affecting the Nash equilibrium are analyzed, and relevant suggestions are put forward to provide reference for the comprehensive development of the cloud accounting resource sharing platform.

articleTitle: An approximate gradient descent algorithm for Spiking Neural Network
abstract: Spiking Neural Network (SNN) is the third generation of neural networks, which transmits information through the impulse train, but the discrete impulse train has the property of non-differentiable, so it is difficult to apply the gradient descent algorithm to the spiking neural network. In this paper, the approximate derivative of the impulse activity is introduced to simulate the impulse activity, and then the spiking neural network based on the gradient descent algorithm is realized. On this basis, the influence of different approximate derivatives on the training accuracy of the spiking neural network is explored, and the iterative formula of LIF (Leaky Integrate and Fired) neurons is optimized and simplified. The results show that when the approximate derivative is introduced, our neural network has lower consumption, better performance, and the accuracy of the moment function model neural network is higher. We take the MNIST data set as the input of the spiking neural network, convert it into the impulse sequence information by the frequency coding method based on the impulse counting, and transmit it through the simplified LIF neuron model. On the basis of the error back propagation rules, the synaptic weight and error deviation of the neural network are constantly updated. The results show that the proposed algorithm is of higher accuracy and faster speed.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of 6-DOF Manipulator based on Improved Active Disturbance Rejection Control
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high coupling, parameter uncertainty and external environment interference in practical applications of six degrees of freedom manipulator, a control strategy based on improved active disturbance rejection control was proposed. Firstly, in order to improve the response speed of the system, the sliding mode control tracking differentiator (SMC-TD) is designed based on the synovial theory.In order to reduce the system jitter, the new sliding mode function is used to improve the sliding mode control law, which reduces the system jitter and improves the system response speed. Secondly, the han function is constructed to realize the design of continuous smooth extended state observer, and the improved fractional extended state observer (FO-ESO) is designed in combination with fractional calculus, which enhances the anti-interference ability of the system. Finally, combined with the traditional nonlinear error feedback control law (NLSEF), an improved active disturbance rejection controller was built, and different control strategies were used to compare the six degrees of freedom manipulator in the same environment. The experimental results show that the controller has good control effect and anti-disturbance robustness, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A DAG-NOTEARS-based Data Mining Method for Faulty Samples
abstract: Existing methods for directed acyclic graph (DAG) structural learning are often computationally intensive in multi-variate systems, which limits their application in practice. The so-called DAG-NOTEARS algorithm transforms the discrete combinatorial optimization problem into a continuous optimization problem, thus can obtain an accurate and stable DAG structure with much lower computation. In this paper, a DAG-NOTEARS-based data mining method for faulty samples is proposed, which can build an accurate and stable graph from data in an efficient way and do not require prior knowledge. In addition, average cosine similarity is used to determine faults and achieve better performance due to its ability of detecting changes not only in the number of edges but also in their directions. The experimental results based on the Tennessee Eastman process benchmark and hot strip rolling dataset demonstrate the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Control for A Class of Linear Stochastic Impulsive Systems with Partially Unknown Information
abstract: This paper studies the optimal impulsive control problems of linear stochastic impulsive systems with periodic impulses and partially unknown information. By utilizing the collocation method combined with a periodic Lyapunov function, a sufficient condition for stochastic optimal impulsive control is derived in terms of a hybrid Riccati equation. Based on Bellman’s dynamic programming principle, an online reinforcement learning algorithm is further presented to attain optimal impulsive control with partial system information. A numerical simulation illustrates the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: A Review of Chaotic Time Series Prediction Methods
abstract: In this paper, some prediction methods of chaotic time series are summarized. Not only the phase space reconstruction method, a traditional chaotic time series prediction method, and some improved prediction algorithms based on this method are introduced, but also two other novel chaotic time series prediction methods (chaotic time series prediction method based on neural network and chaotic time series prediction method based on kernel adaptive filter) are presented focusing on the current frontier of chaotic time series research. In addition, future research directions of chaotic time series are analysed in this paper. In summary, this paper focuses on the methods of chaotic time series prediction.

articleTitle: On Punching Mode and Strategy Optimization of Punching Production Line for Longitudinal Beam
abstract: The longitudinal beam plays a key role in the load-bearing of commercial vehicles. There are a large number of holes with different diameters on the ventral surface of the longitudinal beam. Therefore, the processing of the ventral surface of the longitudinal beam is of great significance to the production of the longitudinal beam. With the hydraulic press as the main machine, the integral die longitudinal beam ventral punching production line is the main way to process the longitudinal beam ventral hole. Punching efficiency is an important index to measure the quality of production line products. This paper analyzes the punching process of integral die longitudinal beam punching production line. Based on the two aspects of punching method and punching strategy. We propose a double punching processing method and a punching strategy based on modified ant colony algorithm, which reduces the number of punching and the distance of finding holes in the longitudinal beam production line. Through the comparison of the longitudinal beam examples, the punching efficiency of the punching production line of the single-press integral die longitudinal beam can be significantly improved. Finally, the purpose of reducing the time of processing the web of the longitudinal beam in the production line is achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Multimodal Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis Based on Image Caption and Multimodal Aspect Extraction
abstract: Sentiment Analysis is an important task in NLP. In recent years, more and more attention has been paid to Multimodal Sentiment Analysis. For Multimodal Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (MABSA), most of the existing methods take the original information of each modality as input and extract each modality’s features and the alignment between them. Based on the existing methods, additional information, including aspect terms and image caption, is extracted. The original and additional information is used as a compound feature so that the model can have a better understanding of each modality and the relationship between them. Experiments show that the method achieves better results on MABSA and its two sub-tasks: Multimodal Aspect-Sentiment Classification (MASC) and Multimodal Aspect-Terms Extraction (MATE).

articleTitle: Binary Synchronous Compression Algorithm for Big Data Based on Feature-Sample Selections
abstract: The feature selection and the sample selection are main way of data preprocessing to optimize the original dataset, which can solve the problems of long computing time and low accuracy in big data multi-classification area. However, the traditional selection strategy itself requires a lot of computing time; Meanwhile, the order of the adopted multiple selection strategies will affect the optimization results. Aiming at these problems, this paper proposed a binary synchronous compression algorithm (BSCA), which includes three key parts: firstly, a feature selection method and a sample selection method based on variance analysis and random sampling comparison, respectively, are presented; Then, the proposed two methods handle the original dataset synchronously and mark the selection results; Finally, according to the labeling results, the selected features in the selected samples are extracted to form a new sample dataset as the optimization result. The experimental results show that the proposed BSCA is effective by neural network classification problem.

articleTitle: Prescribed Performance Position Control for PMSM System via a Novel Non-Recursive Design Framework
abstract: In order to optimize the transient-time control performance and facilitate the implementation of the industrial application for the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) position control system, a non-recursive prescribed performance control strategy has been proposed in this paper. Firstly, a higher-order sliding mode disturbance observer is constructed to exactly estimate the disturbance terms. Secondly, we introduce a performance function to realize the asymmetric prescribed performance constraint of the PMSM position. Based on the accurate estimations of the disturbance, the reference signals of each state can be calculated, and eventually, a concise control law is obtained directly in the subsequence. As a new feature, the proposed non-recursive control framework ensures the simplicity of the PMSM position controller design process by maintaining a high position control performance for the PMSM system. Several simulations verify the effectiveness and disturbance rejection ability of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Detection Technology of Mobile Application Third-Party Library Based on Binary Tree Model
abstract: At present, most of the research on the detection effect of third-party libraries is not ideal, and it has weak robustness to the third-party libraries with confusing or flat packages, and few technologies can be detected at the library version level. Aiming at the current problems, this paper proposes a third-party library detection model based on binary tree, which can effectively enhance the robustness of detection by using keywords, comments and constant strings in source code files as data sets. In addition, a library version identification technology based on maximum feature matching is proposed to identify the versions of third-party libraries. Experiments are conducted on 200 Android applications from the application market to detect the okhttp3 library and identify the version of the library. The results show that the detection accuracy of the third-party library reaches 96.5%, and the version identification accuracy of the third-party library reaches 76.84%.

articleTitle: Scheduling Algorithm based on Fallback Strategy for Multiple Time Constraints Carpooling Service
abstract: It is challenging to balance the real-time response and the solution quality of the scheduling algorithm in the carpooling service problem. To reduce travel distance while meeting multiple time requirements of the passengers to be picked up/dropped off, the carpooling service usually involves a complex optimization problem. This paper proposes a low computational complexity scheduling algorithm for the carpooling service problem. Firstly, we construct a scheduling model for carpooling service between vehicles and passengers based on total travel distance optimization. Then, a low computational complexity heuristic algorithm based on the fallback strategy is designed, which significantly reduces the problem-solving time and improves the feasibility of this scheduling model. Finally, a series of simulations are performed to evaluate the performance of the proposed method. The simulation results show that the computation time of the proposed heuristic is negligible compared to the optimal solution found by the Gurobi solver, with a cost of 20% solution quality reduction.

articleTitle: Robust Bipartite Output Consensus Tracking for Heterogeneous Multi-agent Systems via Output Regulation Method
abstract: This paper focuses on the robust bipartite output consensus tracking problem of heterogeneous multi-agent systems with model uncertainties. Firstly, the linearly parameterized neural networks are adopted to approximate the uncertain parts of the system model. Then, the adaptive update laws are constructed for the unknown parameters. Based on the output regulation method, the robust adaptive state feedback bipartite consensus tracking controller is proposed for the follower agents. In addition, according to the Lyapunov stability theorem, we have proved that the bipartite output consensus tracking control of multi-agent systems is achieved. Finally, some numerical simulation results are given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Failure probability and spectrum occupancy rate based routing and spectrum allocation algorithm in elastic optical networks
abstract: In an elastic optical network, it is essential to ensure that the service transmission is stable and smooth. This means that service transmission requires lower blocking probability and lower failure probability. This also depends heavily on the path selection. Therefore, we propose a dynamic routing and spectrum allocation algorithm to select paths that are more in line with the needs of blocking probability or failure probability. The proposed algorithm selects path through calculating and comparing the cost value of alternative paths, hence, achieving the purpose of reducing the network blocking rate and average path failure probability. Simulation results showed that the proposed algorithm can obtain lower network blocking probability and guaranteed the failure rate of the service compared with the traditional D+FF algorithm.

articleTitle: Disturbance Observer-based H∞ Control for Interval Type-2 T-S Fuzzy Systems With An Event-triggered Communication
abstract: This paper deals with the asynchronous fuzzy H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control for nonlinear network control systems with network-induced delays, exogenous signal disturbances, and asynchronous premise variables. This system is represented by the interval type-2 Takagi-Sugeno (IT2 T-S) fuzzy model. An asynchronous disturbance observer is designed to estimate the system states and the disturbances simultaneously. In addition, an event-triggered communication (ETC) is developed to reduce network costs. Finally, the feasibility of DO and fuzzy controllers is verified by numerical simulation.

Author Keywords: Interval type-2 Takagi–Sugeno (IT2 T–S) fuzzy model

articleTitle: A Global Maximum Principle for Controlled Fully Coupled FBSDEs with General Cost Functional
abstract: This paper is concerned with an optimal control problem for the fully coupled forward-backward stochastic system. The control variable can enter the diffusion term and the control domain is not necessarily convex. The cost functional we consider is the general form with both integral term and initial-terminal term. Using the decoupling method established in [4], new first- and second-order adjoint equations are obtained, among which, the first-order equation is a non-coupled forward-backward stochastic differential equation (FBSDE). Finally, a necessary condition of Pontraygin's type is deduced.

articleTitle: Prescribed performance and anti-noise control of airbreathing hypersonic vehicle with AOA constraint
abstract: Due to the scramjet equipped on airbreathing hypersonic vehicle (AHV), a serious coupling between flight and propulsion system occurs. Meanwhile the problem of model perturbation and measurement noise is notable during the long range ballistic flight. In order to ensure the flight safety, a robust anti-noise prescribed performance control scheme for AHV with AOA constraint is presented. First, the AOA constraint during ballistic flight is solved according to the air inlet condition, and the transient process of AOA tracking is designed based on the prescribed performance control theory combined with the exponential function. Then a new nonlinear extended state observer (NESO) based on cascade is introduced to suppress the peaking phenomenon of the traditional high gain observer, nonlinear gain tuning mechanism is introduced to improve the anti-noise ability of the observer. The Lyapunov stability of above control system is proved to ensure the safety of AHV during cruise flight theoretically. Finally, a simulation comparison between the prescribed performance control system and the robust-ADRC system is given. The results show that the prescribed performance control system can ensure AOA within the prescribed boundary to meet the demand on the air inlet condition, and has more reliable robust security guarantee with better command tracking performance in the engineering noise environment as well.

articleTitle: Third-order fast finite-time extended state observer-based fault tolerant control for autonomous underwater vehicles with thruster saturation
abstract: In this paper, the fault-tolerant control problem is investigated for AUV with thruster faults and thruster saturation. A non-singular terminal sliding mode control method is developed based on a third-order fast finite time extended state observer (FFTESO). Firstly, the third-order FFTESO is introduced to estimate the generalized uncertainty, which includes current disturbance, dynamic model uncertainty, and thruster fault and saturation. Then, a non-singular terminal sliding mode-based fault tolerant control is presented by combining the estimation provided by the observer. And the Nussbaum-type function is applied to deal with the unknown gain caused by the thruster saturation. It is proved theoretically that the stability of the observer and the designed fault-tolerant controller can ensure the boundness of tracking errors. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme is evaluated by simulation and comparison experiments on ODIN-AUV.

Author Keywords: Third-order fast finite-time extended state observer

articleTitle: DOA Estimation via Adaptive Weighted Truncated Nuclear Norm
abstract: Aiming at the large error of traditional direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation algorithm caused by the low signal-to-ratio and limited sampling. This paper proposes a DOA estimation method based on adaptive weighted truncation nuclear norm. First, a new model which combines γ norm and adaptive weighted nuclear norm is proposed to accurately reconstruct the received signal covariance matrix into a low-rank covariance matrix and a sparse covariance matrix. Next, the generalized alternating direction method of multipliers (GADMM) with an adaptive stopping criterion is used to solve this convex optimization. Finally, based on the reconstructed low-rank noise-free covariance matrix, a multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm is used to achieve DOA estimation. The simulation results are provided to verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A synthetically photogrammetric system for precise contour parameters with bi-telecentric imaging
abstract: The traditional method is inefficient and expensive, and the traditional machine vision measurement method has issues with inadequate measurement accuracy and low stability. However, the contour distance measurement of the traditional polygonal workpiece plays an important role in ensuring its processing quality. In this research, a high-precision measuring method for polygonal workpiece contour distance based on photographic bi-telecentric lens imaging is created in order to achieve greater manufacturing quality. First, a bi-telecentric imaging method-based analytical modeling and overall structural design of the measuring system is completed; next, a more accurate approach for exact edge extraction of contour images is proposed. By performing quadratic function interpolation on the gradient modulus values of nearby three points in the gradient direction of candidate edge points, this method raises the connection degree of the edge point chain and yields more precise sub-pixel coordinates of edge points. Finally, the RANSAC algorithm improves the contour line. obtaining the contour distance using the multi-sample interactive point-line distance computation method. The average relative error of the measured contour distance obtained by this system is less than 0.007mm, and the repeated measurement accuracy is less than 0.2m, according to an experiment measuring the contour distance of a polygonal workpiece at various points in relation to the nominal value highly reliable measurement of the profile distance.

articleTitle: A Price-Based Bi-Level Scheduling Optimization Method for Power Systems and EA Enterprises
abstract: As a typical industrial load, electrolytic aluminum (EA) load is one of the most important demand-side resources. EA load participating in demand response (DR) is beneficial for EA industries to reduce energy bills and carbon emissions, and can also be coordinated with thermal units to cope with the uncertainties of renewable energy generations. Therefore, the research on the modeling and dispatch method of EA load for DR is of great significance to realize the economic operation of power systems. In this paper, a price-based bi-level scheduling optimization method for power systems and EA enterprises is proposed. The proposed model considers the power system and the EA enterprise as independent stakeholders, where the dynamic compensation prices are introduced to guide the DR of EA load. The formulated bi-level dispatch problem is addressed by the single-level reduction and the convexization techniques. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model. Corresponding to different aluminum profit per ton and carbon prices, the compensation price can be adjusted accordingly, which demonstrates the applicability of the proposed bi-level optimization model.

articleTitle: 3D Reconstruction of Reflective Objects Based on Local Grating Completion
abstract: A reconstruction technique using local grating complement is suggested in order to address the issues of phase error and decreased reconstruction accuracy brought on by grating deformation brought on by strong reflection on the surface of the object during three-dimensional reconstruction of structured light. First, it is investigated how the measured object's material characteristics and reflection parameters like the specular reflection angle contribute to the missing phenomenon in the 3D reconstructed point cloud model. Second, a local grating completion approach is added before phase unwrapping to finish the missing portion of the grating in the reflective area in order to increase the phase unwrapping accuracy. This method is based on the phase shift method and complementary Gray code reconstruction method. The reflective rectangular aluminum alloy plate was constructed with a monocular structured light 3D reconstruction technique that had a flatness inaccuracy of less than 0.5 millimeters. After testing, it has been found that the improved method described in this paper can effectively compensate for the reconstruction loss brought on by the object surface's reflection. In addition, the phase decoding information is more complete, the reconstruction rate is 25% higher than with the traditional method, and the flatness error rate is reduced by 28.2%.

articleTitle: Movie Recommendation System Research Based on Improved DeepFM
abstract: In recent years, the application of deep learning in many fields has gradually increased, and the practice in the field of information recommendation has also achieved excellent consequence. DeepFM model is used to share input data between wide and deep parts, it does not need artificial feature engineering, which can handle the advantages of low and high-order features simultaneously. In this paper, the hidden layer of DeepFM model is improved to solve the problem of gradient vanishing and gradient explosion in deep neural network effectively, and the improved algorithm model is verified by experiments on the MovieLens dataset. The improved model achieved a 1.29% increase in AUC indicator, and reduced the deviation between the predicted value and the true value of the model to a certain extent. Practice has proved that the improved model solves the problem of sparse film user rating data in the movie recommendation scenario, the accuracy of movie recommendation has been improved indirectly.

articleTitle: DSMO-based hybrid sliding mode control for direct-drive PMSG wind power generator systems
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid sliding mode control (HSMC) stability control method is proposed to enable the generator to track the optimal speed and extract the maximum wind energy stably under different wind speed conditions. The control method combines a disturbed sliding mode observer (DSMO) and a sliding mode controller (VSRL-SMC) based on a variable speed reaching law (VSRL). VSRL is used to improve the convergence speed of the sliding mode controller while weakening the sliding mode chattering to further improve the response speed and robustness of the system. DSMO performs online real-time estimation of the aggregate disturbance and feeds the estimated value to VSRL-SMC for compensation in real time to weaken the power oscillation of the wind power generation system (WPGS) and improve the stability of the WPGS. Finally, the overall simulation analysis of HSMC-based WPGS is performed using MATLAB under the wind speed step change condition. The simulation results show the effectiveness and feasibility of the designed control scheme.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization method of blast furnace operation performance indicators based on data and knowledge
abstract: During blast furnace (BF) ironmaking, hot metal quality and energy consumption directly affect industrial economic benefits. Field engineers usually adjust the production state based on their experience, which makes control optimization uncertain. A data and knowledge-based optimization framework for BF operation performance indicators is proposed in this paper. Firstly, design the Attention Long Short Term Memory (Attention-LSTM) neural network to predict the Silicon content and coke ratio, which is used as fitness value function of the multi-objective optimization model. To initialize the population, knowledge based non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (KB-NSGA) uses a knowledge base of historical optimal solutions. Finally, an optimization solution set that meets the actual production requirements is obtained using the TOPSIS evaluation method. The KB-NSGA successfully achieves the goal compared with other genetic algorithms. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by long-term running experiments.

articleTitle: A container scheduling strategy based on node image layer cache
abstract: With the advancement of computer technology in recent years, container technology has become widely used. One of the most important elements influencing container deployment is the latency of the image download. Researchers have studied image distribution techniques extensively in an effort to speed up image downloads. However, current approaches only consider the reuse of the entire container image when specifying the scheduling policy, ignoring reusable image layers among different images, resulting in cache waste. This paper suggests a container scheduling policy based on the image layer cache that speeds up container startup by scheduling containers to the node with the highest hit rate of the image layer cache, thereby reducing the download of the image layer. In comparison to the ImageLocalityPriority scheduling policy of the Kube-Scheduler, the experimental results demonstrate that the policy can effectively decrease the download of the image layer and improve the container startup speed.

articleTitle: Design and analysis for distributed optimization algorithm based on nabla fractional calculus
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of unconstrained distributed optimization over an undirected topological network structure. The difference from the existing continuous time domain distributed optimization algorithms is that nabla fractional calculus is introduced. This improves the algorithm performance of the original literature in terms of iterative complexity of the algorithm. This paper shows that the proposed algorithm is guaranteed to converge to a global minimum of the sum of convex functions on any connected undirected graph, as long as the objective function is convex but not required to be smooth.

articleTitle: Monocular Non-linear Photometric Transformation Visual Odometry Based on Direct Sparse Odometry
abstract: When no photometric calibration is available in Direct Sparse Odemetry (DSO), a direct sparse odometry with method of Monocular Non-linear Photometric Transformation Visual Odometry is proposed to improve tracking accuracy and robustness of DSO. Compared with DSO method, a new regularization item and a non-linear brightness transfer function are integrated in proposed method, so it can better simulate the photometric calibration process. The proposed method is evaluated on 50 different sequences of TUM MonoVO datasets containing several hours of video in total. The results show that the rms of aligned error of the proposed Monocular Non-linear Photometric Transformation Visual Odometry method is 11.4% lower than original Direct Sparse Odometry on average. Successful running times of the proposed method are 4.4% more than original Direct Sparse Odometry when the environment light source intensity changing.

articleTitle: Research on Submarine Maneuvering Control Method
abstract: Submarine maneuverability is one of the important comprehensive navigation performances of submarines. Submarine maneuvering control method plays a vital role in submarine maneuverability. Based on the collection and analysis of related documents about submarine maneuvering control methods at home and abroad, this paper focuses on the research results and existing problems of submarine spatial motion model, hydrodynamic identification method and control algorithm, therefore points out the characteristics of various control methods and future research hotspots.

articleTitle: Research on Realtime Decision Making Strategy of Swarm Intelligence based Gaming
abstract: Modern war has the features of multi-level, high dynamic, high coupling and high complexity. Intelligent situation cognition and tactical decision making based on hierarchical reinforcement learning are the future development trend. To face the current challenges, this paper studies the lightweight problem of situation cognition and realtime decision making strategy in complex incomplete information dynamic game, focusing on game space reduction, multi-level situation cognition and collaborative strategy optimization. The game decision making model driven by data and knowledge is constructed, and the level of game strategy is improved through self-gaming of reinforcement learning, to gradually reach the level of human commander.

articleTitle: Optimal Synchronization in Dynamically Coupled Fractional-order Chaotic Systems Based on Intelligent Optimization Algorithm with Simulink
abstract: In this paper, for the synchronization control of the dynamically coupled fractional-order Rössler system, by reasonably selecting the optimization objective function and using the efficient global optimization ability of the intelligent optimization algorithm, the optimal values of the error system parameters are directly determined; besides, a fractional integral optimal sliding mode control laws is designed, so that the parameters are changed from unknown to known, which avoids the construction of Lyapunov function according to the Lyapunov stability principle and the large amount of calculation of trial and error method, and provides an idea for us to determine the parameters in the system or controller. With the help of MATLAB Simulink, the fractional differential solver is obtained and the Simulink block diagrams of the systems is made. The fast synchronization of the dynamically coupled drive and response system can be achieved by substituting the optimal parameter value into the systems. The numerical simulation results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Aerial Autonomous Docking Control Method of Quadrotor UAV
abstract: The unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) can autonomously assemble in the air, so as to deal with different scenarios and mission requirements. However, on the problem of autonomous aerial docking of rotorcraft UAVs, there are few existing research and most of them focus on docking with hovering UAVs. This paper proposes a solution to the problem of docking with hovering or moving quadrotor. The whole docking process is divided into the approach phase, the tracking phase and the docking phase. In the tracking phase and the docking phase, guidance methods are proposed according to the phase targets correspondingly. A docking controller which can adaptively estimate the desired point velocity and external disturbance is used to control the quadrotor UAV to complete the docking. The final simulation results show that the proposed method can complete the autonomous docking with a moving quadrotor UAV under disturbance.

articleTitle: Fault Estimation and Observer-Based Fault-Tolerant Control for Multi-Agent Systems with time-delay
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of fault estimation and fault-tolerant control for nonlinear multi-agent systems with time-delay, actuator faults, sensor faults. First, a fault estimation observer is designed to achieve the estimation of actuator faults and sensor faults. Second, a feedback controller based on observer is used to compensate the effect of faults and disturbances. Third, the linear matrix inequality is applied to obtain sufficient conditions for observer and controller. Finally, the effectiveness of observer and controller is verified by one example.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Optimization of Multi-Energy System Considering Power Loss
abstract: The capacity configuration of the multi-energy interconnection system is an important issue. This paper proposes a novel optimization model considering the power loss of the multi-energy system. The whole optimization is divided into two layers. The first aim is to optimize the photovoltaics and wind turbines considering the investment amount, power loss, power lack, and abandoned power. The second layer focuses on the capacity configuration of the energy storage and diesel generators. The improved particle swarm optimization algorithm with convertible weight coefficients is implemented in the optimization, guaranteeing reliability and efficiency. Case studies test the proposed method and algorithm, and the coordination strategy of a multi-energy system is offered.

articleTitle: Small-scale block defect detection of fabric surface based on SCG-NET
abstract: In contrast to the common small target detection problems, it is more difficult to locate and identify the small surface defects of fabric due to its own texture and complex background interference. Therefore, this paper proposes an effective detector for small-scale block defects on fabric surface by taking advantage of the backbone which integrates the Coordinate Attention module to enhance the acquisition of small-scale block defect location information. The FPN + PAN multi-scale detection structure is adopted to effectively integrate the feature information between different levels and deal with the multi-scale problem of defects. In the Neck section, a small target detection layer is set to expand the receptive field to prevent the loss of small-scale defect feature information. Moreover, we propose to use the GhostBottleneck module instead of the ordinary downsampling process to eliminate redundant convolutional calculations to improve the detection speed. The experimental results show that the optimal detection results of 0.855 and 0.912 are achieved in the detection recall and accuracy of fabric dataset, compared with other detectors, the result of small-scale defect detection rate is increased by at least 4.5% , and the detection process meets the real-time requirement of automatic defect detection, which verifies the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Safety-Critical Control of Euler-Lagrange Systems Subject to Position and Velocity Constraints
abstract: This paper presents a study on safety-critical control problems for Euler-Lagrange (EL) systems subject to multiple safety constraints. Specifically, we focus on position constraints characterized by a set of ball obstacles and velocity constraints that adhere to feasible velocity ranges. Our novel contribution lies in a new cascade design of safety-critical controllers, which feature an inner-outer-loop structure. We have developed an outer-loop controller based on quadratic programming (QP) to handle position constraints and generate velocity reference signals that conform to velocity limitations. By fully utilizing the energy-conservation property, we have designed a nonlinear velocity-tracking controller to form the inner loop. However, a significant challenge is posed by the non-Lipschitz continuity of the standard QP algorithm when there are multiple constraints. To address this issue, we propose a refined QP algorithm with the feasible set reshaped by an appropriately chosen positive basis to ensure that feasibility is maintained while the resulting outer-loop controller is locally Lipschitz. We have proven that safety-critical control can be achieved as long as the ball obstacles satisfy a mild distance condition. Finally, we have validated our proposed design via numerical simulations of safety-critical control of a 3-link planar manipulator.

articleTitle: MPPT of Wind Power System Based on Hybrid Perturbation Observation and Global Fast Integral Sliding Mode
abstract: In order to overcome the drawback that the conventional perturbation observation method (CPO) cannot satisfy fast tracking and low oscillation at the same time, an improved hybrid perturbation observation method (HPO) is proposed in this paper. The method uses a strategy that combines large-step fast tracking and small-step accurate tracking. The large-step tracking utilizes the curve of Power Coefficient variant proposed in this paper to calculate the approximate optimal angular velocity from the output power and angular velocity of the wind turbine at the current moment to achieve fast tracking, and the multi-solution problem is taken into account in detail in this process. In order to achieve accurate tracking, small-step tracking is used after the end of large-step tracking. In addition, a global fast integrated sliding mode controller (GFISMC) is proposed to improve the transient tracking performance, and the softsign function is used instead of the sign function to compensate the disturbance term and reduce the jitter. To verify the effectiveness of the above algorithm, a wind energy conversion system (WECS) based on a doubly-fed asynchronous generator (DFIG) is constructed and simulated in MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation results show that the above method not only enables the wind power generation system to reach the maximum power point quickly, but also has small overshoot and steady-state jitter.

Author Keywords: Global fast integral sliding mode controller (GFISMC)

articleTitle: An Error Compensation Method for Industrial Robots Based on Anisotropy Spatial Interpolation
abstract: The absolute positioning accuracy of industrial robot is essential in the applications of offline programing, machining etc. Kinematic calibration is the common way to improve the absolute positioning accuracy, which can only compensate the error caused by deviation of kinematic parameters. Non-kinematic compensation methods usually use inverse distance-weight to calculate the compensated error, but the difference of error similarity between the grid reference points and the positioning points in each direction is not considered, which makes the compensation lack of effectiveness. In this paper, an alternative weight evaluation index for error directions is proposed, and an anisotropic spatial interpolation compensation model is constructed based on the similarity of error directions to account for the sample point errors in each direction. First, a simulation is used to analyze the interval joint angle error in various directions. The robot's workspace was then segmented into a series of cubic grids. A new spatial grid interpolation compensation model and its weight evaluation index are built based on the distances between the reference points and sample points in each direction in the spatial grid, and a thorough interpolation compensation method for the positioning error of the industrial robot is proposed. Finally, simulations are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results of the simulations show that after compensation with the proposed method the maximum error, average error, and standard deviation of the sample points in x, y and z directions decrease greatly. Moreover, by comparing with the traditional inverse distance-weighted spatial grid interpolation compensation method, the compensation accuracy of the proposed method is much higher.

articleTitle: Learning Prototype from unlabeled regions for Few-shot segmentation
abstract: Few-shot segmentation (FSS) uses only a few labeled images to learn the method of segmentation rather than training on huge dataset to find satisfactory parameters. Existing methods pay more attention on labeled data leading to the waste of unlabeled data, i.e., potential novel classes are treated as background on training phase. Our method aims to lighten this problem and improve the feature embedding space of all classes. In our work, we propose a novel framework to learn prototypes of labeled and unlabeled classes. When training on support-query pairs, we introduce an additional prototype generating branch that exploits unlabeled classes using a clustering-based method and a new method for prototype rectification on unlabeled classes to promote stability of prototypes. Above all, our prototype generating technique has the ability to utilize unlabeled classes improving the embedding space. Extensive experiments on two FSS benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms the previous state-of-the-art by a margin of 1.13% mIOU on PASCAL-5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sup> and 2.15% mIOU on COCO-20<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sup>, according to our extensive experiments on two FSS benchmarks.

articleTitle: Collaborative Allocation of Manufacturing Tasks and Services from the Supply Chain Perspective
abstract: For the resource allocation from the supply chain perspective, a collaborative allocation method of manufacturing tasks and services is proposed. In this method, the cross-regional distribution of manufacturing services and the specific cooperation constraints between services are considered, and a collaborative allocation model of manufacturing tasks and services with the optimization goal of minimizing total cost is established. The improved genetic algorithm based on multilevel integer coding (MICGA) is proposed to solve the model. Experimental results show that the MICGA algorithm is better than Genetic Algorithm (GA), Generation Algorithm with Generation Gap (GGGA), and Stud Genetic Algorithm (StudGA) in finding approximate optimal solutions, the value of optimal solution obtained by MICGA algorithm can be 11.39% lower than that of GGGA.

articleTitle: Research on the teaching model of knowledge graph for professional introduction course based on OBE
abstract: In view of the problems of the current professional introduction course, such as wide scope of knowledge, lack of in-depth knowledge explanation and weak relevance of each course content, this paper proposes a knowledge graph teaching model of professional introduction course based on OBE method. Taking the professional introduction course of "Introduction to the Internet of Things" as an example, we firstly construct the visual course knowledge graph according to the course content arrangement. Secondly, based on the OBE method, we design a set of knowledge graph teaching mode framework. Then, we adopt the knowledge graph completion algorithm based on transE to further complete the course knowledge graph according to the update and change of the content of the major system and the periodic feedback needs of students. Finally, with simulation experiments used, we verify the feasibility of the proposed method, and the actual teaching practice results show that the curriculum knowledge graph can effectively assist teachers to teach professional introduction courses and promote students to systematically master the relevant knowledge system required to learn the major, so as to improve the teaching effect.

articleTitle: Isolated Forest Based Flame Recognition
abstract: Flame recognition is an important part of fire monitoring system. To address the problems that the effect of traditional flame recognition methods is easily disturbed by external environment and the flame feature extraction has low differentiation between flame and scene, this paper proposes a flame recognition method based on Isolated Forests (IF). The method analyzes the static features of the image to get the flame candidate regions; combines the dynamic features and texture features of the image to sample the flame candidate regions to remove the non-flame targets; uses the IF algorithm to calculate the data obtained from the sampling to get the anomaly score, and divides the image based on the score to get the real flame regions. In three typical scene tests, the average detection rate of this method is 74.88%, the average completion rate is 79.08%, the average intersection ratio is 64.91%, and the average pixel accuracy rate reaches 73.37%, which is suitable for fire monitoring in industrial and forest scenes.

articleTitle: Two-person Interaction Recognition Algorithm Based on the Joint Points Attention Motion Features Map
abstract: The human interaction recognition based on joint point date and RGB video has broad application prospects. RGB video contains information such as the appearance and texture of the human body. The joint point data is the coordinate’s position of three-dimensional skeleton during the human body movement. The two features have good complementarity. However, the fusion methods currently studied mostly adopt the decision-level fusion method, leading to less change of the fusion form and failing to make a better use of the complementarity of the two data sources. In response to the above problems, a human interaction recognition algorithm is proposed by fusing joint point data and RGB video in the feature layer. The RGB video is used as the main identification information, and the joint point data is used as auxiliary identification information in the proposed method. First the joint points attention motion features map is constructed by analyzing the joint point data to obtain the main motion part, and paying attention to the corresponding position of the RGB motion feature. Then the VGG19 network is used to extract deep features of the joint points attention motion features map. Finally the Bi-LSTM is introduced to perform timing modeling to obtain the final recognition result. The method was tested on the international standard NTU RGB+D database. The test results show that the algorithm greatly improves the accuracy of similar actions recognition, which proves the feasibility of the algorithm. This method provides a novel solution based on the fusion of RGB video and joint point information. It is simple and easy to implement, and has good practicability.

articleTitle: Fixed-time Convergent Backstepping Sliding Mode Guidance Law with Impact Angle Constraint
abstract: A new guidance law considering the impact angle constraint, autopilot dynamics and fixed-time convergence is proposed. Firstly, the nonsingular terminal sliding mode control, fixed-time stability theory and backstepping control are used to design the guidance law. In the design process, a nonsingular terminal sliding mode surface with fixed-time convergence is designed. Based on the super-twisting algorithm and fixed-time stability theory, a fixed-time convergent sliding mode disturbance observer is designed to estimate the target maneuvering and other disturbances. A tracking differentiator is used to solve the differential expansion in the traditional backstepping control. Then, based on the Lyapunov stability theory, the fixed-time stability of the guidance law is proved, and the expression of convergence time is given. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed guidance law is verified by simulation analysis. Compared with the existing guidance laws, the proposed guidance law has higher guidance precision and angle constraint accuracy, faster system convergence speed and less energy consumption.

articleTitle: A Single Image Defogging Algorithm Based on Bright and Dark Region Segmentation
abstract: The defogging algorithms based on the dark channel prior have a poor effect in the scene with dim brightness or multiple bright and dark regions, and the defogged image is generally dark. In this paper, a single image defogging algorithm based on bright and dark region segmentation is proposed. Firstly, the foggy image is sharpened, and segmented into several super pixels by using the improved SLIC super pixel segmentation method. According to the brightness feature of the super pixels, they are classified into multiple bright and dark regions. Then, the transmittance and atmospheric light are calculated by using the bright and dark segmentation image and the physical model of atmospheric scattering, and the preliminary defogged image is obtained. Finally, HSV spatial brightness adjustment algorithm is used to correct the brightness of bright regions, and multi-scale Retinex algorithm with adaptive weights is used to enhance the brightness of dark regions to obtain the final defogged image. The experiment shows that the method in this paper can effectively avoid the influence of multiple bright and dark regions on estimation of transmittance and atmospheric light, and it has a good effect in ordinary scenes and scenes with dim brightness or multiple bright and dark regions, so it is more applicable than other defogging methods based on the dark channel prior. In addition, the defogging ability of the proposed method is comparable to that of defogging methods based on deep learning, and the real-time performance of the proposed method is higher than that of defogging methods based on deep learning.

Author Keywords: division of bright and dark regions

articleTitle: UGG-DA:Uncertainty-Guided Gradual Distribution Adaptation and Dynamic Prediction with Streaming Data
abstract: Streaming data prediction has had a great deal of success in a variety of situations as sensor technology has advanced. However, efficacy declines due to the typical evolution of data distribution over time. Traditional domain adaptation entails only a minor transition. We propose a novel progressive domain adaptation method to address this issue. Our method can reduce domain discrepancy for both large and minor shifts that have accumulated. Our approach designs a dynamic alignment strategy for pseudo labels based on uncertainty and confidence. Then, we provide a new theoretical bound for a scenario of gradual domain adaptation that is more stringent than traditional DA. The experimental results confirm the superiority of our method in the wind field dataset, demonstrating its viability and potential.

articleTitle: Improve Indoor Localization Accuracy by Enriching CSI Fingerprints with CDPM
abstract: Existing WiFi indoor localization methods require collecting a lot of Channel State Information (CSI) fingerprints at each reference point, which costs significant manpower and time. In this paper, we propose to expand CSI fingerprint dataset by using Conditional Diffusion Probabilistic Model (CDPM), generating artificial fingerprints for each reference positions additionally. The method avoids the high difficulty of adversarial training and mode collapse caused by traditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), and only needs to collect limited CSI fingerprints. The results on the public dataset show that the mean error of the proposed method is 2.7%~10.1% lower than the method based on ACGAN.

articleTitle: Front Matter
Parameter Determination for Hyper-elastic Material based on a BLSTM Neural Network with Optimized Condition Numbers
abstract: Parameters determination is crucial in applications involving hyper-elastic materials. In this paper, a novel method based on a bidirectional long short-term memory (BLSTM) neural network is proposed to learn the relationship between the indentation load-depth data and the hyper-elastic material parameters. Considering the influence of data errors on prediction accuracy, condition number in this inverse problem is analyzed and optimized. In addition, the input data are assigned different weights according to their condition numbers in order to bring more attention on the reliable data. Our network has been tested by using a finite element simulation dataset and has shown excellent effects results for identifying hyper-elastic material parameters.

articleTitle: Path planning and control implementation of belt rounded grinding based on cooperative robot
abstract: At present, most of the wood fillet profiles are grinding by hand, and the precision of manual grinding is insufficient. Therefore, this paper proposes an integrated grinding platform for belt fillet grinding with cooperative robot as the core to solve the above problems. Through the design of the servo, fixture structure and control system, the automatic machining and grinding of the workpiece can be realized. In order to improve the precision of fillet grinding, the path of fillet grinding is reasonably planned, and the final grinding accuracy is ± 1mm. In this paper, a fully automatic, visual, safe and practical integrated platform for belt fillet grinding of mechanical arm is designed, which effectively reduces the overall equipment and labor costs, and improves the processing efficiency.

articleTitle: A Crossing Azimuth based Optimal Base Station Selection Algorithm for 5G Positioning
abstract: We propose an optimal selection method for 5G base station data to achieve high-accuracy positioning estimation in indoor and outdoor environments. The proposed method is mainly composed of three sequential modules, namely initial positioning estimation, measurement data optimization and estimated position update. Initial positioning estimation uses the raw measurement data and the basic mathematical model with position estimation to work out the mobile vehicle position. The measurement data optimization module takes the number of buildings in the azimuth threshold area set between the initial position of the mobile vehicle and the 5G base station position as the judgment condition to achieve the re-selection of data. The estimated position update implements the initial estimated position update of the mobile vehicle by using the preferred data and the basic mathematical model with pose estimation. The results of the simulations show that the performance of the localization results of the solution mode with preferred data is significantly better than that of the solution mode using the initial data measurement.

articleTitle: A Demand Charge Model for Energy-intensive Enterprises based on Model Predictive Control
abstract: The emission reduction of energy-intensive enterprises has become increasingly important due to the goal of carbon dioxide peaking. While ensuring economic performance, how to reduce the demand charge is an important part to optimize electrical consumption. However, the problem is hard to consider in the short-term period because the monthly demand charge may increase due to the previous strategies. Based on the peak load shifting method, this paper proposes a short-term scheduling problem with the measurement of the slip type demand which combines the short-term forecast data with day-ahead forecast data to introduce the effect of future demand. The problem is formulated into a mixed integer linear programming problem with the objective of minimizing the economic cost. Numerical results show the demand charge can be reduced by 7.97% with the short-term scheduling strategies, and the forecast demand can be well used in short-term regulation decisions.

articleTitle: An SSVEP Classification Method Based on a Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: Steady-state visually evoked potential (SSVEP) is a typical paradigm of brain-computer interface system (BCIs). How to fully extract and utilize the features of SSVEP to improve the classification accuracy is a crucial task in the development of SSVEP-BCI system. Aiming at the SSVEP-BCI system with little target visual stimulus paradigm, deep learning is applied to the research of SSVEP signal classification in this paper, and a classification method of SSVEP signal based on convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed. It solves the problem of lower classification accuracy of canonical correlation analysis (CCA) and filter bank canonical correlation analysis (FBCCA) methods in short-time. The data set used for the study was 800 sets of SSVEP data from 20 subjects of Inner Mongolia University of Technology (IMUT). In this study, the effects of data length and number of leads on classification accuracy and information transmission rate (ITR) were analyzed. The experimental results show that the highest classification accuracy of CNN model reaches 95.86%, and the maximum ITR reaches 183.05bit/min. Compared with the existing CCA method and FBCCA method, CNN method can significantly improve the classification accuracy and ITR of SSVEP signal stimulation frequency.

articleTitle: Drought Prediction Using SVM, Naïve Bayes and LSTM Recurrent Neural Network*
abstract: Based on the meteorological records of 16 regions in Yunnan Province, this paper establishes a drought prediction model using three machine learning methods: support vector machine (SVM), naive Bayes, and Long Short-Term Memory model (LSTM). The analysis of the cross-validation results shows that the predictions of the three models have high cross-validation accuracy (see Table 1). By comparing and analyzing these three types of models, the author found that LSTM adopted in this paper is superior to the other two models from the perspective of cross-validation accuracy, while the SVM model is superior to the naïve Bayesian model in comparison with the other two types of models. In addition, this paper also uses the three models that have been trained to predict the drought of 16 regions in Yunnan in the coming month. It is found that the three models have high average prediction accuracy (see Table 2). Through comparison, it is found that the deep learning model LSTM is superior to the other two models, while the SVM model is superior to the naïve Bayes.

articleTitle: A Novel Route Planning Approach Based on Energy-Based Action Sample Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Route planning for driverless vehicles in given environment has been widely studied. In this paper, a novel route path planning approach is proposed for self-driving based on energy-based action sample reinforcement learning. Firstly, based on the established graph, Q-learning is adopted in agent training with an novel considering steering penalty into reward function. Secondly, an innovative energy-based action sampling method is used to choose the most valuable action. Thirdly, the agent interacts with environment to plan a global path from the start to the goal point. As the results shown in experiments, this approach can complete the route planning task, and perform better in path length and turns (i.e. evaluation indicators).

articleTitle: A three-dimensional flow field reconstruction method of wing based on SE-3DUnet
abstract: Convolutional neural networks are used instead of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solvers to simulate flow fields in design, analysis, and optimization problems related to aerodynamics. However, in the flow field distribution, the flow field near the aircraft wing changes It is more severe at the nearer end. When reconstructing the flow field information, we should focus on the near-end How field characteristics of the aircraft and increase the weight of its features. However, feature redundancy will appear when using the existing method for sample feature extraction. This paper proposes a 3D airfoil flow field prediction method based on improved SE-3DUnet, which improves SENet and introduces global maximum pooling. The method in this paper can fuse shallow feature maps with more detailed texture information into advanced Among the characteristics. The experimental results on the actual data set show that compared with Unet, the average precision of the method in this paper is increased by 5.76%

articleTitle: Multi Aspect Attention Online Integrated Distillation For Few-shot Learning
abstract: Few-shot learning is to identify new visual patterns with only a small number of labeled samples in each class. We propose an online integrated distillation extraction method KDCP (Multi Aspect Attention Online Integrated Distillation) based upon a multi-attention mechanism. The parallel attention mechanism is used to construct the sub-network branch part to mine the semantic information of the image multi-aspect. The feature distribution obtained from different attention angles is integrated as a teacher network. Let the integrated teacher probability distill the probability of different attention predictions so that the child-student network continuously learns the implicit essential point relationship. Through a major number of experiments on commonly used benchmark datasets, it is proved that the proposed method is superior to the most advanced method, and it is confirmed that multi-aspect online knowledge distillation can clearly impress the accuracy of the network.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification and Extended State Observer-Based Predictive Control for Single-Phase Inverter
abstract: The single-phase inverter-based circuit breaker test system has the advantages of fast current response speed and simple structure. In this work, the deadbeat model predictive control (DMPC) combined with parameter identification and extended state observer (ESO) is proposed for the output current control of the single-phase inverter. With merits of fast dynamic response speed, the DMPC is designed to control the output current of the multi-magnetic circuit transformer. However, the disturbances caused by the varying load impedance and model parameters will affect the control performance of DMPC. Therefore, an identification method is proposed to extract the parameters to improve the regulation accuracy of DMPC. Furthermore, the ESO is proposed to estimate and compensate the model mismatches. Finally, the control accuracy and output current response speed are improved by using the composite controller. The robustness against the varying load impedance and model mismatches of the proposed control strategy are verified by simulations and experimental results.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimal Height of Ionospheric Thin Layer Based on Scintillation Phase Screen Model
abstract: In the modeling of ionospheric scintillation analysis, the irregular layer causing scintillation is regarded as a single thin layer structure. In civil aviation, the scintillation modeling error caused by the regional change of the height of this thin layer directly affects the subsequent test of receiver performance. In order to improve the accuracy of scintillation modeling, a method for optimizing the height of ionospheric thin layer is proposed. This method uses the relationship between the height of ionospheric thin layer and the change rate of the total electron content of the ionosphere in the modeling, and determines the optimal height of thin layer in different regions by comparing the estimated value and the reference value of the change rate of the total electron content. The proposed method is analyzed and verified by the peak height of electron density and the measured scintillation index data. The experimental results show that the optimized thin layer height value conforms to the actual change and makes the simulated scintillation size more accurate.

Author Keywords: rate of total electron content index

articleTitle: H∞ Output Regulation of Switched Multi-Agent Systems with multiple Lyapunov function method
abstract: This paper addresses the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> cooperative output regulation problem of multi-agent systems where each agent is a switched system. By using the regulation equations, the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> cooperative output regulation problem can be converted into the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control problem. Under the algebraic Riccati equations and some mild assumptions, sufficient solvability conditions of the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> cooperative output regulation problem for switched agent networks are obtained by multiple Lyapunov function method. With available constrained information, the distributed dynamic controllers are designed. Finally, an example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control protocols.

articleTitle: A web service selection model based on DeepFM and hash space segment matching
abstract: QoS is an important indicator to measure the quality of web services. How to choose the most suitable web service is an urgent problem to solve. Factors such as independent QoS attributes and data sparseness may cause poor service selection accuracy, making it impossible to select matching web services for users. Therefore, this paper proposes an algorithm for service selection based on DeepFM model and hash list. By learning the interaction relationship between low-order features and high-order features of QoS attributes based on the DeepFM model and DeepFM model can effectively solve the cold start problem caused by data sparseness. To improve the accuracy of QoS prediction, the hash-based service matching algorithm is used to quickly select service resources. Experiments show that the proposed model is helpful to improve the effect of service selection.

articleTitle: A multiple-time-scale control strategy for burden distribution and blast supply of a BF
abstract: The operations of blast furnaces (BFs) are very vital for the long-term stability of the iron making process. The burden distribution and blast supply are the two major operation systems of BFs. At present, the researches are lack effective adjustment methods for the BF operations combined with burden distribution and blast supply. The burden distribution affects the iron making process on a long time scale, while the blast supply affects the iron making process on a short time scale. This paper presents a multi-time sampling-data adjustment strategy for the BF operations aiming at optimizing GUR on multiple time scales. First, this paper analyzes the relationship between the gas utilization ratio (GUR) and the burden distribution, the blast supply on multiple time scales. Then, this paper establishes a prediction model of GUR on the long time scale and the short time scale based on autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA). Next, this paper provides a control strategy of burden distribution and a control strategy of blast supply by a prediction model based on support vector regression (SVR).
