Finally, this paper makes experiments and applies this method in a real-world BF. The analysis of the results shows the control strategy of the BF operations provides a good guide on making a suitable decision for burden distribution and blast supply.

articleTitle: Robust Mixed H∞ and Passive Event-triggered Reliable Control for Networked Control Systems under Denial of Service Attacks
abstract: This paper studies the event-triggered robust mixed H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> and passive finite-time control for uncertain Networked Control systems (NCSs) with actuator failure and malicious denial of service (DoS) attacks. First, a time-delay system model is established based on a switching-like event-triggered scheme. Then, some sufficient conditions that can ensure finite-time bounded with mixed H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> and passive performance for the nominal and uncertain NCSs are derived in the presence and absence of DoS attacks, respectively. Furthermore, the co-design of the robust reliable controller and event-triggered parameters is obtained in terms of linear matrix inequalities. Finally, a single-link robot arm example is given to illustrate the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Operation Optimization Method for Alumina Evaporation Processes
abstract: Alumina evaporation process is one of important process in alumina production plant. The purpose of the above process is to control alkaline solution concentration within a certain range. However, alkaline solution concentration can not be measured on-line. Moreover, dynamics characteristic between the optimal goals and the control loops are too complex to established model. Thus, the existing optimal methods can not solve the optimal control for operation of the alumina evaporation process. To address above problem, a hybrid intelligent optimal control method is proposed, which include feedforward and feedback compensators based on expert rules, presetting model based on case-base reasoning (CBR), soft sensor model based on recursive partial least squares (RPLS). The simulation results show that the proposed methods can control the alkaline solution concentration within their scopes.

articleTitle: Inspection trolley based on the distance detection obstacle
abstract: In Industry 4.0 background, unmanned full-process automated production has gradually become a hot topic, and the realization of intelligent and information factory requires the joint cooperation of multiple industries, in which the inspection device that replaces traditional manual work is an inescapable topic. At present, domestic and foreign research on intelligent inspection trolley is focused on obstacle avoidance function based on various sensors. In this context, it is introduced an algorithm based on monocular camera as a sensor, using Python language to access OpenCV library, and utilizing Gaussian filter function and Canny operator-based image contour extraction to complete the distance measurement. The algorithm can achieve the distance measurement and obstacle avoidance function at a lower cost. The test results show that the system can automatically identify the distance of obstacles in the inspection process, and according to the visual information captured by the camera in real time, it can independently generate steering action and collision reminder, and can complete the preliminary requirement of intelligent inspection.

articleTitle: Model-free distributed coordination control for dual-arm reconfigurable manipulators with handling task constraints
abstract: In this paper, a distributed coordination control of dual-arm reconfigurable manipulators based on neural networks learning is presented for handling tasks. Based on Newton-Euler algorithm, the dynamic models of the manipulators and grasped object are established through kinematic analyze, respectively. According to the load distribution method, the motion-induced force is effectively distributed to each arm of the manipulator, and then the dynamics of the single reconfigurable manipulator is obtained. An improved sliding mode function is designed to reflect the error of the joint trajectory and internal force. The radial basis function neural network (RBFNN) is utilized to learn the uncertain dynamics of reconfigurable manipulator. Then the model-free distributed coordination controller is obtained. The asymptotic stability of dual-arm reconfigurable manipulators is proved through Lyapunov stability theory. Finally, the validity of the model-free distributed coordination controller is verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Research on Trade Credit Contract with the Fluctuation of Manufacturer's Purchase Price
abstract: This paper considers a credit system composed of a manufacturer and a retailer. Consider the fluctuation of raw material prices of manufacturer, the optimal decision-making of manufacturer and retailer in the supply chain under the exponential pricing contract is studied by adopting the exponential pricing strategy. The change law of the optimal order quantity and the optimal pricing with the proportion index is given. It is found that the optimal order quantity decreases with the price, and the relationship between the optimal order quantity and the proportion index is related to the current price and the expected price; the manufacturer's profit is a concave function about the proportion index, and the conditions for the optimal proportion index are given. Finally, the theoretical results are verified and extended by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Hybrid-scheduling-based sliding mode control of Markovian jump systems
abstract: This study deals with the sliding mode control problem for a class of Markovian jump systems (MJSs) with limited communication channel bandwidth. To reduce the transmission frequency and improve the channel resource utilization, a hybrid scheduling scheme that integrates event-triggering (ET) mechanism and Round-Robin protocol (RRP) is employed to decide the data transmission of sensor to controller (S/C) communication network. In this paper, the RRP is used to assign the access of sensor nodes that meeting specified triggering condition. Based on which, a token-and-mode-dependent sliding mode control law is constructed, which only depends on the triggered state component. Moreover, sufficient conditions are established such that the resulting MJSs is stochastic stable. Finally, a numerical example shows the effectiveness of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Classification of Power Quality Disturbances Based on Multi-domain Parallel Feature Extraction and Optimization Strategy
abstract: With the extensive application of renewable energy generation and lots of new nonlinear loads such as electric vehicles, the power quality disturbances (PQDs) in the power grid become more complex and diverse. So how to extract complex features from big data of various PQDs and improve the classification accuracy by artificial intelligence technology has become a key issue in the field of power quality analysis. This paper presents a classification method based on multi-domain parallel feature extraction and optimization strategy. Multi-domain feature extraction is proposed to overcome the disadvantage of traditional feature extraction methods and enhance the diversity and completeness of original feature set. Feature selection strategy based on mutual information and fisher sore is used to reduce the cross-coupling of the original features, which obtains an efficient feature subset. Finally, the classifier based on extreme learning machine (ELM) is trained by optimized feature set and outputs the classification results. Numerical simulations illustrate efficiency and feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Research on master-slave teleoperation control algorithm based on exoskeleton master hand
abstract: In order to obtain a more anthropomorphic experience in remote control, we use a wearable exoskeleton type master hand, which can obtain real-time human upper limb motion information. And through the master-slave constraint algorithm, it completes the synchronous control of the slave robot, and then completes a series of tasks that people cannot directly participate in. The original control scheme is further optimized, so that the tracking accuracy of the slave end effector is significantly improved. First, the Denavit-Hartenberg model of the master and slave devices is established through Robotic Toolbox 9.10 robot toolbox, and the workspace of the master and slave devices is analyzed respectively using Monte Carlo method. Secondly, the control scheme is designed to make the master exoskeleton complete the high-precision real-time control of the slave robot. Finally, the simulation results show that the master exoskeleton can complete the synchronization control of the slave robot, and the terminal accuracy is further improved on the basis of the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Variable selection method based on filter-wrapped hybrid framework and its application in wastewater treatment processes
abstract: In order to achieve the goal of intelligent management of wastewater treatment plants, it is necessary to monitor the parameters of wastewater treatment in real time. Currently, soft measurement technology based on neural network is widely used to solve the problem of key parameters that are difficult to obtain directly in wastewater treatment processes. Selecting appropriate input variables can reduce the complexity of the neural network topology while improving the prediction accuracy of the soft measurement model. To this end, this paper proposes a variable selection method based on the filter-wrapped hybrid framework (FWHVS), which uses the maximum information coefficient (MIC) index and a radial basis function (RBF) neural network. The proposed method only considers removing redundant and irrelevant variables to optimize the review stage of the SFFS method, thus improving computational efficiency. Finally, common variable selection methods are used as comparison methods to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method using the UCI wastewater treatment dataset.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis for Single-phase Grounding in Distribution Network Based on Hilbert-Huang Transform and Siamese Convolution Neural Network
abstract: Single-phase grounding fault is the most common fault in distribution network. It is very important to quickly identify the cause of single-phase grounding fault for improving the reliability of power supply in distribution network. For similar types of faults that are not easy to identify, this paper presents a feature extraction method for single-phase grounding faults in distribution network based on Hilbert-Huang transformation. To solve the problem of insufficient training samples, this paper presents a fault diagnosis method for single-phase grounding in distribution networks based on Siamese convolution neural network, which can extract valid fault features under the condition of insufficient fault samples and significantly improve the fault diagnosis results.

articleTitle: Feature selection based on Null Importance for Fault Diagnosis of Chiller
abstract: Fault detection and diagnosis of chillers have a significant impact on equipment lifetime, indoor comfort, energy efficiency, and performance of building management systems. The feature selection of chiller variables is the most important step in the process of FDD of chillers, and the selection of important features not only reduces the variable dimension and the use of field sensors, but also improves the detection accuracy. In this paper, we apply the Null Importance method based on the LightGBM(Light Gradient Boosting Machine) model to the feature selection of chiller variables and use ASHRAE project 1043-RP for experimental validation. This set of features and all features are then used to train common models for fault detection and diagnosis separately to verify the validity of feature selection. These common models include Support Vector Machine, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and K-Nearest Neighbor. The results of the experiments show that the Null Importance feature selection method based on the LightGBM model is effective for chiller unit fault diagnosis, and the selected 16 features can achieve better fault diagnosis and detection results than using all features on the Support Vector Machine, Decision Tree, and K-Nearest Neighbor.

articleTitle: Fixed-time distributed cooperative control for pure feedback multi-agent systems with quantized input saturation and output constraints
abstract: This paper investigates the distributed fixed-time cooperative control problem of nonlinear pure feedback multi-agent systems with quantized input saturation and output constraints. The mean value theorem is used to deal with the problem of non-affine structure in nonlinear pure-feedback systems. Meanwhile, the radial basis function neural networks are employed to approximate the unknown smooth functions produced in the adaptive control design process. Furthermore, A barrier Lyapunov function is used to solve the output constraints, and the control input saturation signals will be quantized by a hysteresis quantizer. It is shown that the fixed-time consensus control protocol designed in this paper ensures that all signals in the closed-loop system are semiglobally uniform and ultimately bounded in a fixed time. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: ICRFormer: An Improving Cos-Reweighting Transformer for 3D Human Pose Estimation in Video
abstract: Monocular 3D human pose estimation is a difficult task due to depth blur and occlusion. Spatial-temporal information is used in recent methods to alleviate these problems. However, recent methods usually utilize the original Transformer architecture and ignore the impact of efficient Transformer on 3D HPE. Therefore, we propose an improving Cos-Reweighting Transformer (ICRFormer) to estimate 3D human pose with better performance. In detail, we firstly analyze the general expressions of attention and propose an efficient Transformer architecture named Enahnced Transformer (EFormer). Then, to further extract the association among different sequences, we propose a Cos-Reweighting module to strengthen the ability of correlation calculations. Abundant experiments are conducted on two commonly used datasets: Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP to evaluate ICRFormer. It is shown that our model achieve competitive performance on Human3.6M and obtains the state-of-the-art result on MPI-INF-3DHP. Compared with the most recent method MHFormer, our model outperforms it 0.2% MPJPE on Human3.6M dataset and 43.4% MPJPE on MPI-INF-3DHP.

articleTitle: Optimal configuration method of distributed energy storage system with branch flow model constraints
abstract: In order to realize the goal of "double carbon" and the photovoltaic strategic planning of the whole county, aiming at the problem of location and capacity determination of distributed energy storage to reduce the influence of distributed new energy on the distribution network, this paper considers the system benefits and costs, and proposes an optimal configuration model of distributed energy storage based on the constraint of branch power flow model on the basis of phase Angle relaxation and second-order cone relaxation of the power system constraints. Examples show that this method can effectively improve the voltage quality of distribution network, reduce the maximum transmission power of heavy-duty lines and improve the absorption rate of distributed new energy.

articleTitle: Proportional-Integral Observer-Based Fault-Tolerant Control for Markov Jump Systems with Partially Unknown Transition Probabilities
abstract: In this paper, the problem of fault-tolerant control (FTC) is researched for a class of Markov jump systems in the presence of partially unknown transition probabilities. A proportional-integral observer is designed to simultaneously estimate faults, system states, and measurement disturbances. Then, a FTC strategy is put forward to guarantee that the closed-loop system is asymptotically bounded in mean square. The effectiveness of the FTC scheme is confirmed by simulation results.

articleTitle: The Environmental Efficiency Assessment of Logistics Service Providers: a Non-radial Data Envelopment Analysis
abstract: Logistics activities have drawn lots of attention for its environmental externalities. From micro perspective, this paper gives comprehensive measurement of environmental efficiency to logistics service providers by using non-radial data envelopment analysis. The environmental efficiency measurement is framed into two by environmental management strategies, the reactive and proactive. The results show that the environmental efficiency values under reactive strategy are higher than the efficiency values under proactive strategy, while the efficiencies under proactive strategy are more differentiated. Moreover, the statistical test shows that the environmental performance of international logistics companies is better than Chinese logistics companies under the proactive strategy. These empirical findings can provide implications to the reformation of environmental management strategy in the sustainable development of the supply chain.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Flight Attitude Control Using Error Dynamics Based Dual Heuristic Dynamic Programming
abstract: This paper presents an improved approach called error dynamics based dual heuristic dynamic programming (ED-DHP) for nonlinear flight attitude control. The augmented system state containing tracking error and reference trajectory are defined for the DHP to solve the tracking problem, without requiring the complete knowledge of the vehicle dynamics and the reference trajectory dynamics. A recursive least square method is used to identify not only the input dynamics, but also the total uncertainty of the system based on the error dynamics in real time. The simulations of two different air vehicles demonstrate the good performance of ED-DHP for the online self-learning flight attitude control.

articleTitle: A lithium-ion battery RUL prediction method based on improved variational modal decomposition and integrated depth model
abstract: In the context of energy shortage, lithium-ion batteries have become the highest consumer demand and most widely used class of batteries in the global battery market with their excellent performance of high-energy density, small size, low rate of self-discharge, good cycling performance and long lifetime, and the research into predicting the remaining useful life (RUL) of lithium-ion batteries has also grown in importance. In this essay, a new method to predict battery RUL based on improved variational modal decomposition (VMD) with integrated depth model is proposed, which improves the prediction accuracy of a single model under a single scale signal. Firstly, the general deterioration trend and local random fluctuation components of signal are obtained by performing a multiscale decomposition on battery capacity data. Secondly, the time convolutional network (TCN) and the convolutional neural network and long and short-term memory neural network combined (CNN-LSTM) are used to model each fluctuation component and global degradation trend respectively. Thirdly, the predict result of each sub-model is combined to get the ultimate battery RUL predict result. Finally, lithium-ion battery datasets from NASA are utilized to test the accuracy of the prediction model, and the result demonstrates the excellent stability and prediction accuracy of the suggested approach.

articleTitle: Fast Distributed Economic Dispatch for Hybrid Ship Microgrid with Photovoltaic Panel
abstract: This paper proposes a fast distributed economic dispatch method for hybrid ship microgrids. Firstly, for a hybrid ship microgrid with fossil fuel-burning generators and renewable energy generators, the economic dispatch model is constructed with the objective of minimizing the overall cost of power generators. And, an environmental cost function is introduced to reduce the emission of polluting gases and increase the overall proportion of renewable energy generators. Then, a fast distributed algorithm is proposed to solve the optimization problem. Finally, the simulation results show that the method proposed in this paper is able to converge to the new equilibrium faster when dealing with the variation of power generation of photovoltaic panels and is suitable for the hybrid ship microgrid proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Few-Shot Segmentation based on Global-cross Attention
abstract: As one of the major problems in the field of computer vision, few-shot segmentation has been always in the spotlight. The goal of few-shot segmentation is to employ a few samples to train a model so that it can segment the same kind of query images. However, features of images are invariably the crux to achieve semantic representations. For the sake of extracting more features and further improving the accuracy of semantic segmentation, we propose a network based on global-cross attention. The network obtains global information of the images through the global-cross attention module and correlates local regions to generate more detailed knowledge. The two modules cooperate jointly to improve the performance of the network via feature fusion. We conduct a series of experiments on PASCAL-5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sup> to evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed network and achieve better performance.

articleTitle: Water Quality Prediction Model Based on DSAPSO Optimized Radial Basis Function Neural Network
abstract: Sewage treatment is a nonlinear and complex biochemical process, which needs reasonable monitoring and control to make it run stably and efficiently. However, online monitoring of relevant water quality parameters is currently difficult, time-consuming and costly. In order to improve the situation and improve the effluent quality, a DSAPSO (Dual Search Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization) algorithm was proposed to optimize the soft measurement model of effluent quality of RBFNN (Radial Basis Function Neural Network). By comparing the improved algorithm proposed with the standard PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) algorithm and the APSO (Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization) algorithm under four test functions, the results show that the improved algorithm has better optimization accuracy and robustness. Finally, the prediction results of effluent COD (Chemical Oxygen Demand) content of DSAPSO-RBF model were compared with those of RBF model, PSO-RBF model and APSO-RBF model. The MSE (Mean Square Error) and RMSE (Root Mean Square Error) of DSAPSO-RBF model were proposed to decrease by 0.72%-4.23% and 4.39%-15.45% respectively. MAE (Mean Absolute Error) decreased by 3.46%-15.04%, and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (Model Correlation Index) increased by 4.26%-25.14%, which proved that the model built in this paper has better prediction accuracy and can provide a new idea for the measurement of key parameters of sewage treatment.

articleTitle: Quadruped Robot Get Bionic Learning Method Based on Intelligent Memory Soft Actor-Critic
abstract: Quadruped robot gait control is a widely studied topic, with the advancements in artificial intelligence, reinforcement learning-based approaches provide a promising solution for bionic gait learning of quadruped robots. In this study, we propose an Intelligent Memory Soft Actor-Critic (IM-SAC) algorithm that uses the Soft Actor-Critic algorithm as the basic framework and incorporates Long Short-Term Memory network (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) to extract time-sequence-related sequence information of the quadruped robot motion. The IM-SAC algorithm aims to maximize the motion reward by controlling the degree of memory and forgetting of sample information, giving priority to learning samples with high reward values, and achieving faster cumulative rewards and optimization models. We design a reward function using the quadruped robot's own speed, swing angle, and other information to train the robot, and use the 12 motor angles as output values to control the movement of the quadruped robot. We conducted experiments on the Pybullet platform to test the algorithm's performance in gait learning tasks of the quadruped robot. The results show that our study provides a promising solution for gait control of quadruped robots by integrating reinforcement learning and intelligent memory mechanisms.

articleTitle: Target Detection in Remote Sensing Images Based on Multi-scale Fusion Faster RCNN
abstract: Target detection in remote sensing images is widely used in civil and military applications and plays an increasingly important role. In this paper, a novel multi-scale fusion Faster RCNN model is proposed to realize target detection in optical remote sensing images. First, the preprocessing operation is performed on the dataset by using VOC format for pretreatment and data enhancement. Second, based on traditional Faster RCNN architecture, the EfficientNetb0 and FPN is combined to extract multi-scale fusion image features, so as to obtain pyramid feature and improve the ability of network. Finally, the prepared dataset is used to train the multi-scale fusion Faster RCNN model, and then the prediction results are obtained by ROI Polling. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method in this paper can achieve higher accuracy as high as 84.4% of target detection in remote sensing images while reducing the size of the model.

articleTitle: Compensation of transmission delay of SM controlled DC/DC converter systems
abstract: In order to solve the problem of transmission delay located in DC/DC converter systems, a novel compensation approach is proposed by combining sliding mode (SM) control and predictive control. Taking an n-phase interleaving DC/DC buck converter as an example to simulate the signal transmission in such systems like the distributed energy and DC micro-grid types, the discrete model is established, following the design of discrete SM controller based on Lyapunov stability. Considering the random property of the transmission delay, a buffer zone is adopted to change the delay time into a fixed value, and further, a multistep prediction approach is used to estimate the length of the delay time. By using the robustness of SM controller, the influence of transmission delay can be compensated automatically, following the analysis of the system stability. Simulations validate the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on equalization of lithium battery pack based on Buck converter
abstract: The available capacity of the series lithium battery is limited by the capacity of the single battery. The capacity difference of the single battery is easy to cause the phenomenon of overcharge and over discharge, and it will cause deflagration problem seriously. In order to increase the available capacity, an equalization circuit based on Buck converter is proposed in this paper. The equalization circuit includes a Buck converter and a switching bridge structure, which improves the flexibility of the circuit while reducing the number of switching devices. With the state of charge (SOC) of a single battery as the equilibrium variable, the "valley filling" of the single battery with the lowest SOC and the "peak cutting" of the battery pack can be realized. The simulation results based on MATLAB/Simulink show that compared with the control group without using equalization circuit, the available capacity of this scheme is increased by10 %,12.5 % and 13.7 % respectively under charging, discharging and resting conditions, which proves the practicability of this scheme.

articleTitle: Cooperative Hunting Method of Unmanned Surface Vehicle based on Attention Mechanism
abstract: The hunting of dynamic targets by multi unmanned surface vehicle(USV) is an important problem in USV swarm operations. In this paper, aiming at the dynamic target oriented swarm hunting problem, by analyzing the shortcomings of the hunting mechanism based on MADDPG algorithm, we introduce the attention mechanism into the hunting process, and then design the cooperative hunting strategy based on the attention mechanism(Att-MADDPG), updating the corresponding hunting algorithm. Firstly, the attention module is added to critic network to process the information of all USVs according to different attention weights. Secondly, the attention module is added to actor network to promote other USVs to carry out cooperative hunting. Finally, establish obstacle-free and obstacle simulation environment according to the hunting task. The simulation results show that the training stability and timeliness of Att-MADDPG algorithm are significantly improved compared with MADDPG algorithm. After learning, the USV can cooperate to make the swarm emerge more intelligent behavior.

articleTitle: The container stowage planning problem in a barge convoy system via Q-learning-based NSGA-II algorithm
abstract: The Container Stowage Planning Problem (CSPP) is a very complex and challenging problem involving the interests of shipping companies and ports. In inland shipping, multiple barges can be assembled into a fleet to transport a large number of containers to and from the hinterland. For this scenario, El Yaagoubi et al. [1] proposed the 3D-barge Convoy Container Stowage Planning Problem (3D-CCSPP), which is an extension of CSPP. This article optimizes the 3D-CCSPP mathematical model and proposes a Q-learning-based non-dominated genetic algorithm (Q-NSGA-II) to solve the model efficiently. The main innovation of the algorithm is its new mutation operator selection mechanism, which incorporates Q-learning to select the appropriate mutation operator during the search process. Comprehensive computational experiments were carried out on a wide range of examples to evaluate the performance of the proposed algorithm. Experimental results show that for the 3D-CCSPP problem, the proposed Q-NSGA-II can obtain a better set of non-dominated solutions. Moreover, the algorithm is more stable, with better convergence and robustness.

articleTitle: Multistable Behaviors Analysis and Sliding Mode Control of Fractional-order Memristive Hindmarsh–Rose Neuron
abstract: In this paper, based on the existing 3D memristor Hindmarsh–Rose (HR) neuron model, a fractional-order model is constructed and numerically solved by Adomian decomposition method. The influence of fractional-order q on the system is analyzed by using bifurcation diagram, Spectral entropy(SE)/C0 complexity, 0-1 test and other algorithms, it is found that the multistable characteristics of the system are more complex under fractional-order behavior. The effects of coupling parameters of external stimulus current and memristor on the multistability of the system are also studied. Then, based on the sliding mode control theory, chaos synchronization controller of the system are designed, Matlab simulation results show that the controller is realizable and effective, and also has the characteristics of fast response, which provides a reference for the control and application of memristor neural network system.

articleTitle: Output tracking control of discrete network time-delay systems under input quantization and colored noise
abstract: In this paper, we study the output tracking control (OTC) performance of multi-input-multi-output (MIMO) discrete network time-delay systems under input quantization and colored noise, at the same time, the effect of output channel energy limitation is considered. On the basis of the coprime decomposition, all-pass factorization, inner-outer factorization and Youla parameterization of two-degree-of-freedom (TDOF) compensator, a new performance index is proposed and the exact expression of the system OTC performance is derived by designing the compensator. The results show that the OTC performance is determined by the position and direction of the non-minimum phase (NMP) zeros and unstable poles (UPs) and time-delay of the controlled plant. In addition, the presence of quantization error, bandwidth constraints, coding and decoding and colored noise can also affect the tracking performance. Finally, a simulation example proves the accuracy of the theory.

articleTitle: Control logic design and application for large scale helium cryogenic refrigerator on CODAC system
abstract: The Comprehensive Research Facility for Fusion Technology (CRAFT), as a large-scale scientific research facility led by Institute of Plasma Physics, aims to study and verify the key technologies of the fusion reactor host. The 1kW/4.5K helium refrigerator process and control logic, control architecture, classification and description of the control logic were mainly introduced in this paper. The preliminary construction of the control system based on Control, Data Access and Communication (CODAC) was completed, including continuous control logic, interlock control logic, and supervisory control logic, and the automatic control of vacuum pump group was used as an example to show the implementation of control logic.

articleTitle: Integral Sliding Mode Control of Quadrotor Attitude Tracking based on Adding Power Integrator Technique
abstract: The attitude tracking control problem of a quadrotor in the presence of the parametric uncertainty and external disturbance is studied. Firstly, the adding power integrator technique is employed to design a finite-time nominal controller for the attitude tracking control system. On this basis, an integral sliding mode surface is developed. The system state can converge to zero within finite time along the sliding surface when the ideal sliding motion is established. Combining the adaptive control technique and sliding mode control theory, an adaptive finite-time sliding mode control scheme is presented. It can drive the tracking errors converge to a small region containing zero. The finite-time stability of the attitude control system can be proved by the Lyapunov method strictly. Finally, a simulation example is conducted to verify the attitude tracking controller's effectiveness.

articleTitle: Multi-stage Feature Interaction Network for Masked Visible-thermal Person Re-identification
abstract: Visible-thermal person re-identification (VT-ReID) aims to match person images between visible and thermal modalities. Existing methods have achieved desirable performance based on holistic person images. However, they cannot effectively cope with the information loss issue due to occlusion in the imaging process in complex scenes. In this paper, we propose a multi-stage feature interaction network (MSFIN) to learn features from the body and background regions respectively. First, a multi-stage feature fusion learning (MFL) module enhances semantic information by aggregating multi-dimensional features to mitigate adverse effect of occlusion. Second, a multi-scale attention (MSA) module is designed through receptive field scaling to effectively highlight the pixels of non-masked regions. Experiments on SYSU-MM01 and RegDB with occlusion demonstrate that our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art VT-ReID methods.

articleTitle: Finite-time Target Function Tracking of Quantum Systems with Impulsive Control Fields
abstract: In this paper, the finite time tracking issue for a class of closed quantum systems under the action of impulsive control fields is addressed. The aim is to steer the state of the quantum system to the trajectory of a periodic time-varying target. By using the Lyapunov direct method and considering a finite-time control strategy, the modified impulsive tracking controllers are designed such that the error dynamical system converges to zero in finite time. While finite-time tracking implies optimality in convergence time and has better disturbance rejection. Numerical simulations are given to illustrate the effects of system’s trajectory tracking, and also given to demonstrate the superiority of the control laws which are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Application of PID Control in Garbage Incineration Equipment
abstract: In order to improve the stability of garbage incineration control and reduce the emission of dioxins and other harmful substances, a PID based garbage incineration control method is proposed. By analyzing the change of combustion conditions and the working principle of garbage incinerator, the models of steam flow control, garbage layer thickness control, furnace temperature control and oxygen volume control are designed. The stable control of various indicators such as oxygen content, furnace temperature and dioxin content is applied and realized. The proposed PID control strategy for garbage incinerator can effectively ensure the stable operation and high efficiency of garbage incinerator under the change of garbage characteristics. It plays an important role in effectively improving the operation and management level of garbage incineration plant, reducing the emission of dioxins and other harmful substances, and reducing economic costs. The case study results of Yemachuan garbage incinerator show that the proposed PID control method for garbage incineration is feasible and the designed system works well. It provides a technical method for the automatic development of garbage incineration equipment, and has significant social and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Global Output-Feedback Adaptive Stabilization for a Class of Single-Link Robot Systems
abstract: In this paper, the global output-feedback adaptive stabilization control scheme for a class of single-link robot systems with unknown system parameters is studied. Motivated by the related works, a global output-feedback adaptive stabilizing controller based on the dynamic high-gain observer is designed with the universal control theory and the method of backstepping. The results show that the boundedness of all the closed-loop system signals, while the global regulation of robot arm system is achieved. Simulations are used to demonstrate the validity of the method.

articleTitle: Design of Nonsingular Terminal Sliding Mode Guidance Law with Disturbance Observer
abstract: Guidance law is an algorithm used to guide a missile to attack a target. The target evasive maneuvers are difficult to measure by sensors in the missile guidance law design, and are usually treated as known bounded disturbance leading to large error in intercepting targets with high-speed and high-maneuvering. A high-order sliding mode interference observer is designed to estimate the target evasive maneuver for a nonsingular terminal sliding mode guidance law to achieve better interception performance. Simulation results show that the proposed guidance law has a flatter ballistic curve and faster response to target maneuvering.

articleTitle: A method for establishing a ship safety domain oriented to collision risk judgment
abstract: Ship Domain (SD) is an important concept for the navigational safety of ships that can be used to determine the risk of ship collision. In this paper, we propose a method to establish a Ship Safety Domain Oriented to Collision Risk Judgment (CRSD), which considers the quantified collision risk in the process of establishing the ship domain, therefore the CRSD model is more suitable for risk judgment. Firstly, Automatic Identification System (AIS) data of paired ships are analyzed through using the ship collision risk detection model, and the cases with high collision risk are counted. Then, considering the relationship between ship domain and ship's length, the selected cases are classified according to the ship's length of Own Ship (OS), and the angle when OS encounters with Target Ship (TS) is quantified to get the relationship between the radius of the ship domain and ship's length at different angles so that the shape of CRSD can be obtained. Finally, the CRSD is analyzed and the results show that the CRSD model is consistent with the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea (COLREGs) that is suitable to be applied to ship collision avoidance risk judgment.

articleTitle: Design of Tan Sheep Intelligent Feeding Navigation System Based on RTK and Machine Vision
abstract: Tan sheep is an important industry in Ningxia province, China, and plays a very important role in local agriculture and animal husbandry.However, most of the existing Tan sheep feeding methods relies on human power, which has deficiencies in the efficiency and effectiveness of the operation. To solve the above problems, the navigation system based on RTK and machine vision is designed for Tan sheep intelligent feeding cart, with ultrasonic sensor for collision avoidance. Compared with the existing Tan sheep feeding methods, this research greatly reduces the need for human and material resources, and makes up for the inaccuracy of RTK navigation in bad weather conditions through machine visual navigation. This study has important reference value for similar intelligent navigation feeding cart.

articleTitle: A Joint Simulation Method with LTspice and MATLAB for EIT System Research
abstract: To improve the design efficiency of the imaging system, a joint simulation method based on LTspice and MATLAB integrated into the same EIT system is carried out. Firstly, the principles of the proposed method are explained in detail. The LTspice is used to simulate the hardware measurement circuit, and the program EIDORS by MATLAB is responsible for EIT image reconstruction. Then, by using the joint simulation method, the influence of measuring voltage signal characteristics and electrode contact impedance on the EIT imaging results was analyzed. Based on the voltage signal characteristics obtained from the joint simulation, an adaptive gain boundary voltage acquisition method was proposed. Finally, the performance of the designed EIT system using the raised method is evaluated with measuring voltage data and reconstruction image quality. The results show that the proposed boundary voltage acquisition method is beneficial to improve the accuracy of the EIT system, and the joint simulation method in this paper can also be a beneficial, more convenient way for engineers to develop other medical imaging technologies.

articleTitle: Control strategy for the rotor position angle of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on error extended state observer
abstract: In order to solve the problems of strong coupling, variable parameters and nonlinearity of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), an expanded state observer based on error is proposed in this paper to achieve fast response, accurate tracking and strong anti-disturbance control performance of the rotor position and angle of PMSM. Firstly, a new nonlinear function is designed to replace the nonlinear function of the extended state observer (ESO) in the traditional active disturbance rejection controller (ADRC). Secondly, based on the improved nonlinear function, the structure of ESO is improved according to the error principle. Finally, the position and Angle control system based on PMSM is simulated. Simulation results show that the ADRC based on error ESO has better response speed, tracking accuracy and anti-disturbance performance than the traditional ADRC.

articleTitle: State-of-health Monitoring of Li-ion Battery Driven by Convolutional Neural Network and Attention Mechanism
abstract: Aiming at the scarcity of lithium battery data under abnormal working conditions, we introduce a TCNN-Trans-TG hybrid model. This algorithm combines 1D temporal convolutional neural network(TCNN) with Transformer encoder. The TCNN-Trans is the base model of TCNN-Trans-TG. The sparse dataset on abnormal operating conditions is enlarged by data augmentation based on the TimeGAN neural network. This method can compensate for the lack of prediction accuracy caused by data imbalance.Compared with other networks, the model can predict data under abnormal conditions more accurately. Finally, The experiments performed on NASA datasets achieve average root mean square error(ARMSE) 0.0070, and achieve ARMSE 0.0032 with data augmentation.

articleTitle: A hybrid iterated greedy algorithm for distributed flowshop group scheduling problem to minimize total tardiness time
abstract: In a customer-oriented environment, the total tardiness time is becoming more important as competition increases. While the distributed flow shop group scheduling problem (DFGSP) has a wide range of practical applications with the development of cellular manufacturing (CM). Therefore, for this problem, we use total tardiness time as the optimization objective. A mathematical model is constructed and a hybrid iterated greedy algorithm (HIG) is designed to increase the search ability by combining the variable neighborhood descent local search. Moreover, a reinitialization strategy is introduced to avoid falling into local optimum. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is demonstrated by simulation experiments compared with four advanced algorithms.

articleTitle: Kernel locality preserving projections algorithm based on T-class weighted kernel functions with center kernel alignment
abstract: The current data generally has a high dimension and contains many features unrelated to category labels.On the basis of local preserving projection,we proposed a kernel local preserving projection algorithm based on T-class weighted kernel function of kernel alignment.Firstly,CKA algorithm was used to calculate the weight of each kernel matrix,which was used as linear combination coefficient.Combined kernel function was constructed by combining different types of kernel functions to improve the recognition rate and anti-noise ability.Secondly,we use the t distribution in probability statistics to construct the T-type kernel function,which further improves the combined kernel function.Finally,we use the kernel local preservation projectin for identification,and verify it on several data sets.The experimental results prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Dynamic weapon target assignment of USV based on hybrid compact Genetic algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the dynamic weapon target (DWTA) assignment problem of the weapon platform, guidance platform and target platform in different USV, an integrated dynamic weapon target assignment model was established with the minimum loss of our side as the objective function. A novel hybrid compact genetic algorithm (HCGA) was proposed to improve the efficiency of this model. The proposed HCGA is used to solve the integrated DWTA problem. After comparison and analysis with several related algorithms, the proposed algorithm has a good convergence effect.

articleTitle: Research on Seismic Data Compression and Error Correction System
abstract: This paper introduces a seismic data compression and error correction system suitable for digital seismic stations and networks. The transmitter of the system performs intra-frame compression and inter-frame redundancy on seismic data, and sends the processed data Return to the seismic monitoring center through wired or wireless channels. After receiving the data, the real-time compression and error correction equipment of seismic data in the seismic monitoring center performs inverse processing to realize the error correction function and outputs the seismic data in 24-digit format to the computer. This paper describes the working principle, hardware structure and main functions of the instrument.

articleTitle: A Slide Mode Observer and Disturbance Observer Based Control Method for the Voltage Sensorless Control of Three-Phase Rectifier
abstract: Owing to the high-power factor, low-current harmonics, controllable dc-link voltage, and bidirectional energy flow, The PWM rectifier has been rapidly developed. However, by using the traditional control strategy, the output voltage of the dc-link suffers from the undesired voltage fluctuation under varying loads. In addition, the utilization of voltage sensors increase the cost and decreases the system reliability. Thereby, an improved fractional-order power sliding mode observer (FOP-SMO) for the voltage sensorless control of the PWM rectifier is proposed to acquire accurate grid voltage. Furthermore, to mitigate the dc-link voltage fluctuation, an extended-state observer is established to estimate and compensate the load disturbance. In simulations, the high- precision grid voltage observation and dynamic control performance are achieved by using the composite control strategy.

articleTitle: Distributed Model Predictive Control Considering Fuel Economy for Heterogeneous Vehicle Platoons
abstract: Vehicle platoon control based on vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication is one of the promising technologies to improve the performance of transportation systems. It has the potential to increase traffic throughput, improve road traffic safety and reduce energy consumption. This paper proposes an innovative distributed model predictive control (DMPC) solution to the cooperative adaptive cruise problem of heterogeneous vehicle platoons. The vehicles (or nodes) in a platoon are dynamically decoupled but constrained by spatial geometry. Each node solves a local open-loop optimal control problem in a distributed manner. The cost function is designed by considering the error between the predicted trajectory and the assumed trajectory, and the optimization is carried out by comprehensively considering platoon stability, passenger comfort, fuel economy and other objectives. The effectiveness of the proposed DMPC algorithm is verified by simulation in MATLAB, and is compared with the traditional linear PID controller under different working conditions.

articleTitle: Application of Rain Classroom based Blended Teaching Mode in Postgraduate Course “Machine Learning”
abstract: Machine learning plays a more and more important role in postgraduate research, so it has become a course that must be offered in every university. The aims of this course are to enable graduates to master common machine learning algorithms and deepen the understanding of the algorithm through programming exercises and typical examples of applications. This paper tries to conduct a novel blended teaching mode based on rain classroom. The blended teaching mode is composed of three stages: pre-class, in-class and post-class. Each stage has clear and distinct teaching objectives: pre-class emphasizing knowledge transfer, in-class stressing knowledge internalization & ability development, and after-class strengthening knowledge & ability consolidation. The course score in 2022 proves the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: PID Parameter Tuning of Flight Atmospheric Parameter Test System Based on Policy Iteration
abstract: Aiming at the need for verification of airborne atmospheric data equipment, a flight atmospheric parameter test system based on policy iterative PID control is designed. The control parameters of the PID are tuned by the policy iteration algorithm. Firstly, the mathematical model of the pressure control system is established, which takes the sensor error and the air actuator error into account. Then, the policy iterative PID control is introduced, and the policy iterative PID control is used to decide the pressurization and depressurization according to the pressure error. Finally, compared with the classic PID simulation, it can be seen from the simulation results that the policy iterative PID control has a faster system response speed than the classic PID control. The policy iterative PID has more accurate in terms of accuracy, which can meet the needs of high-precision verification.

articleTitle: SIG-SLAM: Semantic Information-Guided Real-Time SLAM for Dynamic Scenes
abstract: Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (Visual-SLAM) providing the camera’s location and the map of surroundings, becomes more and more popular in the field of AR/VR, robotics, unmanned vehicle driving and so on. Traditional SLAM assumes that the scene is static, which results in the bad performance in dynamic scenes. In this paper we present SIG-SLAM, a real-time dynamic SLAM system that is built on ORB-SLAM2, adding the capability of dynamic object pixel-level semantic segmentation. SIG-SLAM can still perform well in dynamic scenes via taking the semantic information into account. Besides, by adding another independent thread for semantic segmentation, tracking thread does not need to stop to wait for semantic information any more. Finally, a novel approach to utilize the semantic information efficiently is proposed, making sure the real-time performance of our system. We evaluate our system in the public dataset TUM. The result shows that compared to other state-of-the-art algorithms, our proposed method can provide competitive accuracy while ensuring good real-time performance.

articleTitle: Lightweight object-level monocular data association system
abstract: Mobile robots can generate point cloud maps based on continuous image sequences to realize the perception of the environment. However, in the lightweight application scenario, the sparse point cloud map generated based on monocular camera is difficult to carry out accurate object data association due to the lack of sufficient object information. Therefore, this paper proposes a lightweight object-level data association method based on the monocular camera to realize the robot’s more accurate perception and positioning of environmental objects. In this method, feature points of monocular images are tracked, semantic information is introduced to parallel data association, and map points are distinguished in three stages, and a mutually exclusive object table is proposed to improve the accuracy of data association. The method is extensively tested on several public datasets and a real robot. The results show that data association is superior to similar methods in terms of accuracy and computation cost. In addition, this paper implements a lightweight robot system, which can achieve a frame rate of 20 FPS when using only half of the system’s computing resources, achieving lightweight real-time performance.

articleTitle: Sea state level acquisition and division based on Hilbert transform
abstract: This paper focuses on the deep learning convolution neural network, based on the ship motion response real-time rapid prediction of the current sea state information. Firstly, the time series of ship motion response is transformed into two-dimensional signal scatter diagram by Hilbert transform. Secondly, the color dimension is introduced into the two-dimensional scatter diagram, and the scatter diagram is colored according to the density of points. Furthermore, through image recognition classification to achieve the classification of sea state level. Finally, the correctness and feasibility of the method are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Spatio-Temporal Fusion: A Fusion Approach for Point Cloud Sparsity Problem
abstract: 3D LiDAR point cloud target detection is one of the keys of robot and autonomous vehicle. To low-beam LiDAR, missing detection is inevitable because of sparsity of the point cloud. To solve the problem, a fusion method based on temporal and spatial dimensional information is proposed to increase the richness of the point cloud to improve the accuracy of target detection. The method consists of two stages. Firstly, in order to solve the uncertainty of point cloud data density cause by Down-sampling, local and global features of the point cloud data in single frame are fused. Point cloud density is estimated to obtain local feature of the point cloud, then a combined global and local point cloud feature enhancement method is used for feature fusion, and the feature-enhanced single-frame point clouds are acquired by bilateral filtering. Secondly, to solve the problem of low accuracy of target detection caused by irrelevant data, the correlation coefficients of multi-frame point cloud data from last stage are evaluated by Hausdorff distance, and the point cloud data with low correlation degrees according to the correlation coefficients are eliminated to achieve the correlation fusion of multi-frame point clouds. Finally, the point cloud data with richer features is obtained to improve the target detection accuracy of 3D point clouds. The experimental results from NuScenes dataset and real outdoor scenes show the effectiveness of proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on medical automatic Question answering model based on knowledge graph
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data, knowledge interconnection has received extensive attention. As a core of this era, knowledge graph has broad applicationprospects. The application research in the intersection of big data and medical care will play an important role in solving the contradiction between the insufficient supply of high -quality medical resources and the continuous increase in the demand for medical services. Finding the medical -related knowledge you need from a large amount of data has become the core of this technology. At present, the research on medical knowledge graph is still in the exploratory stage. In the case of insufficient clinical data, how to obtain the data set is difficult. For the strong professionalism of knowledge in the medical field, the construction of knowledge graph should be targeted. How the system needs to accurately collect the questions that users want to ask is a big difficulty in the question answering system of deep learning. To solve the above problems, the data collection source is from the Tianchi Chinese data set Toyhom, the bert model is used for word segmentation and vocabulary construction, Neo4j realizes the organization and storage of knowledge, and the naive Bayesian machine learning method is used for intention recognition. Based on the above technology, the medical knowledge graph is built, and the visual Q&A window is completed. Finally, this kind of medical automatic question answering robot was realized.

articleTitle: A Wireless Node Location Method Combining Least Absolute Deviation and Least Square Method*
abstract: Wireless node loaction using the least square method (LSM) may lead to errors in the case of unstable signals of wireless access points. In this paper, a wireless node location algorithm combining least absolute deviation (LAD) and LSM is proposed. Firstly, the algorithm converts the collected received signal strength indicator (RSSI) between the unlocated nodes and the wireless access points into distance through the path loss model. Then the LAD algorithm is analyzed and transformed it into a linear programming problem. Finally, We convert all wireless access points into a set, LAD set and LSM set methods are combined to obtain the estimated location of the unlocated node. The experimental results show that the proposed method is better than the LAD and LSM in terms of location accuracy with or without singular points.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearings Based on MTF-TLResNet34
abstract: Aiming at the problem that traditional fault diagnosis methods have low diagnosis recognition rate under the condition of complex actual working conditions and small data set, a rolling bearing method based on Markov transition field (MTF) and TLResNet34 (TLResNet34) model was proposed. Firstly, Markov transfer field is used to encode the one-dimensional time sequence vibration signal, and then transform it into the probability feature image of signal points to generate the corresponding fault diagram. Secondly, the two-dimensional feature image is used as the input of TLResNet34, and the feature extraction of two-dimensional image is carried out through TLResNet34 to improve the utilization rate of information and realize fault classification. In order to verity the effectiveness of the proposed method, the bearing data set of Western Reserve University was selected. The results show that the proposed method has a higher accuracy of 99.34% than other methods, and has better generalization performance and recognition effect for rolling bearing fault diagnosis under the environment of small data set and load change.

articleTitle: An improved car-following model based on the basic traffic unit from the perspective of CPS
abstract: From a practical point of view, drivers not only pay attention to the behavior of preceding and rear vehicles while driving, but also to the behavior of vehicles in adjacent lanes. However, most microscopic traffic models do not accurately portray the multidimensional vehicle-to-vehicle relationship. In this paper, a new car-following model is proposed by considering information of surrounding multiple vehicles from the perspective of cyber-physical systems (CPS). In particular, the factors influencing car-following behavior are analyzed using actual data. Then, the basic traffic unit affecting the longitudinal speed of the target vehicle is proposed, which portrays the effect of the six surrounding vehicles on the central vehicle. Finally, the experimental results show that the proposed model can better reproduce the traffic phenomenon of the actual transportation systems.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered LADRCs for the Coaxial Tilt Rotor UAV
abstract: In this paper, a class of novel event-triggered linear active disturbance rejection controllers (ELADRCs) are proposed for attitude and position control of coaxial tilt rotor unmanned aerial vehicle (CTRUAV). First, the dynamic model is established on the basis of coordinate transformation, control allocation and Newton-Euler equation. Then, the event-triggered mechanism is introduced into the design of active disturbance rejection controllers. Subsequently, the input-to-state stability is addressed for the event-triggered linear extended state observer. Finally, simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, which can effectively reduce the resource of data communication while ensuring the control performance.

articleTitle: Double closed-loop driving system for resonant tactile sensor
abstract: Self-excited driving is a main closed-loop driving technique for resonant sensors. To meet the needs for amplitude control and frequency tracking of a self-excited tactile sensor system, a self-excited drive circuit based on phase locked loop (PLL) and automatic gain control (AGC) is designed to achieve amplitude stabilization and frequency tracking for tactile sensor output signals. Firstly, the hardware design of the double closed-loop circuit is determined. Meanwhile, the system model of the double closed-loop self-excited drive circuit is established based on Simulink. Then, based on the double closed-loop control system model, this paper analyzes the performance parameters. Meanwhile, the feasibility of the double closed loop self-excited drive is verified by simulation. Finally, the hardware design scheme is determined. The simulation verifies the control effect of the hardware circuit. The simulation results show that the double closed-loop self-excited drive circuit can drive tactile sensor to achieve frequency tracking and amplitude stabilization control.

articleTitle: Dandelion Optimizer Based Decision Method of Burden Distribution Matrix in Blast Furnace Iron-making Process
abstract: Burden distribution at the furnace throat plays an important role in blast furnace (BF) iron-making, which influences the furnace efficiency and stable operation. Burden distribution matrix (BDM) is a key operating variable to adjust a reasonable burden distribution. However, due to complex iron-making mechanism, it is difficult for operators to formulate BDM to achieve a reasonable burden distribution in practice. Focus on this challenge, this paper studies the burden distribution model and proposes a decision method of adjusting BDM based on Dandelion Optimizer (DO). Finally, simulation results demonstrate that the decision model based on DO has better reliability and generalization performance, comparing with other models which are based on the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Simulated Annealing (SA).

articleTitle: PHM of Roller Tyre in Nonferrous Metal Crushing Process Based on DUAE
abstract: The roller mill is a crucial production equipment for the nonferrous metal beneficiation process, responsible for crushing ores. Over time, the roller tyre of the roller mill gradually wears down, ultimately impacting the crushing efficiency. Therefore, Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) of the roller tyre is crucial to enhancing the production efficiency of the roller mill. In this study, a PHM method based on Dual Autoencoder (DUAE) is proposed to predict the grinding roller tyre’s service life. The effectiveness of the proposed PHM method is validated using actual data from a domestic concentrator. This research demonstrates that the PHM of roller tyres can be effectively conducted.

articleTitle: A Variational Bayesian Multisource Data Fusion Method Based on L2 Second Order Penalty Combined with Entropy Empirical Pool
abstract: Data fusion has become an important technology in all fields to cope with the current big data Era. Current data-level research algorithms have different degrees of flaws. The main purpose of this paper is to solve data sparsity and loss of information caused by L1 norm distance measurement in data-level variational Bayesian inference model fusion. Based on L2 norm second-order penalty, a variational Bayesian inference model is proposed. The input of the model is updated twice by combining an empirical module of entropy values. The Total Variation (TV) penalty factor is applied to keep the sparsity of signal mutations. The commonly used data level fusion algorithm is compared with the method proposed in this paper by using simulated biological signals. The experimental results show that the improved model method presented in this paper can effectively preserve the maximum amount of information and eliminate redundant information. Under the constraints of L2 norm model, the model has a good ability to prevent overfitting and a certain ability to generalize the model.

articleTitle: A Digital Twin System for 6DoF Robot Grasping
abstract: Driven by Industry 4.0 and smart logistics, robot technology has entered a stage of rapid development. Robots are increasingly applied in factories. In this paper, we propose a digital twin system for robot grasping. A 6DoF industrial robot is used as the execution module of object grasping in the physical world, and a simulated grasping environment is built in the virtual world as same as the physical world. After the path planning and collision detection in the virtual world, the trajectory data of the robot is sent to the physical world with a specific data structure. The experimental results show that the parameter error of the end effector between the physical twin and the virtual twin is less than 5mm, which verifies that the system proposed in this paper has good real-time performance.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Application of Online Case-based Teaching in the Course of Electrical Control Technology
abstract: In order to meet the current online + offline teaching mode of electrical control technology course and further increase students' understanding and participation in the course, this paper proposes a teaching mode of online case-based teaching + online virtual simulation verification + offline experimental verification. For online case-based teaching, it is necessary to do a good teaching design to ensure that the cases are representative, comprehensive and easy to simulate and verify. The simulation software and virtual simulation verification process based on both relay and programmable controller control methods are introduced. Next, the simulation software and virtual simulation verification process based on both relays and programmable controllers control methods are introduced. With the introduction of online case-based teaching, offline lab courses can be arranged more efficiently to enhance students' practical skills.

articleTitle: Valuation of Convolutional Neural Network in Intelligent Computer Games
abstract: Many problems in incomplete information games also exist in our daily life. It is of great significance to solve the problems in our daily life and improve the quality. Texas Holdem is a typical card game with incomplete information. For Texas Holdem a valuation algorithm model based on convolutional neural network is proposed. To train the model using the game history between the masters, to achieve the purpose of learning master skill. The game procedure of the valuation model plays the game with the game procedure designed by the predecessors, and the experimental results show that the convolutional neural network valuation method of learning human master experience can provide better decisions and enhance the Texas Holdem game procedure.

articleTitle: Full cycle personnel simulation from entry to evacuation of multi-story building : An office building case Study
abstract: Multi-story buildings still occupy a large proportion in urban buildings. It is of great significance to evaluate the layout and internal transportation design for these buildings. A full cycle personnel movement simulation from entering to escaping the multi-story building is studied to excavate the shortcomings of the building layout or interior traffic design. In order to realistically simulate building layout and personnel movement, in this paper, multi-agent modeling and simulation method is adopted. Taking a multi-story office building as a typical case, the building structure and personnel models are built, and the simulation of full-cycle workflows from personnel entering the building to evacuation escaping the building are designed. Through simulation, the density of people distribution at each movement stage and the quantitative evacuation time are obtained. Suggestions based simulation to improve the building design of layout and optimize the transportation in building are given. The result shows that the proposed modeling and simulation method is effective for the study of internal transport movement, evacuation time prediction, and building design considering the safety of personnel in practical significance. It can also be used for guiding reconstruction of buildings later.

articleTitle: Nearly-Controllable Subspaces of Discrete-Time Inhomogeneous Bilinear Systems
abstract: In this study, we investigate the nearly-controllable subspaces of a class of discrete-time inhomogeneous bilinear systems. Invertible transformations are made to bridge the inhomogeneous systems and homogeneous systems, which are used to obtain the criterion for the existence of nearly-controllable subspaces. A necessary and sufficient condition is established to derive nearly-controllable subspaces of the systems. In particular, the largest dimension of the nearly-controllable subspaces is identified, which is found to be similar with the homogeneous case. This reveals that the controllability properties of inhomogeneous systems might simply depend on their homogeneous counterparts. An example is given to illustrate the obtained results.

articleTitle: A force grey wolf optimizer algorithm for unmanned aerial vehicle trajectory planning
abstract: A force grey wolf optimization (FGWO) algorithm is proposed in this paper. The FGWO algorithm is used to deal with the local optimum and premature convergence problems in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) trajectory planning. Firstly, the mathematical model of environmental trajectory planning is built, and the weighting of both track distance and threat constraint is used as the cost function. Secondly, a nonlinear convergence factor is introduced to balance the global exploration and local exploitation capability of the GWO algorithm. In addition, a new search mechanism is introduced in the late iteration by weighting to enhance the merit-seeking ability. Finally, the levy-flight and greedy strategies are applied to make the algorithm avoid local optimality and thus obtain optimal solutions. The results of simulation show that the proposed FGWO algorithm can get better results in function testing and trajectory planning.

articleTitle: Distributed Multi-energy Dispatching of Community Integrated Energy System Based on Stackelberg Game
abstract: The clean, low-carbon, safe and efficient community integrated energy supply is the important material basis for building a modern energy system, but it still faces many challenges brought by the complexity of multi-energy flow coupling and the security of privacy information. Therefore, a new multi-energy dispatching framework for community integrated energy system is proposed, and a multi-energy complementation model of electricity-gas-heat-cold is established. A distributed bi-level iterative algorithm based on Stackelberg game theory is designed, which effectively protects the privacy information of all users, and finally obtains a Stackelberg equilibrium strategy to maximize the revenue of the aggregator and minimize the energy cost of each user. Numerical simulations validate the effectiveness of the proposed distributed multi-energy dispatching strategy for community integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Multimodal swimming control of bionic fish based on CPG
abstract: First of all, according to the swimming mode and functional requirements of the bionic fish, this paper designs a multi joint bionic fish with chest tail coordinated propulsion, and designs the bionic fish body with the idea of modularization. Secondly, the biological control mechanism of animal CPG (central mode generator) is introduced. A Hopf oscillator with independently adjustable parameters is selected. The relationship between the convergence rate, amplitude, frequency and parameters of the Hopf oscillator is studied in depth, and a CPG model suitable for bionic fish is established. Finally, the CPG model is used for simulation and experimental verification, and the swimming control of various modes of the bionic fish, such as forward, steering and multimodal switching, is successfully realized.

articleTitle: Defect detection of automotive leather based on Nanodet-Plus
abstract: During the processing of automotive leather, various defects such as folding and oil stains can occur for several reasons. Therefore, it is essential to detect such defects before leather manufacturing to prevent them and enhance the quality of leather products. However, the current defect detection methods are not only expensive but also inefficient, indicating a need for a more efficient alternative. To address this problem, we constructed an Automotive-leather-defect dataset for vehicles based on collected leather defect samples. Subsequently, we proposed a defect detection method using the NanoDet-Plus neural network model, which can enhance the accuracy and speed of the detection process.

articleTitle: Prediction of NOx Emissions based on Ensemble Stochastic Configuration Network for Municipal Solid Waste Incineration Process
abstract: To accurately predict the nitrogen oxides (NOx) emissions concentration during the municipal solid waste incineration process, a prediction method based on the Bagging ensemble and stochastic configuration network (SCN) is proposed, and the relevant variables of the municipal solid waste incineration process are used to predict NOx concentration in this paper. Firstly, the Bootstrap sampling method is used to generate several different training subsets, and multiple SCN base models are trained under different subsets. The average value of the output results of every base model is taken as the final output. Finally, the actual historical data of a solid waste treatment plant in Beijing are used to verify the model and compared with the single SCN, random vector function link network (RVFLN), Bagging-RVFLN. The experimental results show that the proposed method has high accuracy and can accurately predict the NOx emissions concentration in MSW incineration process.

articleTitle: Real-time traffic accident detection based on the derivative of traffic parameters
abstract: This paper focuses on the study of the derivative of traffic parameters for detecting traffic accidents in real time. The temporal properties of both the traffic flow and the vehicle speed are analyzed per day in May. It is found that the falling and rising of both the traffic flow and the vehicle speed have a relationship with the traffic accident happening on the urban road. Then, the traffic accident on the urban road can be detected in real time by the shape variation of falling and rising rapidly over time, namely, their derivatives. Through surveillance video and traffic accident records from the Traffic Police Detachment of Fuzhou Public Security Bureau (TDFPSB), the method based on the derivatives of both traffic flow and vehicle speed is verified to identify the traffic accident from traffic congestion.

articleTitle: Research on Redundant Control System for Surface Mount Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
abstract: This paper investigations a redundant control system and method suitable for surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor. The research is mainly carried out from the following aspects: firstly, the speed and position monitoring module is used to obtain the included angle of the A-phase axis of the motor and the angular speed of the motor. Secondly, the speed and position estimation module is used in the case that the speed and position monitoring module can't detect the included angle of the motor A phase axis and the motor angular speed. Thirdly, the included angle of motor A phase axis and the estimated value of motor angular velocity are obtained. Then there is the signal processing and generating unit, which is mainly used to generate the control signal according to the detected value of the speed and position monitoring module or the estimated value of the speed and position estimating module. And finally, a switching unit, which switches the speed and position monitoring module into a speed and position estimation module to be connected with the signal acquisition and generation unit when detecting that the speed and position monitoring module cannot detect the position and rotation speed information of the motor. Therefore, this paper studies a redundant control system and method suitable for surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor to solve the problems of motor shutdown and endangering the safety of equipment operation due to the loss of mechanical position signal during the operation of permanent magnet synchronous motor.

articleTitle: An Improved Data-Driven Modeling Method for Aircraft Based on Prediction and Optimization
abstract: This paper proposes a data-driven modeling method for aircraft by predicting model errors and optimizing model structures.
