Based on flight test data from the mechanism model, the aircraft data-driven model is established by several trained basic neural networks for fitting dynamics relationships of aircraft and recurrent neural networks for compensating for model errors. Compared to the traditional data-driven modeling method, this method can more effectively avoid and solve the problem of instability of data-driven models with disturbances at long running times. Finally, the proposed method’s feasibility and the established model’s credibility are verified by simulation experiments with complex disturbance and statistical analysis for model accuracy.

articleTitle: Event-triggered compensation control of networked control systems with threshold consideration
abstract: An ℋ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> composite control strategy under the event-triggered framework is discussed in this paper. To treat the abrupt data jittering, the transmission of control signal is determined by a mean value based triggering structure. With this structure, composite controllers under three triggering modules are built on the mean value part, the nonlinear part, and the threshold dependent part, respectively. Resorting to Simpson’s rule, sufficient conditions are proposed to make the resultant closed-loop systems be uniformly ultimate boundedness (UUB). The validity of the proposed schemes is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Multiple Ranging Fusion Positioning Model Based on Total Least Squares
abstract: During the flight of a spacecraft, ranging measurement data are a very important data source for realizing high-accuracy trajectory and achieving the characteristics of fewer error sources and high measurement accuracy. According to the GPS pseudo-range measuring element of multiple satellites with similar observation intervals, in this paper, we proposed a fusion positioning method based on the total least squares algorithm, linearized the observation equation, established the augmented matrix of the coefficient matrix error and observation vector, and obtained the trajectory fusion positioning results based on singular value decomposition theory. In contrast to the least squares algorithm, the proposed algorithm considers both the measurement information error and coefficient matrix error without necessitating the execution of iterations and providing a precise trajectory as the input. In addition, the validity estimation model of the proposed algorithm was established. The positioning difference between the positioning result obtained using the proposed algorithm and that obtained using the traditional LS algorithm is within 10 meters, and at the time of object maneuvering, the position random error improved from 1–2 meters to 0.5 meters. The first- and second- order validities of the estimation fusion model are greater than 0.9. The trajectory positioning result obtained using the proposed algorithm is more reliable, and the precision accords with the processing requirements.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Correction of Numerical Weather Prediction Solar Irradiance Forecasts Based on Similar Day Analysis
abstract: Solar forecast based on Numerical weather prediction (NWP) is widely recognized and applied for a safer and more sufficient usage of solar energy sources at present. However, there are many negative cases of forecasts due to the unescapable inherent errors of numerical techniques. Thus, aiming to correct the error of NWP, this paper proposes a day-ahead correction model, which makes use of actual observation, for correcting NWP global horizontal irradiance (GHI) forecast. A dynamic time-window is adopted to select the similar day, whose size can be adjusted adaptively. The similar days of the corrected day constitute the training set of a generalized regression neural network (GRNN) model. This work is well demand-oriented, which can improve the day-ahead correction results of GHI forecast with 15-minute interval. The data under different weather conditions are selected to test the model performance, evaluating with root-mean-square error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE). The results clearly demonstrate that the accuracy has been effectively improved by combining the actual observation and NWP data. Moreover, the proposed correction model allows more accurate forecast of photovoltaic (PV) power generation.

articleTitle: Random forest-based quality fluctuation stability analysis for early abnormal warning in spinning process
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to forewarn the abnormal fluctuation of spinning process quality, a random forest-based quality fluctuation abnormal warning mechanism for spinning process stability is proposed. Firstly, the time series set of yarn quality process parameters is decomposed by the window, and the abnormal fluctuation rate is defined to characterize the fluctuation degree of the window sequence. Then the window according to whether there is abnormal fluctuation is marked, and random forest model is built to identify the window fluctuation pattern, so as to build an abnormal early warning strategy for spinning process quality fluctuation. Finally, a case study is conducted through a spinning process data set to evaluate the performance of proposed model. Results show that the proposed method can provide early warning of abnormal fluctuation in spinning quality, which provides guarantee for quality stability in spinning production process.

articleTitle: Unsupervised bas-relief generation with angle defect
abstract: The generation of bas-relief based on 3D models has always been a research hotspot in computer graphics. Traditional algorithms are computationally complex. The latest methods based on deep learning bring new ideas to the problem but are rely on supervised training, which requires a large number of samples to be constructed manually. In this paper, an unsupervised bas-relief generation method is proposed. In this method, we take the depth field of point cloud as input, and reconstruct the bas-relief using a Convolutional Neural Networks. During the process, the smallest change of angle defect is selected as the objective of optimization, thus, avoids the constructing of the "ground truth". Experiments show that the method in this paper is simple and efficient, and can generate bas-relief models with good saturation and detail feature.

articleTitle: 2-Copula and Simple Criterion based Algorithm for Identification of Time Delay Dynamic Systems
abstract: In this paper, the identification of time-delay dynamic systems is considered. Due to the limitation of the hardware and other reasons, time-delay systems exist widely in the industrial field. The identification of this kind of system includes time delay identification and parameter identification. Firstly, a time delay identification method based on the 2-copula is studied, which can obtain an accurate estimation of time delay when the parameters are unknown. Secondly, a compact multi-innovation stochastic gradient algorithm named multi-gradient algorithm is proposed. The algorithm uses the simple criterion of selecting step size in the stochastic gradient method to determine the stacking length and obtains the available stacking length based on the bisection search method. A numerical example shows the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Adaptive-Fuzzy-Based Control Method for Grasper on Power Frequency Magnetic Field Immunity Test Equipment
abstract: The electronic devices need to pass the electromagnetic interference test, to validate it can work safety in the electromagnetic interference environment. In the traditional test, the position fixation of the tested device is clamped the device by hand, which reduce the test efficiency and harm to operator’s health. Here, we designed an automatic grasp equipment and proposed an adaptive-fuzzy-based control method for grasping stability. This device is driven by two pneumatic slide rails to realize the synchronous motion control in the x and y-axis directions. A gas flow sensor is installed in the inlet pipe to estimate the amount of air entering the pneumatic cylinder. A force sensor is installed on the contact surface between the grasper and the object. Adaptive-fuzzy-based control algorithm applied in grasping the object with different sizes quickly and stably. The experimental results show that the stable grasping force is 10% by weight, the grasp time is 0.3s from contacting to the stable grasping state. The grasping force can be sustained and stable even external disturbing forces are applied to the tested object. Our control method has great potential of applying in the automatic testing equipment.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Multi-Model Non-Fragile Control of Fractional Order Unified Chaotic Systems
abstract: Based on the in-depth analysis of several kinds of fractional order chaotic systems, a unified framework of fractional order chaotic systems is proposed. Under the unified framework, the T-S fuzzy model fractional order chaotic system is constructed, and a non-fragile controller is designed to control the T-S fuzzy model. Firstly, according to the characteristics of several kinds of fractional order chaotic systems, a unified T-S fuzzy model is constructed; Secondly, the antecedent structure and parameters of the fuzzy model are determined by clustering method; Thirdly, based on the idea of non-fragile state feedback and fuzzy control, the global asymptotic stability condition of fractional order unified chaotic system is derived through Lyapunov function, and the design condition of fuzzy controller is given. Finally, the simulation examples of chaotic systems are carried out to prove that the proposed control method is valid.

articleTitle: Innovative Application of Computer Game Algorithms of Surakarta Based on Reinforcement Learning
abstract: The traditional methods to solve the computer games problem are to use various search algorithms on the game search tree and to combine the situation evaluation to generate the corresponding methods. The paper discusses the principle of MCTS based reinforcement learning. Based on this principle, BP algorithm is combined, it is designed a self-learning game playing program of Surakarta. The experiment shows that the methods can improve the performance of the agent, avoiding design static evaluating function by manual.

articleTitle: Adaptive attitude control of H∞ quadrotor UAV based on neural network
abstract: A robust attitude control scheme based on disturbance observer is designed to meet the attitude control requirements of quadrotor UAV. The H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control problem of a class of non-affine nonlinear systems based on neural network is studied. A controller based on neural network is designed, which can not only ensure the stability of the closed-loop system, but also reduce the influence of interference on tracking to a given performance index. By means of implicit function theorem, Taylor formula and mean value theorem, the non-affine nonlinear system is transformed into affine nonlinear system. The designed controller is composed of equivalent controller and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is proved by theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Predictive self-tuning of speed control parameters based on parabolic command
abstract: The servo industrial application using the traditional generalized predictive control (GPC) is limited by reference commands. To solve the above problem, a special structural integral proportional (SSIP) controller based on extended generalized predictive control (EGPC) is designed in this paper. Firstly, an SSIP controller is designed to progressively suppress higher-order interference and realize error-free tracking of parabolic command. Then, a backward third-order difference operator is used to build an augmented prediction model based on the controlled object, whose output incorporates of the speed error, so that the EGPC is released from the speed command. Next, the optimal control law is obtained by the rolling optimization to realize the parameters mapping of the SSIP controller. Finally, the simulation results verify that the proposed method has obvious advantages in tracking accuracy and anti-disturbance ability compared with the existing control methods.

articleTitle: Study on Advance Prediction Model of Exhaust Gas Temperature Based on LSTM
abstract: The advance prediction of exhaust gas temperature (EGT) can judge the performance states of the engine in advance and provide decision supports for engine fault diagnosis and preventive maintenance, which is of great significance for the normal operation of the engine and the safety of aircraft. In this paper, a prediction model based on LSTM is proposed to realize the advance prediction of EGT. Firstly, the principle of LSTM model is introduced. Secondly, the modeling and training process of EGT advance prediction model based on LSTM is discussed. Finally, by using the QAR data of A320, a case study is carried out. The results of case study show that the model in this paper can realize the advance prediction of EGT effectively.

articleTitle: Decentralized Cruise Control of High-Speed Trains with Modelling Uncertainties
abstract: This paper deals with the decentralized cruise control problem of high-speed train movements. We treat the high-speed train as a multiple-point-mass model where adjacent cars are connected by flexible couplers. Then we design a decentralized control algorithm for the high-speed train, so that each car can track the reference speed. In order to guarantee the stability of the high-speed train system, we present sufficient conditions in the form of linear matrix inequalities. Under the conditions, the speed of each car converges to the reference value. Finally, numerical experiments are given to confirm the correctness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: A Pavement Cracks detection algorithm based on CCA-YOLOv5s
abstract: A pavement crack detection algorithm based on CCA-YOLOv5s is proposed to address the issue of the low efficiency and accuracy of traditional pavement crack detection. Firstly, as the inadequacy of the dataset may affect the detection accuracy, we perform data enhancement in this paper. Secondly, the attention mechanism CA (Coordinate Attention) module is introduced in the YOLOv5s network backbone, which strengthens the ability of the network to extract features. Thirdly, to make the regression more accurate, use the loss function CIOU rather than the loss function GIOU as the bounding box regression loss function. The experimental results show that the Mean Average Precision (mAP) of the CCA-YOLOv5s model on the test dataset has reached 96.5%, and the detection rate is 36.7ms. Compared with YOLOv5s, the mAP is increased by 1.8%, while the detection rate is only decreased by 0.4ms. Therefore, the CCA-YOLOv5s algorithm can effectively detect pavement cracks and provides certain engineering practical significance for pavement quality monitoring and maintenance.

articleTitle: Hierarchical optimal scheduling of DC distribution network based on model predictive control theory
abstract: The existing AC distribution network faces many challenges, such as diversified demand, complicated power flow dispatching, and large-scale access of distributed generation. Dc distribution network with flexible DC devices has become the research and development direction of electric power industry. In this paper, combined with the operating principle and characteristics of the flexible DC device, the power flow model of the flexible DC device is established, and then the power flow model including distributed power supply is established. Then, a dual-layer optimization strategy of DC distribution network based on model predictive control is proposed, and the MATLAB simulation platform is built to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the strategy.

articleTitle: A Low Carbon Economic Scheduling Method of Cogeneration System Based on Memetic Algorithm
abstract: To improve the flexibility of the cogeneration system, reduce carbon emission and promote the grid-connected consumption of wind power, carbon capture technology, energy storage technology, and demand response mechanism are introduced into the system. Firstly, the structure and operation principle of the cogeneration system is described. Secondly, aiming at the minimum operating cost and the minimum carbon emission of the system, a low-carbon economic scheduling model of the cogeneration system is established. Then, according to the model characteristics and scheduling needs, the memetic algorithm is used to directly solve the Pareto front of low-carbon economy scheduling. The search process, parameter setting, algorithm evaluation, and intelligent decision-making are designed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed scheme is proved by comparing the simulation results of the system before and after improvement and similar algorithms. The simulation results show that carbon capture device, energy storage device, and demand response can enhance system scheduling flexibility and improve system operation efficiency. The memetic algorithm combines the global evolution of the population with local search, which can effectively avoid falling into local optimum and has a better optimization effect in solving.

articleTitle: State of Charge Estimation of Lithium-ion Batteries Based on An Adaptive Cubature Kalman Filter
abstract: An adaptive cubature Kalman filter is proposed in this paper to estimate the state of charge (SOC) of a lithium-ion battery. Firstly, a second-order RC equivalent circuit model is constructed to describe the dynamic characteristics of a lithium-ion battery. Secondly, we design a linear Kalman filter and a cubature Kalman filter to achieve the adaptive estimation of SOC, model parameters and the coefficients in the measurement equation. Thirdly, the noise covariance matrices are adaptively adjusted in order to further improve the estimation accuracy of the proposed algorithm. Finally, the estimation accuracy and adaptability of the algorithm proposed in this paper are verified by different experiments.

articleTitle: A data-based architecture of smart workshop based on multi-intelligent units
abstract: With the development of industry 4.0, the vision of building a smart workshop become stronger and stronger. However, the physical system architecture of traditional workshops cannot meet the performance requirements of smart workshop (self-organizing, self-adaptation) for manufacturing system. The build of architecture of workshop is a key problem. Therefore, this paper proposes a distributed architecture of smart workshop based on multi-intelligent units (DASW-MIU). First, the smart workshop floor is divided into different manufacturing cells according to different functions. Then, this paper designs an intelligent unit for manufacturing entities to achieve the function of physical device connection, information interaction and scheduling decision. Lastly, an experimental platform is built to verify the feasibility and performance of DASW-MIU. The results show that this distributed architecture can achieve online scheduling according to real-time production data and has good scheduling performance.

articleTitle: Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Method Based on NSCT Combined with Guided Filtering
abstract: To address the problems of information loss and incomplete display of edge and texture detail information in existing image fusion methods, this paper proposes an infrared and visible image fusion method based on NSCT combined with guided filtering. The method decomposes the visible source image and infrared source image by NSCT algorithm to obtain low-frequency and high-frequency subbands; according to the characteristics of information contained in low-frequency and high-frequency subbands, a weighted averaging rule based on guided filtering is proposed to fuse low-frequency subbands, and a fusion rule based on regional standard deviation and pixel value taking larger combined with Gaussian adaptive is designed to fuse high-frequency subbands; finally, the image is reconstructed by NSCT inversion to obtain the final fused image. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms other methods in several evaluation indexes, has better edge retention, higher contrast and sharpness, and better visual effects.

articleTitle: Parametric observation rule-based intrusion detection strategy for in-vehicle network
abstract: Due to the increasingly frequent interaction between in-vehicle network information and the outside world, a large number of network intrusions have already occurred in vehicles leading to loss of control of the vehicle and jeopardizing public safety. To protect the controllability of the vehicle and avoid the intrusion of the in-vehicle network, this paper proposes an intrusion detection method based on parameter observation rules and constructs an intrusion detection model based on parameter observation rules, and the observation rules are designed from message-level rules and signal-level rules. This paper builds a HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) testbed, and its experimental results show that the method effectively resists the message replay attack, message injection attack, and signal tampering attack of the in-vehicle CAN network, and the identification rate of attack detection reaches 97.53%.

articleTitle: MPC-Based Motion Planning and Tracking Control for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles
abstract: This paper proposes a motion planning and tracking control method based on model predictive control (MPC) for autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs). Traditional planning algorithms do not smoothly search for paths on grid maps and fail to satisfy AUV’s kinematic constraints. To address this, a new objective function with an obstacle avoidance function is designed to reduce excessive avoidance in traditional algorithms. The motion planning controller is designed to find a kinematically feasible obstacle avoidance trajectory by solving a nonlinear optimization problem with constraints based on AUV state information, obstacle information, and reference target information. The MPC trajectory tracking controller combines the planned trajectory to track it. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A metal surface defect detection method based on improved YOLOv3
abstract: Metal surface defect detection is important to ensure product quality and reduce production costs. This paper proposes an improved detection method for metal surface defects based on YOLOv3, and the defects of the original algorithm are improved. In order to solve the problem that the image of metal surface defect is difficult to collect and the number of samples is small in the real industrial environment, the data augmentation method is used to increase the number of samples. In order to solve the problem of poor performance of small object detection, a feature fusion module is added to the original network. Finally, the CIoU bounding box regression loss is used to improve the localization accuracy of the network.

articleTitle: Ladle Collision Detection Algorithm Based on Three-dimensional Point Cloud Data
abstract: To solve the problem of collision detection between the ladle and the object in the workshop during crane movement, a fast collision detection algorithm is proposed based on large-scale 3D point cloud data. The implementation of the algorithm is divided into three stages: model building, point cloud data reading, and collision detection. Firstly, the physical model of the ladle is reasonably abstracted into collision detection points in five directions, and the detection range is set according to the actual application situation, simplifying the collision detection problem without affecting the algorithm’s accuracy. Secondly, according to the distribution characteristics of data points in the point cloud file, the large-scale point cloud data file is preprocessed to generate an index table, which is used to optimize data reading and reduce unnecessary I/O collision detection operations. Finally, to meet the algorithm’s real-time requirements in the production process, the algorithm is optimized using multi-threaded parallel processing technology. Experiments show that the multi-threaded parallel algorithm works much better in real time than the single-threaded algorithm and can improve the efficiency of collision detection by a large amount.

articleTitle: A multi-strategy valuation model for popular mahjong actions
abstract: One of the most important and challenging research directions in artificial intelligence is incomplete information games. Mahjong is a typical representative of incomplete information games. Compared with other incomplete information games such as two-player Texas Hold'em and bridge, mahjong is characterized by many players and high uncertainty in the order and strategy of each player, which makes it difficult for the opponent to make reasonable behavioral decisions by accurately assessing the game situation. In this paper, we propose a multi-strategy valuation model based on popular mahjong: by evaluating the winning rate of the situation and the prediction of the opponent's listening tile, we divide the playing strategies into offensive, defensive and general strategies, and adopt different joint playing models for different strategies. The experimental results show that the proposed strategy has a higher level of decision making under a limited number of hands compared with the previous method of single-play model.

Author Keywords: the winning rate of the situation
the prediction of the opponent's listening tile

articleTitle: Disturbance Observer Based Control for a Class of Uncertain Inverse Response Process
abstract: A sinusoidal disturbance rejection method is proposed for a class of uncertain inverse response process. Firstly, the observer is designed to estimate the frequency parameters, and the disturbance with the equivalent equation is constructed using the estimated values and auxiliary intermediate variables. Then the equivalent disturbance state observer is designed to reconstruct the input disturbance. The estimation processes are independent of each other, thus the inverse response disturbance compensation problem can be simplified to the linear observer design problem. Based on the mentioned above, the disturbance observer based control is implemented in combination with a dynamic output feedback controller. As a result, satisfactory disturbance rejection performance can be achieved by adjusting the parameters of the controller and the observer. Finally, the stability of the system is analyzed by using the Lyapunov theorem, and the simulations are used to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: PID-based multi-mode oven heating control system design
abstract: A PID-based multi-mode oven heating control system is designed. Solve the current market of the traditional oven of the knob control method mode less and conventional control are large temperature deviation, low precision and other problems, it is difficult to achieve a better control effect. This work uses intelligent multi-segment PID control strategy, divides the algorithm design into multiple temperature rise sub-modules and designs a consistent control scheme for ovens of different equipment. The temperature control system designed in this paper can perform fast and slow heating in multiple modes, and the steady-state accuracy can be steadily controlled at ±2°C, while having good equipment consistency. The implementation of the multi-mode system and the experimental verification of the related performance are presented.

articleTitle: Variable fractional-order model for lithium-ion battery based on a hybrid fractional particle swarm optimization method with crisscross learning strategy
abstract: A variable fractional-order (FO) equivalent circuit model with order related to the state of charge (SOC) of Lithiumion batteries (LIBs) is addressed in this paper. A hybrid fractional particle swarm optimization with crisscross learning strategy (FOPSO-CL) algorithm is proposed to identify the parameters of the FO equivalent circuit model. In order to well balance the global exploration and local exploitation capabilities of PSO, a search direction adjustment mechanism based on subpopu-lation division operation is proposed. Meantime, to avoid the premature convergence and enhance the global search ability, a crossover-based comprehensive learning strategy (CCL) is adopted. Additionally, a stochastic example learning strategy (SEL) is introduced, which can assist collective information to be spread among separate sub-swarms, improve the local exploitation ability of the algorithm. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by experimental data.

articleTitle: Multi-stage Feature Fusion Network for Edge Detection of Dunhuang Murals
abstract: Dunhuang murals have generally suffered serious damage due to natural disasters and human factors. As a result, the conservation and restoration of Dunhuang murals are becoming increasingly urgent, in which the line drawings of Dunhuang murals are an important work in the restoration of Dunhuang murals. The line drawings of the Dunhuang murals can be regarded as an image edge detection task. Although many CNN-based edge detection methods have made significant progress, they still produce thick edges and non-edges in the Dunhuang murals dataset. To solve this problem, we propose a novel edge detection method for generating line drawings of Dunhuang murals. Firstly, a novel loss function is proposed for edge detection, which uses focal Tversky loss to effectively suppress the background pixels near the edge pixels and allows CNN to produce sharp edges. Moreover, the proposed network introduces the dilated convolution modules and the spatial attention modules in each side output features to fully learn hierarchical features and obtain richer scale features. Finally, the results of experiments conducted on the BIPED dataset and the Dunhuang murals dataset show that the proposed method can generate richer and sharper edge maps.

articleTitle: Research on energy consumption prediction of public buildings based on improved support vector machine
abstract: An improved support vector machine model for energy consumption prediction is proposed to achieve efficient energy saving in buildings. In this paper, firstly, a gray correlation analysis model is used to measure the correlation between temperature, humidity, sunlight and other factors and building energy consumption. Secondly, the sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is introduced to optimize the penalty coefficient c and kernel function parameter g of the support vector machine, and then the SSA-SVM energy consumption prediction model is established. Finally, the experimental results are analyzed by comparing with the data derived from the support vector machine prediction (SVM) model and BP neural network energy consumption prediction. The experimental results show that compared with SVM and BP neural network, the prediction results of SSA-SVM model perform better in error index, indicating that the energy consumption prediction of SSA-SVM model has higher prediction accuracy; the maximum relative error of SSA-SVM prediction model is 0.0514, and the maximum relative errors of the other two models are greater than 0.55, indicating that SSA-SVM model has a higher degree of reliability.

articleTitle: The Influence and Mechanism of Social Value Orientation on Cooperative Behavior in Gift Exchange Game
abstract: This study uses a newly developed game theoretic model to explore the effects and mechanisms of cooperation indicators such as interpersonal trust, social preferences, and social value orientations on cooperative behavior, and we develop a psychologically grounded model of trust-based cooperation. Research on cooperation in gift choice games has focused on the extent to which it promotes noncooperative choices, which derive exclusively from the payoff structure of the game. However, this approach does not clearly explain the psychological mechanisms of why the game’s payoffs affect the rate of cooperation. In trust-based cooperation, we show how simple decision models predict the emergence of expected utility maximizing strategies when both individual social preferences and positive expectations are considered. In addition, we show the relationship between these predictions and the game cooperation indexes. Finally, we describe the conditions under which trust-based cooperation is justified and how the decision to trust can be understood through the interplay between payoffs, preferences, and beliefs.

articleTitle: 3D Contextual Transformer & Double Inception Network for Human Action Recognition
abstract: The 3D Contextual Transformer & Double Inception Network called CoTDIL-Net is proposed for human action recognition. The spatio-temporal enrichment module based on a 3D Contextual Transformer (CoT3D) is proposed for enhancing the features of adjacent frames. In addition, 3D Inception and 2D Inception are combined to form the feature extractor called DIFE for capturing short-term contextual features. Moreover, the LSTM is used to obtain long-term action change features, and a multi-stream input framework is introduced to obtain fuller contextual information. It aims to obtain multi-scale spatio-temporal features compared with single convolution methods, where CoT3D combines contextual action information, the DIFE captures short-term features while LSTM fuses long-term features. The experiments are carried out on a laptop with 32G RAM and a GeForce RTX3070 8G GPU by using the KTH dataset, and the results show a recognition accuracy of 97.2%. The obtained results indicate that the proposed CoTDIL-Net promote the convolutional structure understanding of human actions changes.

articleTitle: Voltage Recovery and Current Sharing of DC Microgrids With Uncertain Constant Power Loads Using Neural Networks
abstract: In this paper, we investigate distributed secondary control for DC microgrids with uncertain constant power load (CPL). First, a model of DC microgrids is established, where a controllable current source is introduced to be an control input and uncertain CPLs are regarded as unknown nonlinear dynamics. Based on the established model, an adaptive neural network (NN) controller is designed to achieve both voltage recovery and current sharing. The approximation property of radial basis function neural networks (RBFNNs) is used to neutralize the uncertain nonlinear dynamics in DC microgrids. It is proved that our proposed controller can guarantee the stability of DC microgrids. Simulations are performed to demonstrate the effectiveness and validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of the three-dimensional environment pollution dynamical system with time delay
abstract: In this paper we consider the environment pollution dynamical system described by the ordinary differential equations. Firstly, we establish the three-dimensional environment pollution dynamical system which reflects the relationships among the air quality index, population and economic growth. Secondly, by introducing the effect of the time delay we establish the three-dimensional environment pollution dynamical system with time delay. And then we analyze the stability of the system with time delay by using the stability switch theory of the differential equations. Thirdly, we show the properties of the Hopf bifurcation. Finally, numerical simulations have been given to show the effectiveness of the main results.

articleTitle: Applying 3DCNN to Recognize the weighted Time- frequency Features by Phase Locking Value for Epilepsy Prediction
abstract: Deep neural network has been widely applied for seizure prediction, and its appropriate input is the key to prediction effect. However, the phase synchronization which may happen before seizure onset has seldom been received sufficient attention. In this paper, a novel seizure prediction method is proposed. The multi-channel electroencephalogram (EEG) signals are preprocessed for denoising, and wavelet transform (WT) is employed to extract time-frequency features. Then, the phase locking value (PLV) of each channel of filtered EEG is calculated based on two frequency bands (i.e. 2-40 Hz and 80-128 Hz), and it is used for weighting time-frequency features, obtaining the fused features. Finally, a three-dimensional convolution neural network (3DCNN) is constructed and the fused features are used as input to achieve epilepsy prediction. Experiments are conducted based on the CHB-MIT dataset, and the average prediction accuracy of 10 subjects reaches 99.14%. The results show that the fusion of PLV and time-frequency features can reflect the characteristics of Epilepsy, and it matches with 3DCNN well.

articleTitle: Forecasting of the Incoming Dustcarts of a Waste Transfer Station Based on SARIMA Model
abstract: The quantity forecast of incoming dustcarts in the waste transfer station is essential to enhancing the operational efficiency of smart sanitation, because it is helpful for the station management and the planning of resources. In this study, a seasonal autoregressive integrated moving average (SARIMA) model is suggested to forecast the incoming dustcarts of a waste transfer station. The dataset utilized contains both the hourly-sampled quantity and proportion of residual waste dustcarts. The outcomes of single step and multi-step forecasting are examined with different performance measures in order to confirm SARIMA’s effectiveness. The experimental results show that the SARIMA model has better prediction results compared with the LSTM model. In addition, SARIMA model has high accuracy in both single step and multi-step forecasting, but multi-step forecasting is more effective for solving real-world issues because of its less time-consuming.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization Method of Variable Impedance Controller Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
abstract: To solve the problem that traditional variable impedance controllers do not consider the initial parameter setting, a parameter optimization method of variable impedance controller based on particle swarm optimization algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the equation of impedance control is established, and then the stability of the discrete system is analyzed by using Rouse criterion. The Simcape model of UR5 manipulator is built on Matlab simulation platform, and the impedance controller based on particle swarm optimization algorithm is designed. Finally, the experiment is carried out on the real object of UR5 manipulator. Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed method is feasible.

articleTitle: A decentralized adaptive sliding mode control method for reconfigurable modular robots considering joint friction
abstract: The main challenge of the decentralized control method for reconfigurable modular robots lies in the handling of interconnection terms and joint friction torque. In this paper, an adaptive terminal sliding mode decentralized control method is proposed for the trajectory tracking problem of reconfigurable modular robots. Firstly, the robot dynamics equations are rewritten in the form of decentralized dynamics equations, and a radial basis neural network is used to fit the approximation for the local information term; for the interconnection terms, its bound function is transformed into a nonlinear function of local joint information and an adaptive compensation term is designed to compensate it; the LuGre friction model is used to accurately describe the joint friction torque, and a robust control term is designed to compensate the effect of the joint friction torque. The convergence of the control law is proved based on Lyapunov theory. Finally, the effectiveness of the control algorithm is verified by combining with simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Artifact Elimination Algorithm for Heart Rate Monitoring in Wearable Application
abstract: Heart rate estimated using the photoplethysmography signal during intense physical exercise is highly onerous owing to the existence of noise components like motion artifacts in the photoplethysmography signal. In this paper, a de-nosing technique based on a multi-reference signal is proposed, which can accurately estimate heart rate. The proposed method gets accelerometer data and the difference between two photoplethysmography signals to obtain multiple reference signals at first. Then it uses cascaded Normalized Least Mean Square adaptive filters for motion artifact elimination . Finally, it adopts search range and accelerometer power to track spectral peaks. Simulation results show that the proposed method can reduce the influence of motion artifacts and improve the accuracy of heart rate estimation. The margin of error between the estimated heart rate and the true value is 1.5 ± 1.5 BPM.

articleTitle: PCB Defect Detection Algorithm Based On YT-YOLO
abstract: The quality of printed circuit board (PCB) has an important impact on electronic products. Aiming at the defects of PCB, this paper proposes a lightweight detection algorithm model YT-YOLO. Part of the dataset consists of PCB defect data publicly released by Peking University laboratory. SRGAN and data augmentation are used to increase the sample feature granularity and eliminate background noise, respectively. The designed YT Block is used to replace the original architecture to strengthen the feature Extraction ability. Compared with the original model, the parameters are reduced by 16.5%, the prediction accuracy is achieved by 93.5%, and the detection speed is improved by 13.4%. It can be directly deployed in the application terminal with limited computational power. It makes it possible to replace manual quality inspection with automatic, efficient and accurate inspection in the whole process.

articleTitle: A Constant Flow Air Sampler Based on Interval Type-2 Fuzzy PID Controller
abstract: A constant flow air sampler with closed-loop control is designed to increase the accuracy of pollutant detection. Orifice plate and differential pressure sensor are used as the flow measurement device instead of float flow meter. To improve the adaptability of the air sampler to various flow rates and collection devices, the air sampler is equipped with an interval type-2 fuzzy PID controller. The simulation results show that in comparison to fuzzy PID controller and PID controller, the interval type-2 fuzzy PID controller performs better. The experiments on the real air sampler system show that the interval type-2 fuzzy PID controller has better performance under different flow rates and different loads than traditional PID controller.

articleTitle: Time series forecasting of NOx concentration based on Informer for MSWI
abstract: Accurate time series forecasting of NOx concentration in flue gas is an important part of MSWI (municipal solid waste incineration). Time series prediction methods based on sliding window prediction, such as CNN and LSTM, have the problem of error accumulation, that is, the longer the predicted time series, the greater the error. Aiming at the above problems, we innovatively introduce Informer for time series prediction of NOx concentration. In this paper, we propose a method in which Informer fused with learnable positional encoding is trained with the dataset generated with variables selected by TLCC (time-lagged cross-correlation) between NOx concentration time series and other parameter time series to achieve time series forecasting of NOx concentration. Firstly, the TLCC was used to select the appropriate variables to generate the data set. Secondly, the global timestamp encoding of Informer is discarded, and the experiment proves that the global timestamp does not help the time series forecasting of NOx concentration. Thirdly, the learnable positional encoding is integrated into Informer to enhance the model's flexibility to obtain the location information of data at different time steps to compensate for the lack of the global timestamp. Finally, the prediction results of the proposed method are compared with those of other models and methods using several evaluation indicators. The experimental results show that this method has better prediction ability.

articleTitle: Dynamics Modeling and Flight Control of a Dual-rotor Tail-sitter UAV
abstract: This paper focuses on the dynamics modeling and flight control of a tail-sitter unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), which is composed of a fly-wing and dual rotors. The tail-sitter combines long endurance of the fixed-wing aircrafts as well as vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) ability of the rotary-wing aircrafts. The six degrees-of-freedom (6-DOF) equations of motion are firstly developed. To achieve a good performance during the whole flight envelope, a systematic controller which is based on the vertical and horizontal Euler angles is proposed. The controller mainly focuses on the position loop of the vehicle at the hovering and horizontal flight modes as well as their mutual transitions. Simulations conducted in our newly developed Matlab + X-Plane platform are presented to corroborate the effectiveness and robustness of the controller.

articleTitle: The Stable Method of UAV Landing on the Moving Platform
abstract: This paper addresses the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) landing problem. Aiming at the problem that the UAV is easy to roll over when landing on a mobile platform, this paper proposes a method of adding electromagnets on the landing gear, and quantitatively calculates the required electromagnet parameters. This method enables the UAV to land stably on a mobile platform and take off repeatedly. To demonstrate the performance of the proposed method, we present and analyze both simulation and experimental results, showing that this method enables the UAV to land smoothly and has good stability.

articleTitle: Analysis of key natural influences on the occurrence of Chilo suppressalis based on AHP-DEMATEL method
abstract: To investigate the key natural factors influencing the occurrence of Chilo suppressalis and their relationships, a systematic analysis was carried out from two perspectives, environmental and biological, using the AHP-DEMATEL method to reveal the weights of each natural factor influencing the occurrence of Chilo suppressalis, as well as the influence relationships and centrality of each natural factor. The findings revealed that, in the criterion layer, environmental factors had a greater impact on the dynamics of Chilo suppressalis occurrence than biological factors. The initial weight of meteorological factors in the factor layer was 0.48, which was the highest initial weight value among all factors, indicating that meteorological factors were the specific key factors influencing the dynamics of Chilo suppressalis occurrence. After correction with the DEMATEL method and combined evaluation with the AHP method, it was discovered that the comprehensive influence degree of all factors except planting area was greater than 0.05, with the meteorological factor having the highest value among all factors, with the comprehensive influence degree of 0.36, indicating that the meteorological factor had the greatest comprehensive influence on the dynamics of Chilo suppressalis occurrence, and the remaining factors having greater comprehensive influence. Finally, this study concluded that more research on specific meteorological factors should be conducted in order to clarify the key meteorological factors influencing the occurrence of Chilo suppressalis.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Game of Manufacturing Traceability System Based on Blockchain
abstract: The scale of manufacturing industry is huge, and the production of a product requires the cooperation of many enterprises. Based on blockchain technology, for the traceability of manufacturing production data, this paper designs a reasonable incentive method to encourage enterprises to actively upload manufacturing data and build a perfect blockchain traceability platform. Then, the paper establishes a game model for enterprises to upload data, and uses evolutionary game theory to analyze the model to study the strategy selection process of enterprises under the blockchain traceability system. Finally, use simulation to verify the evolution path of the game under different parameters.

articleTitle: Bounded Uncertainty and Disturbance Estimator-based Vector Control for PMSM Drives
abstract: In this paper, in order to handle the voltage constraint of the permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) drive, i.e., the limitation for the square root of the sum of squares of d−qaxes voltages, a bounded uncertainty and disturbance estimator (UDE)-based vector control method is proposed. Both the robust regulation of d−qaxes current and the fulfillment of the voltage constraint are achieved without integral windup. A control sphere is proposed to guarantee that the voltage inputs always move and remain on this control sphere to satisfy the voltage constraint. An additional time-varying variable is introduced to dynamically tune the gains of the integral behaviors in the UDE design. And a dynamic controller is developed to facilitate both the control sphere and the additional time-varying variable. The effectiveness of the proposed design is validated through simulation studies.

articleTitle: A Homologous Composite Detection Method Based on AC Magnetic Flux Leakage and Differential Eddy Current to Detect Steel Plate Defects
abstract: Alternating current magnetic flux leakage (ACMFL) and eddy current (EC) testing are two commonly used methods to detect defects in ferromagnetic materials. In this paper, a homologous composite detection method is proposed, which uses the same energy source to stimulate the two detection methods and takes into account the advantages of the two methods to realize the composite detection of defects. First, the homologous compound detection method is proposed, and the feasibility of the proposed method is analyzed in principle. Then, by solving the finite element simulation model, the results show that the ACMFL and differential eddy current(DEC) signals are positively correlated with defect depths. Next, the correctness of the simulation model is proved by the composite detection experiment of different depth defects. Finally, the results show that the proposed method is an effective defect detection method.

articleTitle: Covariance Matrix Adaptation for Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization
abstract: Pertinent works have shown that the on-policy reinforcement learning algorithm Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization(MAPPO) can perform similarly to other off-policy learning algorithms in multi-agent systems through minimal hyperparameter tuning. However, previous literature has indicated that in multi-agent tasks, although refined agent features improve the utility of the algorithm, they inevitably affect efficiency. Meanwhile, the policy generated from sampled advantage value may lead to overfitting and the algorithm reduces the exploration variance prematurely which leading the policy falling into the local optimal solution. Drawing inspiration from Proximal Policy Optimization With Covariance Matrix Adaptation(PPO-CMA), we improve the update of the loss function in continuous action space. Experimental results show that our method is superior to the original MAPPO and QMIX algorithms.

articleTitle: The impacts of government green innovation subsidies in a complementary supply chain
abstract: The government provides green innovation subsidies to firms to stimulate their innovation ability and products’ green innovation levels. We consider a complementary supply chain composed of one supplier and one manufacturer. The supplier and the manufacturer produce components separately, and then the manufacturer combines those two components into one product and sells them to consumers. The government adopts three strategies to maximize social welfare: subsidizing the supplier, manufacturer, or both. Through comparative analysis, we find that when the government subsidizes the manufacturer, the product green innovation level and social welfare are the highest. However, subsidizing the supplier strategy is the worst. Social welfare and product innovation quality are more sensitive to consumers’ green product innovation coefficient than improving cost parameters. Surprisingly, the consumer demand is the same under those three strategies.

articleTitle: Optimal Deployment of UAV Base Stations for Maximum Coverage of Task UAVs with Dynamical Positions
abstract: With the wide application of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in military and civil affairs, multi-UAVs cooperation has become an important solution to the increasingly complex target missions. However, it is challenging to meet the communication requirements of multi-UAV collaborative missions. Due to the advantages of UAV base stations (UAV-BSs) in flexibility, economy and universality, it shows potential prospect to utilize UAV-BSs to enhance the communication in multi-UAV collaborative missions. In this paper, a UAV-BS deployment problem is considered to provide effective communication for task UAVs (T-UAVs) for collaborative missions. With the unknown number and locations of T-UAVs, we introduce probability hypothesis density to describe the joint distribution of the locations and number of T-UAVs in a limited 3D area. Then, an optimization problem is formulated and a novel algorithm is proposed to cope with the optimal deployment of UAV-BSs. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Framework for Data-driven Soft Sensor Modeling
abstract: Deep learning has been widely used in industrial processes, which automatically learns hidden knowledge from process data and detects quality variables that are difficult to measure. Therefore, accurate extraction and utilization of effective features and elimination of useless features are still one of the most important research issues in soft sensor modeling. In this paper, an attention-based gated supervised encoder-decoder BiLSTM (AGSED-BiLSTM) is proposed. AGSED-BiLSTM first encodes input variables to obtain feature expressions of different abstract levels with high correlation with quality parameters, and links the outputs of each layer together through gating neurons, so as to make full use of the information of different hidden layers to obtain the final output, and improves learning efficiency through bidirectional architecture. Finally, the proposed model is applied to penicillin fermentation process, which proves the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed soft sensor model based on AGSED-BiLSTM network, and is superior to the most advanced and traditional soft sensor models based on deep learning.

articleTitle: Hopf Bifurcation Analysis of Malicious Virus Propagation Model with Time Delays and Diffusion Effect
abstract: This paper establishes a delayed SIR malicious virus propagation model in mobile wireless sensor networks (MWSNs). Since these nodes are mobile, we introduce diffusion effect into the model. With time delay as the bifurcation parameter, the local stability of the positive equilibrium point and the existence of Hopf bifurcation are analyzed. We find that when the time delay exceeds the critical value, the system will lose stability and Hopf bifurcation will occur. Eventually, the correctness of the main results is illustrated by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: A New Augmented Observable Canonical Form and Its Applications
abstract: In this paper, a new augmented observable canonical form is presented and applied to observer design for both linear and nonlinear systems with uncertain measurement disturbance. In order to analyse the effect of the disturbance to the estimation errors, we propose a novel analytical method with some tunable parameters. For any kinds of measurement disturbance, by tuning these parameters, it is shown that some estimation errors can converge to an arbitrarily small neighborhood of the origin. It is also shown that the augmented high-gain observer has low sensitivity to measurement noise, especially for high dimension nonlinear systems. Finally, a numerical simulation is offered to confirm the validity of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Controllability of Linear Time-Varying Control System Based on Non-Cooperative Dynamic Games
abstract: When we face a complex, evolving artificial system, there are "rational" individuals in the system who pursue their own interests. This paper we regulate the individuals in order to avoid significant pitfalls. First, we introduce hierarchical structure model of a game-based control system for macro-regulation and formulate the model by forward differential equation. Then we analyze the system with the extreme value principle and give the unique solution known as the Nash equilibrium. Moreover, we converse the model to the forward and backward equation to study the necessary and sufficient condition on the controllability of the system. Finally, we give the dual model of the system to study the observability inequality.

articleTitle: Pedestrian tracking and counting based on YOLOv4 and DeepSORT in Subway Stations
abstract: Real walking parameters of pedestrians are the basis of research on pedestrian dynamics. The detection and tracking technology provides the possibility of accurate walking parameters. To tackle the problem of lower detection accuracy of small-scale pedestrians, the YOLOv4 algorithm has been improved in two aspects. Then, the improved YOLOv4_I model acts as the detector of DeepSORT algorithm for pedestrian tracking and counting. After the improvement, the YOLOv4_I algorithm performs well in both the public and private datasets. The mAP is 90.61% in the private dataset, raising about 3.42%. Detection speeds reach 28.2 and 18.2 fps for processing images and video, respectively. Based on the YOLOv4_I-DeepSORT algorithm, trajectories and walking parameters of pedestrians can be obtained. Results show the average speed of pedestrians on stairs in subway stations follows the normal distribution, the mean value is 1.27 m/s, and the standard deviation is 0.33 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Optimization of intermittent oil recovery mechanism based on multi-objective genetic algorithm
abstract: With the continuous exploitation of oil fields, the problem of long-term inefficient operation of some pumping units is common in major oil fields in China. The intermittent oil recovery mechanism can effectively avoid the wear and tear of empty pumping while reducing electrical energy consumption. The Pareto multi-objective genetic algorithm is used to optimize the optimal downtime of the pumping units from the perspective of energy saving in the oil recovery system, to maximize the efficiency of oil recovery while minimizing power consumption. A comparison of the experimental results showed that the intermittent oil recovery mechanism was optimized to save 21.45% of energy consumption and improve the system efficiency by 38.85%. This method solves the problems of empty pumping and inefficiency of pumping units and achieves the purpose of reducing the mechanical wear and tear of oil recovery machines, saving electrical energy, and improving the overall development benefit of the oil field.

articleTitle: A deployment method of multi-sensors based on parallel genetic algorithm for target coverage
abstract: Under the constraints of complex environment such as buildings and ground features blocking in cities, the full-coverage monitoring of buildings and other objects is of great significance for emergency rescue and anti-terrorism security. Compared with the traditional monitoring methods, using multi-sensors carried by UAVs to monitor targets has the advantages of strong mobility, cost-effective and so on. This paper proposes a method using parallel genetic algorithm (PGA) with Message Passing Interface (MPI) for target coverage monitoring. Firstly, the paper analyzes the factors of the target monitoring under the complex environment. And then, the paper has released the gene series coding and fitting function in the above PGA to achieve the monitoring task. Finally, the paper gives out analysis and conclusion on the PGA by simulation. It is of great application value to arrange stations for multi-sensors, coordinate the deployment position of multiple UAVs, and achieve full space coverage monitoring of targets.

articleTitle: Vehicle Point Cloud Segmentation Method Based on Improved Euclidean Clustering
abstract: Point cloud segmentation is the key technology of automatic vehicle location in factories at present. Aiming at the problem that traditional Euclidean clustering algorithm is sensitive to distance threshold and easily causes over segmentation or under segmentation of clustering objects, an improved Euclidean clustering algorithm is proposed. The improved algorithm first uses the preprocessing method to reduce the noise of the initial point cloud data, then filters the point cloud on the ground where the vehicle is parked and the environment through the random sampling consistency algorithm, and finally uses the smoothness parameter to re optimize the Euclidean clustering algorithm. The experiment applies the improved Euclidean clustering algorithm to the clustering of vehicle target point clouds. The experimental results show that the improved Euclidean clustering algorithm has a good clustering effect in a certain range of large distance threshold interval, reduces the difficulty of selecting distance threshold of traditional Euclidean clustering algorithm, for the vehicle point cloud segmentation in the case of adhesion between the head and the carriage, the accuracy is improved by about 5%, and meets the requirements of vehicle point cloud segmentation and positioning.

articleTitle: Cooperative collision avoidance and obstacle avoidance path planning for multiple unmanned underwater vehicles
abstract: To address the problem of collision avoidance and obstacle avoidance of multiple unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs) in complex environments, a dynamic path planning method based on the velocity obstacle is proposed. This method constructs a three-dimensional model of UUV and other dynamic obstacles when UUV needs to avoid obstacles and establishes a velocity obstacle cone according to the velocity obstacle method. A feasible velocity outside the obstacle cone in the UUV velocity set for collision avoidance. To address the problem of path oscillation of the traditional velocity obstacle, reciprocal velocity obstacles are adopted so that each UUV can reach the target point safely. Simulation results show that this method can make multiple UUVs reach their respective target areas safely and quickly.

articleTitle: Convex and Concave Surface Detection System for Bamboo Pieces Based on Linear Laser and Image Fusion
abstract: In this study, we propose a method based on linear laser and image fusion to detect the convex and concave surfaces of bamboo pieces. The aim of the study is to further automate the processing of bamboo products (mainly bamboo chopsticks, toothpicks and bamboo mats). We derive the expression for the laser arc on the surface of the bamboo piece to obtain the optimum angle of irradiation. In order to deal with the outliers on the laser arc, we propose an outlier removal algorithm based on the first-order difference method. To determine the result of the convex and concave surface of the bamboo piece, we use a quadratic polynomial regression method. Finally we use this inspection system to flip the bamboo pieces so that all the pieces are fed to the next production stage with the same side. The experimental results show that this method has a detection error rate of less than 1‰ and is able to replace manual flipping to a certain extent and is suitable for industrial production.

articleTitle: Generating New Transient Chaos by Reconstructing a Nonlinear System
abstract: Based on a three-dimensional chaotic system, a nonlinear system is constructed by adding a nonlinear equation with a new state variable in this paper. When the new state variable has an impact on the differential equation of the original chaotic system further, new transient chaos can be generated potentially within a finite time from the reconstructed nonlinear system with a combination of several appropriate parameters. A numerical example on a new three- dimensional chaotic system with a strange attractor verifies better the existence of new transient chaos in a reconstructed nonlinear system.

articleTitle: Recovery of Sharp Feature Based on Neighborhood Fused PointNet
abstract: Feature points are important elements of the model, and how to use uniform parameters to extract feature points from multi-scale feature point clouds is a challenging problem. Therefore, this paper proposes a feature point extraction method based on a data-driven point cloud.This method can extract the feature points of multi-scale feature point cloud by unifying the model parameters. Specifically, we fuse the center feature and the neighborhood multi-channel feature, and map the category of the corresponding center point through the neural network. In addition, based on the reliable model feature points, we propose a novel joint loss function based on the expected position and normal vector constraints, which allows the smooth features to recover the sharp state. Experiments show that our algorithm can accurately extract feature points from the model point cloud with strong noise and multi-scale features, and realize the reconstruction of sharp features on feature points with good robustness.

articleTitle: Collaborative A*-Market-based Intelligent Planning Algorithm for Multi-Spraying Robots
abstract: This paper addresses the cooperative path planning problem of multi-spraying robots with rectangular spraying areas, where obstacles are the rectangular spraying areas that are once completed. A novel collaborative A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup>-market-based planning algorithm is designed to achieve the cooperative path planning with obstacle avoidance. The optimal performance of the robot utilization, the short time and the low path cost are under consideration and achieved by the proposed A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup>-market planning algorithm. Three scenarios with the fixed starting points of each rectangular spraying area (that is, the upper left vertex, the upper right vertex, the lower left vertex and the lower right vertex) and without fixed starting points are given in simulation. It is indicated that the average time cost and the total distance cost in the case without fixed starting points are reduced by 7.93% and 15.54% as compared with the case with fixed starting points.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Data Collection with Charging Stations
abstract: Incorporating efficient charging strategies into the trajectory planning process for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) data collection missions remains a difficult task. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) approach for training trajectory planning policies which jointly considers data collection and charging. Firstly, a trajectory planning optimization problem constrained by charging and other environmental constraints is formulated. Secondly, a Markov decision process is constructed based on the proposed optimization problem. Then, the deep RL algorithm DDQN is employed to obtain the optimal trajectory planning policies, where the convolutional layers in the Q-network are utilized to extract the charging and other environmental information for decision-making. Finally, a custom data collection environment is built, and the simulation results demonstrate that the UAV successfully learns to collect more data through charging as well as satisfying the safety constraints guided by the trained policy.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning With Distributed Targeted Multi-Agent Communication
abstract: Centralized training distributed execution (CTDE) in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is a commonly used application paradigm. This paradigm usually assumes that the global state of the environment can be obtained during training, which is often difficult to satisfy in various scenarios due to constraints such as data transfer and processing power. Fully distributed multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithms do not depend on the knowledge of global state, with each agent trained independently and treating the remaining agents as part of the environment. However, applying single-agent algorithms to multi-agent systems faces the problem of non-smoothness of the environment and difficulty in forming effective collaborative strategies. In this paper, we propose a new method, Distributed Targeted Multi-Agent Communication (DTMAC), which makes each agent generate messages and pass them to other agents, explicitly enhancing the collaboration among individual agent and facilitating the formation of collaborative strategies. Experiments are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Track planning model of USV based on multi-granularity pattern ant colony algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the problem of cooperative track planning with multiple USV, a path planning method based on multi-grain pattern ant colony algorithm was proposed. The cost function of USV collaborative track planning was redefined. Meanwhile, the ant colony algorithm was studied and improved, and the multi-grain mode ant colony algorithm was proposed. The correctness of the proposed multi-grain mode ant colony algorithm was proved by the simulation of TSP problem. The multi-grain pattern ant colony algorithm proposed in this paper is applied to track planning. When dynamic threats occur, the heuristic evaluation function is constructed by using the rolling optimization method to guide the ants to search direction. Simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively avoid sudden mobile threats.

articleTitle: Output Feedback Control of Multi-Agent Systems Based on Dynamic Event-Triggering Mechanism
abstract: This paper aims to study the output feedback control for multi-agent systems under dynamic event-triggering mechanism. First, a new dynamic output feedback control law is developed by using the relative outputs between neighboring agents at triggering time instants. Compared with existing work, this control protocol does not require interaction between controllers. Second, a dynamic event-triggering mechanism is designed, which effectively reduces the amount of data transmission between agents. Events are mainly triggered during initial periods when the system has not achieved consensus, and each agent will not show Zeno behavior when intensive triggering is required. Finally, the effectiveness of the developed control protocol under dynamic event-triggering mechanism is verified by a numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Monocular SLAM Based on Point-Line Affine Invariant
abstract: At present, the mainstream monocular SLAM algorithms are still based on point features to estimate trajectory of camera and build environment maps. However, it is usually difficult to find enough point features in low texture environments, which will lead to system performance degradation or even collapse. Therefore, this paper introduces line features on the basis of ORB-SLAM2 and a monocular SLAM based on point-line affine invariant is proposed. It can reduce the segmentation and redundancy in the extraction process according to the relationship of line features, and construct the relationship between points and lines through point-line affine invariant to improve the speed of line features matching. At the same time, the idea of weight is introduced into the calculation of point and line reprojection error to further enhance the accuracy of the system. Finally, we have verified the feasibility of our system through multiple experiments on different datasets. The results show that our system has better stability and robustness in low texture environments.

articleTitle: Adaptive Command Filtered Backstepping Control of Connected Vehicles with Nonlinear Disturbances
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of adaptive control of connected vehicles subject to uncertain nonlinearity. A third-order nonlinear error model is established, which considers the effect of nonlinear vehicle dynamics and unknown acceleration disturbances. To deal with the nonlinear dynamics and uncertainty, the command filtering technique is used to design the controller, where the radial basis function neural networks (RBFNNs) is introduced to estimate and compensate for the uncertainty. It is evident that the problem of "explosion of complexity" is solved when the backstepping method is involved. Both the individual vehicle stability and the disturbance string stability can be guaranteed by the designed controller. The effectiveness of the proposed method is illustrated by the numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Self-compensation Method for Harmonic Error of Resolver Based on Characteristic Frequency Observer
abstract: The amplitude error and quadrature error of the resolver are reflected in the angular velocity spectrum as the second frequency of the resolver precision machine rotational frequency, which is called the second harmonic error and is the main component of the resolver angular measurement error. In order to compensate the second harmonic error of the resolver and improve the accuracy of resolver angle measurement, this paper proposes a software self-compensation method of resolver harmonic error based on the characteristic frequency observer. Firstly, we model and analyze the resolver harmonic error; then we use the Characteristic Frequency observer constructed by adaptive notch filter (ANF) to filter out the resolver harmonic error accurately; then, we identify the amount of rotating transformer harmonic error according to the convergence coefficient of the Characteristic Frequency observer and compensate the error of the resolver original angle measurement. Finally, this method is experimentally verified to significantly reduce the harmonic error of the resolver.

articleTitle: Passivity-based finite-time H∞ control for an affine nonlinear system
abstract: The issue of passivity-based finite-time H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control issue for an affine nonlinear system is addressed in this paper. First, a finite-time version Hamilton-Jacobi inequality is presented, which is a generalization of the classical Hamilton-Jacobi inequality. Then, a sufficient condition by finite-time passivity is provided in terms of a storage function, which enables derivation of finite-time stability and an L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-gain level. Moreover, when the nominal system does not possess the finite-time passivity property, a control strategy based on finite-time feedback passivation is also established.

articleTitle: Design of anti-pinch control strategy for vehicle sunroof based on Hall motor
abstract: Due to the design defects of the anti-pinch algorithm or strategy of the automotive sunroof, the anti-pinch function is easily affected by voltage, temperature, and adhesive strip aging during the motion, which makes the sunroof mistakenly reversed and unable to close or the anti-pinch fails. In this paper, the motor motion state is judged by obtaining the Hall state and current information of the sunroof, and the interference factors such as voltage and temperature are combined with adaptive learning to set the anti-pinching thresholds for different motion regions of the sunroof. The test bench validation shows that the gradient anti-pinch threshold considering disturbance factors can be applied to a variety of sunroof anti-pinch conditions and makes the effective rate of this sunroof anti-pinch control strategy improve, and the standard anti-pinch situation reaches 90.48%.

articleTitle: HRV-Transformer: Transformer-based non-contact heart rate detection
abstract: As a kind of physiological measurement utilizing a camera to sample face feature, there are two important factors: accuracy and real time. This paper presents a framework based on Transformer called HRV-Transformer. The framework takes full advantage of Transformer, which improves the accuracy of non-contact heart rate detection and accelerates the speed of model training. However, the Transformer structure has a pronounced disadvantage which is redundancy of the structure. Through the removal of some non-essential modules, the performance of Transformer is not affected, thus realizing the real-time heart rate detection. In order to further improve the accuracy and latency, the original video frame is compressed into frames and frames difference, which can decrease the number of parameters during training. There are four kinds of data respectively used as the input of HRV-Transformer framework, so as to compare the effect of the different size and type of the data. Through experimental verification, compared with the traditional methods, the proposed model obviously improves the accuracy and latency of heart rate detection based on a camera.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of SDN Controller Based on Campus Network
abstract: SDN network separates the control plane and the data plane of the traditional network. It provides a new way for the future network upgrade and evolution. In SDN network, the controller plays an important role, and OpenFlow is the core technology. According to the characteristics and needs of the campus network, we design a SDN controller based OpenFlow. The controller can realize the physical and virtual network management of the campus network and I analyze the performance of SDN controller based on the campus network.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Detection Based on Improved GWO to Optimize Multi-Stable Stochastic Resonance Parameters
abstract: For the problem that the traditional stochastic resonance system cannot adaptively adjust the system parameters in the bearing fault signal detection. In this paper, a bearing fault signal detection method based on improved gray Wolf algorithm is proposed for adaptive optimization of multi-stable stochastic resonance parameters Firstly, the best point set theory was used to initialize the grey wolf population to improve the diversity of the population.
