An exponential convergence factor is introduced to balance the global search and local development of the algorithm, and an adaptive position update strategy is introduced to improve the accuracy of the algorithm. Then, based on the multi-stable stochastic resonance system model, the structure parameters of the multi-stable stochastic resonance were optimized by adaptive improvement of the grey wolf algorithm, so as to enhance the fault signals and realize the detection of bearing fault signals. The experimental results shown that the proposed method has fast convergence speed, high output signal-to-noise ratio of the multi-stable stochastic resonance system, and accurate and efficient fault detection performance. The method lays a foundation for the application of adaptive multi-stable stochastic resonance in engineering practice.

articleTitle: State Bounding of Memristive Cohen-Grossberg Neural Networks with Mixed Delays
abstract: This paper concerns the state bounding problem for a class of memristive Cohen–Grossberg neural networks with mixed delays and bounded disturbances. A delay-dependent sufficient condition, which is presented in terms of system parameters and contains several simple inequalities, is first given to guarantee that the state trajectories remain inside or converge exponentially into a polytope. Furthermore, based on the state bounding results, reachable set estimation and global exponential stability criterion are obtained. Finally, a numerical simulation illustrates the effectiveness of the obtained theoretical results.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimal Filter for Networked Stochastic Uncertain Systems with Correlated Noises and Fading Deception Attacks
abstract: This paper studies the distributed security estimation problems for networked stochastic uncertain systems with correlated process and measurement noises and fading deception attacks. Many measurement data from neighbor nodes are first compressed by a weighted measurement fusion algorithm in the least square at each sensor node. Then, a distributed optimal filter in the linear minimum variance sense is presented based on compressed measurement data. It has the same estimation accuracy as and lower computational cost than that based on uncompressed measurement data. A Simulation example verifies the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Efficient Deep MSC-MBiLSTM-ECA Model for Network Intrusion Detection
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the level of network information technology, network security issues are receiving more and more attention. Machine learning has been widely used in the field of network security. However, traditional machine learning methods have problems such as weak generalization ability and high difficulty in feature selection in network traffic anomaly detection. Therefore, this paper proposes a deep learning model based on a multi-scale one-dimensional convolution neural network(1D-CNN) combined with multi-layer Bi-directional Long Short Term Memory(BiLSTM) and attention mechanism to detect anomalous traffic. In this paper, we use the UNSW-NB15 dataset to simulate a real network environment to validate the model. The experimental results show that the model has a relatively high accuracy rate on the UNSW-NB15 dataset, and has better performance indicators than other commonly used algorithms.

articleTitle: Pupil Control Intelligent Wheelchair based on MediaPipe
abstract: In order to solve the problem that some quadriplegics cannot control the wheelchair autonomously, a vision tracking wheelchair control system which combines hardware and software is studied. The Raspberry Pi camera is mounted directly in front of the seat and is used to gather real-time information about the person's face. Using Google pre-trained MobileNetv2 based MediaPipe Face, as well as OpenCV image processing, to achieve the key point of face extraction. In consideration of People's Daily living habits, through the analysis of the direction of sight, eyes closed, mouth closed and other conditions output corresponding commands. The whole system runs on a Raspberry Pi 4B, and the output commands are sent to a motor controller to control the wheelchair. In addition to add automatic obstacle avoidance function to ensure the absolute safety of personnel. The system can operate in a variety of environments, such as background brightness and face occlusion, the system has high robustness.

articleTitle: Track Irregularity Detection Based on Lateral Offset of High-Speed Railway
abstract: Track irregularity detection is crucial to assure passenger comfort and operation security of the train. In this paper, a novel track irregularity estimation model based on Temporal Convolution Network (TCN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) is proposed to monitor the track state promptly and accurately. Firstly, a denoising method combining Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) and grey theory is established to realize the noise reduction of the train attitude data with a poor signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Then, the vehicle attitude characteristic information extracted from TCN is input into LSTM, and the complex model between train body lateral response and track irregularity is constructed. Finally, utilizing a dataset made up of real track irregularities and the vehicle-rail model, experimental validation is performed. The experiment results show that the track irregularity is detected effectively. Compared to the TCN, LSTM and CNN-LSTM, the detection error of TCN-LSTM is the lowest. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method can be demonstrated.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Energy Consumption Model for Data Center
abstract: The accurate prediction of time series data in the industrial production process can provide important guidance for the scheduling and decision-making of industrial systems, and is also an important part of predictive control technology. In this paper, a time series prediction model which introduces the graph neural network (GCN) is proposed. This model mainly consists of a time series feature extraction module and a relational modeling module. In the time series feature extraction module, the Att-LSTM model is proposed to extract the feature information of time series data. In the relational modeling module, a novel M-GCN network is proposed to model the relevance among different time series nodes. In addition, based on the time series prediction model, a time series multi-classification model is also proposed. The proposed model can predict the energy consumption conditions of the data center accurately. The experimental results demonstrate that the propose model can provide a desirable performance superior to some traditional models in accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fuzzy Control With Guaranteed Performance For Electric Vehicles
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new adaptive fuzzy control scheme with a saturator for a class of constrainted uncertain unparametrizable nonlinear electric vehicle (EV) systems. The control scheme effectively addresses the nonlinearities and uncertainties in the EV systems without exact knowledge including variable hill climbing angle and other system parameters, and solves the constraints on the amplitude of input voltage. The techniques of adaptive control, fuzzy logic system, and backstepping design are utilized. With the scheme, the speed tracking error of the system converges to a preset interval asymptotically even in the presence of time-varying hill climbing angle and other system parameters. The control algorithm is illustrated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: A Graph Convolutional Network Approach for Predicting Network Controllability Robustness
abstract: Network controllability robustness reflects the ability of a network system to maintain its controllability against various attack strategies, which can be measured by a sequence of values that record the controllability of the remaining network after a sequence of node or edge-removal attacks. Convolutional neural networks can be used as a tool for predicting network controllability robustness, whose input is a gray-scale image converted from a network topology and the model size and the number of parameters are quite huge. In this paper, a graph convolutional network approch is developed for network controllability robustness prediction, in which a graph data along with its node characteristics is directly used as input without being converted to a gray-scale image. Experimental studies are carried out, which demonstrate that the proposed approach can obtain similar performance while the model size and the number of parameters have a hundredfold decline compared with the existing convolutional neural network approach.

articleTitle: An evolutionary multi-objective optimization algorithm based on LPBI with adaptive penalty value
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive localized penalty boundary intersection method is proposed and applied to MOEA/D, which is called ALPBI algorithm. In order to solve the problem that the penalty value of the penalty-based intersection (PBI) is difficult to determine, the ALPBI algorithm uses a linearly changing penalty value during operation, and uses the Subproblem-based Penalty Scheme (SPS) method to skillfully set the initial and final value of the changeable penalty value, which improves the performance of the algorithm. Experiments prove that: (1) When solving multi-objective optimization problems, the trouble of selecting a penalty value is avoided because ALPBI automatically sets the appropriate penalty value. (2) The ALPBI algorithm balances diversity and convergence metrics at the same time, so that the results have more boundary solutions and are closer to PF. (3) In early stages of operation, the ALPBI algorithm enhances the diversity of the solutions, making it perform well in diversity measurement within a small number of iterations; then, it also accelerates the convergence of the solution set in later stages, and the solutions better approximate PF.

articleTitle: Pointer-Type Instrument Recognition Based on Improved U2-net
abstract: The reading and recognition technology of pointer-type instruments have laid the foundation for the realization of intelligent industry. The existing image segmentation method has achieved good results in the reading and recognition stage, but the problem that the low recognition accuracy of pointer and scale in the actual complicated scene is inevitable. As a result, an image segmentation method based on the modified U<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-Net is proposed to improve the recognition accuracy of strip scale and pointer. Firstly, this method presents a SPRSU (Strip Pooling Residual U-block) module to add the attention of strip objects during the process of pointer-type recognition. The recognition accuracy of strip-shaped objects in the segmentation process is considerably improved by adding a strip pooling layer to the residual joint. Secondly, the focal loss function is used to solve the problem of uneven distribution of image samples in the process of instrument segmentation. The experimental results suggests that the proposed method increases pointer and scale recognition accuracy in complicated scenarios.

articleTitle: A multi-sensor deployment method for cooperative coverage of targets in complex geographic environments
abstract: Based on the principle of maximum elevation view, this paper firstly conducts the research on the visibility analysis method between the grid of alternative sensor deployment locations and the grid of target table in the gridded geographical environment to obtain the set of coverage of each alternative location to the target. Then, based on the particle group population optimization method, we conduct a study on the search space determination, particle composition and adaptation value function of to determine the optimal sensor deployment solution for the full coverage of the target space.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Output Voltage Practical Tracking Control for Uninterruptible Power Supply Systems
abstract: In this paper, by using the output regulation theory, we research the output voltage practical tracking problem for un-interruptible power supply systems under event-triggered control technique. By configuring the desired poles for a controllable pair and solving the regulator equations, a state feedback gain and a feedforward gain can be obtained for designing the control law. Further, under event-triggered mechanism, a control law that can be applied to a digital platform directly is designed to solve our problem. Moreover, it can be verified that the voltage tracking error can converge to a pre-specified neighborhood of the origin.

articleTitle: Time series prediction with missing values: a bidirectional fully connected neural network approach
abstract: Time series prediction with missing values is a universal problem in various fields, while existing models cannot satisfy the requirements of engineering systems. To solve this challenge, an effective model is proposed: Bi-FCNN, which combines the bidirectional fully connected neural networks (FCNN) and the back propagation (BP) algorithm with linear propagation and nonlinear mapping capabilities, and performs well in temporal information with missing values forecasting tasks. Analysis of comparative experiment indicates that Bi-FCNN could be competent in missing data environment for predicting deletion that is inescapable due to natural or artificial factors.

articleTitle: Impedance control for biped modular reconfigurable robot with gait coordination under complex environmental contact
abstract: In this paper, an impedance control algorithm for biped modular reconfigurable robot (MRR) is proposed for steady walking. Base on Newton-Euler iterative method, the dynamic models of legs and hips are established respectively. Considering the contact state between environment and foot, a contact model is established. The desired trajectory is generated based on zero moment point method (ZMP). In the process of biped MRR movement, aiming at the problem of gait coordination in the single support phase (SSP) and the double support phase (DSP), the impedance coordination control algorithm is introduced, and the impedance controller for both legs is designed. The leg track the desired trajectory and achieve the purpose of stable walking. The stability of the impedance controller is proved by Lyapunov theory. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Effect of different organic wastes on kitchen waste machine composting secondary fermentation
abstract: Five organic wastes were mixed with the kitchen waste machine compost to improve its key physicochemical properties, including garden waste, straw, wood chips, reeds, and rice hulls, and then subjected to a 35-day secondary fermentation, with an equal amount of kitchen waste compost mixed in as a control. The test results revealed that during the secondary fermentation process, all treatments experienced significant temperature increases, with the rice husk treatment experiencing significantly higher temperatures than the other treatments during the high temperature period. During the secondary fermentation process, the total nitrogen content of the composts decreased significantly, while the total phosphorus and potassium contents increased. In terms of water content, organic matter content, and pH indexes, all treatments met the requirements of the agricultural industry standard NY/T525-2021 Organic Fertilizers. All treatments showed good degradation rates for fats and oils in the kitchen waste machine compost, with straw and rice hulls showing the greatest degradation rates for fats and oils, both with a reduction in crude fat content of more than 60%. The composts made from wood chips and rice hulls had the lowest sulphur content, both less than 0.25%. The germination index of the reed, wood chip, and rice hull treatments met the requirements of the agricultural industry standard NY/T525-2021 Organic Manure. The rice husk treatment had the highest GI value (85.27%), while the garden waste treatment did not. In summary, this study conducted a secondary fermentation of kitchen waste machine compost and concluded that secondary fermentation with rice husk mixed with kitchen waste machine compost could have the most obvious effect on its properties such as decomposition, but the 35-d fermentation cycle made complete decomposition of kitchen waste machine compost difficult, and further research on the use of long-cycle fermentation to improve composting is recommended. More research on the use of long cycle fermentation to improve the properties of machine composted kitchen waste is suggested based on the findings of this study.

articleTitle: Hopf Bifurcation Analysis of Computer Virus Propagation Model with Time Delays and Diffusion Effect
abstract: In this paper, a SIQ computer virus propagation model with time delays and diffusion effect is proposed, which can describe Internet virus propagation more accurately. Then, the local stability of the steady state and the existence of Hopf bifurcation are analyzed. The conditions that ensure the stability of the system and the existence of Hopf bifurcation are given. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical analysis is verified by some numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Research on Relative Motion Trajectory Design and Tracking Control Method of Spacecraft
abstract: Aiming at the requirements of the rapidity, stability and robustness of the control system for the near relative motion of the spacecraft, taking the nominal trajectory as the reference model and the relative orbital dynamics as the controlled object, a new method is proposed, based on the model reference theory. Novel joint design strategy for nominal trajectory planning and relative motion control. First, a model-referenced output tracking (MROT) theory is applied to design a combined controller that combines feedback stabilization and feedforward compensation. Secondly, a simple adaptive control (SAC) theory is applied to design an automatic control system based on tracking error A high-precision robust controller that adapts to the tuning control matrix. Finally, a numerical simulation model is built to verify the performance of the two controllers. The results show that the MROT controller can achieve bounded error tracking of the reference model (nominal trajectory); however, the SAC controller has strong robustness to the parameter uncertainty and unmodeled dynamic characteristics of the controlled system, and can be automatically adaptive parameter tuning enables high-precision tracking of the reference model.

articleTitle: A Vision-based UAV Tracker Aiming at Aerial Targets
abstract: Autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) tracking has been widely used in inspection, rescue, follow-up and many other fields. Compared to ground targets, aerial targets are smaller, more flexible and possess more freedom of motion, which makes the task more challenging. In this paper, we propose a vision-based UAV tracker aiming at aerial targets. Firstly, a lightweight detection model is deployed for target detection and target’s position is estimated taking advantage of detection box information and camera internal parameters. Then, a flexible motion prediction method is proposed followed by an efficient and occlusion-aware front-end path searching approach. Finally, an optimization-based multicopter trajectory planning framework is employed to generate a spatio-temporal optimal trajectory. The experimental results indicate that our tracker achieves great robustness and security in both vertical and horizontal tracking.

articleTitle: Single-Shot Cascade Bounding Box Refinement Neural Network for High Quality Object Detection
abstract: This paper proposes a novel one-stage detection method with cascade bounding box refinement, called CasDet. Generally one-stage detection methods generate less accurate bounding boxes than two-stage methods. Motivated by the location refinement of bounding boxes of two-stage methods, we present a cascade bounding box refinement for one-stage detection networks. By refining the detection results for multiple times, CasDet can generate high quality bounding boxes. To further improve the feature representation, we present a multi-scale feature aggregation structure (MBFA). By fusing features with adjacent three scales and adding multiple top-down and bottom-up aggregation paths, MBFA introduces rich contextual information and local details into each detection feature. The experimental results on COCO benchmark confirm that our CasDet outperforms existing state-of-the-art detection methods and achieves a better balance between speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Civil Aircraft Door Warning System
abstract: Whether the door of a civil aircraft works reliably or not directly affects the flight safety of the aircraft, and in severe cases, it may even threaten the lives of the crew and passengers. The door warning system is an important subsystem of the door system of civil aircraft. This paper focuses on the safety issues of flight accidents caused by door accidents caused by the failure of the door warning signal or the error indication, and a set of advanced civil aircraft door warning system is designed. In this paper, the detailed function of the door warning system is described, and the door warning system is built with FPGA microprocessor as the main control unit, the design of the door warning controller and the test section are tested and debugged, and the corresponding false alarm suppression control strategy is put forward. The experimental results show that the system can meet the functional performance index, and can operate reliably and suppress the false alarm in the process of operation. The design framework and method of the system can provide some reference and guidance for the future model development.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling and Control of Piezoelectric Ceramic Actuators Based on Improved Duhem
abstract: In order to solve the problem of hysteresis nonlinearity in the operation of piezoelectric ceramic actuator system, a rate dependent dynamic hysteresis nonlinear model based on the improved Duhem is proposed. At the same time, based on this model, an internal mode control method based on hysteresis linearization is designed. Finally an experimental platform is built for the control system to conduct experimental research. The results show that the control scheme can effectively solve the problems of the system and the control system achieve good control effect.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Transformer-Based Point Cloud Upsampling
abstract: Point cloud upsampling is used to densify the sparse set of points collected by 3D sensors, which is widely used in the field of robotics. In this paper, a two-stage method is used to generate upsampling point cloud. In the first stage, the rough upsampling point cloud is generated, and in the second stage, the rough point cloud is refined to obtain high-quality point cloud. The generation of high quality point cloud heavily relies on feature extractors. In the first stage, we introduce a transformer model to improve the feature extraction effect, which helps to fully extract the features of different location points. A Refinement Unit is proposed in the second stage to improve the rough upsampling point cloud generated in the first stage. The Refinement Unit is based on another transformer model in which the relative position coding function improves the coordinates of the deviation points generated in the first stage. We evaluate our approach on synthetic data sets. Experimental results show that the performance of this method is better than other methods.

articleTitle: Fractional Order Active Disturbance Rejection Controller for First Order Plus Time Delay Systems
abstract: This paper proposes a modified fractional order active disturbance rejection controller (MFOADRC) for the first order plus time delay systems. To improve the disturbance rejection ability, the model-based extended state observer with model informations is structured. The mathematical derivation and frequency-domain analysis verify that the proposed control system satisfies the separation principle. The foundational of separation principle and Bodes ideal transfer function plus time delay generate the fractional order feedback controller, which consists of a fractional order operator and a PI controller. A frequency-domain tuning method based on gain crossover frequency and phase margin is given to calculate the fractional order controller (FOC). A systematic and complete frequency-domain analysis method is introduced to reveal the disturbance rejection and noise suppression abilities of MESO, open-loop frequency characteristic, closed-loop frequency characteristic, disturbance rejection and noise suppression abilities of closed-loop system, and robustness to plant gain variations. Simulation illustrations for lag-dominant plant, lag-delay balanced plant and delay-dominant plant, using the proposed MFOADRC are presented to demonstrate the significant performance improvement, especially for ramp load disturbances rejection ability, over timedelay active disturbance rejection controller and fractional filter fractional order PID.

articleTitle: Multimodal Fusion for Human Action Recognition via Spatial Transformer
abstract: The recent generation of Microsoft Kinect cameras capture a range of multimodal signals providing RGB video, depth sequences, and skeleton information, making it an option to achieve enhanced HAR performance by fusing different data models. However, most existing fusion methods simply fuse multimodal features with a large amount of background noise, ignoring the underlying semantics between different models, resulting in a lack of accuracy. In this work, we propose a bilinear pooling and attention network (BPAN) fusion mechanism based on spatial transformers for human action recognition. This work improves the recognition accuracy in the following aspects.1) An effective two-stream feature pooling and fusion mechanism is proposed. RGB frames and skeletons are fused to enhance the spatiotemporal feature representation. 2) A spatial visual transformer is proposed and the framework is evaluated based on two widely used video action benchmarks, and the proposed method exhibits more favorable performance compared to the existing state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Study on Synchronization Point Self-learning Strategy of 3DHT Synchronizer
abstract: Mainly analyzes the control method of the gearshift actuator of 3DHT, and puts forward the learning strategy of the dynamic synchronizer synchronization point based on the P1 motor, P3 motor, C0 clutch and gearshift actuator in the static state of the vehicle. The complete learning strategy is established, the control model is established by MATLAB, and the closed-loop control platform is established by the compiled control software and the real vehicle. The analysis of the real vehicle test results shows that the proposed learning strategy of synchronization point can make the synchronizer learn the synchronization point under a specific motor speed and gear when the vehicle is stationary, which provides the most important parameters for the shift control of the synchronizer, thereby indirectly optimizing the shift performance and improving the service life.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Blended Teaching & Learning Mode Based on Web Platform : A Case Study of Control Theory
abstract: With the increasing popularity of web connectivity and smart products development, innovative educators have been creating new delivery methods in education by combining elements of in-person teaching with technology-enabled learning. This paper is proposed to investigate the blending mode in teaching and learning control theory base on the web platform. This mode includes three stages: preview before class-interaction during class-discussion after class. There exist resourceful T & L materials and various activities for students to learn and discuss on cloud class. The platform can reflect the students' classroom engagement and utilization of web platform resources, so as to observe the students' learning attitude and put forward specific suggestions for the students. This mode can arouse students' interest in learning and improve their enthusiasm for learning. In the future, the blended T & L mode will he used widely and benefit more students.

articleTitle: Early Warning of Surround-bidding and Forging-bidding in Sunshine Procurement Based on Clique-Grey Relation Analysis
abstract: The surround-bidding and forging-bidding in Sunshine Procurement is a complicated and hidden illegal behavior, which seriously destroys the principle of fairness and justice in the bidding process. In this paper, the bidding price is taken as the research perspective to build an early warning analysis model of surround-bidding and forging-bidding behavior of enterprises based on Clique-Grey Relation Analysis(C-GRA). It uses the community discovery to identify the community structure in the bidding enterprises, at the same time, it uses the grey relation analysis to mine the strong association between enterprise quotations, and establishes a comprehensive evaluation function to warn the abnormal behavior of surround-bidding and forging-bidding in the enterprise bidding. The numerical simulation shows that the C-GRA model can better identify the abnormal behavior of bidding enterprises.

articleTitle: Adaptive Dynamic Programming-based Fault Tolerant Control for a Quadrotor UAV Attitude Stabilization ⋆
abstract: This paper addresses an attitude stabilization control problem for a quadrotor UAV under actuator faults via adaptive dynamic programming. First, a Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation is solved by utilizing an adaptive critical neural network (NN) structure in the absence of actuator faults, and an approximate optimal control policy is derived. Meanwhile, a novel NN weight update law is proposed based on the Bellman error upper bound function, which not only has simple structure but also relieve the persistent excitation condition. Then, an adaptive law-based feedforward compensator is proposed to restrain actuator faults. Moreover, the ultimately uniformly bounded stability of the closed-loop system is proved by the development of Lyapunov methodology. Finally, the numerical simulation results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method of Rolling Bearings Based on Supercomplete Dictionary Learning
abstract: As one of the most important technologies to guarantee the safe operation of industrial equipment, fault diagnosis technology has gained wide attention. Rolling bearings are indispensable and wearing parts for large machinery equipment. It’s greatly significant to find out the fault type, fault severity, and fault location in time for maintaining the normal operation of a mechanical system. Based on the advantages of the supercomplete dictionary learning model, this paper proposes a new feature extraction method, which is combined with the Softmax classifier for rolling bearing fault diagnosis. We use a measured rolling bearing data set to prove the effect of our method. Then we design contrast experiments to compare our method with traditional methods. The experiment results show that our method can accurately diagnose multifarious bearing faults, and the supercomplete dictionary model can extract the characteristics of vibration signals well, which is superior to traditional research efforts.

articleTitle: Road Map Assisted Multi-Target Tracking Method for Intelligent Vehicle
abstract: Accurate and real-time target tracking is essential to ensure the safety of intelligent vehicles. However, tracking in complex traffic environment is still a challenging problem. Considering that the road map is usually known in the traffic scene, this paper proposes a road map assisted Gaussian Mixture Probability Hypothesis Density (GM-PHD) filter to improve the target tracking performance. By the method, the road area and non-road area are extracted and distinguished from the map firstly, and the targets in the non-road area are removed; Then the number of birth target appearing in different areas is calculated at current time, to update the intensity information of birth target in the road area and non-road area iteratively. Finally, the updated birth target number is used as the state estimation of sensor measurement information at next time. The simulation results show that, compared with the Gaussian mixture probability hypothesis density filter without road map assistance, the proposed method improves the target tracking accuracy and reduce the calculation costs.

articleTitle: Interpretable Deep Reinforcement Learning for Voltage Regulation in Active Distribution Networks with High-penetrated Renewables
abstract: Renewable distributed energies are widely used in power grids for reducing carbon emission, which also aggravates the voltage violation problem. In this paper, we investigate a coordinated voltage regulation problem in active distribution networks (ADNs). Due to the existence of uncertain parameters and inaccurate ADN model, it is difficult to design an effective voltage regulation policy. To this end, we propose an online voltage regulation policy based on interpretable deep reinforcement learning (IDRL). The key idea is to develop a voltage regulation policy based on attention-based multi-agent proximal policy optimization and then use the developed policy to construct a decision-tree based policy. The proposed voltage regulation policy does not require any prior information of uncertain parameters and is explainable. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed policy.

articleTitle: Design of a clever carbon monoxide monitoring system
abstract: Carbon monoxide is a colorless and odorless gas that is extremely dangerous. Carbon monoxide cannot be accurately detected or eliminated by the senses in high concentrations in the body under relatively airtight conditions. As a result, the human body can only inhale it passively. Carbon monoxide inhalation can deplete the body's oxygen supply, causing symptoms such as nausea, dizziness, headaches, and, in severe cases, death. In response to the event's insidiousness, urgency, and gravity. Simultaneously, because the current carbon monoxide monitoring system is not portable, it is proposed to design a microcontroller as the core, with a concentration collection module, a wireless transmission module, an LCD module, and so on. Interact with information between intelligent monitoring systems via wireless transmission module and mobile phone APP. The system consists of a microcontroller, concentration acquisition module, wireless transmission module, and LCD display module. And the performance of the system is tested by changing the environmental conditions, while a control test is conducted. The results show that the system has a fast and stable transmission rate, small size, and wireless monitoring function. Users can be informed of environmental conditions via their mobile phones, providing early warning and quick alarms.

articleTitle: Research and design of brushless DC motor cyclic variable speed control system
abstract: As a new type of helicopter, the swashplateless helicopter replaces the automatic tilter in the traditional micro-helicopter by the periodic variable speed control of the brushless DC motor, thereby simplifying the structure of the helicopter. Therefore, on the basis of the mathematical model of the brushless DC motor and the technology of magnetic field directional control, the method of cycle variable speed control of the brushless DC motor is presented. At the same time, the control scheme of the system is designed according to this method, and the MATLAB/SIMULINK simulation model of the brushless DC motor control system and the corresponding test platform are built, which verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the design.

articleTitle: Iterated Bidding-based Autonomous Mission Planning of Multiple Agile Earth Observation Satellites
abstract: To address the autonomous mission planning (AMP) problem of multiple agile earth observation satellites (AEOSs) with a large batch of tasks, this paper presents a novel AMP framework based on an improved contract net protocol (CNP) with an iterated bidding mechanism. In this framework, the bidding task distribution rules, the bidding strategy and four bid evaluation strategies are proposed. Meanwhile, four experiments with different bid evaluation strategies are designed and successfully completed on the real onboard processors based on the existing single-satellite AMP technology. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach is able to get satisfactory planning results and has important practicality in the real application.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Stabilization Method of Power System with Constant Power Load
abstract: In order to solve the phenomenon of bus voltage resonance instability caused by the negative impedance characteristics of constant power load in DC power system, a sliding mode controller based on overtorsion algorithm was designed. Firstly, the space state equation of the converter is derived according to the switching state of the converter, and a sliding surface is created using the error between the inductor current and the output voltage of the converter. Then, the convergence and stability of the sliding mode are judged by combining the super twisting algorithm with Lyapunov theorem. Finally, the simulation software Matlab/Simulink is used to verify the controller. The experimental results show that the controller has a robust and fast dynamic response to the external interference of the load side and the source converter side.

articleTitle: Collisions-free Deployment based on PDE of UAV Swarm*
abstract: This paper proposes a PDE continuum model for the UAV swarm where all UAVs are deployed to the target position subject to collisions-free. A parabolic system is established based on the artificial potential functions among UAVs by using the continuous approximation method. The asymptotically stability of this parabolic system is rigorously proved with the help of the eigenvalue of closed-loop such that the state converges to the equilibrium point. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Three phase Rectifier Circuit Based on VMD-SSA Algorithm
abstract: With the rapid development of power electronic circuits, power electronic devices are becoming more and more complex, with many fault types and low diagnostic accuracy. This paper proposes a solution based on variational mode decomposition and sparrow search algorithm to optimize support vector machines. Firstly, Simulink is used to establish the simulation model of three-phase bridge type fully controlled rectifier circuit, and the output voltage signal is decomposed by using variational mode decomposition to calculate and extract fault eigenvalue, and the fault data is normalized; Then the sparrow search algorithm is used to optimize the support vector machine, and the penalty factors and kernel parameters of the optimal estimation are searched out, and the obtained data are trained and diagnosed; Finally, the method is compared with the support vector machine without optimization. The final simulation results show that the method is superior to the unoptimized support vector machine in training accuracy and diagnosis effect.

articleTitle: A Particle Swarm Optimizer with adaptive dynamic neighborhood for multimodal multi-objective optimization
abstract: In this paper, a multi-objective particle swarm optimizer based on adaptive dynamic neighborhood (ADN-MOPSO) is proposed to locate multiple Pareto optimal solutions to solve multimodal multi-objective problems. In the proposed algorithm, a spatial distance-based non-overlapping ring topology is used to form multiple subpopulations for parallel search to enhance the local search capability of the algorithm. In addition, an adaptive dynamic neighborhood selection strategy is proposed to balance the exploration and exploitation capabilities of the algorithm, allowing the size of the subpopulation to change automatically when the neighborhood switch time is met. To prevent the algorithm from premature convergence, a stagnation detection strategy is introduced to apply a Gaussian perturbation operation to the particles that fall into the neighborhood optimum. Finally, the proposed algorithm is used to solve multimodal multi-objective test problems and compared with existing multimodal multi-objective optimization algorithms. The results show that the proposed algorithm can obtain more Pareto solutions when solving different types of multimodal multi-objective functions.

articleTitle: Fast Realization of Robot 3D Simulation Based on WebGL
abstract: As science and technology have advanced, an increasing number of people are focusing their study on 3D robot simulation. The 3D quick simulation of the mechanical arm can be achieved using 3D modeling software and Three.js. Use the third-party WebGL library Three.js<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> to construct the simulation scenario, then interact with and render the 3D scene and 3D robot model directly on the Web, which is easier and faster than downloading plug-ins<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>. This essay briefly explains the benefits and applicability of Three.js in the creation of 3D virtual simulations, then goes on to discuss the quick implementation process of 3D robot simulations before summarizing the building technique.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Control for a Remotely Operated Vehicle Based on Cascade Model Predictive Control
abstract: Nowadays, more and more remotely operated vehicles are applied in the underwater explorations. Tracking control is essential in certain tasks such as pipeline inspections. In this paper, a cascade model predictive control is proposed for the tracking control of a remotely operated vehicle. Then, we compare the proposed cascade model predictive control and the integration of model predictive control and sliding mode control through simulation. Their performances in the tracking of planar and spatial trajectories will be compared to verify the differences. The cascade model predictive control is experimentally proven to outperform the integration of model predictive control and sliding mode control in terms of convergence speed and simulation run time.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation of an Improved Path Planning Algorithm based on the Intelligent Watering Robot
abstract: Taking the watering problem of multi-potted plants as the research object, the automatic planning path of intelligent watering robot is used to solve the problem of automatic and efficient watering, avoiding the situation of routing and repeated watering of watering pipes. This paper proposes an improved path planning algorithm based on fixed path and automatic path planning to achieve efficient and accurate watering for multiple potted plants, especially for personalized watering of rare potted plants. Through the MATLAB simulation experiment, the effectiveness of the improved path planning algorithm proposed in this paper is verified. Through the analysis in different situations, the algorithm shows better accuracy and rapidity.

articleTitle: Teaching Practice of BOPPPS for The Cultivation of Application-oriented Programming Talents under The Perspective of OBE
abstract: In view of the current teaching situation of the course " Fundamentals of Programming (C++)", which is characterized by the uneven foundation of students, insufficient traditional teaching resources, and the need to guide the expansion of knowledge, we analyzed the causes and countermeasures of the teaching pain points and proposed the teaching reform of "BOPPPS teaching practice for the cultivation of application-oriented programming talents from OBE perspective". The program designed a curriculum that focuses on five aspects of students and covers all aspects of their professional skills. The results of students' performance and academic competitions have proved that the teaching effect has been significantly improved and students' ability of application and innovation has been greatly enhanced.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Self-learning Method of Conveying Volume Prediction for Distribution Robot Based on Data-driven
abstract: The improved self-learning method of conveying volume prediction for the distribution robot driven by filling volume data is studied to improve the correction effect of self-learning for the predictive value. Through qualitative and quantitative analysis of the influence of the filling volume on the conveying volume, it is found that the reduction of the concrete filling volume in the hopper will lead to the reduction of the screw conveying volume of the distribution robot. The relation model between filling volume and screw conveying volume is established by data fitting method, and the self-learning method for predicting conveying volume is improved accordingly. The experimental results show that the improved self-learning method can not only adapt to the change of distribution conditions to quickly modify the predictive value of the screw, but also provide a more accurate control target value for the weight control system of the distribution robot. Then, the initial distribution deviation caused by the poor adaptation of the target value is improved.

articleTitle: A Consensus Model to Manage Non-Cooperative Behaviors with Linguistic Scale Gradation-based Clustering and Mixed Adjustment Methods in Large-scale Group Decision-making
abstract: Due to the uncertain nature of qualitative criteria, probabilistic linguistic term sets are used to express the vagueness or incomplete information-based judgement in large-scale group decision-making (LSGDM) problems. The popular clustering methods could conflict with the interests of decision-makers (DMs); therefore, a new clustering method is proposed to aggregate DMs into the same subgroup according to whether they have the identical support degree over an alternative by exploiting the weighted averaging probabilistic linguistic term set. Additionally, previous consensus-improving studies preserve the members in each subgroup throughout the decision process and involve an automatic procedure which does not require real participation by DMs. This is usually not true because only a small preference adjustment of the DM could result in the change of his/her support degree and thus cause the re-clustering. To overcome this problem, we propose a consensus model that mixes three methods called the slight adjustment, the extensive adjustment, and the weight adjustment to manage non-cooperative behaviors and probabilistic linguistic perceptions. An illustrative example is implemented and a comparative study is investigated to verify the proposed consensus model. The proposed model is useful when DMs are reclustered into another subgroup due to preference adjustments in the LSGDM problems.

articleTitle: Cascaded extended state observers-based recursive sliding-mode dynamic surface control with nonlinear gains for uncertain nonlinear systems
abstract: In this paper, a recursive sliding-mode dynamic surface controller using an adaptive cascaded extended state observer (RSCESO) is proposed for the single-input-single-output (SISO) nonlinear systems in the presence of matched uncertainties and mismatched uncertainties, including parametric uncertainties and unknown time varying disturbances. Firstly, a series of cascaded extended state observers (CESO) are proposed to estimate the disturbances and the parametric uncertainties are handled by adaptation law in controller, which guarantees the mostly uncertainties are attenuated by the robust adaptive controller in the feedback, and avoiding high-gain feedback control. Secondly, the improved nonlinear gain functions are developed and incorporated into the control design to compensate for the input saturation limitation caused by the large control gain effectively. Finally, both a recursive sliding-mode surface and the nonlinear gain functions are introduced to deal with drawbacks in dynamic surface control approach. It is theoretically revealed that the proposed control strategy can make the tracking error arbitrarily small. Extensive comparative simulation results showed that the proposed RSCESO method has superiorities in terms of high-precision tracking accuracy and robustness to unknown time varying disturbances.

articleTitle: Multi-robot Localization for a Formation System Based on Range Information Only
abstract: Localization of the multi-robot formation system without infrastructure is vital for navigation and control when priori knowledge of environment is unavailable. This paper proposes an approach to estimate robots’ poses and landmark positions of a multi-robot formation system. Through combining odometry and observation information, the multi-robot localization problem is formulated as a least squares problem, which is solved through Gauss-Newton iteration algorithm. Particularly, two particular scenarios are discussed, which shows that the ambiguity level of the landmark can be avoided comparing with existing range-only SLAM methods. The effectiveness of the method proposed is verified via simulation results.

articleTitle: Signal-to-noise ratio vs. unstable pole, non-minimum phase zero and relative degree in mean-square stabilizability
abstract: In this work, the mean-square stabilizability via output feedback of a networked feedback system over an unreliable communication channel is studied. The unreliability of the channel is modeled by multiplicative noises. The admissible signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the unreliable channel with which the mean-square stabilizability of the networked feedback system is preserved is studied in terms of characteristics of the plant in the system. It is found that the infimum of the admissible SNR is determined by the inner of the plant’s non-minimum phase zeros, the balanced realization of the inner of plant’s unstable poles and the relative degree of the plant. Moreover, it is shown that this infimum of the admissible SNR is an exponential function of the relative degree with the square product of the unstable poles as the base. Our result analytically describes the inherent constraint between the channel SNR and the unstable poles, non-minimum zeros, relative degree of the plant in the mean-square stabilization problem of the network feedback system.

articleTitle: Finite-time H∞ Control for Switched Systems: An Event-triggered Bumpless Transfer Approach
abstract: In this paper, the event-triggered finite-time H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> bumpless transfer control problem of switched systems is studied. An event-triggered bumpless transfer control method with local constraints is proposed to reduce the bump generated by switching event-triggered controller. A sufficient condition is given to ensure the solvability of the switched systems with event-triggered finite-time H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> bumpless transfer control. The positive lower bound of event-triggered integral is obtained, which implies that Zeno behavior is excluded. By using the multiple Lyapunov functions method, a state-dependent switching law, an event-triggered mechanism and a bumpless transfer controller are co-designed. Finally, a simulation example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Directed Graph-Based Data Processing and Discharge Model Parameter Identification of Ternary Lithium Battery
abstract: Based on the discharge test data of a single ternary lithium battery, a battery discharge model was constructed. Firstly, the constant current discharge test of 0.5C and 1C discharge rate of the single ternary lithium battery was carried out through the programmable constant temperature and humidity test chamber and battery test bench. Obtain test data, battery resistance, capacity and rated voltage and other standard production known parameters. Based on the graph theory method, the test defect data is identified and its validity is proved. Then, based on the test data and physical mechanism of the two working conditions. The two key parameters of the battery discharge model are polarization resistance and exponential region constant, which are identified by MATLAB. At last, comparing the identified model and test data, the results show that the polarization resistance and exponential region constant identified within the allowable error range are effective and make the battery discharge model have better accuracy and feasibility. This model better simulates the discharge characteristics of the battery.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of Ionospheric Amplitude Scintillation Index Based on Random Forest Regression
abstract: According to the information obtained from satellite navigation, the traditional calculation method of the amplitude scintillation index requires too many intermediate variables to estimate, which caused the low accuracy of results. The conventional ionospheric scintillation model and real-time receiver branch information was utilized to produce amplitude-related parameters by the simulated signal technique. The parameters with strong correlation with the scintillation index are selected through feature selection to form a training data set, and the amplitude scintillation index calculation model based on the random forest is trained. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional method, the calculation model constructed by using the characteristics of random forest with high tolerance to outliers avoids the estimation of too many intermediate variables, and can effectively and accurately calculate the ionospheric amplitude scintillation index.

articleTitle: An upgraded iterated greedy scheduling algorithm for distributed blocking flowshop group problem
abstract: Owing to the needs of production technology, the demand for group scheduling models will further increase to save costs and time. Thus, the flowshop group scheduling problem (FGSP) has attracted a lot of attention, and is of theoretical significance for academic discussion and practical application. In this paper, we consider a distributed FGSP with blocking constrain (DBFGSP). First, a mathematical model of DBFGSP with makespan criterion is formulated and an upgraded iterative greedy algorithm based on intra-group and inter-group operations (UIG) is developed to increase the solution diversity and balance global and local search capabilities. Through numerical simulation of 810 test cases and statistical comparisons with four representative algorithms, it is verified that the proposed UIG algorithm can obtain good scheduling schemes for DBFGSP.

articleTitle: Adaptive Event-Triggered Mechanism-Based Synchronization Control of Master-Slave Delayed Neural Networks Under Randomly Occurring Deception Attack
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of adaptive event-triggered mechanism-based synchronization control of master-slave delayed neural networks (MSDNNs) under randomly occurring deception attack (RODA). Firstly, in order to reduce the load of network, an adaptive event-triggered mechanism (AETM) is introduced to determine whether the sampled data should be sent to the network. By introducing a set of Bernoulli distributed random variable (BDRV), describes the probability of whether the network has been attacked and a mathematical model of RODA is established. In summary, AETM, RODA and DNNs and synchronization problems are incorporated into a unified construction, a model of the augmented system under this framework is constructed for the first time. Secondly, by employing the Lyapunov–Krasovskii functional (LKF) method and linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) techniques, some sufficient conditions on the synchronization of MSDNNs are derived, and the parameters of the designed are given in an explicit form. In conclusion, the feasibility of the method is demonstrated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Path Planning for Soccer Robots Based on Improved Informed-RRT* Algorithm
abstract: In the actual soccer robot game, a good path planning result is the premise for the robot to carry out strategic movement. To solve the problems of the traditional Informed-RRT<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> algorithm, such as long initial path generation time and poor path smoothness, a path planning method based on the improved Informed-RRT<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> algorithm is proposed to make it suitable for soccer robot walking. First, we propose an initial path sampling based on rectangular sampling range, and then we use multi-threaded double tree growth instead of traditional alternate double tree growth. Secondly, a node expansion method based on simulating multiple resultant forces is proposed, and an adaptive step strategy is introduced. Finally, a method based on path point stretching and sharp angle bluntness is proposed to process path points, and a path with continuous curvature, good smoothness and short path length is obtained. And a series of experiments show that the algorithm in this paper has good efficiency and adaptability for soccer robot.

articleTitle: Load torque feedforward compensation method for control of variable load of dexterous hand
abstract: Precise position control of the dexterous hand is necessary in using the dexterous hand to realize the flexible grasping body sensing. Based on the hardware of the self-developed rope-driven dexterous hand, this paper aims to realize the precise position control of the dexterous hand during the grasping process. First of all, this paper analyzes and establishes the structural model of the dexterous hand measurement and control system, and establishes the simulation model accordingly. Then, for the variable load position control problem introduced by the torsion spring at the finger joints, a load torque feedforward compensation method is proposed. It solves the problem that the fixed parameter cascade PID control algorithm cannot achieve position tracking in the late stage of the grasping process due to the large load torque. Finally, to further improve the dynamic performance of the grasping process, pulse compensation is introduced in the desired position signal, shortening the dynamic response time of the whole process and achieving both fast and accurate grasping process.

articleTitle: Manipulator Reinforcement Learning with Mask Processing Based on Residual Network
abstract: In the field of intelligent manufacturing, manipulators are expected to have a higher level of learning ability to master skills. In this paper, the method of visual support is adopted to enable the UR5 manipulator to learn the skills of grasping object blocks in a random environment. The deep reinforcement learning algorithm can effectively learn visual support mapping to guide the grasping action of the manipulator. To verify the designed algorithm, a manipulator grasping system and test scenario are built on the CoppeliaSim simulation platform. The simulation results show that the deep reinforcement learning algorithm combined with the residual network (ResNet) obtains good success rate for the manipulator to grasp the target block. The experimental results show that the method significantly improves the grasping efficiency of the manipulator.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation: Recoloring of the Flame Image Based on GAN
abstract: The flame’s color and texture will change in different environments, even if they are the same flame. To simulate this change and augment the data, we design a flame coloring framework, which adds different colors and textures to flame graphics. Based on GAN, a one-to-many mapping from the graphics domain to the flame image domain is established by mapping noise to the texture domain, and taking the color flame graphics without texture as the control condition. That means that not only the color and texture strength of the flame generated by our model could be controlled according to the light intensity, but also the flame’s texture is variable under the same light intensity. The variability of flame texture is directly related to input mode of the control condition. And our model is the only one which is capable of generating flames with variable textures.

articleTitle: A hierarchical speed optimization strategy for connected automated vehicles at signalized intersection
abstract: The rapid development of autonomous driving technology has brought new opportunities to improve driving safety and traffic environment. Continuous intersection traffic, not only hinder the operation of the traffic environment, and the loss of vehicle fuel efficiency, is not conducive to the development of energy. This paper proposes a layered velocity optimization strategy (HSO) to improve fuel efficiency and reduce pollutant emissions. First, build the upper level controller and calculate the feasible speed. Then, under the constraint conditions, the lower controller tracks the feasible speed and obtains the optimal speed. Finally, different driving scenarios were built in Prescan and Simulink to verify the effectiveness of HSO. Simulation results show that the strategy is effective under different driving conditions.

articleTitle: Reinforcement learning based ball mill discharge size distribution control
abstract: The particle size distribution of ball mill grinding products is an important production index of the grinding operation, and due to its multivariate strong coupling and nonlinearity in the operation process, it leads to difficulties in achieving optimal control of the discharge particle size distribution. To this end, a reinforcement learning-based optimal control method is proposed for the control of ball mill discharge size distribution. The proposed method implements the strategy evaluation and strategy iteration using different neural networks and establishes a model-free controller. Finally, the method is compared with the model predictive control method through simulation experiments, and the results show that the proposed method outperforms the predictive control method in terms of time consumption and control accuracy.

articleTitle: Fault Detection Method for INS/GNSS Navigation System Based on CERIM in V2V Network
abstract: Internet-connected vehicles are one of the research directions in the field of intelligent transportation, and navigation integrity is of great importance for the safe operation of vehicles in dense urban building conditions. In this paper, we propose a fault detection method using baseline inter-vehicle collaboration algorithm to improve the fault detection and integrity assurance of navigation system under the condition of limited measurement information, in view of the fault influence of GNSS in the process of vehicle navigation. The proposed algorithm can make full use of the observation information of the cooperative vehicles to improve the sensitivity and accuracy of fault detection. Simulations show that compared with the traditional GNSS receiver autonomous integrity detection technology, this paper can significantly improve the fault detection sensitivity of vehicle navigation system in urban environment and guarantee the navigation integrity under fault conditions.

articleTitle: The interaction force model of soft tissue for virtual surgery system based on KNN algorithm
abstract: It is difficult to simulate haptic interactions in a virtual surgical system due to the complexity of biomechanical features. Most prevalent methods simulate the viscoelasticity of soft tissues by establishing spring and damping models or neural networks, but the former often have poor accuracy while the latter cannot satisfy the real-time requirements of virtual surgical systems. This paper proposes an interaction force model based on K-nearest neighbor algorithm (KNN algorithm) and applies it to a virtual surgical system. The experimental result shows that the model to predict the force feedback of the soft tissue based on KNN algorithm can calculate the interactive force accurately during the puncture process. It meets the requirements of real-time and yields a range of error narrower than that incurred in case of manual perception.

articleTitle: An improved YOLOv7 method for vehicle detection in traffic scenes
abstract: Vehicle target detection is a key task in intelligent traffic management and has important significance for the construction of intelligent transportation systems. To address the problem of the adaptability of target detection algorithms in actual traffic scenes, a vehicle target detection algorithm based on the improvement of YOLOv7 is proposed. Firstly, the original backbone network is replaced with the MobileNetV3 network with a depth separable convolution structure, which reduces the model parameters and computational complexity. Secondly, the BiFPN structure is introduced in the feature fusion module to combine the position information of low-level feature maps with the semantic information of high-level feature maps. Finally, the Focal-Loss EIOU is used as the positioning loss function to accelerate the convergence speed of the predicted box. Based on the UA-DETRAC dataset, the best improvement strategy is determined through comparative experiments, and the superiority of the combination of improvement strategies is verified through ablation experiments. The experimental results show that the improved YOLOv7 algorithm has an average precision of 93.1%, which is 6.6% higher than the original YOLOv7, and the frame rate reaches 41, meeting the real-time requirements.

articleTitle: Bayesian motion intention estimation-based impedance control of modular robot manipulator: theory and experimental verification
abstract: This article proposes an impedance control method of modular robot manipulator (MRM) system for physical human-robot interaction (pHRI). Bayesian parameter estimation is employed to identify human motion intention, which is considered as the desired trajectory in impedance control that allows the MRM easily to track the target impedance model. The uniformly ultimately bounded (UUB) of the tracking error is proved based on Lyapunov theory, and the experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control method in pHRI.

articleTitle: Design of Ignition Sensitivity Test Device and Application of D-optimality Method
abstract: This paper analyzes the principle and process of the existing ignition sensitivity test of energetic materials, and designs a new type of automatic ignition sensitivity test device for the lack of complicated operation of the ignition sensitivity test device. The device uses the mobile terminal as the control core to control the high-precision numerical control voltage source to achieve efficient voltage regulation; The calculation process of D-optimality method in sensitivity test is analyzed, and the Android program of D-optimality method sensitivity test is designed and developed. The calculation accuracy of the program is verified by using the method of standard calculation examples compared with simulation, and the D- optimality method is tested for the ignition sensitivity of an igniter. The results show that the device improves the efficiency of the test while meeting the test accuracy of the ignition sensitivity test of energetic materials.

articleTitle: Application of Nonlinear Model Predictive Control Method Based on GA for Northeastern Greenhouse in China
abstract: The purpose of the greenhouse system is to build a suitable microclimate environment for crop growth in northeastern China. The precise control of environmental factors is the key factor to ensure the high quality of crop growth. However, the actual greenhouse system is described as a complex dynamic characteristic with strong nonlinear, strong coupling, multiple disturbances. Therefore, the traditional PID control method is difficult to solve the above problems. In order to solve the above problems, this paper develops a microclimate dynamic model suitable for the northeastern greenhouse. Subsequently, the Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) algorithm combines with GA algorithm is applied to the northeastern greenhouse. This scheme is applied to the control of temperature, humidity and carbon dioxide concentration in the greenhouse compared with the traditional PID control. The simulation results show that the nonlinear model predictive control based on GA algorithm has better control performance and stability. Furthermore, the proposed method can meet the actual demand.

articleTitle: Stabilization Control of Auto-balancing Bicycle subject to disturbances
abstract: In recent years, underactuated systems have been widely employed in engineering due to their simple structure, high performance, and low cost. This paper deals with the robust stabilization problems of a riderless bicycle at low speed. To facilitate the analysis, non-singular coordinate transformation is applied to dynamic model of the bicycle and an effective control method is proposed. By dividing the new dynamic model into two separate subsystems, the control objective is achieved by introducing a new virtual control input and disturbance rejection controller. The linear extended state observer is implemented to approximate and compensate for the lumped disturbances, including parametric uncertainties, internal non-linearity and external disturbances. Simulation and experimental results on an auto-balancing bicycle show the satisfying performances of the proposed method for the stabilization.

articleTitle: State Feedback Exponential Stabilization of Coupled ODE-Wave System with Nonlinear Boundary Condition
abstract: In this note, we concentrate on the state feedback stabilization for coupled wave PDE-ODE systems associated with cubic nonlinearity term at the uncontrolled end. Due to the energy injection, cubic displacement nonlinearity and the interconnection between the coupled wave PDE-ODE system, the system considered in this note is more complex and interesting. First, two novel transformations are introduced to convert the original system into a desired system. Then a state feedback controller is proposed. Next, the desired system is shown to be exponentially stable by using semigroup theory. At the end, the well-posed and the exponential stability of the closed-loop system is derived. The numerical simulation results are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the controller.

articleTitle: Single Image Super-resolution Method for Electrical Equipment Images Based on Deep Learning
abstract: Image super-resolution (SR) has achieved wide interest in the field of computer vision since it was proposed. Single image super-resolution (SISR) refers to obtaining a corresponding high-resolution (HR) image from a low-resolution image (LR). High-resolution images have more information and thus help to improve the training accuracy of neural network models. High-resolution images are often lacking in electrical engineering due to the limitation of sensor and optical device manufacturing process and cost. Therefore, it is of great practical importance to obtain HR images by super-resolution techniques. In this paper, we propose a novel approach based on generative adversarial network (GAN). Our proposed method is better than existing methods with respect to accuracy, and the visual improvement in our performance is evident.

articleTitle: Real-time Omnidirectional Depth Perception Based on Multi-view Wide-angle Vision System
abstract: Omnidirectional depth matters significantly to the field of environmental 3D perception. Currently, the learning methods for inferring depth from visual information primarily focus on accuracy improvement at the expense of computational speed and cost, which makes them unsuitable for some real-time applications like robotics.In this paper, we present a real-time and lightweight deep learning network to predict omnidirectional depth from four wide-angle camera images, which includes a multi-scale feature extractor and a two-stage cost aggregation architecture to effectively integrate feature information. Moreover, we propose a synthetic urban dataset for learning omnidirectional depth. It relies on four lenses, each with the field-of-view (FOV) of 180°, and a panoramic lens to render multi-view images and ground-truth depth maps on the Blender platform. Plus, the GAN network is employed to enhance the dataset diversity by producing different weather samples. Finally, the whole network is trained and evaluated on our dataset, and experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the dataset and the feasibility of the proposed method. It can achieve a trade-off between model accuracy, computational speed and complexity, making it useful for real-time applications.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Feature Injection for Occluded 3D Human Pose and Shape Estimation
abstract: 3D reconstruction has been applied to many research fields such as robots and computer vision with the fast development of technology. Despite significant progress, current 3D human pose and shape estimation methods still remain challenge to recovery 3D human mesh under occlusions. Previous works use a Iterative Error Feedback (IEF) loop to construct the regressor and often have disregarded information at occluded regions that make them difficult to handle occlusions. However, we argue that occluded regions have strong correlations with human body so that they can offer effective information for 3D human pose and shape estimation. To address this, we propose a multi-scale feature injection network MFINet, that utilizes the information at occluded regions as a secondary clews to enrich the image features in a coarse-to-fine manner. In MFInet, given the image feature at current scale, a Transformer-based module, called feature inject transformer module (FIM) is used to inject human feature into occluded region by considering their correlation. To this end, experiments show that our method is effective in both object and subject results on several benchmarks including Human3.6M, 3DPW, LSP and COCO.

articleTitle: Monitoring the ratio of two normal variables based on double exponentially weighted moving average control charts with fixed and variable sampling intervals
abstract: Monitoring the ratio of two normal random variables (RZ) is one of the most important directions in Statistical Process Control (SPC). To enhance the sensitivity of traditional RZ charts in detecting process shifts, especially small and moderate shifts, this paper proposes a new RZ control chart on the basis of the exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) RZ control chart. Firstly, by smoothing the coefficient of EWMA-RZ control chart twice, the double exponentially weighted moving average (DEWMA) RZ chart is obtained. In particular, the variable sampling interval (VSI) strategy has been adopted to different control charts by researchers. With the application of this strategy, the VSI-DEWMA-RZ chart is then developed to further improve the performance of the proposed DEWMA-RZ chart in detecting process shifts. Secondly, the run length (RL) properties of the proposed DEWMA-RZ charts are obtained by using the Monte-Carlo (MC) simulation. Finally, for different chart parameters, the performance of the proposed VSI-DEWMA-RZ chart is compared with the proposed DEWMA-RZ and the existing VSI-EWMA-RZ charts. The simulation results show that the proposed VSI-DEWMA-RZ chart performs better than the DEWMA-RZ chart and moreover, it has better performance than the VSI-EWMA-RZ chart for small and moderate shifts.

articleTitle: Energy Price Index Prediction via Information Granulation and Fuzzy Time Series Model
abstract: Capturing the trend and main variation ranges of the energy price index is crucial for energy management and decision-making. This study designs a forecasting method of the energy price index based on information granule and fuzzy time series model. Firstly, the principle of justifiable granularity is applied to a collection of interval-based information granules for characterizing the main variation interval of the energy price index. Next, the fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm based on Hausdorff distance is employed to fuzzify the granular time series. Then, the fuzzy rules based on granular time series are established, and a fuzzy inference system is constructed to forecast the future variation ranges. The experimental results on four energy price index data demonstrate the practicality and effectiveness of the proposed granular fuzzy time series prediction method.

articleTitle: Robust multi-objective optimization-based Fuzzy Energy Management System for lithium battery/supercapacitor HEV
abstract: The real-world driving environment is complex and uncertain, and the solution to the vehicle energy management system (EMS) is not unique. Therefore, solutions with robustness are more valuable due to their stability in unknown environments. In this paper, we propose a robust multi-objective optimization algorithm to optimize the parameters of the fuzzy logic controller (FLC), in which the robustness is incorporated as part of the search process of multi-objective algorithm. It uses the sequence of historical and current fitness values to construct a predictor in order to estimate the fitness values of the population in the future environment to select individuals with better robustness. 4 typical driving conditions including busy city, urban, suburban and highway are selected to demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed method. Experimental results show that the method has significant advantages in terms of output fluctuation and saving lithium battery energy consumption.

articleTitle: Target Identity Probability Analysis for Multi-Target Tracking
abstract: This paper proposes a novel target identity probability analysis algorithm for multi-target tracking (MTT) problems. By introducing a target identity probability matrix, finding the identity probability is converted into the problem of target-to-target association. The issue in solving the equivalent problem is that the computational complexity increases exponentially with the increase of the problem size. We propose a Gibbs sampling approach to find approximate polynomial-time solutions. Theoretical analysis reveals that the proposed algorithm provides a performance-guaranteed approximation.
