Numerical simulations are conducted to support the analytical findings.

articleTitle: A Novel State Estimator Based on Algebraic Parametric Method
abstract: It’s crucial to design a robust and accurate state estimator for a given observable LTI system of which the initial conditions are unknown, especially when the system is in a noisy environment. This paper handles this problem from the non-asymptotic perspective and provides a novel design process for estimators based on the algebraic parametric method. Unlike other algebraic-parametric-method-based state estimators, the proposed estimator regards the unknown initial conditions as values to be estimated, which can also provide some theoretical support for initial value settings in other estimation methods. Moreover, the separation theorem is proven to hold, so we can construct a state feedback controller based on the designed novel estimator to achieve the control objective. Finally, numerical simulations with a damping platform model illustrate that the proposed state estimator outperforms the traditional Luenberger state observer in robustness, accuracy, and fastness.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method of Rolling Bearing Based on Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: Rolling bearing is a vital part of mechanical components, and its working environment is complex, which is prone to failure. Once a fault occurs, the rotating machinery will be shut down or even scrapped, which directly affects the economic benefits and personal safety. Therefore, this paper presents a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on convolution neural network (CNN). Through a series of comparative experiments, the best parameters of the model, such as learning rate, BatchSize, Dropout layer position and Dropout rate, are determined. In this article, after Fourier transform of primitive vibration signal of the bearing, the frequency domain signal is transformed into a two-dimensional condition as input of CNN to diagnose and identify inner circle fault, outer circle fault, cage fault and mixed fault. Finally, the experimental data set of rolling bearings published by Xi 'an Jiaotong University is used, the diagnostic accuracy rate is as high as 99.89%, which shows that the model can effectively diagnose rolling bearing faults. In addition, the proposed method is compared with Gates recurrent neural (GRU) and long-short term memory neural networks (LSTM), and the results show the advantages of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Prediction of Moisture Content in Lead-zinc Sintering Returns Based on Linear Parameter-Varying Models
abstract: Cooling of the lead-zinc sintering returns is one of the processes in the lead-zinc sintering process in the smelter, and the purpose is to recycle the sintered ingredients that do not meet the requirements of the sintering process. Due to the complexity of the production process and the influence of nonlinear factors, it is difficult to predict the water content of the sintering returns at the output end of the cooling cylinder. In order to improve the accuracy of the prediction of the return powder moisture in the cooling cylinder, a new nonlinear prediction model is proposed. First, the complementary integrated empirical mode decomposition (CEEMD) and fast Fourier transform (FFT) are used to de-noise the original data, and then the water content prediction model of the sintering returns is built based on the linear parameter-varying models (LPV). Finally, the differential evolution algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the model to achieve accurate prediction of material moisture content. A series of comprehensive experiment are conducted using the production data of a smelter in Guangdong, China. The experimental results show that the model has high prediction accuracy and strong multi-step prediction performance, which proves the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Modified average-consensus of generalized second-order and high-order multi-agent systems
abstract: Addressed in the present paper is the modified average-consensus problem of two types of discrete-time multi-agent system (DTMAS) models: generalized second-order DTMAS and generalized high-order DTMAS. It is first shown that, by using a doubly stochastic scaling algorithm, a generalized second-order DTMAS can achieve the desired average-consensus with the assumption that the underlying topology is strongly connected. The result is then extended to generalized high-order DTMAS. Finally, a simulation example is given to illustrate the correctness of theoretical derivation.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on Optimized Deep Hybrid Kernel Extreme Learning Machine
abstract: Bearings are important components in mechanical equipment. Fault diagnosis of bearings is of great significance. High accuracy and strong adaptability are necessary for a bearing fault diagnosis method. In this paper, a fault diagnosis method based on an optimized deep hybrid kernel extreme learning machine is proposed. This method adds the idea of deep learning to the traditional machine learning method, and has the characteristics of simple implementation and strong feature extraction ability. In addition, the sparrow search optimization algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the diagnostic model, so that the model can achieve the best effectiveness. Experiments show that our proposed method can achieve satisfying performance on the same working condition, different working conditions and imbalanced datasets.

articleTitle: Implementation of gateway message scheduling method for CAN/CANFD hybrid network
abstract: A scheduling algorithm based on different cycle queues is proposed to solve the delay problem of multi-cycle messages scheduling and forwarding in CAN/CANFD hybrid network gateway. When scheduling cycle messages in different weight and different cycle queues, this method can ensure the priority scheduling of short-cycle messages and enable the scheduling of long-cycle messages as soon as possible, so that it can reduce the stack of long-cycle messages. The proposed method can effectively reduce the average delay of the long cycle messages, thus ensuring the real-time performance of the messages.

articleTitle: DV-Hop Indoor Localization Algorithm Based on Tortuosity Factor
abstract: To solve the problem of poor localization accuracy when the Distance Vector-Hop(DV-Hop) algorithm is applied to indoor environment with complex structure, an indoor localization algorithm based on anchor node set is proposed. First, a preliminary judgment is made on whether anchor nodes are suitable to participate in the localization of unknown nodes by the tortuosity factor. Then, a fitness function is employed to evaluate the localization error for more accurate estimated coordinates. Simulation results show that for different indoor topologies, the proposed algorithm enhances the localization accuracy by 40% to 60% compared with the DV-Hop algorithm.

articleTitle: The time-consistency of optimality principles in SVO-based multistage cooperative games
abstract: In this study we consider the time consistency of multistage cooperative games with social value orientation (SVO) in which there is one optimal trajectories with complete information. In dynamic cooperative games, an important condition for the distribution of players’ payoff is that individual rationality needs to be satisfied. If the players’ payoff do not satisfy individual rationality as the game progresses along the cooperative trajectory, some players will deviate from the cooperative trajectory. And SVO can affect player payoffs along a strategy and thus influence cooperation.Therefore, we show the SVO influences the multistage cooperation games with complete information.

articleTitle: Research on Temperature and Speed Cascade Control Method of Liquid Viscous Drive Based on Variable Ratio Model
abstract: For the liquid viscous-driven cooling fan system, a cascade control strategy including inner-loop speed feedback and outer-loop temperature feedback is proposed. The inner-loop control system is based on the variable ratio model to achieve the speed regulation of the liquid viscous-driven fan; the outer-loop control system is responsible for regulating the target speed of the fan. The experimental results show that the MPC temperature control algorithm based on model identification can provide a suitable target speed, and the speed control algorithm based on the variable ratio model compensation can reduce the dead zone of the system, expand the effective control interval, weaken the influence of hysteresis nonlinearity and improve the speed tracking accuracy, the hysteresis of the system is reduced from 40%-50% under open-loop control to 15% under feedforward compensated closed-loop control; the turn-point lag time is less than 1 s.

articleTitle: Switching-Gain Active Disturbance Rejection Control for Air Starting Systems of ATF With Multi-Valve Linkage Strategy
abstract: The air starting system (ASS) of the altitude test facility (ATF) has complex nonlinearity and uncertain disturbances, which seriously affects high performance system control and fast response. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a switching-gain active disturbance rejection control (SG-ADRC) framework for the air start system of the ATF for the first time. In particular, a multi-valve linkage strategy is proposed (i.e., simultaneously adjusting the opening of the main and the bypass control valves), which improves the flexibility and rapidity of pressure regulation. Moreover, a switching-gain scheme is designed to further improve the control performance under multiple working conditions. Simulation results show that the proposed method can achieve stable and fast tracking of the target pressure, and the control steady-state error is maintained within 0.0024 (after normalization) and the settling time is about 3 s.

articleTitle: Economic Dispatching of Virtual Power Plant Considering the Shared Energy Storage
abstract: In the existing research on the economic dispatch of virtual power plants, there is little consideration of the cost of electricity on the user side, and in order to ensure its own benefits when interacting with the power grid, there will also be cases where the demand for peak-shaving and valley-filling on the power grid side is ignored. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a new virtual power plant operation mode. Considering the advantages of shared energy storage such as good flexibility, good economic benefits, convenience for multi-party dispatching and the potential of residents’ demand-side response, a shared storage system with power grid, virtual power plant and users is established, and a multi-objective optimal dispatch model with users’ electricity costs and benefits of virtual power plant is constructed, the weight coefficient method is used to transform the multi-objective into a single-objective optimization problem, and proposes a new benefit distribution mechanism to minimize the user’s electricity cost while benefiting from the virtual power plant. Using the IBM solver Cplex to solve the problem, the simulation results show that the virtual power plant operation mode in which users participate in dispatching through shared energy storage can achieve a win-win situation for the energy supply side, energy transmission side, and energy consumption side, which is conducive to promoting the diversified development of energy storage and optimizing the structure of electric energy usage is instructive.

articleTitle: Development of Casting Curve of Copper Anode Plate Based on Self-learning Algorithm
abstract: Based on the understanding of the changing characteristics of working conditions in the casting process of copper anode plate, on the basis of establishing a good mathematical model, the smoothness control of copper water flow rate in the casting process and the fallback control of the casting package are completed by using a self-learning algorithm, so as to realize the accurate control of the weight of the copper anode plate. After a period of debugging and trial operation in a copper company, the correctness and adaptability of the control algorithm were verified.

articleTitle: Predictive Active Disturbance Rejection Control for Networked Control System
abstract: Consider the impact of network delay on control system performance, a kind of control strategy of predictive ADRC (active disturbance rejection control) for NCS (networked control system) is proposed. The strategy includes two parts: prediction of network delay and improved ADRC of motor. In order to realize the accurate prediction of network delay, a delay prediction model based algorithm of CEEMD (complementary ensemble empirical mode decomposition) and LSSVM (least squares support vector machine) is proposed. The linear ADRC algorithm is used for controller of motor, and the value of predicted network delay is used as an input of controller. And a predictive PI algorithm is introduced into ADRC to realize predictive ADRC of motor. Finally, the simulation model of NCS based on predictive ADRC is established using the TrueTime toolbox, and the corresponding simulation research is carried out. Simulation results show that the strategy of predictive ADRC can more effectively improve the tracking performance of motor. The feasibility and superiority of this proposed method is proved, especially for long-delay NCS.

Author Keywords: predictive linear active disturbance rejection control

articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Trajectory Tracking Control of AGV with Input Saturation
abstract: This paper studies the trajectory tracking control problem of an AGV under the influence of input saturation, where an improved adaptive sliding mode control method based on a barrier function is proposed. The barrier function is used to ensure that the tracking error converges to a predefined range, and system chattering is reduced. An auxiliary system is designed to compensate for the vehicle system’s input saturation, allowing the vehicle to maintain a satisfactory trajectory tracking performance when the control torque is limited. Finally, simulation results shows the effectiveness of the method proposed.

articleTitle: Watermarking-based Discrete LQG Systems for Detecting Replay Attacks
abstract: The problem of detecting replay attacks on discrete-time stochastic systems using Kalman filter state estimators and LQG controllers is studied. A dynamic watermarking method based on the dynamic characteristics of the system is proposed to deal with the replay attack on the output measurement values. The stability of the main system is maintained, and the condition of the dynamic parameters of the watermark is given, so that the attack can be revealed by the instability of the difference between the estimated output and the measured output, i. e. the residual trajectory. This method adjusts the detection rate of the system by changing the design parameters of the system. However, because the designed watermark signal will affect the performance of the controlled system, an optimal control method is adopted to minimize the loss caused by the watermark signal. Simulation results show that the proposed dynamic watermarking method has better performance than the additive white noise watermarking method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Prediction Modeling of Oxygen Content in Flue Gas for Municipal Solid Waste Incineration Process
abstract: To accurately predict the oxygen content in flue gas during the municipal solid waste incineration process, this paper uses mutual information, differential evolution algorithm and stochastic configuration network to select the features of the oxygen content in flue gas and predict the modeling. Firstly, the mutual information method is used to eliminate some irrelevant variables. Secondly, the differential evolution algorithm is combined with the stochastic configuration network to further eliminate redundant variables from the above selected feature variables, so as to determine the input variables for predicting the oxygen content in flue gas, and train the stochastic configuration network prediction model for the oxygen content in flue gas. Finally, the actual data sampled from a solid waste incineration plant in Beijing is used to test and verify. The results show that the hybrid feature selection method and prediction modeling method in this paper are effective and can accurately predict the oxygen content in flue gas during the solid waste incineration process.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Levitation Controller of Medium-Speed Maglev Train Based on SOM-BP Neural Network
abstract: In this paper, a fault diagnosis method combining SOM and BP neural networks is designed for fault diagnosis of levitation controllers of medium-speed maglev train. On the one hand, this method overcomes the limitation that SOM networks cannot directly determine the correctness of clustering results and the clustering results are difficult to understand, and on the other hand, it overcomes the shortcomings of poor generalization performance of BP networks and difficulty in achieving accurate classification. Based on the fault data of medium and low speed maglev trains obtained by the project team in Changsha Maglev Airport Line, the simulation test proves that the stability and accuracy of the SOM-BP neural network in the fault diagnosis of the suspension controller are significantly higher than that of the neural network alone.

articleTitle: A Robust Circular Marker Detection Method Based on Revised Tiny-yolov3
abstract: Circular markers were often used in computer vision measurement due to their obvious geometric features and high positioning accuracy. However, traditional methods were susceptible to external interference when locating the circular marker, which could lead to location failure and affect the actual measurement. For this reason, a robust circular marker detection method based on revised tiny-yolov3 was proposed in this paper. Specifically, we improved the network structure of tiny-yolov3 and added the geometric constraint of the object boundary box in the loss function of the algorithm to improve the positioning accuracy of circular markers. We also performed a large number of experiments on actual datasets. The results have shown that our method could accurately locate the region where the circular marker is located, and the precision reaches 98.93%, which was more than 8 percentage points higher than the state-of-the-art methods. The robustness is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Study on the diagnosis of control valve fault diagnosis based on EEMD-sample entropy and 1DCNN-BiLSTM
abstract: The control valve, as an important part of the industrial control system, is of great significance to accurately realize the failure diagnosis of the control valve. In response to the non -linear and non -smooth characteristics of the control valve composite fault signal, this article combines signal processing and data -driven methods to establish a control valve composite fault diagnosis method. In this paper, a control valve fault diagnosis method based on Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD)-sample entropy and one-dimensional convolutional bidirectional long short-term memory neural network (1DCNN-BiLSTM) is proposed. Extract the time domain characteristics of signals such as pressure and medium flow rate under multiple faults, and use EEMD to decompose signal features and calculate the sample entropy to jointly build a new feature signal. With this feature signal as the input of the 1DCNN-BiLSTM classification model, the 1DCNN-BiLSTM classification model has five multi-fault data training and verification of the control valve. The experimental results show that the failure diagnostic model proposed in this paper is better than other commonly used models for multi -fault data classification, and more accurate accuracy.

articleTitle: Calculation of the maximum transmit power of the fractional order equivalent circuit for lithium-ion batteries
abstract: Achieving maximum power transmission is of great significance in reducing power losses. In actual electric vehicle condition, due to the influence of the internal electrochemical kinetics and thermodynamics of the power batteries, lithium-ion batteries usually do not achieve the maximum power transmission under ideal conditions. In this paper, an improved fractional-order particle swarm optimization algorithm with a linear differential decline strategy (IFPSO) is proposed to identify the model parameters. The chaotic mapping is used to improve the diversity of the population and the jump-out strategy is designed to overcome particles stagnation situations. According to the obtained identification result, the maximum transmission power of three kinds of fractional order equivalent circuit models (FOECM) of a lithium-ion batteries is presented based on the maximum power transmission theorem.

articleTitle: The evolutionary game analysis for integrated circuit industry competition between China and the United States
abstract: In this study, a framework of evolutionary game is applied to analyze the integrated circuit industry competition between China and the United States, and equilibrium points are generated from this framework. Furthermore, these equilibrium points are divided by different categories, in which the evolutionary stable strategies (ESS’s) are the most concerned points. The conclusions of stability analysis imply that China and the United States are unlikely to give up competition in the integrated circuit industry and return to the previous situation at present, and when one party’s investment is significantly greater than the other party’s, the other party is likely to adopt a passive strategy. These results are of great significance to the formulation of integrated circuit industrial policies in China.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fault-tolerant Pitch Control of Wind Turbines
abstract: In order to effectively cope with the influence of internal/external factors on the wind turbine pitch control system and solve the dynamic uncertainty of the system, this paper proposes an adaptive fault-tolerant pitch tracking control method. A dynamic model of the wind turbine pitch control system is established with considering the aerodynamic resistance, partial actuator failure, unknown and time-varying system parameters and other factors suffered by wind turbines during actual operation. This method does not involve the specific values of unknown parameters in the controller design and can avoid continuous control parameter adjustment process. Besides, it can well handle the impact of actuator losses on the pitch system. Simulation results show that the proposed method is feasible, and the experiment further prove that the method can achieve stable pitch angle tracking control target and has practical application value.

articleTitle: Detection of Nectarines on Trees with YOLO Models
abstract: In agricultural production, the introduction of artificial intelligence can speed up the detection of fruit and yield statistics. To address the problem that nectarines are not easily detected due to their uneven color, easy exposure, and leaf shading in natural picking environments, our research proposes a YOLO-based nectarine detection network. Based on the datasets with data augmentation, we use the YOLO family of deep learning models to train on the collected nectarine data, compare different pre-trained models for single species target detection of nectarines, compare the results of each model, and find the model that can accurately detect nectarines. In this experiment, Precision (accuracy), Recall (recall), F-Measure (F1) and mean Average Precision (mAP) were used as accuracy metrics for the models. The experimental results showed that the weight files obtained from training with the YOLOv3 network were relatively stable, with 98.1% accuracy, 95% recall, 96.5% F1 value, and 98.1% mAP. Compared with other networks, the precision, recall, and F1 value were on average 1.275% higher and the mAP was 4.85% higher. The model was found to maintain high accuracy and performance in the detection of nectarines in a natural picking environment, providing technical support for the rapid, accurate, and stable detection and counting of nectarines by artificial intelligence in complex natural environments.

articleTitle: Supersonic wind tunnel total pressure control based on dynamic matrix control
abstract: Improving the accuracy of total pressure control is an important research direction for the control of air flow fields in supersonic wind tunnels. Predictive control is based on the prediction of the future time control deviation to optimize the control rate, and has the ability to achieve high precision control of total pressure. Therefore, in this paper, taken the transient supersonic wind tunnel as the object, the dynamic matrix control in the predictive control method is used to achieve high-precision control of total pressure. To solve the problem that the step response model is inaccurate due to the drop of air source, the model compensation method is used to modify the measured step response curve. The dynamic matrix control algorithm with the modified model is applied in the wind tunnel simulation system to improve the total pressure control accuracy of the wind tunnel. This paper lay a theoretical foundation for the application of predictive control method in a supersonic wind tunnel test site.

articleTitle: Generalized PI Observer Design for Higher-order Descriptor Linear Systems
abstract: Based on the solutions of a class of higher-order Sylvester matrix equations, a parametric method for the proportional-integral (PI) observer design problem of higher-order descriptor linear systems is proposed. The parametric expressions for the gain matrices and the left eigenvector matrix of the kind of observer are given. The original system coefficient matrices are utilized and manipulations are involved only in high-dimensional matrices. A numerical case demonstrates the effect of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Sticking of Fuel Metering Valve in Aero-Engine Based on 1D CNNs
abstract: In aero-engine, the opening of the fuel metering valve determines the amount of fuel supplied. During engine operation, the movement of the fuel metering valve will be stuck, failing to supply fuel as expected because of the existence of unfiltered impurities or fuel viscosity. This fault is the sticking of the fuel metering valve (SFMV). In this paper, a method based on one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (1D CNNs) is proposed to diagnose SFMV, this method can diagnose the SFMV of different levels under multiple operating conditions of engine. It directly processes the original fault data, integrates feature extraction and classification, thus saving calculation costs and speeding up detection. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Strategy Implementation and Key Algorithm of NoGo Program in Computer Games
abstract: For NoGo, an efficient, feasible, easy to understand and use placement feasibility judgment algorithm is designed in the paper. It analyzes the three elements of NoGo, designs the corresponding physical structure, introduces a game strategy used in actual combat, and analyzes in detail the stacking algorithm of the position of adjacent pieces of the same color, the calculation algorithm of Qi and the judgment algorithm of landing feasibility, so as to finally realize these key algorithms in the computer game program of NoGo. The experimental results show that the key algorithm meets the requirements of chess rules, and they are safe and reliable, and the operation speed is fast.

articleTitle: The UAVs formation Tracking Control with Obstacle Avoidance and Distributed Prescribed Performance
abstract: This paper investigates a distributed robust tracking control under obstacle avoidance constraints and unknown external disturbance for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) formation. First, a formation cooperative control model with UAV system under top view is established. Second, to solve the internal obstacle avoidance, a distributed prescribed performance function is presented to design the restricted movement regions to guarantee the trajectory of each system moving within a prescribed region. Through constructing the state auxiliary variables of the adjacent information of the UAVs formation under the prescribed performance function and directed topology, a distributed robust tracking control scheme is studied to perform formation tracking with unknown external disturbance and obstacle avoidance. Finally, simulations illustrate the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Discrete Sliding Mode Control Based High-precision Flux tracking of Reluctance Actuator
abstract: In linear reluctance actuator, the rate-dependent hysteresis nonlinearity is an essential characteristic, and it pose great challenge for its application in the high precision positioning. In this paper, the rate-dependent hysteresis of the linear reluctance motor is described by Hammerstein structure. In order to achieve the high-precision flux tracking, a new control method, composed by sliding mode control and inverse model compensation, is applied. In the proposed control strategy, an inverse model compensator is used to eliminate the hysteretic nonlinear part of the system, and transforming the system into a linear system with an inverse bias. Further, a sliding mode controller is designed to handle linear dynamics, unmodeled dynamics and disturbances in the system. Finally, the simulation of a protype of linear reluctance actuator is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy. From the simulation results, we can conclude that the Hammerstein structure can effectively characterize the rate-dependent hysteresis nonlinearity of the reluctance actuator, and the proposed control method can achieve outstanding performance.

articleTitle: Comparison of CNN and CNN-LSTM Algorithms based on Earthquake Magnitude Estimation
abstract: After the earthquake, the rapid determination and estimation of earthquake magnitude is one of the most important tasks of the earthquake early warning system. In the model construction of magnitude determination, it is necessary to comprehensively consider the seismograph response time, the error of arrival time selection, and the inaccurate velocity model, which will lead to the incompleteness of the current earthquake catalog and the insufficient accuracy of magnitude determination. In this paper, based on the STanford EArthquake Dataset (STEAD), convolution neural network (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) are mainly used for fast estimation. This paper compares the timeliness and accuracy of the two algorithms for magnitude assessment. By comparing the characteristics of absolute error standard deviation and mean value, it provides a new idea for the improvement of subsequent magnitude determination methods to better enhance the disaster reduction effect of earthquake early warning.

articleTitle: Flight Safety Risk Analysis Method During TakeOffPhase *
abstract: In this paper, a flight safety risk analysis method is present aiming at both the tail strike and slow rotation hazards. A fuzzy comprehensive model is present to perform the safety risk assessment for takeoff phases. The basis of the model are the extracted characteristics and key flight parameters that generated by flight data from QAR. Then practical flight data are collected to show the validity of hazard analysis process. The experimental results show that the proposed scheme is effective for takeoff phase analysis.

articleTitle: An Interval Multi-objective Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm with Niching Technology for Multimodal Problems
abstract: This paper proposes an interval multi-objective niching particle swarm optimization (IMNPSO) algorithm for solving interval multimodal multi-objective optimization problems (IMMOPs). Firstly, in order to locate and maintain multiple optimal solutions, an interval niching PSO (INPSO) algorithm using a ring topology is introduced, and a dual archive mechanism is used to store personal and neighborhood best positions of all particles. Then, a fast non-dominated sorting algorithm based on interval analysis and the interval special crowding distance (ISCD) calculation method are presented, which are combined to form the sorting mechanism of interval particles in IMNPSO. Finally, several multi-objective test functions are selected, and the results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Adaptive identification control method for aircraft dynamic parameters under passive excitation
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of the flight model, an adaptive identification control method for aircraft dynamic parameters under passive excitation is proposed in this paper. Based on the classical recursive least square method with forgetting factor, the validity criterion of the identification results is designed. When the identification results meet the criterion, the online identification results are maintained to ensure the identification accuracy of recursive least square method and obtain the high-precision flight model in real time. Finally, the method is verified by simulation based on an aircraft, and compared with the traditional identification method, which shows that the method has high accuracy when applied to dynamic parameter identification, and verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Fault Detection for Electro Hydraulic Position Servo System Based on Kernel Regression Interval Model
abstract: Considering that the problems of traditional fault detection methods used for electro-hydraulic position servo system in which is incapable of obtaining adaptive threshold and improving the generalization performance of model structure, a fault detection method based on kernel regression interval model is proposed in this paper. The method make full use of the measurable input-output data to construct interval model, where those data is capable of reflecting the uncertainties of electro-hydraulic position servo system in the absence of failure and accuracy and structure complexity of the constructed interval model can be trade-off. Then, interval model is used to judge whether the actual output of the electro hydraulic position servo system exceeds the interval output to realize fault detection. Because this method considers the dynamic threshold based on interval for fault detection, it can eliminate the false alarm of fixed threshold and is capable of improving the adaptability in detecting fault. Finally, The experimental examples are investigated to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed fault detection methodwhich can be applied for the real-time fault detection of the electro-hydraulic position servo system.

articleTitle: Bio-inspired cooperative control for robotic joint actuated via sequential recruitment of multiple pneumatic artificial muscles
abstract: Pneumatic artificial muscles (PAMs) are expected to play an important role in endowing the advanced robot with the compliant manipulation. Though, PAMs can produce hundreds or even thousands of newtons of output force, their contraction length is limited. This limits the radius of the pulley of the robot joint in the classic PAMs antagonistic actuator system, which results in the limitation of the output torque of the robot joint. In this article, we propose a cooperative sequential recruitment driving plan and control algorithm for a robotic joint multistagely actuated by multiple PAMs. Physical experiments are presented to validate the advantages of the proposed robot joint design scheme as well as the cooperative control algorithm: It can not only generate a much larger driving torque for the joint, but also realize smooth cooperative transition among the multiple antagonistic PAM pairs, consequently it can achieve the human-like motion on a robotic joint. Therefore, we suggest that both the proposed robot joint design scheme and the cooperative control algorithm can be widely applied to the PAMs actuated robotic system for better human-robot cooperation.

articleTitle: Convex quadratic bilevel programming problem based on the redesigned BAS algorithm and application to supply chain
abstract: In this paper, convex quadratic bilevel programming problem is studied based on the redesigned beetle antennae search algorithm and applied to the supply chain. Beforhand, the beetle antennae search algorithm is introduced and the convex quadratic bilevel programming problem is proposed. Subsequntly, in order to solve the convex quadratic bilevel programming problem, a redesigned beetle antennae search algorithm is designed. Then, an example is given to show the effectiveness of the redesigned beetle antennae search algorithm. Finally, our method is applied to a supply chain model and the effectiveness of our method is shown as the simulation results.

articleTitle: Total pressure control of supersonic wind tunnel based on model feedforward and PID feedback
abstract: The control accuracy of total pressure is one of the important indexes to evaluate the performance of supersonic wind tunnel test. In order to upgrade the quality of wind tunnel tests, this paper investigates the improvement of total pressure control accuracy in a supersonic wind tunnel. Aiming at the problem of insufficient control accuracy of currented used PID control algorithm, a control strategy based on the combination of feedforward compensation of air source pressure and PID feedback control algorithm is proposed. This method establishes the model of the opening of the main pressure regulating valve and the air source pressure. The disturbance caused by the drop of air source pressure is eliminated through this model; The disturbance caused by modeling error and unknown disturbance is eliminated by PID feedback controller. Through the engineering application of this control strategy in the wind tunnel, the control accuracy of the total pressure is improved to meet the new test index standard.

articleTitle: KPCARST: a method of weakening conflict evidence based on kernel principal component analysis and relatively similar transformation
abstract: How to deal with conflict evidence is an essential issue in Dempster-Shafer evidence theory (DST). In the Dempster combination rule, a high anomaly can produce counterintuitive phenomena, so scholars have proposed many effective methods to weaken the anomaly. This paper proposes a novel anomaly evidence detection framework based on kernel principal components analysis and relative similarity transformation (KPCARST) to address this issue further. The new method can weaken anomalies’ influence on the evidence fusion results and achieve more effective results than existing methods. A numerical example verifies the effectiveness of the new method.

articleTitle: Security based Resilient Distributed Energy Management Against DoS and FDI Coordinated Attacks
abstract: Denial-of-service (DoS) and false data injection (FDI) attacks pose significant threats to cyber-physical systems. This fact is also true for energy management in smart grids. In this paper, a resilient security energy management strategy is designed to address the synergistic attacks of DoS and FDI that occur in smart grids. The resilient policy references ACKnowledgement (ACK) to identify DoS attacks, sets up trusted nodes to filter anomalous nodes, and finally designs an anti-attack strategy to mitigate the impact of the attacks. Simulation results show that the proposed distributed algorithm can effectively filter out anomalous information and ensure the convergence capability of energy management against malicious data attacks by adversarial agents.

articleTitle: Improved tentacle-based method based on approximate analysis for entry flight
abstract: Aiming at the no-fly zone constraint in the process of aircraft gliding reentry, this paper presents an improved strategy for tentacle-based detection. The turning radius and reference pitch angle of the aircraft can be obtained by approximate analytical solution and then the waypoint can be obtained according to geometric relationship. Next tentacle-based method is used to correct the trajectory to meet the flight requirements. By approximate analytical solution programming, the number of tentacles required can be reduced, and the influence of integration process on the calculation efficiency can be reduced, thus the calculation time can be shortened effectively. After the no-fly zone is bypassed, height planning is performed to meet the terminal height constraints. The simulation results show that this method can effectively avoid the no-fly zone and satisfy various constraints of gliding reentry process, and The calculation time is shortened to 22.24%.

articleTitle: Research on aircraft target assignment decision based on improved Monte Carlo method
abstract: Modern warfare is developing towards systematic warfare. The cooperation of multiple aircraft can improve the overall combat capability, and the optimal attack effect can be obtained by optimizing the cooperative target assignment scheme. Cooperative target assignment can also be called weapon target assignment problem. To solve the problem of long search time and low search efficiency, an improved Monte Carlo Tree search algorithm is proposed. First of all, a dynamic cooperative target assignment algorithm is designed according to the optimized cooperative target assignment type, and each aircraft performs dynamic target assignment as the number of targets changes. Then aiming at the problem that the search time of Monte Carlo tree search algorithm is too long, the pruning algorithm is added to improve the search process of Monte Carlo, and the MCTS_prun algorithm with a shorter search time is designed. Finally, the original Monte Carlo tree search method and MCTS_prun algorithm in different confrontation scenarios are compared. It is verified that using the MCTS_prun algorithm to make target assignment decisions can save target assignment time while ensuring the optimal overall damage effect, and improve the search efficiency of MCTS algorithm.

articleTitle: A study on the rapid identification method of root nodules based on improved Yolox
abstract: In order to improve the recognition accuracy and efficiency of soybean root nodules, a fast recognition method of soybean root nodules based on improved Yolox is proposed in this paper. Firstly, according to the dense distribution of soybean nodule targets in the image and the small proportion of each nodule in the image, the image fine-grained segmentation method is used to highlight soybean root nodule, then the network structure is improved by introducing the attention mechanism to the original Yolox network, and the network parameter input is reduced by FREE-ANCHOR. In order to further verify the recognition effect of soybean root nodule images, this paper makes an experimental comparative analysis of the original Yolox network structure and the improved network structure based on Pytorch deep learning. The results show that the soybean root nodule recognition accuracy of the improved network structure is relatively higher and can effectively improve the recognition accuracy of each image

articleTitle: Improved Lagrange Air-conditioning Load Forecasting Algorithm Based on Uncertainty Measurement
abstract: Uncertainty exists in every corner and field of air-conditioning control process, which affects accurately predict the load of the air-conditioning systems. This paper proposed a Lagrange optimization algorithm based on uncertainty measurement. The concept of uncertainty measurement was based on maximum entropy theory, and the idea of uncertainty measurement is introduced into the load objective optimization function. Experimental results show that the accuracy of the improved Langrange optimization algorithm is improved by 41.2% compared with the traditional Langrange optimization algorithm, and the root means the square error is obviously reduced. This improved Langrange optimization algorithm makes the predicted cooling capacity more accurate than traditional one.

articleTitle: Control of connected vehicles with multi-type communication topology and delay
abstract: This paper designs a vehicle platoon tracking control method to overcome the effect of various type of intervehicle communication typology and different inter-vehicle communication delays. First, a linear distributed controller is contributed by considering different communication delays between vehicles based on the third-order dynamics model of vehicles. Second, the platoon delay system is decomposed into a form of mutually coupled interconnected multi-subsystem via spectral decomposed technology. Then, by using the Lyapunov-Krasovskii stability theory, the upper bound of the communication delay of a single vehicle is obtained, and then the upper bound of the delay of the platoon system is derived. Furthermore, the frequency domain analysis method is used to analyze the distance error transfer function of the platoon, and the conditions that ensure the string stability of the platoon are obtained. Finally, the effectiveness of the control algorithm is verified by MATLAB/simulink simulation software.

articleTitle: Transient Response and Stability Improvement of Buck Converter by Using Digital Predictive V2C Peak Control
abstract: V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> control is widely used in Buck converter due to its good transient response. However, its control performance is highly dependent on the value of the equivalent series resistance of the output capacitor, which may even lead to system instability. To overcome this issue, a digital predictive V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>C peak control algorithm is proposed. First, the system structure of buck converter based on digital predictive V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>C control is introduced. The control object of the inner loop is the weighted value of inductor current and output voltage instead of only output voltage. Then, according to the geometric characteristics of inductor current and output voltage ripples, the predictive V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>C peak control algorithm is proposed. It can eliminate the inner loop feedback voltage disturbance within two switching cycles and effectively avoid subharmonic oscillation. Furthermore, the small-signal model analysis of Buck converter with the proposed algorithm is carried out to derive the open-loop transfer function, which guides the optimal design of the outer loop controller. Finally, simulation results prove the proposed algorithm has improved transient response and stability than V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> control.

articleTitle: Sliding mode control to stabilization of a fractional ODE and a fractional PDE cascaded systems subject to disturbances
abstract: In this paper, we consider the input-to-state stabilization of a fractional-order ODE-PDE cascaded system with disturbances in all channels. By applying the backstepping method and sliding mode control approach, we design a discontinuous feedback control to reject the matched disturbances. The existence of the generalized solution of the closed-loop system is proved by Galerkin’s method. The input-to-state Mittag-Leffler stability of closed-loop system is proven by Lyapunov method. Finally, we present some numerical simulations to show the correctness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Furnace status recognition based on involution network and decoupling learning
abstract: With the continuous development of smart manufacturing, the use of machine learning methods in industrial processes has increased, and as a key part of hot rolling production, the heating furnace needs to be accurately judged in terms of its operating status. The sample characteristics of the different statuses of the furnace are too similar and the data are unbalanced, which makes it difficult to distinguish. In this paper, we propose a model that uses both involution and convolution, so that the model is able to improve the accuracy of recognition and the parameters can be reduced significantly. Moreover, we use decoupling learning to use different strategies in the data sampling and classifier parts to improve the model's ability to identify long-tail data. The experimental results show that the status-of-the-art performance can be achieved on the furnace dataset using the base network modified by involution under the decoupling learning strategy.

articleTitle: Micro Expression Recognition based on Graph Convolutional Networks with LSTM
abstract: To improve the recognition rate of micro-expression algorithms, we propose an algorithm based on Graph Convolutional Networks with Long Short-Term Memory(LSTM). The algorithm makes full use of the spatial-temporal features of micro-expressions, first extracting the spatial features of micro-expressions through graph convolutional networks, then using LSTM to extract its temporal parts. Extensive experiments on MMEW and SAMM datasets demonstrate that our proposed method improves the accuracy of micro-expression recognition.

articleTitle: Time-varying group formation tracking control for multi-AUV with Markovian switching topologies and multiple leaders
abstract: This paper proposes a study on the time-varying group formation tracking control problem of multi-AUV system with Markovian switching topologies and multiple leaders. The Markovian switching communication topology of the AUV is established by graph theory and Markovian process theory, and a novel distributed leader-following group formation control protocol with time-varying delay for multi-AUV systems is developed based on the model of the AUV,it is proved that the follower AUVs’ states can achieve consensus of leader’s state by using the proposed controller. Finally, simulation experiment is provided to verify the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Prescribed-time Event-triggered Consensus of Second-order Leader-following Multi-agent Systems
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the control of prescribed-time leader-following consensus tracking in a second-order multi-agent system. For each agent, an event-triggered control protocol is proposed in the absence of continuous communication between neighbors. The allowed range of parameters is designed based on matrix inequalities and the Lyapunov stability theorem to ensure the prescribed time consensus. Moreover, a detailed discussion is provided to demonstrate that ZENO behavior is avoided. Finally, a simulation example is provided to testify the effectiveness of the designed protocol.

articleTitle: Global Adaptive Control for Feedforward Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Output Coefficient
abstract: This paper investigates the global state regulation problem of a class of uncertain feedforward nonlinear systems with unknown output coefficient (or called measurement sensitivity). Particularly, the nonlinear terms of the considered systems are supposed to be bounded by unknown positive constant multiplied by states, moreover the unknown measurement sensitivity is allowed to be non-differentiable and varies in a positive interval. To deal with relaxed measurement sensitivity, the extended Lyapunov matrix inequalities are quoted. Then based on the dual domination idea, the problem of global state regulation is solved by adaptive output feedback. The proposed controllers guarantees that the states of controlled systems asymptotically converge to zero. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the usefulness of the output-feedback controllers in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of a curled hyper-redundant manipulator and the motion control with tip-following algorithm
abstract: In order to meet the operational needs in some narrow environments, the hyper-redundant snake-shaped manipulator has received extensive attention and has been widely studied due to its compact shape and multiple degrees of freedom. At present, the research of hyper-redundant manipulator mainly focuses on the straight push platform. Considering the limitation of working space, this paper designed a hyper-redundant manipulator delivered by a curled turntable. According to the characteristics of turntable delivery, a tip-following algorithm based on curve fitting and a tip-following strategy based on terminal posture record are proposed. Finally, with the algorithm applied to the physical robot we made, we successfully realized the tip-following motion control of the hyper-redundant manipulator.

articleTitle: Differential evolution with Grey Wolf Adapting Optimizer for multi-pid Control Optimizer
abstract: In this paper, a novel grey wolf optimizer with differential evolution to optimize the parameters of doubly-fed induction generator with maximum power point tracking strategy. The proposed grey wolf optimizer with differential evolution consists of improved grey wolf optimizer and adaptive differential evolution. The grey wolves of the improved grey wolf optimizer contain four types wolves, i.e., alpha wolves, beta wolves, delta wolves, and omega wolves. The improved grey wolf optimizer can wider and deeper achieve the optimization task. The adaptive differential evolution is applied to cooperate with improved grey wolf optimizer to solve global optimization over continuous spaces. The simulation results on DFIG with MPPT strategies in three real-world cases verify that the GOE accelerated by DFCM can effectively obtain global optimization. The simulation results on doubly-fed induction generator with maximum power point tracking strategy in three cases studies verify that the proposed grey wolf optimizer with differential evolution can effectively obtain the global optimization solution for non-smooth problems.

Author Keywords: grey wolf optimizer with differential evolution

articleTitle: Design of Ready-To-Drink Kettle based on PID and Genetic Algorithm
abstract: In this paper, a control scheme based on PID and genetic algorithm is proposed for ready-to-drink intelligent water dispensers, while adding more control modules to achieve heating before cooling measures for some lower water temperatures to solve the problem that most intelligent water dispensers in the current market are overly dependent on incoming water quality, while ensuring the speed and accuracy requirements. In the work of this paper, the algorithm as a whole is stable and reliable by distributing and controlling each module inside the water dispenser to work in a coordinated manner, while adopting the design idea of high cohesion and low coupling. For multiple scenarios of user use, intelligent pattern recognition functions and corresponding control schemes are also designed to ensure that the overall indexes do not fluctuate greatly, and finally, algorithm correction measures are taken to compensate for the differences between different devices so that they can really be applied in the production and use of water dispensers. In terms of performance indicators, the solution can be completed in about half a minute in the household voltage range as well as water temperature range heating to 45-97°C requirements, and has good equipment consistency.

articleTitle: Improved genetic algorithm for an e-platform low-carbon vehicle routing problem with traffic congestion and delivery commitment
abstract: Although the vehicle routing problem (VRP) has been extensively investigated, traffic congestion and delivery commitment have not been explicitly studied under the low-carbon environment. This article examines a low-carbon VRP with traffic congestion and delivery commitment for an e-platform. Integrating the traffic congestion constraint with the objective function of customer compensation cost and carbon emissions cost, a revised VRP model is established and an improved genetic algorithm is developed for solution method. Numerical examples are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the revised model and method. Sensitivity analysis is also conducted to draw managerial implications for the e-platform.

articleTitle: Robust Control of 3D Coullet System Based on Sliding Mode
abstract: The robust control of three-dimensional Coullet system is researched. Firstly, the complex dynamic behaviors of the system are verified by drawing the time domain waveform diagram, chaotic attractors diagram, Lyapunov exponents diagram and bifurcation diagram. Secondly, the sliding mode control method, high frequency robust control method and High gain robust control method based on sliding mode are used to design the controllers to control the system. Finally, the effectiveness of the controllers is verified by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Design of Tan Sheep intelligent feeding navigation system based on RTK and deep learning
abstract: An driverless feeding cart is designed for the problems of high cost and low efficiency of manual feeding in Ningxia Tan sheep breeding process. In this paper, GPS-BeiDou RTK navigation technology is used. The feeding cart mobile station receives GPS satellite signals and reference station signals, and locates the current position of the feeding cart with centimeter-level accuracy through real-time carrier phase difference technology, while combining deep learning YOLO vision algorithm to assist RTK navigation. By training a large number of relevant obstacle datasets from Tan sheep farms, the vision system achieves the effect of being able to recognize specific categories of obstacles, thus achieving obstacle avoidance of the feed cart. In addition, if the RTK navigates the feed cart in an area where the GPS positioning signal is unstable, deep learning can be used to navigate through visual label localization combined with multi-sensor fusion techniques.

articleTitle: An improved sparrow search algorithm based on fractional calculus and its application to the PID control
abstract: This paper studies the sparrow search algorithm based on fractional calculus. When the original algorithm cannot find the optimal value accurately, this method can effectively balance the search speed and improve the convergence accuracy. To this end, we consider the unique heritability of fractional calculus, which can retain the previous memory features well, with strong correlation and balance. The algorithm convergence of the speed can be considerably improved with the addition of adaptive weight. The performance test on 6 benchmark functions with different characteristics shows that the optimization ability of the new algorithm is obviously better than that of the original algorithm. The improved sparrow search algorithm is then used to adjust the parameters of the fractional order PID controller. Improved simulation results illustrate that this method can effectively obtain the optimal controller parameters.

articleTitle: Mastering Bidding in Fight the Landlord with Perfect Information Distillation
abstract: The popular card game DouDizhu in China has become a research hotspot of computer game because of its unique characteristics. For the bidding stage of DouDizhu game, accurate evaluation of hand cards strength is the key to mastering accurate bidding. In this paper, we propose a method combining convolutional neural network and reinforcement learning, and add the feature of winning distance. Supervised learning is used to train agent, and perfect information distillation technology is used to optimize bidding methods.The experimental results show that the bidding network model proposed in this paper is effective, and by comparing with some open source DouDizhu AI, it proves that the bidding method in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: Open-set Image Classification Via Subdomain Alignment
abstract: Domain adaptation has achieved great success in using labeled source domain samples to identify unlabeled target domain samples. Here, we aimed to solve the open-set domain adaptation, which is different from the closed-set domain adaptation in that it contains categories in target domain that do not appear in source domain. To solve this problem, this paper proposes open-set domain adaptation model based on subdomain alignment, which uses variable weights for discriminative training of unknown samples in target domain. Aiming at the distribution differences between domains, the model aligns the distributions of the category subspaces of source and target domains, enhancing the distribution similarity within the subspaces of the same category. Through experiments on different domain adaptation datasets, the results show that the model proposed in this paper effectively improves the accuracy of open-set domain adaptation classification.

articleTitle: MF-TimeSformer: A Multi-Frequency Feature Enhancement Network for Predicting Unsteady Flow Field of Plane Cascades
abstract: The prediction of unsteady flow field in plane cascades is of great significance for analysing compressor instability. A rapid and accurate prediction method of unsteady flow field is a challenge due to the high-dimensional and nonlinear dynamic behavior. In view of the two shortcomings of the existing spatio-temporal predictive network models, namely, the inability to capture the multi-frequency characteristics and massive consumption of computing resources, we designed the MF-TimeSformer model, which uses wavelet transform and ConvLSTM to capture the spatio-temporal multi-frequency characteristics in the flow field, and uses the filled prediction tokens to achieve the prediction function. We design a number of experiments to verify the effectiveness and generalization of the model and explore the role of filled prediction tokens and multi-frequency feature fusion in the prediction of spatio-temporal sequence. The results show that MF-TimeSformer has a good effect on the prediction of the unsteady flow field of plane cascades, and the structure of each part of the model plays an extremely important role.

Author Keywords: unsteady flow field of plane cascades

articleTitle: Optimization of Data chain entry strategy based on suppression of interference
abstract: In order to improve the network performance and anti-jamming ability of the data link and enhance the testing level of the equipment, it is necessary to simulate the network access process under the special magnetic field environment. In the background of this application, this paper takes link-16 data link system as the research object, analyzes the process of coarse synchronization and fine synchronization in network synchronization, and puts forward a new network integration strategy and optimizes the analysis. On the other hand, the abstract transformation of engineering problem is carried out by using the three-point quadratic interpolation algorithm, the mathematical formula of the time of entry is designed, and the simulation experiment is carried out. Through the mechanism analysis and simulation experiment, the rationality and feasibility of the strategy optimization is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Fusion Based on CNN-LSTM Network for Motion Imagery EEG Classification
abstract: By analyzing the time-domain and spatial domain features of EEG signals, a feature fusion based on CNN-LSTM parallel network for EEG classification is proposed, which realizes feature fusion for different networks and different layers. The parallel network consists of two layers of CNN and one layer of LSTM to decode EEG signals. The CNN network is used to extract the spatial features of signals from different channels, and the LSTM network is used to extract the temporal features of signals, so as to extract the features of original EEG signals from the spatial and temporal domains. At the same time, the features of the intermediate layer of the flatten layer storage network are also used. The classification results can be obtained by fusing at the full connection layer. Public Dataset BCI competition IV-2a are used to verify the proposed algorithm. The Kappa value and average correct rate obtained in Datasets 2a data set reach 0.824 and 87.6% respectively, which are 9.5% and 3.7% higher than those of EEGNet algorithm and higher than the existing base-line classification algorithms.
